title: Concord: A Video Relational Algebra for Cross-Modal Query Optimization
summary: Semantic video queries let users embed natural language prompts and use multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to interpret the video. Such queries are increasingly popular for querying video data. However, their expressiveness comes at a steep cost: an MLLM may process hours of media to return only seconds of relevant output, making naive execution slow, expensive, and inaccurate. We propose Concord, a system for expressing and optimizing semantic video queries. We makes three contributions. First, we introduce Video Relational Algebra (VRA), a nested algebra over videos, transcripts, frames, and object tracks that captures common semantic video operations. Second, we derive a set of approximate optimizations that rewrite VRA queries to reduce MLLM usage while improving result quality. For narrated video, Concord either processes transcripts instead of video or uses them to identify video clips for MLLM processing. For cross-camera queries without narration, detection and tracking replace a whole-video MLLM join with a track-level relational join. Third, we evaluate Concord on real-world videos. Across 4.59 hours of soccer broadcasts and 3.92 hours of lectures, transcript-to-video queries send only 5.32% and 2.47% of source-video duration to the MLLM and reduce MLLM cost by up to 87%. In two five-second highway clips with 18 manually adjudicated cross-camera vehicles, a Detect-Track-Join query improves F1 from .364 to .813 while making no MLLM calls. See our project at this https URL .

AI.tldr: Concord提出了一种用于跨模态语义视频查询处理的Video Relational Algebra（VRA），通过模态替换、跨模态时间候选下推和Detect–Track–Join三种查询重写优化，显著降低MLLM调用成本并提升查询质量。
AI.motivation: 语义视频查询使用户能通过自然语言提示和MLLM解释视频内容，但朴素执行将整个视频发送至MLLM，导致高延迟、高成本和精度下降。需要一种声明式代数来表达和优化这类查询，以在减少MLLM用量的同时提升结果质量。
AI.method: 1. 定义Video Relational Algebra（VRA）：在视频、转录文本、帧、目标轨迹之上的嵌套关系代数，扩展关系算子（Map/Filter/Reduce/Join/Unnest）和媒体算子（View/Transcribe/Detect/Track）。2. 提出三种近似重写优化：O1模态替换（用转录文本替换视频进行语义推理）、O2跨模态时间候选下推（利用转录文本定位候选时间窗口，将视频推理范围缩小）、O3语义Reduce-Unnest到Detect–Track–Join分解（将整体视频语义关联分解为检测、跟踪、轨迹级连接）。
AI.result: 在4.59小时足球比赛和3.92小时讲座视频上，transcript-to-video查询仅将5.32%和2.47%的视频时长发送至MLLM，MLLM成本降低高达87%，F1显著提升。在两段5秒高速公路视频的18辆手动标注跨摄像头车辆上，Detect–Track–Join查询将F1从.364提升至.813，且完全不调用MLLM。
AI.conclusion: Concord通过VRA将模态、时间范围和处理粒度作为显式查询选项，在保持输出模式的同时，通过三种近似重写显著降低了语义视频查询的MLLM成本并提升了查询质量，为未来语义视频处理系统提供了新的方向。

title: sheval: An RDF data shapes evaluation tool and test-suite for recursive shapes
comment: This is related with paper arXiv:2604.20946
summary: Two different languages have been developed to validate RDF data based on the concept of a shape: ShEx and SHACL. In each language it is possible to define a shape that refers to itself, which is called a recursive shape. While in the case of ShEx, the semantics of recursive shapes is well defined and is part of the specification, in the case of SHACL, the semantics of recursive shapes is left to the implementation of the different SHACL engines. Consequently, the different SHACL engines show different behaviours when confronted with recursive shapes. In this paper we present sheval: an evaluation framework consisting of a tool and a test suite that can be used to compare the behaviour of different shapes technologies when confronted with recursive definitions. The tool has been used to evaluate and understand the differences in the implementation of recursive shapes in ShEx and SHACL. It provides a framework for testing and comparing the behaviour of different shape engines, helping to identify inconsistencies and potential issues, and providing a basis for further research and development in the field of shape-based validation of RDF data.

AI.tldr: sheval 是一个针对 RDF 形状语言的评估框架，包含一个命令行工具和一个测试套件，专门用于比较 ShEx 和 SHACL 不同引擎在处理递归形状时的行为差异。核心贡献在于揭示 SHACL 规范未定义递归语义导致各引擎实现不一致的问题。
AI.motivation: ShEx 明确规定了基于 GFP（最大不动点）的递归语义，但 SHACL 将递归形状的语义留给各引擎实现，导致不同 SHACL 引擎（如 TopQuadrant、Apache Jena、pySHACL、SHACL-S、rudof）在面对递归定义时表现出不一致甚至冲突的行为（如崩溃、超时、无限循环），严重影响互操作性和用户预期。
AI.method: 1. 定义了一个简单形状语言（Simple Shape Language）作为抽象语法，包含布尔连接词、量词和形状引用，并引入形状赋值（shape assignment）形式化语义。2. 区分四种递归语义：LFP（最小不动点）、GFP（最大不动点）、勇敢支持模型语义（bSMS）、谨慎支持模型语义（cSMS）。3. sheval 架构：基于 YAML 清单（manifest.yaml）描述测试套件，通过统一的 Runner 接口隔离各引擎差异（pySHACL、Jena、rudof、ShEx-S、TopQuadrant 等），由 Orchestrator 调度，commands 模块负责子进程执行和超时控制，error_classification 映射失败模式（Timeout、Crashed、CyclesDetected、NonStratified），semantics 模块对比引擎结果与预期语义，输出 YAML/CSV/LaTeX 报告。4. 设计了多类测试用例：基本分离测试（bsep1-4）、可达性分离测试（reach1-2、safe1-2）、功能性测试（nstrat、cons、fresh）、对偶性测试（dual1-2）、非递归控制测试（norec1-2）。
AI.result: 1. 非递归控制测试中所有引擎表现一致。2. 三个 ShEx 引擎（rudof、ShEx-S、Jena ShEx）与 GFP 语义一致。3. SHACL 生态高度不一致：pySHACL 多返回 conforms=true；SHACL-TQ 表现为独特语义，不符合任何标准语义；rudof SHACL 通过标志位可切换 GFP/LFP/bSMS/cSMS；Jena SHACL 遵循 GFP；SHACL-S 存在超时错误。4. 非分层（non-stratified）用例中，仅 rudof 和 ShEx-S 正确拒绝，其他引擎尝试验证。5. cons2 测试中 Jena ShEx 的不对称行为可能源于软件缺陷。6. 对偶性测试中 ShEx 验证器符合 GFP，SHACL 验证器也倾向于 GFP。
AI.conclusion: sheval 作为一个开源（GitHub: cogsl/sheval）、支持 Docker 的可复现评估框架，有效识别了现有形状引擎在递归处理上的不一致性，为 SHACL 1.2 规范的递归语义标准化提供了实证基础。测试结果并未证明任何引擎严格遵循特定语义，但揭示了实现差异。未来的工作包括扩展更多引擎实现、增加测试套件，并探索表达力、互操作性、性能和可解释性等维度。

title: Compiling Linear Datalog to SQL for Program Analysis
summary: Datalog is a declarative query language that has proven highly effective for expressing static program analyses. Although Datalog has deep roots in database theory, most recent advances have largely emerged from the programming languages and compiler communities, with systems such as Soufflé. In contrast, modern relational engines have made significant progress in optimizing recursive SQL. This paper revisits the connection between Datalog and relational databases, advocating recursive SQL as a backend for Datalog evaluation. We present a compilation framework that translates Datalog programs, particularly those in the Linear Datalog fragment, into equivalent recursive SQL queries. To bridge the gap between Datalog and SQL, the compiler routes every program through an intermediate language called Midlog. The compiler additionally recovers functional dependencies from the program and exposes them as schema keys, unlocking the engine's standard query optimizations. This approach enables existing database engines to execute a broad class of program analyses, outperforming the Soufflé engine by up to an order of magnitude on the Umbra backend. Umbra achieves a geometric-mean speedup of 5.46$\times$ at 8 threads, whereas DuckDB is competitive with Soufflé single-threaded and is slower at 8 threads (geometric-mean speedup of 0.68$\times$). Furthermore, the generated SQL is portable; it runs on seven database systems without any engine modification. Our results highlight what the relational engines require to fully support Datalog for large-scale program analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DLSQL编译器，将线性Datalog片段编译为标准递归SQL（SQL:1999的WITH RECURSIVE），借助现代关系数据库引擎（Umbra、DuckDB、Hyper等）执行程序分析工作负载。通过设计中间语言Midlog解决Datalog与SQL在互递归和作用域规则上的不匹配，并引入函数依赖发现（主键提示）和多头部优化。在Umbra后端上，相较Soufflé在8线程下获得最高14.3倍、几何平均5.46倍的加速，生成的SQL可移植至七个数据库系统。
AI.motivation: 程序分析社区使用Datalog（如Soufflé）将其编译为C++，绕过了现代关系数据库引擎在递归查询优化方面的进展；而数据库引擎虽支持递归CTE，却缺乏Datalog的抽象与表达能力。两条研究线路长期分离。本文旨在重新连接Datalog与关系数据库，让RDBMS作为高效的Datalog后端运行，无需定制运行时。
AI.method: 1) 识别Linear Datalog片段：每条递归规则体中至多包含一个SCC内的谓词，与SQL:1999线性递归约束对齐；2) 设计Midlog中间语言，吸收Datalog与SQL的两大结构性差异：互递归支持缺失和作用域规则不同；3) 四阶段编译流水线：Datalog规范化→Datalog到Midlog→Midlog规范化（含tagged归约消除MultiDef）→Midlog到SQL；4) 两项优化：(a) 多头部优化——当SCC存在自然primary时，反馈顶点条件成立则避免引入tagged合成关系；(b) 函数依赖发现——从输入数据中恢复主键，作为CREATE TABLE的PRIMARY KEY暴露给引擎；5) 局部IDB内联与CTE-shadowing改写以适配更严格的SQL引擎。
AI.result: 在五个程序分析基准（varpointsto、cgcha、escape、csda、borrow）上与Soufflé、FlowLog、Logica、RecStep对比：DLSQL+Umbra 8线程几何平均加速5.46×，单基准最高14.31×（borrow）；DLSQL+DuckDB单线程0.96×、8线程0.68×；DLSQL+Hyper几何平均1.02×。同后端对比中，DLSQL+DuckDB相对Logica快17–20×。多头部优化在合成SCC M=6时消除1.76–3.51×的tagged开销；FD优化在Umbra上对escape和csda带来1.49–1.68×加速。SQL在七个数据库系统（DuckDB、Umbra、Hyper、PostgreSQL、MariaDB、MySQL、SQLite）上可移植运行。在chains基准的扩展性测试中，运行时间随边数近线性增长，Datalog原生系统在轮数增加时表现更平稳。
AI.conclusion: DLSQL证明了以现代RDBMS作为Datalog后端的可行性：Linear Datalog片段足以表达调用图构造、指向分析、逃逸分析、数据流分析与借用检查等核心程序分析；Midlog成功弥合Datalog与SQL之间的结构差异；将递归作为单一WITH RECURSIVE块交给引擎优化，相比外部驱动循环（如Logica/RecStep）具有数量级优势。局限性在于线性限制与表达性边界（域敏感指向分析等需非线性规则）；未来工作包括放宽线性约束、SCC级线性检测作为Datalog引擎后端选择策略，以及格值聚合。

title: X-DigCheck: Co-Evolving Application Profiles and Knowledge Graphs, Demonstrated on the RTI Documentation of Rupe Magna
summary: We demonstrate X-DigCheck, a domain-independent environment for building and maintaining application profiles as they co-evolve with the data they describe. Profiles developed against a fixed ontology quickly drift from the schema they were meant to capture. X-DigCheck treats profile construction as a continuous ontology-data co-evolution loop: data are lifted into RDF against the profile, checked through competency questions and SHACL, and the resulting reports jointly drive revisions of the ontology, mappings, constraints, and graph. The loop is agnostic to the domain and to the pipeline that produces the graph. We validate and demonstrate the tool in the cultural heritage domain, on the construction of RupeMagna-RTI, the first Reflectance Transformation Imaging (RTI) specialisation of the Cultural Heritage Survey ODP (CHS-ODP), aligned with CIDOC-CRM/CRMdig, ArCo, CHAD-KG, and Getty AAT, with semRTI as the lifting pipeline of this use case. The demonstration lets visitors run one full turn of the loop -on the shipped Rupe Magna (Grosio, Italy) RTI survey, or on a profile and graph of their own -executing the competency-question and SHACL checks live and reading the bidirectional coverage report that flags modelling gaps and stale assumptions. The result is a portable co-evolution environment for profile engineering, together with a reusable RTI application profile produced through it. A screencast of the demonstration is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: X-DigCheck 是一个领域无关的应用配置文件与知识图谱协同演化环境，通过能力问题、SHACL 验证和双向覆盖率分析，将配置文件、映射、约束和数据的迭代修订整合为闭环流程，并以文化遗产领域 Rupe Magna 的反射变换成像（RTI）文档为验证用例。
AI.motivation: 针对固定本体构建的应用配置文件会随数据生产而逐渐偏离其建模假设，而现有工具（如 Astrea、OWL2SHACL、ABSTAT、OOPS!）多为单层自动化，难以同时追踪配置文件、shapes 与实例数据三者间的持续对齐。本文将配置文件工程视为本体—数据的协同演化过程。
AI.method: 构建基于 Docker + Apache Jena Fuseki 的 X-DigCheck 环境，提供三种验证机制：(1) 配置文件与知识图谱的覆盖率/对齐分析；(2) 基于 eXtreme Design 的能力问题（编译为 SPARQL 回归测试）执行；(3) SHACL 验证（OWL2SHACL 自动派生 shapes + 手工编写的约束 shapes）。生成侧使用 semRTI（基于 SPARQL Anything 的 Python 管道）将 RTI 采集输出与人工注释提升为 RDF/Turtle，再经 OWL 推理物化蕴含。支持浏览器门户与 CLI 两种模式。
AI.result: 通过在 Rupe Magna（意大利 Grosio）RTI 调查项目中运行 10 轮协同演化循环，构建了 RupeMagna-RTI 配置文件（CHS-ODP 的首个 RTI 专门化），包含六个模块化本体、28 条可执行能力问题（93% 通过）和 42 条 shapes（76% 通过），产出约 148k 三元组的 FAIR 兼容知识图谱，并将所有能力问题、shapes、配置文件和数据集以 CC BY 4.0 开放发布。
AI.conclusion: 本体工程与知识图谱构建应被视为协同演化过程；X-DigCheck 验证了将能力问题、SHACL 与覆盖率分析贯穿配置文件开发周期的可行性与领域无关性。未来工作包括将映射文件纳入报告、跟踪 Git 修订历史以及结合 LLM 代理辅助映射修复、shapes 生成与查询维护，同时保留可执行验证准则。

title: Preserving contextual information in cultural heritage metadata through multidimensional knowledge graphs
summary: Using Knowledge Graphs (KGs) to describe Cultural Heritage Objects (CHOs) supports semantic richness and interoperability. However, standard KGs fail to capture the context-dependent validity of statements. This limitation is critical for cultural heritage metadata, which must often accommodate evolving or conflicting viewpoints, such as colonial versus post-colonial perspectives or shifting scientific consensus. While current knowledge representation methods address basic contextualization via provenance, qualifiers or reification, they lack a unified framework to simultaneously model and query data across multiple social, cultural, and political dimensions. To bridge this gap, we introduce the conceptual foundations of Multi-dimensional Knowledge Graphs (MKGs) and discuss how they preserve complex, multi-layered contexts in CHO metadata.

AI.tldr: 本文针对文化遗产元数据中标准知识图谱无法表达陈述上下文依赖有效性的问题，提出多维知识图谱（Multidimensional Knowledge Graphs, MKGs）的概念基础。MKGs 基于 RDF 1.2 的引用三元组机制（quoted triples）以及 SHACL 1.2 验证机制，将每条陈述与显式的"维度—约束"对关联，使同一对象可同时承载多重、相互冲突的诠释（如殖民/后殖民视角、政治立场差异、时期不同的科学共识），并支持基于视角的上下文感知查询。论文给出了形式化模型（含 Only / Excludes / AnyOf / AllOf / Exactly 五种集合论算子）、RDF 1.2 + SHACL 1.2 表示方案，并以"君士坦丁赠礼"的作者归属和"Derry/Londonderry"地名争议为案例进行说明。
AI.motivation: 文化遗产对象（CHOs）常承载多版本、相互冲突的诠释（殖民与后殖民视角、政治立场、不断演化的科学共识等）。RDF 的模型论语义未规定三元组断言的成立条件，导致标准知识图谱只能默认陈述普遍为真，无法表达陈述在不同社会、文化、政治、时空视角下的条件性有效。已有方案（RDF 再化、命名图、PROV-O、Wikidata 限定符、RDF-star、NdFluents、Annotated RDF 等）要么局限于单一维度，要么依赖应用层隐式语义，缺乏一个统一、可与现行 RDF/Linked Data 基础设施兼容的框架来同时建模与查询多维上下文。
AI.method: 1. 提出 MKG 形式定义：知识图谱 G=(E,R,T) 中的每条三元组 t 与一个上下文集合 C_t 关联；每个上下文为 (d, κ)，其中 d 为维度（如时间、空间、政治视角、机构权威、语言社群、科学范式），κ 为该维度值空间上的有效性约束。约束通过受限集合代数表达：Only(S)、Excludes(S)、AnyOf(S)、AllOf(S)、Exactly(S) 五种算子。2. 表示层：基于 RDF 1.2 quoted triples（遵循 Daquino 等的 "Expressing Without Asserting" 原则）将上下文资源连接到三元组的 reifier；维度与约束均建模为带类型的 RDF 资源。3. 验证层：利用 SHACL 1.2 的 reifierShape / reificationRequired / Node Expressions 将"维度—约束"对的良构性声明为可强制执行的图形状。4. 查询层：通过 SPARQL 1.2 对引用三元组进行模式匹配以实现上下文感知检索；提出 SHACL 1.2 Profiling 用于声明不同社区的"视角画像"（如 Unionist/Nationalist 在 Derry/Londonderry 上的分歧）。5. 案例：以 Shakespeare 作者归属（Stratfordian / anti-Stratfordian）说明五种算子语义；以"君士坦丁赠礼"在 750–1440 年间被天主教会认定为君士坦丁一世所著、1440 年后被现代史学否定的多维建模与查询为例进行端到端展示。
AI.result: 论文给出了 MKG 的概念基础与形式化定义、RDF 1.2 + SHACL 1.2 的具体表示与验证模式，并通过 Shakespeare 作者归属和"君士坦丁赠礼"两个文化遗产案例展示了：(a) 多重、相互冲突的诠释可同时保留而无须挑选权威陈述；(b) 基于维度的上下文感知 SPARQL 1.2 查询可直接表达；(c) 不同社区/机构可通过 Profile 注册竞争性的维度值集，使分歧显式、可引用、可独立版本化。同时也明确了代价与开放问题：图规模与查询性能开销、共存上下文的合取/析取语义需在查询引擎中显式约定（否则会被规范化合并）、维度值空间的本体工程可能引发新的争议、维度选择与 Profile 注册属于治理问题，模型本身不预设权威。
AI.conclusion: MKG 提供了一个统一、可扩展、与 RDF 1.2 及 Linked Data 基础设施完全兼容的框架，用于在任意认识论维度上建模和查询陈述的条件性有效。它并非取代现有语义网技术，而是补足其上下文建模缺口。下一步工作计划：以 INFINITY 项目为依托，将 MKG 作为公开 Note 提交至 RDF/Linked Data 社区讨论，推动在欧洲 ECCCH 与 DS4CH 中采用；设计将 FAIR 与 CARE 原则在陈述级别机器可检查化的"数据 Profile"，并参考 Local Contexts 的 Traditional Knowledge Labels 引入社区授权元数据；同时强调真实社区协商不可被模式设计所替代。

title: TrajectoryDB: A New Database for Agent Trajectories
summary: AI agents generate rich execution trajectories that capture their interactions with large language models, tools, and external environments. These trajectories are increasingly valuable for downstream tasks such as memory extraction, model fine-tuning, runtime optimization, and security and cost monitoring. Yet trajectory data today is fragmented across files, databases, and observability systems, with no persistent data management system designed around its unique structure and access patterns. We argue that trajectories should be treated as a distinct data type. A trajectory combines hierarchical execution structure, large volumes of text whose analysis often requires semantic reasoning, and rich dependencies and lineage among events, intermediate states, and derived artifacts. These properties introduce new requirements throughout the data lifecycle. Ingestion must reconstruct and preserve execution structure and lineage; storage must efficiently organize large but highly redundant contexts while maintaining relationships among records; and query processing must jointly reason over structure, temporal order, semantics, and lineage. We therefore envision TrajectoryDB, a trajectory-native data management system that co-designs ingestion, storage, and query processing to efficiently manage and analyze agent execution trajectories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TrajectoryDB,一种面向AI智能体执行轨迹的专用数据管理系统,主张将智能体轨迹视为一种独立的数据类型,并围绕其层次化结构、大体量语义化文本、高冗余性及复杂的数据血缘关系,协同设计数据导入、存储与查询处理流程。
AI.motivation: 当前AI智能体产生的执行轨迹数据分散存储于文件、数据库和可观测性系统中,缺乏专门的管理系统。现有方案(JSONL文件、向量数据库、日志存储)只能处理轨迹生命周期的部分环节,无法同时兼顾结构、语义、顺序与血缘的联合推理需求,且随着智能体在生产环境中的大规模部署(如OpenRouter上智能体代币消耗5个月内增长14倍),这一问题日益突出。
AI.method: 论文采用愿景论文(vision paper)形式,首先将智能体轨迹抽象为一种新的数据类型,定义其session-turn-step-message的层次化结构,梳理六类典型应用场景(记忆提取、微调、根因分析、安全监控、运行时监控、资源调度)。然后从三个维度提出系统需求:(1)结构感知检索(层次结构检索与序列检索);(2)将LLM作为UDF进行语义算子与关系算子的组合及增量评估;(3)血缘查询(上下文重建与语义判定血缘保留)。最后将需求映射为七项技术挑战(C1-C7),并讨论现有数据库系统在结构重建、存储布局、查询优化方面的不足及可能的设计方向。
AI.result: 论文未给出具体的实验结果,作为愿景论文,其核心贡献是:(1)首次系统性地论证智能体轨迹应作为一种独立数据类型进行管理;(2)通过生产环境的实证数据(如80%的会话存在上下文突变、连续请求间隔可达数小时至数天、数据导出采用Zstandard可获得20倍压缩率等)支撑设计假设;(3)提出TrajectoryDB的整体愿景,涵盖数据模型、查询算子与跨层优化机会,为后续研究指明方向。
AI.conclusion: 智能体轨迹作为层次化结构、大文本量、高冗余、富含血缘的复合数据,无法被现有数据库系统有效管理。TrajectoryDB通过协同设计摄入、存储与查询处理,将原始轨迹及其衍生数据视为一等公民,支持结构、顺序、语义与血缘的联合推理,目标是使智能体轨迹的存储、查询与优化如同文档数据在文档数据库、时序数据在时序数据库中一样自然。

title: Generalized DBLog: A Verified Contract for Interleaving Database Rows with a Change Log
comment: 38 pages, 6 figures. Formal verification artifacts: this https URL
summary: Change-data capture (CDC) feeds downstream systems like caches, search indexes, and data warehouses from a database's log of committed row changes. When bootstrapping, adding a table, or repairing downstream data, a pipeline must also copy existing rows. Merging this copy with the active log introduces the copy-to-log handoff problem. Changes must not fall through a gap, and older copied state must not overwrite a newer logged update or resurrect a deleted row. DBLog, developed at Netflix, addressed this problem by reading tables in chunks and interleaving those reads with the live log. Watermarks identify the changes that overlap each read, and the log wins when a copied row is stale. Debezium and Flink CDC have since adapted this design. Earlier work proved that applying the original algorithm's copied rows and logged changes in their emitted order reconstructs the source's rows, including the effect of every logged insert, update, and delete processed. Generalized DBLog asks when the same result holds for variants of that design. We state the conditions the source and capture implementation must satisfy. Once copying and reconciliation are complete, we prove that the result holds across all selected tables and key ranges even when their rows were read at different times. A single database snapshot is not required for the copy. Further logged changes advance the reconstructed state one event at a time. We establish these guarantees for classic watermarking, Debezium's signal-table and read-only modes, Flink CDC's parallel chunks, reads and dumps tied to exact log positions, and engine-consistent backups whose log position lies within known bounds. The complete theory is machine-checked in Isabelle/HOL, its core independently verified in Lean 4, and the protocols are also examined by bounded model checking in TLA+.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"广义DBLog"框架，将Netflix的DBLog变更数据捕获（CDC）算法推广为一个通用正确性契约。该契约为复制数据库行与变更日志合并提供了严格的形式化保证条件，涵盖了Debezium和Flink CDC等多种主流CDC实现，并经过Isabelle/HOL、Lean 4和TLA+三种工具的机器化验证。
AI.motivation: CDC管道在引导初始化、添加表或修复下游数据时需要合并现有行的副本与活跃的变更日志，这一"copy-to-log handoff"问题面临两大核心挑战：一是变更不能从间隙中漏掉，二是较旧的复制状态不能覆盖较新的日志更新或复活已删除的行。尽管Netflix的DBLog、Debezium和Flink CDC采用了类似的设计，但缺乏一个统一的形式化框架来证明各种变体实现何时能正确重构源数据库状态。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 方法包含以下核心要素：(1) 建立源端契约——包括S-LOG（提交有序键控日志）、S-IMG（图像充分性）、S-OBS（可观测性）三项源承诺，以及O1-O5五项计划义务（覆盖性、括号局部有效性、域完整性、声明的外部断言、表示一致性）；(2) 证明核心"切割定理"——证明在任何满足契约的捕获计划中，规范回放等于在边界位置上的源行事件回放状态；(3) 形式化三种合并语义——窗口丢弃（window-discard）、范围合并（range-merge）和点拼接（point-splice），并证明其与规范规则的等价性；(4) 实例化五种生产协议——经典水印DBLog、Debezium信号表模式、Debezium MySQL/MariaDB只读模式、Flink CDC并行分块，以及坐标绑定读取/原生转储；(5) 三重机器化验证——Isabelle/HOL（约5000行）、Lean 4（核心定理独立证明）和TLA+（五个有界模型检查）。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) 切割定理（Theorem 2）证明任何满足契约的计划的规范回放在边界位置上与源行事件回放状态逐键相等，无需全局数据库快照，不同键可在不同时刻被读取；(2) 三个推论——共享见证推论（Corollary 8/Shared witness）允许在更早的协调点启动轨迹，延续推论（Corollary 9/Continuation）保证扩展观测下状态仍精确，组合推论（Corollary 10/Mixing）支持异构引导（如转储与分块读取混合）；(3) 证明了O2条件（每键存在性括号局部有效性）严格弱于单一读取点的要求（Proposition 4），展示了每个键可反映括号内不同坐标的实例；(4) 证明了"扣留门"（withholding gate）的必要性（Proposition 13）——窗口收窄变体会错误地让预括号事件复活已删除行；(5) 退化定理（Theorem 6/Degradation）将可信点拼接推广为不确定性区间括号的T2级契约；(6) 四种保证级别T0-T3的语义层级加T4认证覆盖层。所有核心结果均通过Isabelle/HOL完整机器化验证（约5000行），中心切割定理在Lean 4中独立重新证明，五个TLA+模型通过有界模型检查验证了操作协议。
AI.conclusion: 广义DBLog为扩展和组合CDC捕获方法提供了统一基础。中心论断是：一旦复制和协调完成，复制的行和记录的变更必须正确地重构所选数据。该框架明确区分了源数据库必须提供什么保证与连接器实现必须建立什么行为，使得任何新的副本获取方式都可以依据同一契约进行评估。该契约的机器化开发为这些扩展和组合提供了可重用的形式化证明，交付、崩溃恢复和下游应用则需要单独验证。对于连接器维护者和作者而言，该契约为检查现有捕获路径、改变其操作方式或在保持对复制行、更新和删除的正确处理的同时增加新方法提供了具体依据。组合结果还允许一个捕获对不同的表或键范围使用不同的方法（如一张表使用原生转储，另一张表使用分块读取），只要它们都建立在同一源历史之上且分配的键不重叠，就能保持正确性保证。

title: UnespDataLens-RM: A Reference Model for Analytical Data Engineering with Governance, Quality, Provenance, and Reproducibility
summary: The growing reliance on data in analytical processes and evidence-based decision-making has reinforced the importance of Data Engineering in building pipelines capable of integrating, transforming, validating, and delivering data from heterogeneous sources. However, the reliability of analytical assets depends not only on data processing capabilities but also on mechanisms for governance, quality assurance, provenance, traceability, versioning, and reproducibility throughout their lifecycle. These responsibilities are commonly addressed by different models, frameworks, and operational practices, resulting in methodological fragmentation across the analytical data lifecycle. To address this gap, this article proposes UnespDataLens-RM, a technology-independent reference model that integrates technical-operational processes and cross-cutting capabilities within a unified structure for Analytical Data Engineering. The model aims to support the specification, organization, and evolution of analytical pipelines by incorporating governance, quality, provenance, traceability, and reproducibility from the design stage. Developed following the Design Science Research approach, UnespDataLens-RM comprises eight technical-operational modules, eight cross-cutting modules, complementary dimensions, and a formalized set of artifacts, metrics, and validation criteria. The resulting specification offers a conceptual and methodological framework for future instantiations and empirical evaluations of analytical pipelines designed to be more governable, documented, traceable, auditable, and reproducible.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种与技术无关的参考模型 UnespDataLens-RM，旨在统一整合分析数据工程中的技术运营流程与跨领域能力（如治理、质量、溯源、可追溯性和可复现性），以解决当前分析数据全生命周期中方法论碎片化的问题。
AI.motivation: 随着数据驱动决策的普及，数据工程在构建处理异构数据管道方面愈发重要。然而，分析资产的可靠性不仅依赖于数据处理能力，还依赖于治理、质量保证、溯源、可追溯性、版本控制和可复现性等机制。这些责任通常由不同的模型、框架和运营实践分别承担，导致分析数据生命周期内出现方法论碎片化，缺乏统一指导。
AI.method: 采用设计科学研究（Design Science Research, DSR）方法论开发 UnespDataLens-RM。该模型包含八个技术运营模块、八个跨领域模块、补充维度，以及一套形式化的工件、指标和验证标准，将技术操作流程与跨领域能力集成在统一结构中，从设计阶段就纳入治理、质量、溯源、可追溯性和可复现性考量。
AI.result: 产出了一个全面且与技术无关的参考模型规范。该模型提供了概念性和方法论性的框架，包含具体的模块划分、补充维度，以及用于评估和实施的正式化工件、指标和验证标准，支持未来分析管道的实例化和经验评估。
AI.conclusion: UnespDataLens-RM 为构建更具可治理性、有据可查、可追溯、可审计和可复现的分析管道提供了统一的概念与方法论基础，可作为未来相关管道实例化及实证评估的指导框架。

title: SmartANN: Object Causal Modeling Boosts Approximate Nearest Neighbor Diagnosis and Auto-Design
summary: Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN) algorithms achieve high efficiency through interdependent phases across index construction and query execution. This coupling allows upstream performance loss to propagate downstream, affecting execution behavior and measurable outputs. Existing component-level analyses mainly compare isolated design choices, while end-to-end benchmarks report aggregate metrics; neither traces loss propagation across dependent phases, hindering root-cause attribution and automated redesign. We present SmartANN, a framework based on the object causal model (OCM) for ANN bottleneck attribution and automated redesign. SmartANN represents an ANN workflow as eight ordered, replaceable objects and diagnoses them with a sequential diagnose-and-replace loop. At each iteration, it identifies the first object deviating from expected behavior or output as a bottleneck. Because an upstream bottleneck can obscure downstream ones, SmartANN replaces it with a test oracle when available, or with an implementation producing a better outcome, then continues downstream diagnosis. From the diagnosed bottlenecks and failure causes, SmartANN composes compatible actions from a pluggable action library to generate an optimized end-to-end ANN design. We instantiate SmartANN for IVF-PQ and HNSW, covering partition-and-quantization and graph-based ANN families. Experiments on eight real-world datasets show that SmartANN improves Recall by 0.24--74.20%, and increases QPS by 28.8--256.5% at comparable Recall, with low diagnosis and auto-design overhead. The code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: SmartANN是一个基于对象因果模型(OCM)的框架，用于近似最近邻(ANN)算法的瓶颈归因和自动重设计。它将ANN工作流建模为八个有序、可替换的对象，通过顺序诊断-替换循环识别瓶颈，再从可插拔动作库中组合兼容动作生成端到端优化方案。在八个真实数据集上，Recall提升0.24–74.20%，QPS提升28.8–256.5%，且调优开销低于VDTuner 2.9–42.0倍。
AI.motivation: 现有ANN性能分析方法存在两个层面的不足：(1)组件级分析孤立比较设计选择，无法追踪性能损失在依赖阶段间的传播；(2)端到端基准仅报告聚合指标，无法定位根因。这阻碍了自动重设计，因为用户面对特定数据集和工作负载的瓶颈时，只能进行昂贵的试错循环来选择优化方法。
AI.method: SmartANN包含三大组件：(1)对象因果模型——将ANN索引构建与查询执行分解为8个有序对象O1–O8（表征、单元实例化、候选关系生成、关系物化、访问定位、候选探索、候选打分、结果决策），每个对象定义机制Mi、诊断指标Pi和动作Ai；(2)顺序诊断-替换循环——按执行顺序遍历对象，将首个偏离期望的对象标记为瓶颈，用测试预言(test oracle)或更强的替换实现替换其输出后再继续下游诊断，从而抑制上游性能损失传播；(3)归因引导的自动重设计——从42个动作的可插拔库中，经对象覆盖过滤与失败原因匹配两阶段筛选，组合兼容动作并通过选择集评估选出最优设计。框架基于Evaluatology理论，实例化于IVF-PQ和HNSW两大代表性ANN族。
AI.result: 在八个真实数据集(SIFT、Deep、GIST、Tiny5M、GloVe、MSong、Yandex-200、Wikipedia)上，IVF-PQ和HNSW均验证有效：Recall提升0.24–74.20个百分点，或在可比Recall下QPS提升28.8–256.5%。相比随机基线，瓶颈归因能更可靠地选择匹配失败原因的动作；相比VDTuner黑盒调优器，SmartANN在HNSW上端到端延迟加速2.9–36.4倍（聚合约5.0倍），IVF-PQ上加速4.7–42.0倍（聚合约11.6倍）。消融实验验证了替换算子在揭示被掩盖的下游瓶颈中的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: SmartANN通过对象级因果建模和顺序替换诊断，实现了对ANN算法性能瓶颈的细粒度归因与自动化重设计。其核心贡献在于：(1)首次将Evaluatology的对象因果模型应用于ANN诊断；(2)通过替换引导的归因解决损失传播掩盖下游瓶颈的难题；(3)将42个异构优化动作模块化，通过对象接口实现可插拔组合。实验证明该方法在Recall–QPS权衡上优于黑盒调优方法，同时开销显著降低。

title: WiDiff: Extracting Changes from Wikidata's Edit History
summary: Knowledge graphs have become a key resource for integrating heterogeneous data and powering downstream tasks such as question answering, entity linking, and semantic search. They are built and maintained incrementally, either (i) fully automated, e.g., YAGO, (ii) semiautomatically with community oversight, e.g., DBpedia, or (iii) manually through collaborative editing, e.g., Wikidata. Understanding the evolution of knowledge graphs is essential as changes may reflect real-world updates, error corrections, or noise introduced by vandalism, all of which affect the reliability of downstream applications. Among openly available knowledge graphs, Wikidata is the most challenging case to study evolution, with over 120 million entities edited by humans and bots and an edit history spanning more than a decade. Although Wikidata exposes change data in various formats (e.g., periodic dumps and real-time event streams), none support analytical queries over the complete edit history. Therefore, we present WiDiff, a tool that extracts changes from Wikidata's complete edit history and provides a unified interface for large-scale analytical queries over it.

AI.tldr: WiDiff是一个开源工具，用于从Wikidata完整的编辑历史中提取变更数据，并提供统一接口支持大规模分析查询。它将Wikidata的XML转储解析为变更日志并加载到关系数据库中，以支持对知识图谱演化的研究。
AI.motivation: Wikidata作为最大的开放协作知识图谱，拥有超过1.2亿实体和超过20亿次编辑，但现有的数据格式（定期转储和实时事件流）均不支持对完整编辑历史进行大规模分析查询。已有方案（如Wikidated 1.0、Tanon等人的SPARQL端点）要么未公开发布，要么已下线，要么功能受限，无法满足对KG演化研究的需求。
AI.method: WiDiff基于扩展的"变更立方体"（change cube）模型，将每次变更表示为⟨timestamp, entity_id, property, new_value⟩元组，并进一步扩展以捕获语句值、rank、限定符值和引用值四个粒度的变更。架构包括：1)文件解析器（使用lxml流式读取bz2压缩的XML文件）；2)变更提取器（通过比较JSON快照对连续修订之间的标签、描述、语句值、rank、限定符和引用进行比较，使用SHA-1哈希识别限定符和引用的值）；3)使用PostgreSQL作为存储层（经基准测试优于QLever RDF存储2.25倍）。处理流程支持多文件并行和多worker进程配置。
AI.result: 使用2025年6月的Wikidata转储（共2125个XML文件，2.2TB压缩数据），WiDiff在HPC集群上用6.1天（实际计算时间，非并行）处理了1.207亿实体、23.12亿次修订，提取的数据压缩后为4.43TB。应用过滤器（排除学术文章、天体对象和少于10次值变更的实体）后，得到3100万实体、7.43亿次修订、7.095亿次值变更、6.163亿次rank变更、18.77亿次引用变更、1.825亿次限定符变更。研究发现了以下洞察：(1)修订计数会严重低估编辑活动（如《野性的呼唤》有14302次修订但仅涉及61个属性）；(2)35%的rank弃用缺乏P2241限定符说明原因，最常见原因是标识符过时（19%）和已撤回的标识符值（15%）；(3)71%的rank弃用由注册用户执行，58%的rank提升由机器人执行；(4)仅0.07%和0.14%的rank提升和弃用被回退，表明这些变更具有较高可信度。
AI.conclusion: WiDiff填补了Wikidata完整编辑历史大规模分析工具的空白，提供了开源工具和公开数据集。未来工作将涵盖多语言标签/描述变更提取、别名和站点链接变更捕获，以及扩展到DBpedia等其他知识图谱。

title: SQLMorph: Query Mutation and Fine-Grained Metrics for Text-to-SQL Evaluation
summary: Text-to-SQL systems translate natural language queries into executable SQL, democratizing access to structured data. Despite recent advances driven by large language models (LLMs), evaluation remains a major bottleneck: public benchmarks fail to capture the complexity of enterprise schema, while building private evaluation sets is costly and nondeterministic, making evaluation results difficult to reproduce. To address this issue, we present SQLMorph, a framework for Text-to-SQL evaluation via query mutation. SQLMorph introduces two techniques to automatically generate and expand evaluation sets: Join Query Expansion (JQE), which systematically increases structural complexity through valid join additions, and Textual Query Augmentation (TQA), which generates controlled natural language perturbations to assess robustness to linguistic variation. JQE and TQA create targeted choke points to challenge specific system components. When applied to state-of-the-art systems, JQE increases query coverage and reveals accuracy degradation as the number of joins grows. Meanwhile, TQA shows that linguistic brittleness induced by heavy abbreviation can reduce accuracy by up to 17%. Beyond evaluation sets, SQLMorph introduces a family of execution-level metrics that address the limitations of current binary measures, such as Execution Accuracy. We define Execution Precision (EXP) and Execution Recall (EXR) to quantify the fraction of correct and recovered results, respectively, and combine them via F1 for unified scoring. Our experiments show that these relaxed metrics enable fine-grained analysis of over- and under-prediction, revealing differences across systems that binary metrics obscure. Together, SQLMorph's query mutation and fine-grained metrics support debugging and better align Text-to-SQL evaluation practices with real-world deployments.

AI.tldr: SQLMorph是一个Text-to-SQL评估框架，通过查询变异（Join Query Expansion和Textual Query Augmentation）自动生成和扩展评估集，并引入细粒度的执行级指标（Execution Precision和Execution Recall）以替代二元的Execution Accuracy，从而更精确地诊断Text-to-SQL系统的过预测和欠预测错误。
AI.motivation: 当前Text-to-SQL评估面临两大瓶颈：一是公共基准（如BIRD）无法反映企业级schema的复杂性和命名习惯，私有评估集构建成本高且难以复现；二是主流指标Execution Accuracy（EX）是二值的，无法区分部分正确性，无法区分过预测（多出列/行）和欠预测（遗漏行/列），也难以诊断系统具体失败原因。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) Join Query Expansion (JQE)——基于schema图，通过算法化方式增加有效join条件（经语义冗余检查和多样性剪枝）来系统性提升查询结构复杂度，仅在最后用LLM重写NL；(2) Textual Query Augmentation (TQA)——使用SNAILS分类器将schema标识符从自然命名（N1）降级为缩写形式（N3），并通过SQL ALTER和正则替换保持可执行性，专门压力测试检索阶段；(3) 细粒度指标——定义Execution Precision (EXP, 预测正确单元格比例)、Execution Recall (EXR, 真实单元格被恢复比例)及其F1，支持Exact-Column/Semantic-Column/No-Column三种列匹配、Exact-Cell/Partial-Cell两种行匹配，以及Penalize Extras/Ignore Extras两种额外列处理策略。
AI.result: 在BIRD dev集上的实验：JQE生成6873条查询，58条具有非同构的join图结构，平均节点度从0.82升至1.35，环状结构从0.27%升至4.31%（扩展集达51.72%），CHESS/DIN-SQL在扩展查询上EX分别从63.33%/60%降至44.83%/32.76%，准确率随join数增加单调下降（≥4个join时EX≤15%）；TQA在L/L设置下导致DIN-SQL EX下降23.9%，SCSL检索器的Schema Linking Recall从15%降至9.8%；单错误突变实验证明EXP/EXR能精确反映14种不同SQL错误的过/欠预测模式，而EX在所有错误下均为0；在三个系统共同失败的410个查询上，CHESS的EXR约19.66%，MAC-SQL仅16.07%，F1指标揭示了EX无法体现的部分正确性差异。
AI.conclusion: SQLMorph将Text-to-SQL评估从静态基准测试转变为可控的压力测试流程。JQE和TQA作为目标性choke points分别针对SQL生成的结构复杂性和检索阶段的语言鲁棒性，而EXP/EXR指标提供了诊断级的执行正确性度量。三者结合构成了一个可复现的、面向企业部署需求的评估框架，代码已开源。

title: Factorized and Vectorized Execution: Optimizing Analytical and Semantic Queries over Relations
summary: Many-to-many joins are central to analytical and semantic workloads such as fraud detection, network analysis, and recommendation, where insights arise from relationships between entities. These workloads often suffer from an explosion of intermediate results, sometimes orders of magnitude larger than the inputs. Factorized representations address this problem by exploiting conditional independence among attributes to encode intermediates more compactly. In some cases, they can reduce the output size asymptotically below the worst-case output size. However, adopting factorization in modern vectorized query processors remains challenging: factorized representations are hierarchical, whereas vectorized execution is built around flat, block-oriented processing. Prior approaches either rely on full materialization or support only restricted factorization layouts, sacrificing much of the benefits of both factorization and vectorization. We present FFX, a novel engine for Fast Factorized eXecution. FFX is the first pipelined engine to support arbitrary factorization schemes while preserving full vectorization. The engine introduces packed factorized vectors and operators that maintain cache-friendly, contiguous layouts. Beyond analytics, FFX also co-optimizes semantic operators by serializing factorized intermediates into compact prompts for large language models (LLMs), substantially reducing token usage and inference cost while maintaining output quality and, in some cases, improving it. Together, these contributions enable efficient execution of join-heavy analytical queries, including queries augmented with semantic operators.

AI.tldr: FFX 是首个在完全向量化的流水线中支持任意因子化方案的查询引擎，通过引入打包因子化向量（packed factorized vectors）级联更新算子和因子化语义处理，在 join-heavy 分析查询和 LLM 语义算子上同时获得因子化的紧凑性和向量化的高效执行。
AI.motivation: 多对多 join 在分析型工作负载（欺诈检测、图分析、推荐）和新兴的"分析+语义"工作负载中产生巨大的中间结果（有时比输入大几个数量级），导致传统 RDBMS 和图数据库以及 LLM 推理成本急剧上升。因子化表示虽能利用条件独立性将中间结果压缩到 AGM 界以下，但与向量化执行（块式、扁平布局）存在架构不兼容：现有方法要么全物化牺牲流水线，要么仅支持受限的因子化布局，损失两者的优势。
AI.method: 三大核心机制：(1) **打包因子化向量**：在固定大小的连续内存块内，通过 offset 数组显式编码 f-tree 的父子分组关系，保持 fully packed，避免 LBP 的稀疏向量问题，支持任意分支的 f-tree。(2) **级联更新算子 (Cascade Update)**：从 f-tree 派生的依赖树上传播切片收缩和选择器失效，包含 AGG（向上聚合）和 SCATTER（向下散播）两类传播，并采用延迟插入、算子融合和 delta-driven AGG 三种优化。(3) **因子化语义处理**：通过结构感知的窗口迭代器直接对因子化向量做提示词序列化，利用 f-tree 结构避免重复属性，并指示 LLM 执行隐含的笛卡尔积展开，输出端恢复为扁平元组。(4) 多路 join 采用"扩展-求交"交替的最坏情况最优策略。(5) 当因子化无收益时优雅回退到标准向量化执行。
AI.result: 在 Google/Epinions/Amazon 数据集上，FFX 的打包向量相对 LBP 的解包向量在 96.5% 的执行计划上更快，平均加速 2.08×，最大 9.39×；虚拟函数调用减少 78.77×，分支预测、cache miss 均显著改善。在 Amazon 九个 query 上相对 DuckDB/Kuzu 达到 10²–10⁵× 加速，尤其在星形查询（Q5）上 10⁵× 优于 Kuzu。LSQB 和 JOB benchmark 上对 DuckDB 持续更快。在 ArXiv 2-hop 引文任务上，因子化提示词将输入 token 减少 1.7×–22.54×（对比 Lotus 最高 18.83×），在较大 batch size 下退化更平缓。
AI.conclusion: 因子化与向量化是互补的设计选择；FFX 证明了二者可以在单一流水线引擎中统一，支持任意 f-tree 布局而不牺牲全打包和缓存友好性，并通过端到端传递因子化中间结果优化 join-heavy 分析查询和 LLM 增强的语义查询。

title: ProcArena: A Multi-Scenario Benchmark for LLMs on Direct and Interactive PL/SQL Development from Natural Language
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for translating natural-language (NL) requirements into PL/SQL programs, attracting increasing attention from the database community. However, existing NL-to-PL/SQL efforts primarily focus on directly generating PL/SQL from complete NL requirements. In practice, PL/SQL development involves diverse scenarios, such as from-scratch development, code modification, debugging, and optimization, and may require either direct generation or multi-turn interaction. Yet, no comprehensive benchmark evaluates multi-scenario, direct and interactive, and multi-dialect NL-to-PL/SQL development. In this paper, we present ProcArena, an execution-based benchmark covering both Direct and Interactive modes. ProcArena comprises 3,998 executable tasks over 157 databases, spanning nine development subscenarios in PostgreSQL and Oracle. We construct challenging Direct tasks through Iterative Logic Enhancement and scenario-specific adapters, and derive paired Interactive tasks through Knowledge Integration and Requirement Perturbation while preserving executable targets. We further design a controlled Solver-User Simulator protocol that allows models to clarify user intent and inspect the database environment without exposing hidden execution feedback. Evaluating seven language models, we find that the best average scores are only 62.2% and 57.8% in Direct and Interactive, respectively, demonstrating that realistic NL-to-PL/SQL development remains challenging, particularly in interactive settings.

AI.tldr: ProcArena是首个面向多场景、多方言（PostgreSQL/Oracle）的NL-to-PL/SQL基准，涵盖Direct（直接生成）和Interactive（多轮交互）两种模式，包含3,998个可执行任务。在Direct和Interactive模式下，最强模型仅达到62.2%和57.8%的执行准确率，表明实际PL/SQL开发仍具挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有NL-to-PL/SQL研究主要关注从完整需求直接生成代码，缺乏对真实开发场景（如代码修改、调试、优化）及多轮交互的综合评估。同时，缺乏跨方言（PostgreSQL与Oracle）的可执行基准。
AI.method: 提出ProcArena基准：(1) 通过迭代逻辑增强（Iterative Logic Enhancement）和场景适配器（scenario-specific adapters）构建Direct任务，覆盖9个子场景（5个Synthesis + 4个Editing）；(2) 通过知识整合（Knowledge Integration）和需求扰动（Requirement Perturbation）从Direct任务派生配对的Interactive任务；(3) 设计Solver-User Simulator协议，允许模型在不暴露隐藏执行反馈的前提下澄清用户意图、检查数据库环境。评估了7个语言模型。
AI.result: 在7个模型的评估中，Gemini-3.1 Pro表现最佳，Direct模式62.2%，Interactive模式57.8%。交互模式在Synthesis子场景降低准确率，但在Editing子场景（如A2、B3）反而提升准确率。控制流和持久状态错误是主要失败原因。GPT-5.4 Mini加速比最高（1.51x），但工作量为0.18。DeepSeek V4 Pro留存率最低（64.5%）。
AI.conclusion: ProcArena作为首个多场景、多方言、Direct与Interactive结合的NL-to-PL/SQL基准，揭示了当前LLM在真实PL/SQL开发中的局限性，特别是交互场景下的需求解析能力。基准、交互轨迹及构建流程均已开源发布。

title: Protocol effects on feature-based hardware-Trojan detection across Trust-Hub families
summary: Trust-Hub reuses host circuits: several files differ mainly in the inserted Trojan. When gates from sibling variants enter both training and test folds, a detector can benefit from host logic it has already seen. We measure that effect instead of proposing another classifier. The corpus contains 49,124 gates from 16 netlists grouped into five host families. We left the parser, 36 gate features, class weighting, model settings, threshold, and family-level aggregation unchanged and altered one choice: the test boundary. The three settings draw test gates from the pooled corpus, withhold a complete netlist, or withhold every variant of one host. The choice matters. Random forest records F1/AP of 0.914/0.978 with pooled gates, 0.636/0.851 with one netlist held out, and 0.460/0.577 with a host family held out. XGBoost falls from 0.946/0.976 to 0.464/0.544 across the same comparison. Logistic regression loses AP, although its fixed-threshold F1 is not monotonic. Each family shows the same pooled-to-family direction. Feature removal, repeated model and simulator seeds, score normalization, parser-related exclusions, and a smaller sample change the size of the gap without reversing it. Aggregation also matters: a gate-weighted average is dominated by the larger ISCAS files, so the headline values give each host family one vote. Bootstrap and jackknife summaries keep the gap positive, but their folds reuse training families. We treat the five family rows as descriptive evidence rather than independent trials. Five host families are too few for a population claim, and the experiment says nothing about transfer to a new cell library or an industrial design. It supports a narrower conclusion: sibling benchmark variants can inflate apparent transfer. Benchmarks with several variants of one host circuit should report family-aware holdouts and all five family results beside pooled scores.

AI.tldr: 硬件木马检测结果对测试集划分高度敏感。若同一宿主电路的多个变体同时出现在训练集和测试集中，随机划分会因逻辑复用造成数据泄漏，使随机森林和XGBoost的性能被明显高估。整网表留出和整宿主家族留出均带来持续且显著的F1与AP下降，因此仅报告随机切分分数会产生过于乐观的泛化结论。
AI.motivation: 多个硬件木马基准测试由同一宿主电路的不同木马变体构成；传统随机门级切分可能让训练与测试共享高度相似的宿主逻辑，从而夸大检测器在未知设计上的迁移能力。本文不提出新分类器，而是通过系统性改变测试边界，量化这一数据泄漏或评估边界效应对结果的影响。
AI.method: 研究使用包含5个宿主家族、16个网表和49,124个门的Trust-Hub语料。保持解析器、36个门级特征、类别权重、模型超参数、决策阈值及家族级聚合规则不变，仅比较三种测试策略：1）从全部门中随机抽取测试门（pooled）；2）完整留出一个网表（netlist holdout）；3）留出某一宿主电路的全部变体（host-family holdout）。比较随机森林、XGBoost和逻辑回归，并进一步检查特征删除、多次模型与模拟器随机种子、分数归一化、解析器相关门排除及子样本等敏感性因素。最终分数按宿主家族投票，而非按门数加权。
AI.result: 随机森林的F1/AP从pooled划分的0.914/0.978，降至单网表留出的0.636/0.851，再降至宿主家族留出的0.460/0.577。XGBoost从0.946/0.976降至0.464/0.544。逻辑回归的平均精确率（AP）随留出强度显著下降，但固定阈值F1并非单调。五个宿主家族均呈相同趋势；补充敏感性分析仅改变性能差距大小，未改变方向。Bootstrap和jackknife中的训练折仍复用家族，因此所得区间不等同于真正的跨家族不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 论文支持一个较窄但重要的结论：具有同一宿主电路多个变体的基准会显著抬高表面上的迁移性能，测试边界应被视为实验结论的一部分。建议同时报告随机/池化分数、完整网表留出结果及逐宿主家族留出结果，并对存在多个变体的硬件木马基准使用family-aware holdout。五个家族不足以代表总体，也不能证明对新标准单元库或工业设计的迁移能力。

title: Open Tabular Insight Extraction: Where Do We Stand, and Where Should We Go?
summary: Democratizing access to the knowledge held in large corpora of tables such as data lakes is emerging as a central research challenge. Research in this space is advancing and broadening in scope, increasingly supplying the components to satisfy a person's insight need end-to-end. Yet these efforts remain fragmented across communities that frame the problem under their own conventions, such as table question answering, text-to-SQL, and data analysis agents, with works six times as likely to cite within the same task label as across labels. To bring these communities onto common ground, we establish a holistic framework for this pursuit, which we refer to as Open Tabular Insight Extraction (OpenTI). We formalize OpenTI from first principles around the analytical knowledge a person needs, the procedure for deriving it from a corpus of tables, and how well a result serves the person who sought it. In doing so we consolidate frameworks and terminology across information retrieval, natural language processing, machine learning, databases, and human-computer interaction, and apply this grounding in a systematic review and analysis of systems and benchmarks that work towards OpenTI. We find that current systems do not cover the end-to-end scope of OpenTI, mainly focusing on the analysis itself, and that benchmarks are largely unfit for evaluations in an open setting as inputs presuppose knowledge of tables, and validation mechanisms do not match the setup. Finally, we distill a research agenda towards OpenTI systems, evaluation, and interaction paradigms that surface the insights users need. An interactive companion to our paper is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出"开放表格洞察提取"(OpenTI)这一统一框架，旨在整合来自不同研究社区（表格问答、text-to-SQL、数据分析智能体等）的碎片化工作，将从表格语料库中提取分析知识以满足用户洞察需求定义为端到端任务。作者通过形式化定义洞察需求、实现(realization)、效用函数等核心概念，系统性综述了58个系统和42个基准测试，揭示了当前系统在检索能力、输出情境化、推理与因果分析方面的不足，并提出了未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 不同研究社区（数据库、自然语言处理、信息检索、机器学习、人机交互）各自从不同角度研究从表格中提取知识的问题，使用各自的任务标签（如表格问答、text-to-SQL、数据分析智能体），但工作之间引用率在跨标签时仅为同标签的六分之一，导致知识碎片化、进展重复，缺少统一的理论基础和词汇来比较与整合这些工作。
AI.method: 采用系统性文献综述方法：1）从18个会议/期刊（2021-2026）通过7个关键词查询识别583篇文献，经筛选得到160篇核心作品；2）通过前向/后向雪球采样扩展至58个系统和42个基准；3）从第一性原理形式化OpenTI，建立包括洞察、洞察需求、实现、效用函数的概念基础；4）按编排策略（固定、基于规划、反应式、混合）和功能能力（解释、数据检索、分析组合执行、输出合成、过程治理）对系统分类；5）按语料库、输入、验证机制三个维度分析基准；6）通过引用图分析、LLM评判等量化当前现状与局限。
AI.result: 1）当前58个系统中41个缺乏任何检索能力，主要聚焦分析而非端到端；2）输出模态主要为文本，46/58仅输出文本或代码执行结果，仅15个支持表格输出、6个支持可视化；3）基准测试中绝大多数采用精确匹配的输出级验证，对42个基准的分析显示当前基准在开放场景下基本不适用——输入预设了对表格的特权知识，且验证机制与开放设置不匹配；4）分析负载以描述性洞察（查找、聚合）为主，推理性和因果性洞察覆盖稀疏；5）跨任务标签的引用率仅为同标签的约1/6，证实社区碎片化；6）基于规划的编排策略最少（仅2个系统），反应式和混合编排成为新兴趋势。
AI.conclusion: OpenTI作为一个独立领域正在形成，其核心应围绕洞察需求而非表层答案设计系统；未来研究议程应聚焦：1）扩展到推理性和因果性洞察；2）构建质量感知的检索索引以应对异构数据湖；3）设计支持协作交互的范式以弥合潜在洞察需求与表达之间的差距；4）开发能够评估完整实现过程而非仅输出准确性的基准和验证机制；5）超越单纯语言模型，探索更适合表格二维结构与分析过程非线性的架构；6）将人与系统的协作作为系统设计的核心关切，而非边缘问题，确保OpenTI系统输出能被信赖且能服务于用户的真实洞察需求。

title: From Version Conflicts to Decision Conflicts: Selective Revalidation for Long-Running AI Agents
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Supplemental artifact available at this https URL
summary: Long-running AI agents may read state, reason, wait for tools or human approval, and perform an external action much later. The state that justified the action can change in the meantime. For example, after an agent proposes an 80 GBP refund under a limit of 100, a customer-name change affects only presentation metadata, a new limit of 90 still permits the refund, a limit of 50 invalidates it, and a refund issued by another worker must prevent a duplicate. Standard optimistic concurrency control and version checks can detect that previously read state has changed, but by themselves do not determine whether that change invalidates the pending action's justification. We call any detected version change a version conflict; when that change invalidates the action's justification, it is also a decision conflict. ATR records the explicit, executable conditions that justify a pending action and rechecks only the conditions affected by a change before releasing the external operation. It can retain the action, refresh non-decisive metadata, require replanning, or block execution; a target-side transaction or compare-and-set binds checked state to commit. Across 210,000 controlled executions over 15 mutation cases, ATR matched every developer-specified outcome with no false allows or blocks. In ten durable SQLite checkpoint/resume cells, it evaluated 0.6 conditions per change versus 6.0 for FullScan. At 4,093 recorded reads, ATR took 9.3 microseconds versus 2595.9 microseconds for FullScan. These deterministic results establish controlled feasibility, not production generality or automatic extraction of the required conditions.

AI.tldr: ATR (Affected-closure Targeted Revalidation)是一种针对长时运行AI Agent的选择性重验证机制,通过区分"版本冲突"与"决策冲突",仅重新检查受状态变更影响的可执行前提条件,避免在Agent等待审批或工具调用期间盲目丢弃已有决策。
AI.motivation: 长时运行AI Agent在读取状态到执行外部操作之间存在时间间隔,期间支撑决策的证据可能发生变化。传统的乐观并发控制(OCC)能检测到版本变化,但无法判断该变化是否真的使待执行操作的决策依据失效——例如,客户名变更(展示元数据)不应影响退款决策,而退款限额从100降至50则必须阻断。论文旨在解决"版本变化触发检查,而不是自动作废决策"这一核心问题。
AI.method:
1) **模型层**:形式化Agent事务 T=<R,D,I,E>,引入"前提条件"(typed premise)、决策图G=(V,A)、影响闭包(affected closure)、绑定集B(e)等概念;区分四种验证结果(KEEP/REFRESH/REPLAN/BLOCK),严重度排序 BLOCK>REPLAN>REFRESH>KEEP。
2) **协议层**:维护依赖图与反向索引,采用对象/字段/谓词三种粒度捕获依赖;算法1(Validate)将事件提示与权威PRE_EFFECT版本比对结合,沿依赖图遍历受影响闭包,仅对可达前提执行类型化验证;通过目标端事务或CAS将检查态绑定到提交。
3) **两个安全命题**:命题1给出"绑定前置效果安全性"条件(依赖完备性、验证器可靠性、令牌忠实性、观察绑定、目标原子执行);命题2证明反向索引可将遍历局部化至O(|A_c|+|V_c|+L)。
AI.result: 在21万次控制执行(3个业务场景×5种变更×7次重复×1万条轨迹)中,ATR在所有15种变更情形下与开发者指定的判定结果100%一致,零假允许、零假阻断;无检查(NoCheck)错误释放60%,版本中止(VersionAbort)过度重规划100%安全变更。在10个SQLite持久化checkpoint/resume单元中,ATR每次变更仅评估0.6个前提(FullScan为6.0);4093次读取规模下ATR耗时9.3μs,FullScan为2595.9μs;7000对两客户端竞态测试中无双提交或零提交;跨资源策略历史中,仅目标CAS无法阻止违反外部策略的操作(100/100错误提交),加入策略令牌绑定后100/100被正确拒绝;依赖边随机省略1%/5%/10%分别产生0.95%/5.05%/9.97%的假允许率。
AI.conclusion: ATR证明版本失配无需在"忽略变更"与"全盘丢弃推理"之间二选一:通过记录证据到效果的依赖、对影响闭包进行选择性重验证、并用检查过的目标令牌绑定提交,可在微秒级验证成本下保留无害决策、阻断无效决策。但其保证是局部的:跨资源前提需要事务或显式预留/租约机制;依赖捕获必须完备或保守过近似;前提提取与验证器可靠性仍由开发者负责。该工作确立受控可行性,不声称生产通用性,下一步是与持久化Agent框架及事务连接器集成,并基于生产轨迹评估前提提取错误。

title: What Eviction Destroys: A Restore-Counterfactual Audit of Forgetting in Agent Memory
summary: Agent memory systems must discard stored information when their history exceeds a fixed token budget. Existing budget-accuracy frontiers quantify the resulting loss in accuracy, but do not distinguish irreversible losses caused by eviction from recoverable retrieval failures. We introduce the restore counterfactual, a per-question paired intervention that reinstates the question's gold evidence in the read-time context and reruns the same reader. Combining the change in correctness with whether the evidence was retained after eviction classifies each oracle-answerable error as recoverable, irreversible, or residual; in the residual case, the answer remains incorrect after restoration. We evaluate FIFO, random, redundancy-aware, and LLM-importance eviction on LongMemEval-S at three budgets and under two retrieval regimes, using GPT-4o-mini as the primary reader and judge and GPT-5.4-mini as a robustness reader. Under top-k retrieval at an 80k-token budget, the irreversible share among errors corrected by restoration is 0.67-0.73 for FIFO, random, and redundancy-aware eviction, compared with 0.60 for LLM-importance. At 8k tokens, it reaches 1.00 for all four policies. Recoverable errors occur under top-k retrieval at 80k tokens but are absent under forced-gold injection by construction, so budget-accuracy results are not directly comparable unless the retrieval regime is reported. An exploratory matched-accuracy analysis detects no difference in irreversible rate among accuracy-matched policy pairs at a resolution of 1.2-6 percentage points. The same analysis detects the deliberately destructive control. To our knowledge, this is the first per-item, per-question restore-counterfactual audit of eviction for external agent-memory stores on a standard conversational benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM智能体外部记忆存储在超出token预算时的驱逐(eviction)问题，提出了一种"恢复反事实"(restore counterfactual)审计方法，将oracle-answerable的错误分解为不可逆（驱逐造成的破坏）、可恢复（检索遗漏）、以及残余（reader利用失败）三类，并在LongMemEval-S上对四种驱逐策略进行了实证分析。
AI.motivation: 现有的预算-准确率前沿(budget-accuracy frontiers)只能量化总准确率损失，但无法区分两类本质不同的失败模式：(1)证据被驱逐导致不可逆损失（需改进保留策略），(2)证据仍在存储中但未被检索到（需改进检索器）。两者的补救措施完全不同，但在准确率轴上无法区分。
AI.method: 核心方法是"恢复反事实"——在驱逐后，将问题对应的gold证据重新注入读取时的上下文，重新运行同一个冻结的reader；结合gold证据是否在驱逐后仍保留在store中，将每个oracle-answerable错误分类为：不可逆（恢复后翻对且至少1个gold被驱逐）、可恢复（恢复后翻对且所有gold保留）、或残余（恢复后仍错）。在LongMemEval-S（~102k tokens, 470个问题）上评估FIFO、随机、冗余感知、LLM-importance四种驱逐策略，在8k/30k/80k三种预算和top-k/forced-gold两种检索制度下进行，使用GPT-4o-mini作为主要reader/judge，GPT-5.4-mini进行鲁棒性验证，采用question-cluster bootstrap（10,000次）配以Holm-Bonferroni校正。
AI.result: 主要结果：在80k预算、top-k检索下，不可逆占比（不可逆/(不可逆+可恢复)）：FIFO 0.71、随机0.73、冗余感知0.67、LLM-importance 0.60、控制策略（故意破坏型）1.00；在8k预算下四种策略全部升至1.00。在80k下可恢复占比在forced-gold与top-k之间差距显著（FIFO +0.29等），证明两种检索制度不可互换。在accuracy-matched的策略配对比较中（top-k下的不可逆率，caliper 0.05），所有配对均未检测到差异（0/9基线对比，0/6 LLM-importance对比），但故意破坏的控制策略在所有9个对比中显著（p<0.001）。匹配分析的分辨率为1.2–6个百分点。残余错误（约20–40%）主要是reader的跨session汇总/算术失败，更换为GPT-5.4-mini reader后残余bin缩减过半。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献：(1)首个针对外部智能体记忆存储驱逐的per-question恢复反事实度量；(2)可恢复/不可逆/残余三分类分解；(3)LongMemEval-S上四种策略三种预算两种检索制度的受控研究。核心结论是：在紧预算下不可逆损失（驱逐造成的破坏）占主导，因此改进保留策略优先于改进检索器；预算-准确率前沿在未报告检索制度时不可直接比较；本文提供的是分析工具而非策略排名。局限：仅一个benchmark、两个reader、一个主要judge；驱逐策略为策略类别而非完整已发表系统；需gold标签故仅适用于benchmark分析。

title: Beyond Right and Wrong: Evaluating Second-order Social Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Previous AI alignment efforts have focused primarily on first-order social norms -- teaching models what is socially acceptable or unacceptable (e.g., `do not steal'). However, social intelligence depends not only on norm recognition, but also on anticipating who will enforce it and how (e.g., public shame or even imprisonment). These second-order expectations, known as metanorms, govern how people respond when social rules are broken. We introduce a novel framework for evaluating metanorm reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs) along two dimensions: emotional appraisal and behavioral response, and propose new classification tasks, namely, predicting self-regulation in violators, and other-regulation in observers. We release a multi-perspective dataset, NormReact, of 450 norm violation scenarios, hand-annotated for emotions and behavioral responses across norm violators' gender and observers' social closeness. Current LLMs portray a harsher social world: across six models, they overpredict negative sanctions where humans would expect inaction, and alignment with human judgments deteriorates as social distance increases. These findings suggest that AI systems in norm-sensitive domains from conflict mediation to policy simulation, may risk producing a distorted picture of social regulation: one that over-represents punishment and under-represents the tolerance, restraint, and relational calibration that characterize actual norm enforcement in real world.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个评估大语言模型"元规范推理"（metanorm reasoning）能力的框架和基准数据集 NormReact。研究发现，当前 LLM 系统性地构建了一个比人类更严厉、更具惩罚性的社会规范执行模型，缺失了对社会距离、关系校准和容忍节制的理解。
AI.motivation: 现有的 AI 对齐工作主要关注一阶社会规范（教模型"什么是对/错"），但忽视了二阶社会规范（元规范/metanorm），即关于"谁会执行规范、如何执行、在什么条件下执行"的共享期望。这种对二阶社会推理的忽视使 AI 系统在冲突调解、政策模拟、内容审核等规范敏感领域中可能产生扭曲的社会图景。
AI.method: 1. 提出元规范评估框架，包含两个维度：情绪评估（emotional appraisal）和行为反应（behavioral response），并区分自我调节（self-regulation，违反者）和他者调节（other-regulation，观察者）；2. 引入社会距离变量（强关系/弱关系/陌生人）；3. 构建 NormReact 数据集：450 个规范违反场景，来自 Social-Chem-101，涵盖五大道德基础，并按违反者性别和观察者社会距离人工标注情绪和行为反应；4. 招募 871 名 Prolific 参与者进行人工标注；5. 评估 6 个 SOTA 模型（GPT-5.2、Gemini-3-Pro、Claude-4.5-Opus、GPT-OSS-20B、Llama-4-Scout-17B、Gemma-3-12B）；6. 通过三个二分类任务评估模型：自我调节、他者调节、规范执行；7. 分析描述性规范（实际会做什么）vs. 规范性规范（应该做什么）的差异。
AI.result: 1. LLM 系统性过度预测负面制裁，在人类预期会"不作为"的情况下预测惩罚；2. 与人类判断的一致性随社会距离增加而恶化；3. LLM 过度预测观察者的他聚焦情绪（愤怒、厌恶、轻蔑），低估自我聚焦情绪（羞愧、内疚）；4. LLM 对陌生人的行为预测 F1 分数从强关系（0.8）大幅下降至陌生人（0.48）；5. 规范性规范比描述性规范更难预测（弱关系 F1: 0.56 vs 0.46）；6. LLM 在情绪强度上呈现"模式坍缩"（mode collapse），输出集中于中间值；7. 存在精确率-召回率权衡：GPT-5.2、GPT-OSS、LLaMA 高召回易过度执法；Claude 高精确率但对陌生人反应识别保守；8. LLM 过度预测八卦（weak ties 过度预测达 66%），在规范性框架下从八卦升级为言语对抗；9. 情绪强度对执法的预测关系在 LLM 中更陡峭，呈现过早饱和现象。
AI.conclusion: 当前 LLM 缺乏三个关键能力：1) 条件偏好概念（制裁取决于社会期望而非自动反应）；2) 参考网络敏感性（执法合法性随社会关系分布）；3) 描述性与规范性期望的区分。这种惩罚性偏见可能源于训练语料过度表征道德愤慨、后训练机制奖励果断反应以及安全政策推动公开谴责。该研究具有实践意义：AI 系统可能放大人类的多元无知（pluralistic ignorance），导致用户高估社区的惩罚程度，造成 AI 介导的规范扭曲。未来工作应扩展到目标导向任务、跨文化情境，并建模不对称社会成本。该研究将元规范推理确立为社会智能 AI 的核心组成部分，呼吁 AI 对齐超越"对错"判断，延伸至对悔恨、节制、合法性和关系动态的推理。

title: CriticGen: Generation-Aware Evaluation as Actionable Feedback
summary: Current evaluation methods for large language models are coarse-grained and decoupled from generation, producing generic explanations that fail to provide actionable feedback for model improvement. We propose CriticGen, a fine-grained, generation-aware evaluation framework that turns evaluation into actionable control for answer improvement. CriticGen first generates sample-specific evaluation dimensions and scoring criteria under high-level categories such as subjective, objective, and self-derived constraints. These criteria then serve as a dynamic rubric for jointly producing a score, a reason, an executable refinement suggestion, and a refined answer. This rubric-conditioned refinement process enables models to diagnose flaws and perform targeted answer improvement. Experimental results show that fine-grained evaluation should be both instance-specific and actionable. CriticGen induces higher-quality rubrics, improving relevance/coverage from 3.33/4.03 to 3.97/4.24. CriticGen also achieves the best score correlations, with 0.9556 Pearson and 0.9560 Spearman, and raises the F1 of criterion-grounded reasons and executable suggestions from 0.6369/0.5994 to 0.7554/0.7900. Crucially, its feedback translates into reliable answer improvement, improving 73.17% of answers with a 93.28% non-degradation rate.

AI.tldr: CriticGen 是一个面向大语言模型推理任务的"生成感知"评估框架，通过为每个问答对动态生成样本专属的评分维度与等级化准则（rubric），并将这些准则作为接口条件，统一生成分数、归因解释、可执行的修改建议以及改写后的答案，将评估从"判断"转变为"可执行的改进控制信号"。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 评估方法存在两个核心缺陷：一是评估标准通常是任务级或场景级的固定 rubric，难以捕获单个问答对中的具体缺陷；二是评估信号与生成过程脱节，评估结果只能间接通过奖励模型或强化学习影响下游生成。作者希望验证：评估能否同时做到"样本专属"和"可执行"，从而直接驱动答案改写。
AI.method: 框架由两个 SFT 模块组成，通过 rubric 接口耦合：(1) Rubric 归纳器 G 为每个 (q, a) 生成 m 个评估维度 d_i 及其 0–5 分级准则 C_i，组织在三大高层约束族下（主观质量、客观正确性、自衍生约束）；(2) Rubric 条件化评估-改写模型 S，输入 (q, a, d_i, C_i)，统一输出 (s_i, r_i, u_i, a'_i)——分数、归因解释、可执行修改建议和改写后答案。训练数据 RubricData（51,774 条）和 RefineData（1,204,548 条）由 GPT-5 标注，并经 Claude Sonnet 4.5 与 Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 的一致性过滤、词汇多样性与近重复过滤。两个模块均使用负对数似然 SFT 目标训练，不引入额外 RL 阶段。
AI.result: 在 240 个 held-out 问答对的人类评估中，动态 rubric 将相关性/覆盖率从静态 rubric 的 3.33/4.03 提升至 3.97/4.24；维度名 Jaccard 移位 0.37，证明 rubric 对答案敏感。在 RefineData 上，CriticGen-Qwen3.5-9B 取得最佳 Pearson/Spearman 相关系数 0.9556/0.9560，超越 GPT-5（0.9212/0.9143）；归因解释 F1 从 0.6369 提升至 0.7554，可执行建议 F1 从 0.5994 提升至 0.7900。改写任务中改进率 73.17%，非退化率 93.28%。消融实验显示移除归因解释或修改建议会使改进率从 73.54% 降至约 60–62%。Feedback Bench 域外测试中三个相关系数均取得最优，验证了 rubric 条件化评估能力的可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 实验验证了核心假设：细粒度评估应同时具备"实例专属"和"可执行"两种属性。CriticGen 通过结构化的 SFT 监督轨迹（分数-解释-建议-改写），将动态诱导的 rubric 转化为直接的答案改进信号，使评估成为可控生成改进的机制，而非仅仅是诊断工具。局限在于：依赖生成数据质量、当前仅在文本推理任务验证、未引入强化学习优化。

title: When Does Memory Help? A Cost-Aware Evaluation of Long-Term Memory in Tool-Using LLM Agents
summary: Long-term memory for LLM agents is evaluated today by conversational recall benchmarks (LoCoMo, LongMemEval), which measure question answering over dialogue history, not whether remembered facts change what a tool-using agent does. We present MERIT (Memory Evaluation for Realistic Instrumented Tasks), a benchmark and harness that measures the marginal utility of memory for task-executing agents under explicit cost accounting. MERIT provides episodic tool-use tasks in three domains whose dependence on earlier-episode facts is verified by an automated leak check; a difficulty ladder ending in updated-fact recall; controlled memory corruption; and full token and dollar metering of every memory operation. Across 23,440 scored episodes ($42.57), a two-generation pilot on gpt-4.1-mini and a preregistered 3-model x 3-seed grid (GPT-4.1, Claude Haiku 4.5; memory side held fixed), memory lifts dependent-task success from a leak-verified floor of 0.00 to 0.55-1.00. On updated facts, embedding retrieval collapses unpredictably (0.30-0.95 across models; max seed gap 0.45), and agents act on a correctly retrieved value only 55% of the time, while update-on-write stores (a structured fact store and, notably, LLM summarization) remain at 0.70-1.00; the hybrid is worse than the fact store alone. A latest-generation spot-check (Claude Sonnet 5, gated on a clean full-replay control) reproduces the pattern. Swapping a memory's implementation moves task success by up to 60 points, and full replay is never economical: the best condition per domain delivers 2.7-3.9x its marginal utility per dollar. We release the benchmark, harness, and all traces.

AI.tldr: MERIT 是一个面向工具调用型 LLM 智能体的长期记忆评测基准，通过可编程验证的跨会话任务、控制性记忆依赖、难度阶梯、受控记忆腐化与完整的 token/美元计量，衡量记忆对任务执行的边际效用而非对话回忆能力。核心发现是：嵌入检索在事实更新（hard 层级）下不可预测地崩塌，混合方案劣于其最佳组件，LLM 摘要因每轮覆写而天然抗更新，且全量重放在成本上始终不经济。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体记忆评测（LoCoMo、LongMemEval、BEAM 等）以对话问答为主，存在三大盲点：(1) 衡量的是问答而非工具调用行动；(2) 假定记忆有帮助，却未量化其危害（如陈旧记忆导致自信地犯错）；(3) 报告了成本但未给出成本调整后的边际效用。生产部署真正关心的是记忆是否改变了智能体的行动，以及每增加一美元所换来的成功率提升。
AI.method: MERIT 基准包含三个领域（客服、IT 运维、个人助理），采用 ReAct 工具循环 + SQLite 可变世界状态，arc 由 4–6 个 episode 组成（plant / update / probe / independent）。三档难度梯：easy（单事实）、medium（多事实组合）、hard（事实中途更新，需取最新值）。六个记忆条件：C0 无记忆、C1 全量重放、C2 检索（关键词或嵌入）、C3 滚动摘要（截断或 LLM）、C4 结构化事实存储（正则或 LLM 抽取，update-on-write）、C5 混合（C4+C2）。每条件有 starter 与 real 两代实现。关键防护：自动 leak check（确保 gold fact 不出现在 probe 输入或初始世界状态中）+ delta scoring（仅当 checker 谓词在 episode 内由 false 翻转为 true 才算成功）。指标：TSR、MUR、Ignore Rate、SMH、CAMU（含记忆侧调用计量）。统计方法：配对自举按 arc 聚类 + Holm–Bonferroni，预注册 H1–H4。两阶段实验：gpt-4.1-mini 双代 pilot（9,940 episodes），加 3 模型 × 3 种子全量网格（13,500 episodes），附 Sonnet 5、Opus 4.8 抽查。
AI.result: 在 23,440 计分 episodes、$42.57 API 成本上：C0 无记忆基线在依赖任务上 leak 验证后确为 0.00，独立任务 0.83–1.00；所有记忆条件在 easy 上 +0.55 至 +1.00。Hard 层级呈现架构分离——C2 嵌入检索跨模型/种子不稳定（0.30–0.95，最大种子差距 0.45），C3 LLM 摘要（因每轮覆写）与 C4 事实存储稳定在 0.70–1.00，C5 混合在所有领域 hard 上劣于 C4（0.50–0.80 vs. 0.75–1.00）。即使正确事实已在检索块中（55 个 probe），智能体仅 55% 真正按其行动（Ignore Rate 0.45–0.53）；C1 全量重放在多事实组合上 ignore 高达 0.50。Stale 腐化下唯一 Holm 显著伤害出现在 C5（+0.25 at ρ=0.3, p=0.030）。实施替换可使任务成功率移动高达 60 分（如 C4 D2 由正则 1.00 降至 LLM 抽取 0.40；C3 hard 由截断 0.00 升至 LLM 1.00）。CAMU：每领域最佳条件为该领域最经济的 2.7–3.9 倍；C1 全量重放始终不经济。Sonnet 5 抽查复制了该模式（DPO 等政策审慎的混淆须以 C1 为对照解读）。
AI.conclusion: MERIT 将智能体记忆评测从"能否回忆"重构为"回忆是否改变了智能体行为、代价几何、如何失败"。在事实会被更新的场景下应优先选择覆写式记忆（结构化事实存储或 LLM 摘要），混合方案不继承最佳组件行为，全量重放成本上不经济。提取质量是结构化记忆的隐性税，应被 CAMU 计量。MEMIT 的 leak check 与 delta scoring 应成为任务执行型记忆基准的标准实践；跨模型比较应相对于各自 C1 全量重放控制来读，以隔离政策审慎对记忆利用率的混淆。作者公开了基准、harness、追踪数据与预注册。

title: AutoFyn Technical Report: Non-Parametric Expert Iteration for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: We introduce AutoFyn, an agent harness inspired by the Expert Iteration algorithm, adapting a frozen model across many rounds by updating persistent state from verified reward signals rather than model weights. Each round begins from a fresh model session, and durable information is reintroduced only through explicit interfaces such as persistent memory files, reports, and repository state. Within a round, an orchestrator explores, plans and builds many alternative approaches with specialized agents, while a task-grounded verifier verifies the work and supplies an objective reward for measuring progress. This reward is distilled back into the persistent state, which updates the effective policy for the next round. In this technical report, we formalize this loop and describe its persistent state and verification interfaces. We then demonstrate its use in three domains, namely olympiad mathematics, data science, and cybersecurity. On the six fresh problems of the 2026 International Mathematical Olympiad, every model with room to improve scores higher under AutoFyn than in its provider's own coding agent. AutoFyn also built the top-ranked agent on the Spider 2.0 dbt benchmark, and has produced $16$ maintainer-confirmed vulnerability advisories in this http URL , MetaMask, pnpm, Warp, LiteLLM, Langflow, and Open WebUI.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AutoFyn：一种面向长时程智能体任务的非参数化专家迭代框架。它保持基础模型及其角色分配不变，每轮开启全新模型会话，将候选方案、验证证据和经验提炼到持久化状态中，再由外部验证器产生的奖励决定是否更新当前最佳结果。该方法在奥数、数据科学基准和软件安全审计中展示出较强表现，但多数结果属于系统级部署比较，尚不足以分离各组件的独立贡献。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体通常同时面临两个问题：单一会话不断累积上下文，导致模型对历史信息的利用不均；以及智能体依赖自评纠正自身错误，使早期误判在后续迭代中固化。论文据此设计一个以“新鲜会话＋显式持久状态＋外部验证”为核心的循环：上下文长度由可控的持久状态决定，而进展只由环境验证信号确认。
AI.method: AutoFyn 保持角色到模型的参数和分配 Θ 冻结，将持久状态 M_t 划分为目标/用户修订、评估历史、规则与角色经验、工作状态、最佳候选及其证据。外部控制进程为每轮建立空历史的新会话；编排器在探索、规划、构建和审查阶段调用专业角色智能体，并生成多个候选。验证器将每个候选映射为带状态/分数、证据、保证等级和验证者身份的结构化记录。系统仅在候选被接受且质量高于当前最佳时更新 incumbent，同时将有价值的轨迹、证据和经验提炼进 M_t。该方法被形式化为非参数化专家迭代：搜索负责提出候选，外部验证器提供专家判据，状态蒸馏相当于策略更新。它不同于经典专家迭代，因为不更新模型参数、不构建显式专家策略，也不保证验证无误；改进必须由后续已验证表现确认。
AI.result: 在 IMO 2026 六道题上，五个模型在 AutoFyn 中的得分均达到或超过其供应商编码智能体：GPT-5.6 Sol 为 42.0 对 40.0，Claude Fable 5 均为 42.0，Claude Opus 4.8 为 34.7 对 28.0，Claude Sonnet 5 为 29.7 对 23.3，GLM 5.2 为 32.0 对 20.7。分数经独立前沿模型审计并由三名往届 IMO 奖牌获得者复核，结果未反馈到生成过程。需要注意，六个子前沿单元为三次独立运行的均值，且不同智能体在时长、工具、检索和多智能体结构上并不等同，因此不能将全部增益归因于 AutoFyn 循环本身。在 Spider 2.0 dbt 公共榜单中，AutoFyn 自主构建和优化的 SignalPilot Agent 得分 65.60，位列第一；论文所列第二至第五名分别为 60.29、41.18、39.71 和一个图表中未标数值但排名第五的条目。安全审计方面，系统在 13 个项目中找到超过 150 个可复现漏洞，提交 43 份公告，其中 16 份已获项目维护者确认。论文还给出五项审计的逐轮曲线，例如 Hermes Agent 在 19 轮内达到 56 个经确认的可利用路径，pnpm 在第 8 轮关闭 13 个路径并一度停滞，之后在第 129 轮完成一条链。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为，AutoFyn 将长上下文管理、多候选搜索、外部验证和持久记忆整合为一个可审计的长时程循环，并通过三类任务证明其广泛适用性。其主要理论定位是：模型参数保持不变，但通过持久状态改变模型后续行为所依赖的上下文条件，从而实现非参数化专家迭代。论文同时明确其局限：该对应是结构性的，验证器可能误收或误拒，持久状态更新是有损的，因此策略本身不保证单调改善；IMO 实验也是完整部署之间的比较，没有隔离上下文重置、多智能体搜索、工具权限和检索等组件的贡献。因此，结论更支持 AutoFyn 作为一种有效且可审计的系统设计，而非已证明普遍优越或理论保证充分的算法。

title: Damage-Aware Bandit Pruning for Vision and Language Transformers
summary: Structured post-training pruning of transformers requires selecting complete functional units whose suppression causes limited degradation. We formulate structured-unit selection for language and vision transformers as a damage-aware multi-armed bandit problem under a fixed candidate-evaluation budget. Attention heads and MLP channel groups are temporarily masked on calibration batches. Paired damage is the masked loss minus the base loss on the same batch, reducing batch-to-batch variation. A smooth bounded reward drives either a UCB-style policy or fractional-Beta Thompson Sampling, and the final mask is constructed sequentially by adding one unit at each step. The selected units are functionally zeroed in the original dense checkpoint; therefore, the reported parameter effects represent effective structural suppression rather than physical compression or measured speedup. Experiments on WikiText-2, LAMBADA, and Imagenette cover GPT-2, OPT, Pythia, Qwen2.5, SmolLM2, ViT-B/16, DeiT-Tiny, and Swin-Tiny, with comparisons against random, magnitude, static-saliency, and budgeted-greedy selection. Across five seeds, the bandit methods usually reduce degradation relative to budgeted greedy in the paired language-model comparisons. Of 28 comparisons highlighted in the paper, 23 bootstrap confidence intervals exclude zero and 11 paired tests have p < 0.05; six have q < 0.05 after Benjamini-Hochberg correction across the full family of 116 dataset-wise tests. Matched-evaluation results for ViT-B/16 and Swin-Tiny indicate that their gains are not explained solely by a larger candidate-evaluation budget.

title: Compiling VGDL into Causal Models
comment: To be published at IEEE Conference on Games 2026
summary: Reinforcement learning and large language models often struggle to accurately capture the causal mechanics of game environments. Standard reinforcement learning agents tend to rely on spurious correlations, while large language models are prone to hallucinating game rules. Although causal reinforcement learning improves interpretability, there is currently no formal methodology to map complex game mechanics directly into causal models. To address this, we propose a deterministic framework that compiles games specified in the Video Game Description Language into Dynamic Structural Causal Models. Rather than inferring causal structures from gameplay traces or noisy large language models' outputs, our methodology directly translates game components, including sprite dynamics, interaction rules, and termination conditions, into explicit structural equations. Each game tick represents a causal transition from state variables at time $t$ to $t+1$. By establishing this grounded mapping, the approach guarantees absolute causal fidelity to the ground-truth game mechanics. The resulting models offer transparent causal pathways that support counterfactual reasoning, causal reinforcement learning agent training, and procedural content validation. This framework provides a principled bridge between symbolic game descriptions and causally grounded game AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种确定性框架，将VGDL（视频游戏描述语言）编写的游戏直接转换为动态结构因果模型（DSCM），以保证因果保真度，支持反事实推理、因果强化学习训练和程序化内容验证。
AI.motivation: 标准强化学习智能体依赖虚假相关，大语言模型则容易幻觉游戏规则。虽然因果强化学习提高了可解释性，但目前缺少将复杂游戏机制直接映射为因果模型的形式化方法。需要一种能够保证因果保真度、无需从噪声数据中推断的框架。
AI.method: 将VGDL的四个核心组件（SpriteSet精灵集、LevelMapping关卡映射、InteractionSet交互集、TerminationSet终止集）确定性编译为动态结构因果模型（DSCM）。每个游戏tick表示从时间t到t+1的因果转移：(1) 精灵动力学定义局部因果机制（移动精灵、不可移动精灵、随机NPC各自的结构方程）；(2) 交互机制通过空间重叠条件激活（如stepBack、killSprite规则）；(3) 终止机制从存活实例计数推导胜负状态。内生变量包括位置、朝向、速度、存活状态等，外生变量包括玩家动作、随机数和初始布局。以basicgame为例给出完整的SCM映射表。
AI.result: 该框架提供了一个原则性的桥梁，将符号化游戏描述与因果基础的游戏AI连接起来，产生了透明的反事实推理路径，支持因果强化学习智能体训练，并可进行程序化内容验证。主要局限在于因果模型规模随VGDL描述复杂度线性增长，且依赖VGDL与实际实现的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将视频游戏映射到动态因果框架，使对游戏中动作和结果的推理成为可能，补充了基于统计和学习的游戏AI方法。未来工作包括开发从游戏代码自动提取SCM的工具、扩展到多智能体和实时游戏、探索空间关系编码方法，并通过实验评估对智能体性能的影响。

title: ARC-Bench: Closed-Loop Replanning Masks Broken Action Ranking in Frozen JEPA World Models
summary: Reward-free latent world models plan by scoring candidate actions with distances in a frozen latent space: an action is preferred if its predicted future embedding lands closer to the goal embedding. This silently assumes that latent closeness is action-rankable, i.e., that ordering candidates by latent distance agrees with ordering them by true cost. We audit this assumption directly. We introduce ARC-Bench, a no-leak, fixed-candidate protocol that measures whether frozen JEPA-style objectives rank candidate actions correctly, and apply it to official released JEPA-WM checkpoints across navigation and manipulation-style control. The assumption fails, severely and structurally: on the official manipulation audits the top-scored candidate is almost always suboptimal, and the same inversion appears in the maze domains. A controlled visual-backbone extension shows that the defect persists when DINOv2 is replaced by video-pretrained V-JEPA 1 and V-JEPA 2 encoders at ViT-L/ViT-G scale. Provenance, undertraining, matched-budget backbone controls, and metric-circularity controls rule out trivial explanations. We then explain why this defect has stayed invisible: closed-loop replanning masks it. When we reduce the planner's replanning frequency, success collapses in both a navigation and a manipulation domain, and the episodes rescued by frequent replanning are enriched for severe first-plan ranking failures in the PointMaze first-plan diagnostic. Closed-loop success rates therefore systematically overstate the rankability of frozen latent representations. ARC-Bench supplies the measurement, and the masking mechanism the explanation, for methods that adapt, amortize, or replan around latent-space planners without directly auditing released JEPA-WM action rankability.

AI.tldr: ARC-Bench 提出了一种无泄漏、固定候选动作的审计协议，用于评测冻结 JEPA 世界模型（如 DINO-WM、V-JEPA 系列）中基于潜在距离的动作排序假设是否成立。研究发现：在官方发布的 JEPA-WM 检查点上，"潜在距离近似动作优劣"的假设严重失效——Push-T 上 96.8% 的锚点选择了次优动作，MetaWorld reach-wall 上 100% 错误；即便用 V-JEPA 1/2 视频预训练编码器替换 DINOv2，缺陷依然存在。该缺陷之所以长期未被察觉，是因为闭环重规划（每步重新规划）会不断覆盖单步排序错误——降低重规划频率后，成功率显著下降（PointMaze 从 89.6% 降至 61.8%，Push-T 从 36.1% 降至 12.5%）。因此，闭环成功率系统性地高估了冻结潜在表示的动作可排序性。
AI.motivation: 无奖励潜在世界模型（JEPA-WM、V-JEPA 2-AC 等）通过候选动作预测的未来嵌入与目标嵌入之间的距离来选择动作，隐含假设"潜在距离排序与真实代价排序一致"。该假设此前从未被直接基准测试过，而闭环成功率可能掩盖单步排序缺陷，因此需要一套标准化的审计协议来量化这一假设的可靠性。
AI.method: ARC-Bench 采用无泄漏、固定候选动作的审计协议：(1) 在锁定测试集上对官方 JEPA-WM 检查点进行评分审计；(2) 报告 top-1 遗憾、Hit@k、WRR、Mirage 率、Spearman 相关系数等指标；(3) 进行控制实验——替换视觉骨干网络（V-JEPA 1/2 ViT-L/G）、进行欠训练控制、匹配预算骨干控制、度量循环性控制；(4) 附加轻量级终端排序探针作为局部化诊断；(5) 通过改变重规划频率 k（k=1,2,4,6）来隔离闭环重规划对排序缺陷的掩盖效应；(6) 在 U-Maze 和 MiniGrid/FourRooms 上进行拓扑压力审计，验证终端距离几何的固有缺陷。
AI.result: 在官方 JEPA-WM 检查点上：Push-T 错误率 96.8%（Hit@1 仅 3.2%），MetaWorld reach-wall 错误率 100%（Hit@1=0，Hit@3≈0.1%），得分-代价 Spearman 相关性显著为负。V-JEPA 骨干替换后缺陷依然存在（Push-T 错误率 91.1–97.3%，MetaWorld 仍 100%）。采样预算从 2 增加到 12 不修复排序缺陷。降低重规划频率后：PointMaze 成功率从 89.6% 降至 61.8%（McNemar p=1.51×10⁻⁹），Push-T 从 36.1% 降至 12.5%（p=1.08×10⁻⁹）。在 PointMaze 上，41.7% 的高 Mirage 情节被频繁重规划拯救，而低 Mirage 情节仅 8.3%。拓扑压力审计证实原始终端欧氏距离排序在 100% 锚点上是错误的。
AI.conclusion: 冻结 JEPA 世界模型中基于潜在距离的动作排序假设在官方检查点上严重失效且具结构性，跨导航和操控域普遍存在，跨视觉骨干持续存在，且无法通过增加采样预算修复。该缺陷之所以长期未被发现，是因为闭环重规划通过每步重新观测掩盖了单步排序错误——这意味着闭环成功率系统性地高估了冻结潜在表示的真实动作可排序性。该工作的核心贡献在于提供 ARC-Bench 这一可报告的度量协议以及闭环重规划掩盖机制的解释，而非提出修复方案。

title: RAPID: Reliability-Aware Pair Importance Distillation
summary: Inter example relational distillation transfers a teacher's representation geometry by matching relations among examples within a mini batch. Computing all pairs has quadratic complexity in the batch size, whereas uniform subsampling may use a limited relation budget inefficiently. We introduce Reliability Aware Pair Importance Distillation, or RAPID, which separates a reliability gated relational target from a full support adaptive pair proposal. Reliability determines which teacher relations are emphasized, while calibrated teacher entropy and detached student-teacher residuals determine which relations are evaluated. Exact inverse proposal correction makes the loss and gradient estimators conditionally unbiased with respect to the gated mini batch target. We evaluate RAPID in two text classification settings: AG News with BERT-to-DistilBERT distillation using three paired seeds and a relation budget of 256, and SST-2 with DistilBERT to DistilBERT distillation using three paired seeds and a relation budget of 64. Reliability gated relational distillation achieves the highest observed mean student accuracy on both datasets: 94.285 plus or minus 0.054 percent on AG News and 88.800 plus or minus 0.532 percent on SST-2. RAPID ranks second, achieving 94.241 plus or minus 0.025 percent and 88.685 plus or minus 0.462 percent, respectively, compared with 94.154 plus or minus 0.124 percent and 87.271 plus or minus 0.162 percent for the cross entropy baseline. Pilot evaluations are counted toward the same total budget as the main relation evaluations. Across both settings, the gated target yields the highest mean accuracy, while the adaptive proposal remains within seed-level variation. These results support the modular view that target reliability and evaluation priority are separable design dimensions.

AI.tldr: 提出 RAPID（Reliability-Aware Pair Importance Distillation），将关系蒸馏中的"目标可靠性门控"与"自适应采样提议"解耦，通过逆提议修正实现固定关系预算下的条件无偏估计，并在 AG News 与 SST-2 两个文本分类任务上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: inter-example 关系蒸馏在 mini-batch 内计算所有对具有 O(B²) 复杂度，而均匀子采样对有限的关系预算利用效率低下；同时，对教师关系应赋予多少信任（目标可靠性）与应优先评估哪些关系（评估优先级）是两个不应混淆的设计决策，现有方法（如 RKD、CRD、基于重要性采样的 KD）未将二者分离。
AI.method: 1) 标签感知的归一化可靠性门控 r_i = max{r_min, sqrt(p_T^cal(y_i) * m_i)}，通过混合系数 λ 在均匀目标与完全门控目标之间插值；2) 基于分解式端点概率 q_a(i,j) = 2*a_i*a_j / Z(a) 的全支持配对提议，静态信号结合标定熵与可靠性，自适应部分逐步引入脱钩的师生残差；3) 端点级和配对级防御混合保证 q_t(i,j) ≥ ε/M；4) 精确逆提议修正使得损失和停止梯度（stopped-proposal）估计量在给定 F_t 条件下无偏，并通过 Cauchy–Schwarz 分析得到标量损失最优提议 ∝ f_ij。
AI.result: 在 AG News（BERT→DistilBERT，K=256，3 个配对种子）和 SST-2（DistilBERT→DistilBERT，K=64，3 个配对种子）上：可靠性门控关系蒸馏取得最高观测均值（AG News 94.285±0.054%，SST-2 88.800±0.532%），RAPID 紧随其后（94.241±0.025%，88.685±0.462%），均优于交叉熵基线（94.154±0.124%，87.271±0.162%）；在 AG News 上 RAPID 训练时间最短（62.4 min）且显存最低（2127 MB）。但所有方法间的差距均在种子噪声范围内，作者明确表示不主张 RAPID 严格优于纯门控对照。
AI.conclusion: 论文支持关系蒸馏中"目标可靠性"与"评估优先级"是可分离设计维度的模块化观点；RAPID 通过门控-提议分离、无偏修正、全支持提议与固定预算记账，在两个文本分类场景中均优于交叉熵、KD 和均匀关系采样，但 RAPID 与纯门控方法之间的差距处于种子噪声范围内，因此该结论为提示性而非决定性；未来工作需要在匹配架构下进行多预算扫描、更多配对种子以及直接方差诊断。

title: PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN: Prior-Guided Joint Probabilistic Forecasting of Clinical Trajectories
summary: Clinical deterioration unfolds through coupled, partially observed trajectories, not a single diagnostic label. We introduce PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN, a trajectory-first framework for joint probabilistic forecasting of multivariate physiology. It combines missingness-aware temporal encoders, a soft organ-system prior, patient-specific relations, nonlinear Kolmogorov-Arnold messages, and a low-rank multivariate Student-t head. We evaluate 24-hour histories and six-hour forecasts on a frozen MIMIC-IV-derived cohort of 6,882 patients and 54,694 windows. Across five seeds and 13 models, PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN obtains the second-lowest normalized MAE (0.37727 +/- 0.00029) and the lowest RMSE (0.52656 +/- 0.00034). It reduces MAE by 0.52% relative to deterministic TimeKAN. For probabilistic forecasting, it reaches a marginal NLL of 0.66380 and a CRPS of 0.27301. Empirical coverage is 0.533, 0.831, and 0.958 for nominal 50%, 80%, and 95% intervals. Removing relational structure causes the largest ablation loss. Increasing covariance rank improves joint likelihood but has little effect on point accuracy. A trajectory-derived risk score remains weaker than a dedicated GRU-D classifier (AUROC 0.603 versus 0.650), which limits the present clinical claim. Joint trajectory forecasting therefore provides an inspectable intermediate task, but accurate physiology forecasts alone do not ensure a calibrated event detector.

AI.tldr: PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN 是一个用于多变量生理指标联合概率预测的"轨迹优先"框架，结合缺失感知时间编码器、软器官系统先验、患者特异性动态关系、非线性 Kolmogorov-Arnold 消息传递和低秩多元 Student-t 输出头；在 MIMIC-IV 衍生队列上获得最佳 RMSE 和次低 MAE，且在概率预测各项 proper score 上优于所评估基线，但衍生的次级风险评分弱于专用 GRU-D 分类器，限制了临床声明。
AI.motivation: 临床恶化涉及耦合且部分观测的多变量生理轨迹，而非单一诊断标签。直接将历史压缩为风险评分的"history-to-label"范式无法揭示变量如何变化、何时跨越阈值或多个器官系统是否共同恶化。需要一个能保留可检查中间表征、显式建模变量与时间不确定性、并分离"生理预测可靠性"与"事件分类能力"的轨迹优先框架。
AI.method: 1) 缺失感知临床输入：基于掩码 M 与测量间隔 Δ 构造学习式可靠性 r，区分观测/插补/陈旧值；2) 逐变量多尺度 TimeKAN 编码器：FFT 频带分解为 Q 个分量，每分量经 TimeKAN 块（含 Chebyshev 标量 KAN 边）处理后由状态依赖门组合；3) 软器官系统先验：变量-系统映射 S 与系统级软关系 C_organ 经行归一化生成 A_prior；4) 患者特异性动态关系：每时刻 query/key 注意力 + 可靠性偏置生成 A_dyn，由学习门 G 与先验融合 A_rel，并加平滑正则；5) KAN 跨变量消息传递：用 Chebyshev 基函数 ϕ^KAN 替代边权重，输出 m 加 LayerNorm 残差更新；6) 直出式多步解码器；7) 低秩多元 Student-t 输出：Σ = UU⊤ + diag(σ²)，ν>2，共享自由度，配 scale-mixture 采样；8) 掩码联合似然 + Woodbury 加速；9) 由相干样本估计阈值穿越概率与器官功能恶化概率；10) 训练目标含 NLL + 稀疏/平滑/可选风险正则。
AI.result: 在 6,882 例患者、54,694 窗口、5 个种子、13 个模型的冻结 MIMIC-IV 衍生队列上（24h 历史 → 6h 预测）：归一化 MAE 0.37727±0.00029（次低，GRU-D 最低 0.37636），RMSE 0.52656±0.00034（最低），相对确定性 TimeKAN MAE 降低 0.52%；概率指标边际 NLL 0.66380、CRPS 0.27301、能量分数 0.35715 均最优；经验覆盖率 50/80/95% 为 0.533/0.831/0.958（50%、80% 略保守）。消融：移除关系结构造成最大 MAE 损失（0.38162），KAN 关系最优；协方差秩 2→16 几乎不影响 MAE（≤0.00026）但联合 NLL/obs 从 0.58930 改善至 0.50323。轨迹衍生风险评分 AUROC 0.603，弱于 GRU-D 分类器 0.650；正窗口流行率仅 1.039%。
AI.conclusion: PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN 在 13 个模型中获得最低 RMSE 与次低 MAE，并在所评估概率基线中取得全部最优 proper score；消融与协方差秩分析最有力支持跨变量依赖建模；联合轨迹生成提供可检查的中间表征。但准确的生理预测并不保证校准的事件检测器：次级轨迹衍生风险评分弱于专用分类器，作者明确限定其非临床可部署的脓毒症预测器。联合轨迹建模本身有价值，但临床转化仍需更强的端点证据、完整 SOFA 变量、可审计的感染证据、外部/多中心验证与改进的校准。

title: SciLitBench: Benchmark and Design Principles for LLM-Powered Systematic Literature Reviews
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures, and 5 tables. Data and code are available at this https URL
summary: Systematic reviews require sustained human judgment across thousands of records, yet existing evaluations of large language models (LLMs) typically examine review stages in isolation. We introduce SciLitBench, a multi-stage benchmark spanning title and abstract screening, full-text screening, and schema-guided data extraction, with 42,981 retrieved records, 1,012 full texts, and annotations for 888 included papers. Across 22 open-weight LLMs from six model families, explicit inclusion and exclusion criteria improve title and abstract screening $F_2$ by 28.8\%, while researcher-authored rationales improve full-text screening by 15\%. Data extraction reveals a different reliability regime: performance declines from 0.97 accuracy for publication year to 0.37 Jaccard overlap for computational approach, while the strongest models recover only 30\% of annotated evaluation evidence and 25\% of limitations. SciLitBench identifies a practical boundary between high-recall screening and evidence-complete extraction and provides a reproducible resource for evaluating LLM-assisted evidence synthesis.

AI.tldr: SciLitBench是一个多阶段基准测试，涵盖标题/摘要筛选、全文筛选和模式引导的数据抽取三个系统综述阶段，基于42,981条记录、1,012篇全文和888篇纳入论文的标注数据。它评估了来自六个模型家族的22个开源大语言模型，揭示了显式纳入/排除标准可使标题摘要筛选F2提高28.8%，研究者撰写的理由可将全文筛选提高15%，但开放性证据抽取仍是重大瓶颈，最强模型仅能恢复30%的评估证据和25%的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型评估通常孤立地考察综述流程的各个阶段，缺乏对单一语料库上从检索、筛选到抽取全流程的统一基准。此外，自动化证据合成中哪些设计选择能提升可靠性、可靠性是否在各阶段间迁移、以及从低歧义到开放性抽取的过渡中性能如何变化，这三个关键问题尚未得到解答。
AI.method: 基于一项关于文献综述自动化的真实系统综述构建语料库（42,981条检索记录→1,012篇全文→888篇纳入论文），开发六个抽取字段的迭代式模式（年份、领域、综述阶段、方法、评估结果、局限性）。评估22个来自Llama、Gemma、Qwen、Mistral、Phi、gpt-oss家族的开源LLM，采用标准化提示词（基础/纳入/纳入+排除三种变体）、零样本与少样本对比、强池和宽松池的多数投票集成、token感知的路由集成。对于开放性字段采用校准的LLM-as-a-judge协议（基于100篇校准集和29,724条标注的判断决策）。标注审计包括8-12周后重新标注（标题摘要κ=0.992，全文κ=1.00）以及500条银标排除的污染率估计。
AI.result: 1）标题摘要筛选：纳入提示使F2提升17.0%，加入排除推理后总提升达28.8%；强池多数投票（F2=0.808）和宽松池（0.803）均超过最佳单模型；组合池在完美召回下精度为0.275，工作量减少约90%。2）全文筛选：输出可靠性取决于参数规模和上下文窗口的联合作用；研究者理由将少样本F2从0.551提升至0.633（提升15%）；最佳单模型Llama 3.3-70B零样本F2达0.981。3）数据抽取：闭式字段从年份准确率0.97降至方法Jaccard 0.37；开放性字段最强模型仅恢复30%评估证据和25%局限性。4）级联实验中，仅12.1%的论文在到达抽取阶段后能完全正确抽取。
AI.conclusion: 该基准揭示了LLM辅助系统综述中的一个实践可靠性边界：筛选可通过协议设计变得可靠（高召回），但证据完整的抽取在目标变得更具解释性时仍不够可靠。协议设计与模型规模同等重要；可靠筛选是不对称决策问题而非传统分类任务；开放性抽取的主要失败模式是证据覆盖不完整而非无法产生合理输出。人类的判断在过程中向上游移动而非消失，负责定义标准、确定粒度、精炼模式、记录理由。基准以开源模型为中心以确保纵向可复现性。研究结果强调，自动化应减少综述负担而不应使证据路径变得不那么透明可见。

title: SCAFFOLD: Self-Improving Web Agents via Recursive Parametric Skill Abstraction
summary: Web agents need to navigate visually rich, long-horizon interfaces that change across sites, yet most previous agents still learn each task in isolation and discard the procedural knowledge they accumulate. Recent skill-augmented frameworks take an important first step, but they treat the skill library as a flat or two-tier prompt-side cache and offer no principled mechanism for compressing redundancy or composing skills recursively. We introduce \textsc{Scaffold}, a self-improving framework for visual web agents that (i) induces parametric, executable skills from successful trajectories under a multi-instance abstraction constraint, (ii) maintains a recursively composed hierarchy in which higher-level skills invoke lower-level ones, (iii) compacts the library via a minimum-description-length (MDL) criterion and behavioral equivalence checking, and (iv) periodically distills skill-augmented trajectories back into model weights to internalize the abstractions. Across WebArena, VisualWebArena, and a held-out split of Online-Mind2Web, \textsc{Scaffold} improves success rate by $11.1$--$17.2$ absolute points over the strongest skill-augmented baseline and shows monotonic gains across five self-improvement iterations without library collapse. We release the code and documents in the Github \href{ this https URL }{repository}.

AI.tldr: Scaffold是一个面向视觉网页智能体的自改进框架,通过多实例参数化技能归纳、MDL驱动的技能库压缩、递归组合和权重蒸馏四个核心机制,在WebArena、VisualWebArena和Online-Mind2Web上以11.1-17.2绝对成功率提升超越现有最强基线,并在5次迭代中持续改进。
AI.motivation: 现有网页智能体将每个任务视为独立片段,丢弃积累的过程性知识;现有技能增强框架使用扁平或两层提示缓存,缺乏冗余压缩和递归组合机制,且知识仅存在于提示中而未内化为模型权重。
AI.method: 五阶段自改进循环:(1)使用当前策略收集轨迹;(2)基于多实例聚类(≥n_min条相似轨迹)归纳参数化可执行技能并通过保留验证;(3)允许新技能调用任何已有技能实现递归组合并追踪抽象深度；(4)每M次迭代通过MDL准则执行合并(行为等价技能)、重构(重复子序列提升为中层技能)和剪枝(未使用技能)三种算子;(5)将技能增强轨迹通过SFT+辅助技能名预测损失蒸馏到基础策略权重中(LoRA)。
AI.result: 在WebArena/VWA/OM2W-X上达到42.7%/36.3%/43.5%成功率,较SkillRL提升11.1-17.2绝对点;5次迭代持续改进无库崩溃;技能库规模稳定在约181个技能(无压缩则达470个);平均抽象深度从1.05增至2.71;跨站点迁移35.9% vs SkillWeaver 16.6%;在延迟/DOM扰动/时间漂移下退化≤2.1点;平均每任务12.4个原子动作(优于基线)。
AI.conclusion: Scaffold的四个组件(多实例归纳、递归组合、MDL压缩、权重蒸馏)协同构成单一闭环机制,共同解决现有技能归纳方法的三大局限;局限包括依赖GPT-4o归纳器、依赖每任务验证器、MDL贪婪近似无收敛保证、跨站点迁移存在天花板以及≤1.2点的蒸馏遗忘。
