Unsound search in imperfect information games could be exploitable. We replicate a published best-response attack against ByteRL. We then apply the same attack protocol to two search configurations of our agent, and each one resists it better than ByteRL at every iteration. In LoCM unsound search gives us a stronger and more resilient agent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于非完备搜索（unsound search）的集换式卡牌游戏（CCG）AI代理，在LoCM竞赛中以51.35%的胜率击败了不使用搜索的冠军ByteRL，并展现出更强的抗攻击鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 集换式卡牌游戏（CCG）是不完美信息博弈，信念状态空间巨大（约2^101），现有完备搜索方法（如ReBeL、DeepStack）因需枚举信念状态而不可行。当前LoCM冠军ByteRL不使用任何决策时搜索；以往研究也认为基于枚举的搜索在此类游戏中不可用。本文旨在验证：理论上非完备的完美信息蒙特卡洛搜索（PIMC）配合采样信念方法能否在此类CCG中实际生效。
AI.method: 1) 用Rust重写游戏引擎，速度比gym-locm快443倍，并支持一致性过滤的信念采样；2) 通过模仿学习（行为克隆）训练前馈策略-价值网络，使用亚军NeteaseOPD的自对弈数据；3) 决策时采用基于PIMC的束搜索：在对手牌组先验（来自NeteaseOPD的轮抽）上采样W个一致世界（最多384个），对每个计划展开对手一回合并用价值网络打分；4) 测量Long等人定义的三个游戏结构属性（消歧性、叶相关、偏差），验证LoCM处于PIMC缺陷代价低的区域。
AI.result: 在严格配置下（无ByteRL数据，使用对手牌组的混合先验），该代理在官方裁判和计时器下以51.35%（95%CI [50.37, 52.33]，10,000场预注册比赛）击败ByteRL；搜索贡献+24.6个百分点（无搜索时仅26.8%）。在知道对手牌组时胜率达60.4%。搜索将对抗最佳响应攻击的胜率从90.1%（针对ByteRL）降至62–69%（针对该代理），抗攻击性更强。
AI.conclusion: 理论上非完备的PIMC搜索在CCG类不完美信息博弈中可实际提升AI代理的强度和鲁棒性，挑战了"搜索在CCG中不可行"的既有观点。但本文工作存在局限性：仅关注战斗阶段、内存超竞赛上限（256MB）、依赖GPU、未测量认证代理的可利用性，且结构测量仅基于32个牌组。未来工作应探索该方法在其他CCG中的适用性以及采样完备搜索变体。

title: Formation of structural attractors in neuromorphic systems
summary: This paper examines the theory of Invariant Structural Learning (ISL), which proposes a non-optimization approach to concept formation. Learning is interpreted as convergence to structural attractors in a hypergraph space, rather than as the minimization of a global loss function. The paper presents the ISL model, including its mathematical formalization, computational verification, and a hypothetical neurobiological interpretation. The mathematical section introduces the formal apparatus of the structural reduction process and proves its finite convergence, the existence and uniqueness of class structural attractors, and the self-organization of attractor maps. The computational section demonstrates the feasibility of the proposed approach on classical image recognition tasks, utilizing the proposed learning mechanism without backpropagation and with extremely small training datasets. Finally, the neurobiological section formulates hypotheses regarding the possible implementation of structural attractors in dendritic trees, neural coding as a projection of internal attractor dynamics, and the development of neural architectures supporting the proposed learning concept. These hypotheses are discussed in the context of modern experimental data in the fields of dendritic computations, synaptic plasticity, and the structural organization of neural circuits. The proposed neurobiological mechanisms are presented as testable hypotheses rather than established biological facts. The results demonstrate the mathematical consistency and computational feasibility of the proposed model, while the neurobiological hypotheses outline potential directions for its experimental verification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"不变结构学习"(Invariant Structural Learning, ISL)理论,主张学习是一种非优化的概念形成过程,表现为系统在超图空间中向结构吸引子的收敛。文章给出了数学形式化、计算验证及神经生物学假说三个层面的论证。
AI.motivation: 主流深度学习依赖反向传播和大规模数据集进行全局损失最小化,存在生物学上不合理、数据需求大等局限。本文旨在探索一种无需优化的、结构驱动的替代学习范式,并探讨其在神经系统中可能的实现机制。
AI.method: 1. 数学层面:形式化超图空间上的"结构归约"(structural reduction)过程,证明其有限收敛性、结构吸引子的存在性与唯一性,以及吸引子图的自组织性质。2. 计算层面:在经典图像识别任务上实现无反向传播的ISL机制,并使用极小规模训练集进行验证。3. 神经生物学层面:提出树突中结构吸引子的实现假说、神经编码作为内部吸引子动力学的投影、以及支持该学习概念的网络架构发育假说。
AI.result: 1. 数学上证明了结构归约过程的有限收敛、类结构吸引子的存在唯一性以及吸引子图的自组织性,模型具备数学一致性。2. 计算实验在不依赖反向传播、仅使用极小训练集的条件下,在经典图像识别任务中验证了该方法的可行性。3. 提出了一系列关于树突计算、突触可塑性和神经回路结构组织层面的可检验神经生物学假说(尚未获得实证支持)。
AI.conclusion: ISL理论在数学上是自洽的,在计算上是可行的,所提出的神经生物学假说为未来的实验验证提供了方向,但其生物学合理性仍属于待检验的假说,不能视为已确立的事实。整体上,本文为摆脱基于损失优化的学习范式提供了一种结构吸引子驱动的替代框架。

title: NormViz: A Benchmark and Framework for Grounding Multimodal Reasoning in Global Cultures
comment: Accepted to Conference on Language Modeling (COLM) 2026. 37 pages, 23 figures
summary: AI systems are used worldwide, but they struggle to serve the needs of culturally diverse populations. Prior work on cultural understanding evaluates AI systems on text-only settings or on visual artifact recognition (e.g. foods, clothing). The ability to reason about visually observable behaviors through local social norms, which we call visual norm understanding, remains unexamined. We introduce NormViz-Bench, a high quality, human-validated benchmark of 3,268 contrastive image pairs (6,536 images) spanning 16 countries. Each pair varies only in the culturally relevant behavior (e.g., objects, attributes, spatial relations, and actions) that alters how each image is interpreted. Each image is labeled as conforming to, violating, or irrelevant to local social norms, and pair-level evaluation requires both images to be correctly classified, thereby preventing reliance on superficial visual shortcuts. Even the strongest VLMs, Gemini 3.0 Flash and Qwen2.5 VL 7B, succeed on only 26.6% and 21.6% of pairs, struggling most with identifying violating and culturally benign visual behaviors. Towards bridging this, we introduce NormViz-Train, a training dataset of 64k images paired with explanations. Though absolute performance remains low (<30%), finetuning on NormViz-Train improves pair accuracy relatively by up to 125% and 36% Qwen3-VL 4B and 8B respectively, showing a path forward to teach models to connect visual perception to cultural significance. Together, NormViz-Bench and NormViz-Train establish visual norm understanding as a challenging and consequential frontier for multimodal AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NormViz-Bench（3,272个对比图像对，16国）和NormViz-Train（64k合成训练数据），揭示视觉语言模型在跨文化视觉规范理解任务上的显著不足：最强模型（Gemini 3.0 Flash）仅达25.3%组准确率，全球南方国家表现尤差，通过微调Qwen3-VL可提升至27.7%。
AI.motivation: 现有AI文化理解评估局限于文本或视觉物品识别，无法衡量模型对通过视觉可观察行为所体现的社会规范的推理能力（即"视觉规范理解"）。填补这一空白对构建跨文化多模态AI至关重要。
AI.method: 构建NormViz-Bench的五阶段流水线：(1)从三个文本基准（CulturalBench、NormAd、SafeWorld）收集文化规范；(2)GPT-4o提取元数据并按视觉可检测性过滤；(3)生成Follow/Avoid图像描述、Bengin反事实描述及inpainting指令；(4)通过Imagen 3.0文本生成图像、Gemini 2.0 Flash inpainting、DataComp检索三种方式获取图像；(5)由16国本土标注员人工验证（每对3次标注，仅保留多数一致的标注）。NormViz-Train则从CANDLE知识图谱出发，经去污染后用Stable Diffusion 3生成64k图像。评估21个VLM，对比组准确率（pair中两图均分类正确）与单图macro F1；通过两项oracle消融（加入图描述 / 仅用描述替代图像）诊断视觉感知、视觉-语言对齐、文化规范推理三重障碍。
AI.result: 1) 主结果：最佳模型Gemini 3.0 Flash组准确率仅25.3%，GPT-5.2为22.7%，Qwen2.5-VL 7B为23.0%；macro F1最高55.8%。检测Avoid行为（14–54 F1）显著弱于Follow行为（58–67 F1），全球南方（印度、印尼、肯尼亚）表现最差。2) 障碍诊断：三重障碍均显著——视觉感知（+图描述提升+9.0组准确率）、视觉-语言对齐（去图后进一步+4.9）、文化规范推理为最深障碍（即使仅文本，组准确率仅45.3%）。3) 微调效果：Qwen3-VL 4B组准确率提升86%（14.9%→27.7%），Qwen3-VL 8B提升36%（19.6%→26.7%），前者超越Gemini 3.0 Flash。增益在文化欠发达地区（南亚、东南亚、撒哈拉以南非洲）最显著（+15–25分），规范领域在仪礼、公开行为、餐饮礼仪改善最大；Avoid检测提升145%。
AI.conclusion: 视觉规范理解是多模态AI的开放且重要前沿。NormViz-Bench与NormViz-Train首次系统评估和提升该能力，但仍存在绝对性能低（<30%）和内在的三重障碍（感知、对齐、推理），需更丰富的训练信号（空间监督、文化对比目标）、更广文化代理范围及更深推理架构支持。

title: Learning transferable human physiology from two million hours of sleep with SleepFM-2
summary: Sleep provides a nightly window into health by capturing coordinated activity across the brain, heart, muscles and respiratory system. We introduce SleepFM-2, a sleep foundation model developed and evaluated on 282,511 polysomnography recordings from 26 cohorts, including 235,865 used for pretraining. These data span more than two million hours of multimodal physiology. Compared with SleepFM, SleepFM-2 improves disease prediction and sleep scoring, supports arousal, limb movement and respiratory event detection, and transfers to wearable sensing and subjective sleep phenotypes. A model combining its PSG representation with age, sex and BMI met a prespecified discrimination and significance criterion for 215 subsequently recorded EHR phenotypes in two held-out cohorts, including one health system unseen during pretraining. For 155 phenotypes, the PSG representation added reproducible information beyond demographics. SleepFM-2 also outperformed a 480-feature baseline derived from the same recordings. Its disease scores revealed a reproducible principal component associated with reduced sigma-band spatial coupling and increased hypnodensity entropy. The frozen encoder performed within the observed range of expert scorers for sleep events and transferred to wakeful EEG, headband and in-ear EEG, wrist PPG and wrist accelerometry. It improved sleep staging across six accelerometry cohorts and achieved disease-prediction performance in UK Biobank similar to models pretrained directly on accelerometry. Finally, SleepFM-2 captured aspects of subjective sleep not recovered by conventional PSG summaries, particularly reports of the recorded night. These results show that multimodal sleep physiology can provide a transferable representation of human health across diseases, clinical tasks, sensors and subjective experience.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍SleepFM-2，一种基于235,865个多导睡眠图(PSG)记录（超200万小时多模态生理数据）预训练的自监督睡眠基础模型。模型在跨26个队列的任务中表现优异：可预测215种EHR表型疾病、在专家水平上完成睡眠分期与事件标注、捕捉主观睡眠体验，并能迁移至腕戴加速度计等可穿戴传感器（即使与PSG无共享通道）。
AI.motivation: 睡眠期间的多模态生理信号（脑、心、肌、呼吸）含有丰富的健康信息，但临床实践中这些信号被压缩为少量睡眠分期和事件指数。自监督基础模型有望直接从原始信号中提取可迁移的生理表征，跨越疾病、临床任务、传感器和主观体验。已有SleepFM-1验证了可行性，但存在时间分辨率粗（5秒）、无法完成细粒度事件标注、是否捕捉主观睡眠和能否跨医疗系统迁移等问题。
AI.method: 采用四流多模态架构（脑眼/心/肌/呼吸），以1秒patch进行token化，使用28通道区域嵌入，共享1D CNN tokenizer。预训练采用两种互补目标：(1) leave-one-out模态对比学习（InfoNCE），(2) 通道-时间掩蔽自编码（L1重建），按时间块/通道块/随机三种掩蔽策略，掩蔽比0.55。编码器为LLaMA风格Transformer（2.57M参数），两阶段设计：Stage1跨通道-时间联合注意力，Stage2时间注意力。所有下游任务冻结编码器，仅训练轻量任务头（LSTMHead或LinearProbe）。
AI.result: 1) 疾病预测：在SSC和HSP两个医疗系统中（后者未参与预训练）预测215种phecode（C指数≥0.75且Bonferroni P<0.01），其中155种在人口统计学基础上提供独立增量信息，性能超过480个可解释特征基线。2) 睡眠评分：在4类任务上达到专家评分员水平（皮层觉醒、肢体运动、呼吸事件、睡眠分期），跨7个队列macro F1达0.716-0.818。3) 表征分析：发现一个主导的"一般性生理风险"主成分（解释57-58%方差），与sigma波段空间耦合降低和hypnodensity熵增加相关。4) 跨模态迁移：在23个清醒EEG数据集、头带/耳内EEG、腕部PPG和加速度计上迁移有效；在UK Biobank加速度计疾病预测任务上与直接预训练的加速度计基础模型性能相当（C=0.687 vs 0.688）。5) 主观睡眠：在BioSerenity数据上对记录当晚6项问卷全部优于基线，对习惯性睡眠指标增益较小。模型可通过网页界面SleepFM-Interface进行访问。
AI.conclusion: SleepFM-2证明单一冻结编码器可从临床多导睡眠图的多模态生理信号中提取跨疾病、临床任务、传感器和主观体验的可迁移表征。200万小时的PSG预训练产生的表征可在不更新权重的情况下迁移至无共享通道的腕戴加速度计，揭示PSG不仅是传统睡眠指标的来源，更是可编码迁移的人类生理高维窗口。该工作为临床生理信号的AI应用提供了新的范式，预训练于丰富临床数据、迁移至可穿戴传感器，结合两者优势推动睡眠医学从睡眠实验室走向日常生活监测。

title: A visual large language foundational model for medical image recognition using clinician-oriented social media
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities across diverse domains, showing considerable potential in medicine. However, their application in medical settings remains limited by the scarcity of visual question answering (VQA) datasets that capture clinical reasoning and explicit image-text alignment. Here, we leverage de-identified medical images and expert commentaries shared on clinician-oriented social media. By combining an advanced LLM with clinician-in-the-loop verification, we established a rigorous pipeline to construct ThoughtMed-1M, a long-form medical VQA dataset containing over one million VQA pairs and designed to capture structured clinical logic and medical image-text alignment. To demonstrate its utility, we developed a FOundational LLM Trained on ThoughtMed-1M (FOLTMed). FOLTMed achieved state-of-the-art performance across 42 medical VQA benchmark datasets, with a macro accuracy of 85.4%, and generated more clinically coherent responses on the ThoughtMed-1M test set. It outperformed state-of-the-art models by 3--5% across factuality and similarity metrics, highlighting a scalable paradigm for advancing research on clinically grounded multimodal LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个名为ThoughtMed-1M的大规模长格式医学视觉问答(VQA)数据集，包含超过一百万个VQA对，并基于该数据集训练了基础多模态大模型FOLTMed，在42个医学VQA基准上实现了85.4%的宏准确率，超越现有最优模型3-5%。
AI.motivation: 现有医学领域的多模态大语言模型受限于缺乏能够捕捉临床推理过程以及显式图文对齐的视觉问答数据集，制约了其在真实医疗场景中的应用。
AI.method: 1. 数据构建：从临床医生社交媒体上获取去标识化的医学图像和专家评述，结合先进的大语言模型与"人在环路"（clinician-in-the-loop）的临床医生审核流程，构建严谨的流水线以生成ThoughtMed-1M数据集；2. 模型训练：基于该数据集训练了基础大模型FOLTMed（FOundational LLM Trained on ThoughtMed-1M）；3. 评估方法：在42个医学VQA基准数据集上评估性能，并在测试集上对事实性与相似度指标进行评测。
AI.result: FOLTMed在42个医学VQA基准数据集上实现了85.4%的宏准确率，达到最先进水平；在ThoughtMed-1M测试集上生成了更具临床一致性的回答；在事实性和相似性指标上较当前最优模型提升了3-5%。
AI.conclusion: ThoughtMed-1M为推进临床基础的多模态大语言模型研究提供了一个可扩展的范式，证明了结合社交媒体医学图像、专家评述与临床医生审核构建高质量医学VQA数据集的可行性，能够显著提升模型在医学问答任务中的临床推理能力。

title: When and Why LLM Causal Priors Help: Closed-Loop Prior Selection for Amortized Causal Inference
summary: Causal effect estimation asks how an outcome would change under an intervention, and medicine, economics, and public policy all treat it as a foundational task. Prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) amortize the task: a model trained on large numbers of programmatically generated synthetic causal tasks reads a new problem's observational data into context and returns an interventional-effect estimate in a single forward pass. The capability of such models is largely determined by the synthetic training prior, which is currently designed by hand, a bottleneck acknowledged by both Do-PFN and CausalPFN. Large language models (LLMs) can now ``draw'' plausible causal graphs for a given domain, suggesting that LLM-distilled graphs could serve as prior material. Whether injecting such graphs helps at all, where any gain comes from, and when injection helps. Practice has so far relied on manual trial and error. We propose a \emph{closed-loop prior selection framework} that casts prior injection as a budget-constrained optimization over a candidate prior pool. Candidates undergo cheap post-training and are scored by a composite metric dominated by real-domain generalization; the winner then receives full training and paired statistical validation. On a 7.34M-parameter Do-PFN, the framework's winner attains a formally significant $2.75\times$ gain on the primary evaluation domain, and its error falls below that of the uninjected official base. Generalization on an adjacent monitoring domain improves significantly, and no monitored capability degrades. Mechanism experiments show that the gain depends on the semantic content of the distilled graph rather than its structural diversity alone does not produce it (directional evidence). With this framework and this regularity in hand, the use of LLM causal priors stops being manual trial and error and becomes an empirically verifiable selection problem.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个闭环先验选择框架，将LLM蒸馏的因果图作为先验材料注入到PFN类摊销因果推断模型（Do-PFN）中，通过预算受限的优化在候选先验池中自动选择最优注入方案。在7.34M参数的Do-PFN上取得2.75×的显著增益，并通过九个受控实验归纳出"三条件经验规律"。
AI.motivation: 现有的Do-PFN和CausalPFN等摊销因果推断模型，其能力边界由手工设计的合成训练先验决定，这是一个公认瓶颈。LLM可以按需生成看似合理的因果图，但注入这些图是否有效、收益来源、何时有效——这些都依赖人工试错，缺乏系统化验证与自动化选择机制。
AI.method: 1) 将先验注入形式化为预算受限的优化问题（式3）；2) 两阶段闭环选择：第一阶段对候选先验池进行低成本后训练（5k步），用由真实域泛化主导的复合评分筛选；第二阶段对胜出候选进行完整训练（20k步）并配对统计验证；3) 复合评分权重为(0.50, 0.25, 0.15, 0.10)，真实域泛化占主导；4) 含自约束条款与预注册统计纪律（p<0.05且效应量阈值）；5) 三个理论定理分别支撑选择优于集成、探针-迁移排序反转、支持外风险不可界定。
AI.result: 主要结果（M4）：在主域law_race上，优胜配置（高温蒸馏图+50/30/20混合）达到NMSE 0.0211±0.0048，对照组0.0580±0.0143，配对t检验p=0.0086，2.75×增益（n=5）。该误差也低于未注入官方基线（0.0308±0.0083，描述性跨谱系对比）。邻近域sales也显著改善（p=0.0109），诊断面板未退化。机制实验（M5）：温度轴呈V形，T=0.7时退化（p=0.030），随机图同样结构多样性但语义被打乱，差2.1×——拒绝"纯多样性"假说，支持"内容胜于多样性"。M6：同一配方注入已强官方基线则退化4–9×并完全反转排序。M7：跨域从零蒸馏在sales域获3.0×增益（方向性）。M8：主域全面击败7个基线（含CausalPFN的4.1×/6.1×，p≤0.006）。M9：标准基准IHDP和Lalonde均为诚实边界——跨域负迁移，甚至域内蒸馏也无法修复（IHDP 26维远超[1,6]支持范围）。九个模块归纳出"三条件经验规律"：基础模型欠拟合+先验域匹配+任务在训练先验支持内，三者同时满足时注入才产生显著增益。
AI.conclusion: LLM因果先验注入从人工试错变为可经验验证的选择问题。该框架与三条件规律共同提供了可复用程序与操作性准则。诚实声明局限性：仅一个基础模型家族、两个自建域、两个标准基准；每条规律条件仅由单一实例支撑；条件二和三不可分离；注射永远不能超越天然强基线；标准基准上为负面结果。该工作的价值在于域特化与适用边界的完整描绘，而非在标准因果基准上超越现有方法。

title: iBrain: A Unified Foundation Model Reading the Brain from Surface to Spikes
summary: Invasive neural recordings provide high-fidelity measurements of brain activity, with signals such as intracranial EEG (iEEG) and intracortical spiking activity capturing neural dynamics at different spatial and temporal scales. Yet existing neural foundation models have largely been developed independently for different invasive recording paradigms, leaving joint pretraining across heterogeneous invasive signals underexplored. In this work, we introduce iBrain, a unified foundation model that jointly learns from iEEG and spiking activity. iBrain employs signal-specific encoders to accommodate their distinct signal characteristics and a shared spatiotemporal Transformer backbone to model dependencies across recording channels and time. We pretrain iBrain on over 7,000 hours of heterogeneous neural recordings using masked signal reconstruction and channel-view alignment, promoting contextual modeling of neural dynamics and robustness across different channels. iBrain consistently outperforms single-signal pretraining baselines and achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks. Further experiments demonstrate that iBrain exhibits transferability and data efficiency across diverse recording settings. These results highlight the potential of joint pretraining on heterogeneous invasive neural recordings to support scalable neural modeling and transferable representations across recording settings and downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: iBrain是首个联合学习iEEG与颅内spiking activity的统一基础模型，采用信号特定编码器+共享时空Transformer，在7000+小时异质神经记录上预训练，在8项下游任务中7项达到SOTA，并展现出良好的少样本学习能力和可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 现有神经基础模型通常针对单一侵入式记录范式（iEEG或spike）独立开发，未能充分利用iEEG（皮层表面/深部场电位）与spiking activity（神经元放电）在时空尺度上的互补信息，存在跨异质信号的联合预训练空白。
AI.method: 1) 信号特定编码器：iEEG用含残差路径的时间卷积适配器，spike用MLP适配器；2) 共享时空注意力骨干（6层Transformer，d=256）：criss-cross式通道注意力+时间注意力（含相对时间偏置）；3) 自监督预训练目标：masked reconstruction（iEEG用MSE，spike用Poisson NLL）+ 通道视图对齐（类似SimSiam）；4) iEEG与spike以1:1步交替训练。
AI.result: 在Brain TreeBank四个iEEG任务（AUC）和四个spike运动解码任务（R²）的8项基准中7项取得SOTA；联合预训练优于单一信号预训练；少样本场景下50%标签即可接近全量性能；消融验证通道视图对齐与时空注意力均贡献显著；扩展曲线表明数据收益随规模递减，提示需增加受试者/任务多样性。
AI.conclusion: 跨异质侵入式神经信号的联合预训练是可行且可扩展的方向，可产生跨记录接口和下游任务的通用神经表征；未来需通过增加数据多样性而非单纯堆叠数据量来进一步提升。

title: SSP-DMGTimeNet: Physics-Constrained Learning for Spatiotemporal Trajectory Prediction of Vehicle Platoons
summary: Existing car-following prediction methods mainly optimize trajectory accuracy, while rarely considering whether predicted disturbances propagate realistically along a vehicle platoon. This limitation may lead to accurate but string-unstable predictions. We propose SSP-DMGTimeNet, a physics-constrained learning framework for spatiotemporal trajectory prediction of vehicle platoons. The model combines multi-scale temporal representations with cross-vehicle interaction features to capture complex and time-varying platoon dynamics. A propagation-delay-aware causal attention mechanism explicitly models upstream-to-downstream disturbance propagation by learning response delays between adjacent vehicles and accumulating them along the platoon. In addition, time- and frequency-domain string-stability losses relieve disturbance amplification across both adjacent vehicles and arbitrary sub-platoons during training. Experiments on HighD show that SSP-DMGTimeNet achieves an unstable-window rate of 0.65\% for five-vehicle platoons and a maximum head-to-tail amplification of 0.898 on the ground-truth excitation subset, while maintaining competitive trajectory prediction performance. In zero-shot evaluation on NGSIM US-101 and I-80, the model achieves velocity MAEs of 1.316~m/s and 1.252~m/s, with unstable-window rates of 3.90\% and 4.10\%, respectively. These results demonstrate that incorporating platoon-level physical constraints can effectively balance trajectory prediction accuracy and disturbance propagation stability.

AI.tldr: SSP-DMGTimeNet是一个物理约束的时空轨迹预测框架，用于车队扰动传播建模。通过传播延迟感知因果注意力（SP-DACA）和时域/频域字符串稳定性损失，在保持轨迹预测精度的同时，显著降低车队不稳定性窗口率（HighD上0.65%），并在NGSIM上展现良好的零样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有跟车预测方法主要优化轨迹精度，忽略了预测扰动是否在车队中真实传播，可能导致精度高但字符串不稳定的预测结果。这揭示了单车/单时间步精度与车队级物理一致性之间的差距。
AI.method: 框架包含四个核心组件：（1）多尺度时间token提取（4个尺度，膨胀率1/3/7/11对应约0.3-2.3秒感受野）；（2）分层门控融合HGF，基于车辆位置和最细尺度自适应融合多尺度表示；（3）跨车辆协整特征提取CFE，通过相邻车辆均衡残差表征跟车偏离；（4）SP-DACA序列传播延迟感知因果注意力，学习相邻车辆响应延迟（0.3-2.5秒范围内）并沿车队累积，结合高斯延迟核和时空因果掩码；三层SP-DACA堆叠。训练损失包括预测损失和三类稳定性损失（相邻车辆、任意子车队、频域）。
AI.result: 在HighD测试集（5辆车队，5秒历史/3秒预测）：不稳定窗口率0.65%，GT激励子集上最大首尾放大因子0.898（低于1的稳定边界），尾车速度MAE 0.222 m/s。零样本评估NGSIM US-101和I-80：速度MAE分别为1.316和1.252 m/s，不稳定窗口率仅3.90%和4.10%（其他学习模型为87-97%）。车队长度敏感性分析显示N=3,5,6时不稳定率低于1%，N=7时升至24.73%。消融实验证实SP-DACA、HGF、CFE及时频稳定性损失的互补作用。学习延迟收敛至0.84-1.01秒的物理合理范围。
AI.conclusion: 将字符串稳定性作为训练时物理约束，可有效平衡轨迹预测精度与车队级动态一致性。学习到的传播延迟收敛到物理合理范围，频域分析显示无频率选择性放大。模型在跨数据集场景下展现良好泛化性，但长车队（N≥7）的扰动抑制仍具挑战。未来工作将扩展至异构车队并在闭环CACC/MPC系统中评估长时域性能。

title: RedKnot-MLA: Multi-Head Offline-Online Reuse for DeepSeek-V4 Long-Context Serving
summary: Multi-head latent attention (MLA) exposes many logical query heads through one packed latent KV stream. This representation is memory efficient, but it removes the physical per-head cache boundary assumed by conventional head-wise reuse. We present our system, a DeepSeek-V4 realization of RedKnot's head-aware reuse principle. Each immutable document is processed offline at canonical position zero; certified Local-head contributions are retained as MLA-Off. At serving time, query-side RoPE relocation restores the document's request position, a small Global-head set and protected Local token rows are recomputed as MLA-Online, and the two paths are merged before a single shared output projection. The packed MLA latent is never split. DeepSeek-V4-Flash uses 37 reusable layers and a 56/8 Local/Global partition, giving a 75.29% analytic logical head-row ceiling; the Pro-0813 profile uses 55 layers and 112/16 heads, giving 78.89%. Frozen Flash operating points show hot-artifact TTFT speedups of 2.02-3.84x. At 256K, the archived three-dataset study reports an aggregate F1 change of +3.24 percentage points, an EM change of +4.16 points, and a 78.7-79.5% analytic major-operator arithmetic saving, while one dataset decreases by 2.81 F1 points. A separate author-reported 256K hot-artifact QPS measurement is approximately 2.0x; because its raw concurrency trace is not included in this bundle, we mark it as preliminary rather than archived evidence. We describe the factorization, position repair, token-row closure, sparse-MoE support, TP8 integration, and the measurement boundaries needed to interpret these results.

AI.tldr: RedKnot-MLA针对DeepSeek-V4的多头潜在注意力(MLA)架构,提出了一种头级别的离线/在线复用机制。它在保持MLA单一压缩潜在KV流不变的前提下,将逻辑头分为Local(离线预计算)和Global(在线重算)两组,通过对查询端RoPE重定位修复位置信息,并融合被保护token行的修正结果,在共享输出投影前合并两个路径。Flash配置实现2.02-3.84倍的hot-artifact TTFT加速,256K聚合F1提升+3.24个百分点,但存在个别数据集2.81点的F1回退。
AI.motivation: 传统KV复用方案(如CacheBlend、CatchSlide等)依赖逐头的物理缓存边界,而MLA将所有逻辑头压缩到单一潜在KV流中,若按逻辑头物理化缓存会破坏其原生紧凑表示,反而浪费显存。因此需要一种不拆分MLA压缩潜在态的头粒度复用机制,在保留MLA内存效率优势的同时实现非前缀文档的复用。
AI.method:
1. 逻辑头分解:将H个逻辑头分为Local集和Global集,Local头在离线时以规范位置0独立计算并存储投影后的离线贡献z_off,Global头在线重算得到z_online,二者按切片投影W_{a,L}和W_{a,G}相加,再经共享W_b投影。
2. 位置修复:利用RoPE正交性,在线时将查询旋转-Δ_i,直接对规范位置的潜在态C_i做注意力,无需重写或拼接物理缓存。
3. 受保护token行闭包:集合𝒜=Q∪N∪D∪B_{128}∪I_top∪T_{32K},对应查询行、新增行、脏行、边界行、Indexer选中行与32K尾部行,缓存值被替换而非双重计数。
4. 索引器引导的token行减少与自适应稀疏MoE:基于路由权重归一化截断Top-k专家(k∈{3,4,5,6},阈值τ),作为头复用的辅助手段。
5. TP8集成:层次分组预取、CUDA流、SegPagedAttention分段合并,使用设备事件而非主机轮询。
AI.result:
1. Flash配置(3F-37R-3F,56/8 Local/Global):结构化逻辑头行上限75.29%;hot-artifact TTFT加速为64K 2.91×、128K 3.20×、256K 2.02×、440K 3.84×。
2. Pro-0813配置(3F-55R-3F,112/16):上限78.89%,目前仅有TP8负载/HTTP冒烟验证。
3. 256K三数据集研究(2WikiMQA/HotpotQA/MultiFieldQA-en):聚合F1从0.5723升至0.6047(+3.24pp),EM从0.4167升至0.4583(+4.16pp),但MultiFieldQA-en下降2.81 F1点。
4. 物理token行平均节省78.3%,主算子算术节省78.7%-79.5%。
5. 作者报告约2.0×的256K hot-artifact QPS,但因并发轨迹未公开被标记为初步结果。
AI.conclusion: RedKnot-MLA证明可在不破坏MLA原生压缩潜在表示的前提下,通过头级因子分解、查询端RoPE位置修复和受保护行修正实现DeepSeek-V4长上下文的高效复用。Flash档案数据显示多档TTFT加速与聚合质量保持,但个别数据集出现可见回归。报告明确区分了归档热诊断、初步QPS与分析算术台账三类证据,强调证据边界与可复现性,而非给出单一统一的性能声明。

title: Beyond One-Shot Expansion: Contrastive Evidence Exploration for Multi-Hop Retrieval
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) critically depends on retrieving the evidence necessary for effective reasoning. However, this remains particularly challenging in multi-hop question answering (QA), where supporting passages are often linked through intermediate entities and relations that must be progressively uncovered. Existing retrieval approaches typically rely on a single retrieval intent or one-shot query expansion, limiting their ability to adapt to newly retrieved evidence and potentially introducing noisy or redundant retrieval signals. To address these limitations, we propose a training-free multi-hop retrieval framework that integrates evidence-conditioned exploration, passage-specific contrastive refinement, and coverage-aware final ranking. During offline indexing, the framework constructs passage-specific contrastive facets that characterize each passage relative to its semantically similar neighbors, providing fine-grained signals to distinguish closely related candidates. At inference time, the framework iteratively retrieves evidence, generates probes targeting unresolved information needs, refines candidate relevance using the contrastive facets, and selects a complementary set of passages that collectively cover diverse evidence-seeking intents. Experiments on MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and 2WikiMultihopQA demonstrate consistent improvements in retrieval quality and downstream QA performance over baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种免训练的多跳检索框架，通过证据条件探索、段落级对比精炼和覆盖感知排序三个机制，解决现有RAG方法在多跳问答中依赖单一检索意图或一次性查询扩展的局限性。
AI.motivation: 多跳问答中，支撑段落通过中间实体和关系链接，需逐步揭示。现有检索方法依赖单一检索意图或一次性查询扩展，无法适应新检索到的证据，且可能引入噪声或冗余信号，限制了多跳推理的有效性。
AI.method: 框架分两阶段：(1)离线构建段落级对比面（contrastive facets）——为每个段落生成能区分其与相似邻居的自然语言查询，构建对比索引；(2)在线执行多跳检索——迭代检索证据、生成针对未解决信息需求的探测查询，利用对比面对候选进行精炼，最后通过覆盖感知贪心排序选择互补段落集合，结合个体相关性与证据覆盖增益。
AI.result: 在MuSiQue、HotpotQA和2WikiMultihopQA三个数据集上，该方法在检索质量（R@5、FSR@10、MAP@10、nDCG@10）和下游QA性能（EM、F1）上均一致优于基线。MuSiQue上FSR@10从39.20提升至57.00，消融实验表明序贯证据探索贡献最大，对比精炼和覆盖感知排序提供额外增益。
AI.conclusion: 条件化于逐步发现的证据并显式考虑证据覆盖，构成了一种有效的免训练多跳检索方法。但存在计算成本限制：对比面构建需对每个目标-邻居对进行LLM生成，序贯探索需重复调用LLM进行证据摘要和探测生成，可能增加离线处理和推理延迟。

title: VST: Verifiable Structured Transport for Auditable Agent-to-Agent Alpha Discovery
summary: Agent-to-agent (A2A) alpha discovery is slowed by repeated feedback cycles between mining and evaluation agents, whose hand-offs, in contemporary LLM multi-agent systems, are free-form natural-language messages that carry no stable contract and cannot be replayed. We first restructure this communication as a structured agent-to-agent protocol of \emph{typed, causally addressable, unicast records}, so that the committed stream forms a causal trajectory. On that trajectory a single predictor with four typed heads forecasts the accumulated guidance the two miners would receive several cycles ahead; a transactional verify--leap controller then commits a multi-cycle speculative outcome only when it passes a four-level gate, and otherwise rolls back to the exact prior state. Structure is the enabling contribution, and its value is not accuracy. A controlled ablation shows an equal-information free-text channel reaches the same predictor hit rate. What typing provides is a state that can be schema-checked, replayed deterministically, and prevented by construction from leaking a forecast to an evaluator: auditability by construction, not an empirically stress-tested guarantee. On a CSI~1000 out-of-sample holdout, our single run is the only one among eight methods (seven baselines and ours) to hold a positive median annualized return and Sharpe at the factor level, though the median return \emph{in excess} of the benchmark stays negative for every method including ours; its development-selected top-20 portfolios reach a $0.71$ median holdout Sharpe, selected on a split inside the optimization horizon. We report these single-run results descriptively, gross of costs, and are explicit about their limits throughout; in particular we do not isolate the effect of the leap machinery from the inherited search substrate, which we leave to future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VST（Verifiable Structured Transport），将多智能体 alpha 发现系统中智能体间的自由文本通信重构为类型化、可因果寻址、单播的结构化记录通道，使其形成可回放的对齐轨迹；在此基础上引入多步预测器与事务性"验证—跳跃"控制器，以多周期投机结果在四层门控通过时原子提交，否则精确回滚。其核心贡献在于架构正确性（可审计、可回放、结构性防泄漏）而非预测精度。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体 alpha 发现系统（如双环进化搜索）的主要瓶颈在于矿工与评估智能体之间的串行往返通信，而非单次计算开销。现有系统普遍依赖自由文本或松散结构的自然语言进行协调，无法形成稳定、可回放的记录契约，因此既无法预测交互走向，也无法安全地"跳跃"到未来状态。论文主张：通信层的结构化是实现可验证多周期加速的先决条件，而非优化项。
AI.method: 论文以既有双环 alpha 发现系统为固定底座，提出 VST 范式，包含四项贡献：(C1) 三层 A2A 结构化通信协议（信封+角色体+事务性来源），具备确定性单播路由与可见性类型，保证可因果寻址、可回放、结构性防止预测泄漏给评估器；(C2) 多步结构化轨迹预测器——单个共享编码器策略加四个类型化解码头，直接预测未来 k 个周期内两矿工累积指导信号，并附带校准置信度与认知不确定性；(C3) 四层事务性验证跳跃控制器（L1 包合法性/路由策略、L2 实际输出一致性、L3 盲评估风险、L4 开发集经验质量），通过则原子提交，否则回滚到精确先验状态；(C4) 预测器与评估器技能库事务性分离，防止预测器"教会"评估器同意自身预测的奖励黑客风险。预测器采用智能体强化学习，以门控提交/回滚结果为交易级奖励信号。
AI.result: 在 CSI 1000 留出集（holdout）上的单次运行中，OURS 是八种方法（七种基线+本方法）中唯一保持因子级正年化收益（+0.059）与正中位 Sharpe（+0.346，bootstrap 95% CI [+0.21, +0.51] 全在零以上）的方法；按验证集 Sharpe 排序的 top-K 同条件比较在 K=100、200 上仍领先。开发集选出的前 20 个投资组合在 holdout 上中位 Sharpe 达 +0.71、中位年化收益 +13.3%（毛收益，未扣成本）。但所有方法的超额收益（相对基准）仍为负，且 IC/ICIR 并非最高。结构化与自由文本的消融实验显示：两者在预测器命中率（0.9749 vs 0.9754）、平均跳跃周期、LLM 调用次数上无可测差异；结构化的价值不在精度，而在类型契约、确定性回放与可见性泄漏防护——自由文本通道结构性无法表达"预测路由"第九项验证检查。跳跃日志显示 1646 轮中 1308 次提交、33 次回滚（无 L1/L2 回滚，回滚集中在 L3/L4）。
AI.conclusion: VST 的核心论断是结构先于跳跃：将智能体间通信重构为类型化、可回放的记录，是在多智能体工作流中实现可验证投机加速的架构前提。结构化本身不提升预测精度（消融证实），其价值在于正确性属性——可模式校验、可确定性回放、结构性防止预测泄漏——这些是自由文本通道在结构上无法提供的。论文将设计定位为面向受监管/模型风险治理场景的"决策可审计性"而非"决策可复现性"，并坦承尚未隔离跳跃机制与继承底座的独立贡献、缺乏跨市场迁移验证、未做净成本评估、未对安全属性做压力测试等局限。

title: A Hierarchical Consistency Framework for Auditing Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is commonly evaluated by whether the final answer is correct. That test is insufficient: an answer can match its reference while the context that produced it contains a direct contradiction, leaving the contested evidence invisible to answer-only review and retrieval relevance scores. This paper presents the Hierarchical Consistency Framework (HCF), a post-hoc, model-agnostic audit of three distinct levels of a RAG process: the knowledge corpus, the final retrieved context, and the generated answer. HCF represents corpus conflicts as source-linked atomic facts, thereby identifying the documents responsible, and returns each Answer Consistency Score (ACS) with an explanation of supporting and contradictory contextual statements. We evaluate HCF on several controlled corpora spanning five domains and 100 query-corpus instances. A human evaluator compares every generated response with its supplied ground-truth response. The results show that the three diagnostic levels can dissociate: the corpus with the highest mean retrieval similarity has the lowest mean ACS, while a structurally degraded corpus performs worse at corpus level but better at answer level. Most importantly, HCF identifies contradictory retrieved evidence in several cases where the answer still matches the ground truth. HCF does not certify factual truth; it makes the evidence supporting and challenging an answer inspectable and attributable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出层级一致性框架（HCF），对RAG系统在语料库、检索证据和生成答案三个层级进行事后审计，通过原子事实提取检测跨文档冲突，并在答案匹配参考时识别被掩盖的矛盾证据。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG评估仅判断最终答案是否正确，无法揭示答案虽正确但检索上下文中存在直接矛盾的隐患；检索相似度也无法区分主题相关但事实冲突的证据。
AI.method: HCF包含三层诊断：语料库一致性（IaDNI评估文档结构质量、IeDCD通过原子事实三元组检测跨文档冲突）、检索一致性（SS₁、SSμ、SSσ指标）、答案一致性（ACS评估答案与检索证据的支撑与矛盾关系），并在五个领域构建2×2因子设计的四组受控语料库（A基线、B冲突、C噪声、D组合）进行实验验证。
AI.result: 在100个查询-语料库实例上的实验表明，三个诊断层级可解耦：语料B虽CC较高（0.870）但平均ACS最低（0.8780），且平均检索相似度最高（0.8843）；语料C语料层最差但答案层表现较好；ACS在多个答案与参考答案匹配但检索证据包含矛盾陈述的案例中成功识别了冲突证据。
AI.conclusion: HCF使支撑和质疑答案的证据可被审查并可溯源，但并非事实真伪认证；该框架作为互补诊断工具，揭示了语义相似性与证据一致性之间的本质差异，为RAG系统审计提供了分层可解释性。

title: Risk Is Not Review Value: Wrong-Answer Exposure Under Bounded Review Budgets
summary: LLM assistants often produce more answers than humans can review before users see them. Most evaluations ask whether an answer is wrong, unsupported, or low-confidence. Bounded review budgets instead ask which answers should be checked first under a fixed review budget. Risk alone is not enough: a high-risk answer may be hard to repair, while a moderately risky answer may be directly correctable from available evidence. For generated-answer evaluation, we model review prioritization as exposure reduction, where review value combines estimated wrongness, intervention affordance, impact, and cost. We evaluate review queues with Wrong-Answer Exposure Ratio (WAER), the fraction of wrong answers left unreviewed, and post-repair residual exposure (PRRE), the fraction still exposed after deterministic benchmark-supported repairs. PRRE uses repairability rules that do not numerically reuse the affordance scores used for ranking. On a 720-item TAT-QA/SciFact stress benchmark, review-value ranking keeps answer-level WAER nearly unchanged at 20% budget (0.605 vs. 0.600) but lowers PRRE from 0.881 to 0.716. These results show that trustworthy LLM evaluation should measure not only error detection, but also how limited review capacity reduces exposed wrong answers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在有限人工审核预算下评估LLM生成答案的新框架：将"哪些错误答案应优先审核"建模为"暴露减少"分配问题，核心论点是"风险≠审核价值"。提出两个新指标WAER（错答暴露率）和PRRE（修复后残余暴露率），并在720条TAT-QA/SciFact基准上证明：仅按风险排序与按审核价值排序在WAER上几乎持平（0.605 vs 0.600），但PRRE显著降低（0.881 vs 0.716），说明优先审核"可修复的"错误更有价值。
AI.motivation: LLM助手产生的答案量远超人类审核能力。现有的LLM评估多关注"答案是否错误"，但在有限审核预算下，更关键的问题是"哪些答案应优先被审核"。仅靠风险评分（risk score）排序不够——一个高风险但难以修复的错误，与一个中等风险但可直接根据证据纠正的错误相比，后者应被优先审核。论文将"风险"与"审核价值"区分开来，强调评估应关注有限审核能力下"暴露的错误答案"的减少量。
AI.method: 1. **形式化框架**：将审核优先级建模为暴露减少分配问题。审核价值RV_i = r_i × c_i × h_i / q_i，其中r_i为错误风险，c_i为干预可承受性（affordance），h_i为影响/严重程度，q_i为审核成本。2. **提出两个新指标**：- **WAER**（Wrong-Answer Exposure Ratio）：截断审核队列后未被审核的错误答案占比。- **PRRE**（Post-Repair Residual Exposure）：经确定性基准修复后仍暴露的错误答案占比。修复性标志ρ_i基于基准数据力学确定，不复用排序所用的affordance数值。3. **构建诊断基准**：720条TAT-QA/SciFact公共数据样本，包含360个受控错误答案与360个匹配对照，控制错误类型包括数值扰动、方向翻转、范围扭曲、结论失配等，并为每种类型预设干预可承受性和影响先验（g_i, d_i, h_i）。4. **策略对比**：比较纯风险排序（confidence、rule/surface、LLM-judge）与审核价值排序，以及评估用的gold-factor和oracle变体。5. **实验设计**：在20%审核预算下进行32个外层种子的确定性压力测试，并进行错误率扫描（5%-30%）、先验敏感性分析、模板改写和成本代理检查。
AI.result: 在20%审核预算、32种子均值下：- WAER：纯风险代理0.605 vs 审核价值代理0.600（几乎持平，且均接近1−B/W=0.600的捕获下限）。- PRRE：纯风险代理0.881 vs 审核价值代理0.716（显著降低）。- 配对源事实聚类自助法：ΔPRRE = −0.165 [−0.168, −0.160]，ΔRVE = −0.116，均排除0，偏向审核价值。- 错误类型分解：审核价值队列几乎捕获所有数值扰动（WAER=0.067），但所有范围扭曲仍留在审核截止线以下（WAER=1.000）。- 同风险消融实验：固定风险评分r_i后，仅改变排序目标（r_i vs r_i·c_i vs r_i·c_i·h_i），WAER不变（0.600），但PRRE从0.767降至0.600，证明收益来自队列分配目标而非更强的验证器。- 预算扫描：审核价值排序在5%/10%/20%/40%所有预算下均降低PRRE。- 先验敏感性：在±0.1/±0.2/±0.3随机扰动下，PRRE分别100.0%/94.3%/84.3%概率偏向审核价值；固定+0.2偏移时优势消失。- 错误率扫描（5%-30%）：审核价值在所有错误率下均降低PRRE。- LLM辅助验证器200项试点验证了相同机制。
AI.conclusion: 1. **核心结论**：风险≠审核价值。LLM评估在有限审核预算下应被视为"暴露减少"分配问题，审核优先级应综合考虑错误风险、干预可承受性、影响和成本。2. **方法贡献**：区分了"错误检测"与"有限审核容量下错误暴露的减少"，提出WAER和PRRE两个新指标，并设计了修复性规则不复用排序先验的评估机制。3. **实践意义**：当错误检测器已达较高性能后，改进队列分配策略（优先审核可修复的错误）比进一步提升验证器更能有效降低用户暴露的错误信息。4. **局限**：实验基于受控公共数据压力测试，使用合成的答案变体；干预可承受性先验是基准假设而非运营效用估计；PRRE的"确定性可恢复"规则是保守诊断选择；不构成生产环境普遍性估计。5. **未来工作**：需用人类审核数据验证或替换类型先验，探索更多错误类型和自然分布。

title: Beyond Sparse Rewards: A New Benchmark and Structure-Aware Graph Alignment for Micro-Drama Understanding
summary: Micro-dramas, characterized by ultra-short durations and hyper-dense storylines, pose unique challenges for video understanding that conventional benchmarks fail to address. To bridge this gap, we introduce M-Drama, the first large-scale bilingual benchmark for micro-drama comprehension, featuring over 35K instances across 9,138 clips. Furthermore, while reinforcement learning can enhance VLMs on complex narratives, existing reward metrics often suffer from sparse and superficial signals, failing to capture intricate character identities and temporal structures. We propose SAGA (Structure-Aware Graph Alignment), a novel graph-matching reward function that models narratives as heterogeneous graphs. SAGA computes dense, rigorous rewards via decoupled semantic triplet and structural temporal matching. Extensive experiments on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct demonstrate that SAGA outperforms existing baselines, delivering substantial improvements in open-ended accuracy and summary quality, while maintaining competitive out-of-domain generalization. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文针对短视频平台流行的微短剧（micro-drama,1-3分钟、9:16竖屏、高密度剧情）提出两项核心贡献：(1) 发布首个大规模双语微短剧理解基准 M-Drama,涵盖35,472条实例、9,138个片段,围绕角色、情节、场景三大要素设计9类细粒度任务,支持选择题、开放式题和摘要三种评测格式;(2) 提出 SAGA（Structure-Aware Graph Alignment）奖励函数,将剧情建模为异质图（Character/Event/Prop/Scene 节点 + 语义边与时序边）,通过解耦的语义三元组匹配（Semantic Triplet Matching）和结构时序匹配（Structural Temporal Matching）提供密集奖励信号,以解决强化学习中稀疏奖励和表层语义监督不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有影视/剧集理解基准（如 MovieNet、TVQA、DramaQA、MovieChat、InfiniBench、Video-Holmes、SeriesBench 等）均聚焦于横屏长视频,而微短剧具有"超短时长+超高叙事密度"的独特特点,带来快速场景切换、角色密集出现、因果链压缩等新挑战;同时,用于 VLM 强化学习的奖励指标（词法度量、LLM 评判）存在稀疏和浅层信号问题,无法捕捉角色身份与时序结构错误。
AI.method: 方法分两部分: ① 数据集构建——基于 YouTube 收集微短剧,人工标注时间戳分割为单集,由 Gemini-2.5-Pro 生成中英字幕与摘要,GPT-5 生成 MC/OE 题及推理过程,测试集经三人独立交叉人工核验。② SAGA 奖励——将真值与预测字幕转换为四类节点、六类边（语义边 Agent_Of/Target_Of/Has_Prop/Located_In 与时序边 Next_Event）的异质图;语义三元组匹配通过级联规则化实体匹配、邻居指纹（neighborhood fingerprint）事件匹配和匈牙利算法二部图对齐计算 F1_sem;结构时序匹配通过 Next_Event 边的传递闭包计算 F1_struct;最终 R_cap = β·F1_struct + (1-β)·F1_sem,并以 DAPO 为基础 RL 算法,对 caption 段施加 token 级掩码,联合优化答案奖励与中间字幕奖励。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 上的实验表明: SAGA 取得开放式问答 Pass@1 准确率 40.0%,较标准 DAPO 绝对提升 5.1%,较 SFT 提升 4.1%;摘要质量在 DeepSeek-V3.2 与 GPT-5-mini 评判下均取得最高分（5.74/6.41）;在 Video-Holmes、Video-MME、ShortVid-Bench 三个域外基准上均稳定优于同训练设定的 DAPO 基线（46.7/64.9/72.8）,无灾难性遗忘;消融实验证实 F1_struct 与 F1_sem 互补,移除任一组件均导致开放式任务性能下降;任务级分析显示,语义三元组匹配对角色动机类提升显著（+14.3%）,结构时序匹配对叙事分析与逻辑推理类带来 +8.0%~+8.4% 的增益;微短剧叙事密度统计显示其事件密度（6.32/min）和角色密度（1.94/min）显著高于 MovieChat 与 Video-Holmes。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明,通过将剧集叙事显式建模为带类型节点的异质图,并以解耦的语义-时序图匹配奖励替代稀疏监督,可显著提升 VLM 在密集叙事视频上的开放式推理与摘要能力;M-Drama 填补了微短剧理解的基准空白,SAGA 为视频强化学习提供了密集、可解释的结构化奖励设计范式。未来工作将引入音频线索、属性级节点及多模态对齐,并将框架扩展到更大规模的基础模型。

title: EEG-Driven Decoding Framework for Passenger Hazard Perception in Highly Automated Vehicles
comment: 31 pages, 8 figures, 13 tables, including appendices. Accepted for publication in Automotive Innovation. Yingkai Yang and Ashton Yu Xuan Tan contributed equally. Corresponding author: Hong Wang. Data: this https URL ; Code: this https URL
summary: Reliable risk assessment remains a central challenge for Autonomous Vehicles (AVs). Despite advances in automation, passenger cognition provides a non-intrusive auxiliary signal that improves both objective and perceived safety without requiring active human intervention. We introduce an Electroencephalogram (EEG)-based Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) that decodes passenger neural responses for both Risk Prediction (RP) and Danger Identification (DI), explicitly modeling humans as passengers to match real-world AV use. To achieve this, we propose the Passenger Cognitive Model (PCM), Risk-aware Sequential Labeling (RSL), and the Passenger EEG Decoding Strategy (PEDS), which integrates a 3D Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network (3D-CRNN) model for joint EEG decoding. Experimental results show that 3D-CRNN achieves a Balanced Accuracy (BA) of $95.3\% \pm 2.7\%$ in RP and improves single-subject DI from $80.9\% \pm 3.9\%$ to $85.0\% \pm 3.2\%$ with RSL. Event-wise analyses further show that 3D-CRNN consistently outperforms other models across different event types in RP and DI. In generalization experiments, 3D-CRNN achieves $77.0\% \pm 5.3\%$ BA in cross-session DI and $77.4\% \pm 1.1\%$ BA on seen subjects in cross-subject evaluation, while maintaining a $64.9\% \pm 8.5\%$ BA on unseen subjects, demonstrating promising generalizability and transferability across both intra-subject and inter-subject variability. These findings establish an Electroencephalogram (EEG) decoding framework for AV passenger hazard perception and suggest that passenger cognitive signals can provide auxiliary supervision for future AV decision-making and Safety of the Intended Functionality (SOTIF) support.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种以乘客为中心的EEG解码框架,用于高度自动驾驶车辆中的危险感知。该框架通过3D-CRNN模型联合执行风险预测(RP)和危险识别(DI)两个任务,引入乘客认知模型(PCM)和风险感知序列标注(RSL)将神经认知机制融入解码策略,在自建数据集上取得了优异的性能与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 高度自动驾驶车辆(AV)的安全仍面临挑战,现有数据驱动算法在不可预见场景中表现不足。以往基于EEG的驾驶研究多以驾驶员为中心、聚焦于即时危险检测,而忽略了乘客这一更具观察性和预期性认知反应的角色。此外,现有EEG解码器通常将分类视为孤立任务,缺乏对风险预期与危险识别之间序列关系的建模。为填补这些空白,本文探索将乘客EEG信号作为辅助监督信号以增强AV安全性。
AI.method: 本文提出三大核心组件:(1) 乘客认知模型(PCM):通过EEG地形图分析将交通阶段与乘客神经响应关联,刻画从"平静"到"紧张"以及从"主动观察"到"决策"的认知过渡;(2) 风险感知序列标注(RSL):基于"潜在危险(risky/not risky)"与"已实现危险(dangerous/not dangerous)"两个二元轴构建三级风险等级(Safe/Low-Risk/High-Risk),并耦合RP与DI任务标签;(3) 乘客EEG解码策略(PEDS):采用基于电极拓扑的3D-CRNN,将EEG重塑为6×9×T的3D张量,通过双分支3D CNN编码器分别提取RP(因果性前事件窗口[-2.0,-0.5]s)与DI(事件中心窗口[-0.2,1.0]s)的时空特征,并通过GRU融合生成最终DI预测。实验在15名参与者、14种交通场景、45小时乘客EEG数据集上进行,采用EEGNet、ShallowConvNet、DeepConvNet、CTNet、DSC-ConvLSTM、XGB-DIM作为基线对比。
AI.result: 在单被试实验中,3D-CRNN在RP任务上达到95.3%±2.7%的平衡准确率(BA),在DI任务上结合RSL将BA从80.9%±3.9%提升至85.0%±3.2%。事件级分析显示,在AEB、切入和行人三类场景中,3D-CRNN均表现最优,DI的BA分别为77.8%、88.0%和79.9%。泛化实验方面:跨会话DI的BA达77.0%±5.3%;跨被试实验中,已见被试BA为77.4%±1.1%,未见被试BA为64.9%±8.5%(精度、召回率和F1均为最高)。推理延迟为10.616 ms/样本,模型包含77,922个可训练参数,具有实时部署潜力。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了首个面向高度自动驾驶车辆乘客危险感知的EEG解码框架,验证了乘客EEG同时蕴含预期性风险信息和刺激锁定的危险响应信息。PCM、RSL与PEDS的协同设计将神经认知机制、任务建模与深度学习统一起来,为AV安全研究和SOTIF支持提供了新的辅助监督信号。然而,该研究仍存在样本规模有限、模拟器环境受限、跨被试泛化性能下降等局限,未来需扩大受试者群体、引入域适应/迁移学习策略、并在真实驾驶环境中验证,同时结合眼动、心率等多模态信号以提升系统鲁棒性。

title: Encoded Early, Used Late: Where Transformers Begin to Act on an Inferred Partner's Expertise
comment: Published at the Scientific Understanding of Foundation Models (Sci-FM) Workshop at COLM 2026
summary: A transformer can make an attribute linearly decodable in its residual stream at a depth where that attribute does not yet influence the output. This gap between where information is readable and where it is used has been shown for attributes stated directly in the input. We ask whether it also holds for an attribute the model must infer gradually over a conversation, namely how expert its dialogue partner is. Using ExpertCollab, a corpus of multi-turn research-planning dialogues between model-played personas at four expertise levels, we find that partner expertise is most decodable in the early layers and falls to near chance before the midpoint of the network. Counterfactual patching shows that injecting the expertise difference at the layer of peak decodability barely changes a fixed late-layer readout, whereas the same difference injected past the midpoint propagates almost completely, a separation of more than an order of magnitude. A content-matched random control and a probe-free diagnostic place the transition at the same early layer, and a statically specified control attribute stays decodable throughout. An inferred relational attribute is therefore represented well before it becomes causally active, which bounds where any attempt to read out or steer partner-conditioned behavior must intervene. We use one model on a synthetic corpus as an initial demonstration.

AI.tldr: 论文研究 Transformer 如何在多轮对话中推断并使用对话伙伴的专业水平。结果显示，伙伴专业水平在网络的第 8 层最容易被线性探针解码，但此时注入相关信息几乎不会改变最终层表示或输出；到第 36 层才出现显著因果效应，并在第 40 层后接近完全恢复。相比之下，系统提示中直接给定的说话者自身水平在所有层都保持可解码。论文由此指出：残差流中的“信息可读”不等于“信息被使用”，推断性属性存在明显的“早编码、晚致用”深度间隔。
AI.motivation: 已有研究发现，直接出现在输入中的某些属性在某一层已经可被探针解码，却要到更晚的层才真正影响输出；但对于需要模型在多轮互动中逐步推断的关系属性，尚不清楚是否存在同样的可读性与因果作用之间的分离。论文选择对话伙伴的专业水平作为研究对象，因为它只能从对方的表达和互动方式中间接推断，是检验这一问题的合适案例。
AI.method: 作者构建 ExpertCollab：一个包含 28 个研究规划多轮对话、每个对话 12 轮、由 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 扮演四种专业水平角色的合成语料库。专业水平不通过学历或资历明说，而仅通过发言风格体现。作者在模型生成下一轮前的参与者视角位置提取残差流激活，每隔 4 层采样，使用 L2 正则化多项逻辑回归探针测量说话者自身水平和伙伴专业水平的可解码性。随后构造 48 组仅伙伴专业水平不同的反事实对话对，在不同层注入伙伴表示差异，并固定在最后一层用探针读取，计算归一化因果效应。另设置同层校准、范数匹配的随机向量、无需探针的余弦差异和下一词分布诊断作为控制。
AI.result: 伙伴专业水平的探针准确率在第 8 层达到约 0.79，并在第 40 层附近降至接近四分类随机水平 0.25；相对地，说话者自身水平在所有层均保持约 0.60 以上。相同层的反事实补丁效应平均约为 1.01，说明测量校准正常；在第 8 层注入差异的效应仅约 0.01，到第 36 层升至 0.86，第 40 层以后超过 0.90，呈现超过一个数量级的差异。随机向量控制没有类似上升。无需探针的最终层余弦差异也在第 8 层后快速增加，并与探针效应定位到相同的早期转折。晚层补丁大约改变输出概率最高五个词中的一个，而第 8 层补丁几乎不改变输出。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出核心结论：对需要推断的伙伴专业水平，Transformer 会在早期层写入并保留可读表示，但该表示只有在网络后段才真正进入影响输出的因果计算路径。说话者自身水平这一由系统提示直接指定的属性则没有同样的延迟。由此作者提出，残差流的跳跃连接虽然使早期信息持续可读，却不能证明该信息正在被模型使用；因此，功能解释和模型干预应将探针与因果干预结合，而不能仅依据最高解码层进行判断。

title: An Auditable Symbolic-RAG-Generative AI Architecture for Goal-Oriented Conversation Orchestration
comment: 14 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables, Appendices with complete experiments
summary: Goal-oriented conversational systems must answer factual questions, understand visitor-provided information, and advance business objectives without becoming rigid questionnaires. This paper proposes a Symbolic-RAG-Generative architecture centered on the Goal-oriented Retrieval-Augmented Conversation Engine (GRACE). An instruction-constrained Business Goal Compiler transforms business intent into an immutable objective set, normalized priority vector, canonical questions, and initial state vector. At runtime, GRACE receives the complete conversation history, latest visitor message, current state, and grounded answer generated by a separate RAG component. It updates completion only from visitor-authored evidence and selects one contextually modulated follow-up. The core policy maximizes expected business progress subject to a minimum visitor-utility constraint. We formalize the state, monotonic transitions, source separation, question modulation, and constrained policy; present the reference architecture; and define an evaluation comprising 24 English real-estate and 10 Spanish professional-cleaning conversations, totaling 119 protocol-defined visitor turns. Across both domains, GRACE achieves 84.9% exact state-transition accuracy, 91.6% evidence precision, 89.6% evidence recall, 100% monotonicity, and 94.1% terminal-state accuracy. The evaluation establishes compelling symbolic-state performance across standard, multi-goal, RAG-detour, validation, refusal, and robustness scenarios.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种可审计的 Symbolic–RAG–Generative 架构，并以 GRACE 为核心，将业务目标编译、检索问答和对话策略分层组合。其核心思想是把公司事实与访客自述信息严格分离：RAG 仅负责基于企业知识库回答，符号状态机仅依据访客证据更新目标完成度，再在访客效用约束下选择下一问题。该设计在两个领域、两种语言和多种困难场景中保持了完全单调更新、较高证据质量及较高最终准确率。
AI.motivation: 传统封闭式聊天机器人目标跟踪清晰但交互僵化，RAG 助手善于回答却难以持续推进获客目标，通用智能体灵活但行为波动与审计成本较高。论文试图在开放语言理解、受控目标跟踪、知识问答和可审计性之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 离线阶段通过受指令约束并经人工批准的 Business Goal Compiler，将业务意图编译为不可变目标集 Q、归一化权重 w、证据完成准则、规范化问题及初始二元状态向量。运行时由独立 RAG 组件检索企业语料并生成有依据的答案；GRACE 接收完整历史、最新访客消息、当前状态和 RAG 答案，只从访客自述证据中提取完成事件，随后执行 s_(t+1)=s_t∨z_t 的单调转移。公司知识可调节问题措辞，但不得改变访客目标状态。决策策略为在 U_V(a)≥ε 的约束下，最大化未完成目标的优先级；默认效用为 0.40R−0.20B−0.20D−0.20P、ε=0，NONE 始终可行。评估使用 Mistral Small 4、温度 0.2、多语言 E5 嵌入、Pinecone 检索，覆盖 24 个英语房地产会话和 10 个西班牙语专业清洁会话，共 34 个会话、119 个访客轮次。
AI.result: 综合结果为：状态转移准确率 101/119，即 84.9%；证据精确率 120/131，即 91.6%；证据召回率 120/134，即 89.6%；单调性 119/119，即 100%；终态准确率 32/34，即 94.1%。英语场景的 STA 为 84.9%、TSA 为 91.7%、EP 为 91.2%、ER 为 88.3%；西语场景分别为 84.8%、100%、92.5% 和 92.5%。公司事实、拒绝、重新参与、跨语言及多目标轮次总体未污染状态。主要错误不是状态回退，而是密集或语义重叠证据被归因到错误目标或较晚轮次；这会降低 STA，但可通过后续历史恢复，因而 TSA 更高。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明，在 RAG 问答之外增加显式、可审计的符号目标层，可以兼顾自然交互与业务目标控制。架构最有价值的部分是来源分离、单调状态、证据见证和访客效用门槛；这些机制使系统能回答企业知识问题，同时只通过访客自述推进目标。84.9% 的轮次级准确率与约 9%–11% 的证据错误说明：系统适合作为受控业务流程组件，但尚不能替代严格验证或人工监督。未来应扩展为可表示不确定、修订、撤回和矛盾偏好的非二元状态，并通过真实会话、更多模型与领域、直接基线对比和消融实验验证泛化性、稳健性与效率。

title: PhysMAS: Physics-Grounded Multi-Agent Synthesis of Compositional 4D Gaussians
summary: Efficient, fully automatic, and physically plausible 4D Gaussian synthesis is an important goal for dynamic scene generation. Recent physics-based methods couple 3D Gaussians with the Material Point Method (MPM) to generate physically driven motion, but extending this paradigm to heterogeneous multi-part objects and interacting multi-object scenes remains challenging. Object-level physical assignment collapses distinct parts into a single material state, while one-shot predictions from large language models, vision-language models, or agents neither reliably bind different materials to identified parts nor verify that the resulting MPM configuration is executable. Score Distillation Sampling (SDS)-based parameter optimization, meanwhile, requires repeated per-scene score evaluations and gradient backpropagation, incurring lengthy optimization and potentially yielding suboptimal or unstable solutions. We therefore present PhysMAS, a physics-grounded multi-agent framework. From a motion prompt and four scene views, an Object-Part Scene Agent establishes persistent identities and calls a Material Reasoning Agent for part-wise profiles. It invokes solver-aware skills to bind these identities and profiles to per-particle MPM fields and execute all objects in a shared domain; the framework then screens candidate forward-simulation results. This supports heterogeneous multi-part and interacting multi-object scenes without per-scene diffusion-score backpropagation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, compared with recent physics-based 4D Gaussian baselines that rely on SDS, PhysMAS achieves better semantic alignment and perceived physical plausibility while requiring less runtime.

AI.tldr: PhysMAS 提出一个物理驱动的多智能体框架，从运动提示和四个场景视图自动合成具有物理合理性的 4D 高斯动态场景，支持异构多部件和交互多物体场景，无需逐场景的 SDS 梯度反向传播。
AI.motivation: 现有物理驱动 4D 高斯方法存在两个核心限制：(1) 物体级物理赋值将异构部件坍缩为单一材料状态；(2) 大模型的单次预测无法可靠地将不同材料绑定到已识别部件，也无法验证生成的 MPM 配置是否可执行。同时，基于 SDS 的参数优化需要逐场景的分数评估与梯度反向传播，计算成本高昂且结果不稳定。因此需要一种能够建立持久物体-部件身份、进行部件级材料推理并直接在 MPM 求解器中执行的多智能体框架。
AI.method: 框架由两个智能体和求解器感知技能组成：(1) **物体-部件场景智能体**：使用 GroundingDINO + SAM 2 跨四个标定视图建立持久的物体-部件身份，生成结构化场景计划 Π；(2) **材料推理智能体**：对每个活动行 r 融合 VLM 材料/分支分数与冻结的裁剪条件 E/ν 预测器，生成部件级材料证据 ψ_r；(3) **求解器感知技能**：将身份和材料绑定到每个粒子的 MPM 场，在共享速度网格中执行所有物体，并通过 Q_exec 评分筛选候选前向仿真结果。包含动力学结构保持投影以正则化支撑类部件的局部形变，并通过异构步长规则 (CFL 波速缩放) 维持数值稳定性。
AI.result: 在多部件评估（6 种材料剖面）中，PhysMAS 取得最高宏平均 CLIP_sim 0.2787 与 UPR 36.8%，在 Jelly/Metal/Sand/Foam/Snow/Plasticine 六种剖面上全面领先最强基线 PhysGM (0.2725/27.7%)。在多物体评估中达到 CLIP_sim 0.2733/UPR 37.3%，同样显著优于 PhysGM (0.2631/25.7%)。在运动/形变误差上，PhysMAS 在轨迹 nRMSE (0.626/1.085)、投影面积对数 RMSE (2.641/3.980) 和局部应变 RMSE (6.654/15.361) 上均最低。运行时约 2 分钟，大幅快于 OmniPhysGS (>12h) 和 DreamPhysics (>0.5h)。消融实验验证了物体-部件场景智能体和结构保持投影的贡献。
AI.conclusion: PhysMAS 填补了物理驱动 4D 高斯合成中物体-部件组织与部件级材料分配自动化的空白。持久物体-部件身份与材料剖面为多模态推理与 MPM 仿真之间提供了结构化接口，求解器感知技能可编译并筛选可执行候选。系统支持异构多部件与多物体交互场景，避免逐场景 SDS 反向传播，在语义对齐、感知物理合理性和参考视频运动一致性方面均优于对比方法，同时保持较短运行时。未来工作将结合自适应仿真与学习的执行反馈以支持实时大规模组合动力学。

title: EmoMed: An Emotionally-Aware Agent for Multimodal Medical Support with Real-Time Information Retrieval
summary: We present EmoMed - a multimodal medical consultation agent that adapts its responses based on users' emotional states while maintaining clinical accuracy. The system processes text and medical images, detects affect indicators (anxiety, confusion, urgency) from user input, and adjusts response tone, structure, and detail level accordingly. To ensure factual reliability, the agent grounds clinical information through a dual retrieval mechanism: web-based fact-checking and an API-connected, continuously updated medical knowledge base. We evaluate our approach across seven state-of-the-art language models (GPT-4/5, Qwen3, Llama 4, Gemini 2.5, Grok4, Claude3) using comprehensive metrics including LLM-as-judge assessments, MedQA style accuracy tests, BERT Score, safety/helpfulness ratings, and multimodal medical benchmarks. The results demonstrate that emotionally adaptive responses consistently outperform neutral baseline across evaluation dimensions, without compromising clinical accuracy. A controlled user study validated these findings, with participants reporting improved perceived empathy and communication clarity, while maintaining trust in factual accuracy. Source code: this https URL

AI.tldr: EmoMed是一个多模态医学咨询智能体，通过检测用户情绪状态（焦虑、困惑、紧迫感）来调整回复语气，同时结合双重检索机制（网页搜索+医学知识库API）保证临床准确性。实验覆盖7个前沿大模型，用户研究表明情感自适应回复在共情和沟通清晰度上显著优于中性基线，且未损害事实准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有医学大语言模型虽然具备医学知识推理能力，但缺乏对患者情感状态的自适应能力。焦虑、困惑、紧迫感等情绪会影响风险感知、依从性和信任度。情感自适应回复在提升参与度和沟通质量方面有潜力，但必须以不牺牲事实准确性和安全性为前提。
AI.method: 1) 基于VLM的多模态处理管道，接收文本和医学图像；2) 使用GPT-4o进行单标签情绪检测（焦虑、关切、希望、沮丧等）；3) 工具增强循环：调用Tavily网页搜索和MediSearch医学知识库API进行双重事实检索（限制5次迭代）；4) 情感条件化提示工程，调整回复语气、结构、细节层次；5) 严格的回复结构：承认关切→复述问题→临床背景→可操作指导→必要时的澄清问题；6) 基线对比方法：移除所有情感相关指令的相同提示。评估在7个模型（GPT-4o Mini/5 Nano、Qwen3 VL、Llama-4 Scout、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Claude 3 Haiku、Grok-4 Fast）上进行，使用文本QA（lavita/medical-qa-datasets）和Med-VQA（flaviagiammarino/path-vqa）数据集。
AI.result: 文本QA结果（共情+0.20-0.35，清晰度+0.01-0.03）：1) GPT-4o Mini事实准确性+0.139；2) Gemini 2.5 Flash事实准确性-0.080（换取情感大幅提升）；3) 多数模型准确性保持或提升。Med-VQA结果：情感提升稳健，安全性趋势上升，但准确性变化混合（Llama-4 Scout +0.101，Gemini 2.5 -0.098）。48人用户研究（盲法配对比较）：34人（77%）偏好情感感知回复，在共情和清晰度上更优，未感知到事实准确性或安全性损失。失败模式包括：过度对冲、偶发情绪误分类（回退到中性温和语气）、图像提示中情感线索较弱导致一致性下降。
AI.conclusion: EmoMed证明情感自适应风格控制与双重检索相结合，可在不牺牲严谨性的前提下提供以患者为中心的回复。未来工作方向：更丰富的情感动态建模、改进安全性和溯源能力、专科级检索、扩大临床场景中的人体研究。局限性包括：单标签情绪简化方法、LLM-as-judge评估的潜在系统偏差、精选数据集的泛化性限制。

title: Agentic Algorithm Engineering: Improving Shared-Memory Exact Minimum Cuts
summary: The minimum cut problem for an undirected edge-weighted graph asks us to divide its set of nodes into two blocks while minimizing the weighted sum of the cut edges. Over the last years, we engineered a range of fast algorithms for this problem. Our fastest exact algorithm uses an inexact algorithm to obtain a better bound for the problem, reductions that depend on this bound, improved data structures and parallel contraction routines. It is available in the open-source package VieCut and, on real-world instances, outperformed the previously fastest solvers by a factor of up to 2.5 sequentially and up to 12.9 when run in parallel. We improve this algorithm using agentic algorithm engineering (AAE), a methodology that we introduce here, in which autonomous large language model agents run the algorithm engineering cycle on an existing code base: they form hypotheses about where running time is lost, implement them, benchmark the result on a fixed instance set and keep or discard the change. Even though we had already tuned our algorithm by hand extensively, the agent finds significant optimizations, in particular on the DIMACS core instances: factors of 1.28 (sequential) and 1.63 (32 threads) on real-world k-cores, and 6.26 and 127 on the DIMACS core instances.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"智能体算法工程"(Agentic Algorithm Engineering, AAE)方法论，让自主大语言模型代理在现有代码库上执行算法工程循环；并将其应用于已充分手工优化的共享内存精确最小割算法 VieCut 上，在 DIMACS 核心实例上获得最高 127 倍的加速。
AI.motivation: 尽管 VieCut 已经是经过大量手工优化的并行精确最小割算法，但其在为对抗性收缩而设计的 DIMACS 核心实例上表现仍不理想。作者希望探索 LLM 智能体是否能在手工调优基础上进一步找到显著的性能优化机会。
AI.method: AAE 方法论：自主 LLM 智能体（Claude Opus 5）运行六步循环——建模（model）、设计（design）、分析（analysis）、实现（implementation）、实验（experiment）、评估（evaluation），在固定基准实例集上做工程化迭代。会话状态保存在磁盘而非上下文窗口中，通过几何均值作为接受标准，所有改动需通过正确性断言检查。分别在单线程和 32 线程上进行两轮会话，共 44 次实验，接受 23 项改动。
AI.result: 在 53 个实例（33 个 DIMACS 核心实例 + 20 个真实 k-核）上：单线程几何均值从 25.0s 降至 7.28s（3.44 倍），峰值内存从 492 GiB 降至 193 GiB；32 线程上 4 个原版无法求解的实例变为可解，49 个共同实例几何均值从 23.0s 降至 1.07s（21.49 倍）。分场景看：真实 k-核上 1.28 倍（单线程）和 1.63 倍（32 线程），DIMACS 核心实例上 6.26 倍和 127 倍。关键优化包括：根据割值选择堆类型（避免按割值大小分配桶队列内存）、原地收缩避免保留每轮历史图、调整小图启发式策略、按收缩后顶点划分并行工作、精简边记录（40→24 字节）等。
AI.conclusion: AAE 是一种可行且低成本的算法工程方法学，能在手工优化代码基础上进一步发现显著性能改进。智能体并未发明新算法，但通过移除原始调优中的隐式假设（如数据结构按割值大小分配）突破了原有设计边界。正确性断言、几何均值接受标准和人工审核必不可少；21/44 实验被拒绝；瓶颈是基准运行时间而非智能体推理。

title: Unraveling the Real Working Mechanism and Inherent Flaws of GAE: A Method for Interpreting Transformer Processes from an Economic Perspective
summary: We observe a phenomenon that current algorithmic research in the field of explainable artificial intelligence primarily pursues better performance on several proxy metrics. On the one hand, these proxy metrics themselves are more or less flawed and cannot properly measure the quality of methods. On the other hand, metric-oriented research approaches often lead to the neglect of the rationality and interpretability of the methods themselves. Explainable artificial intelligence is abbreviated as XAI. The metric-driven research paradigm has resulted in a lack of interpretability of the relevant XAI methods themselves. Accordingly, there is a need for interpretability research on XAI methods, which can be playfully referred to as XXAI. This paper is one of our works on XXAI. This paper takes Generic Attention-model Explainability (GAE), a widely influential model interpretation method , or rather, XAI method that represents an important technical route, as the research object, and explores the real working mechanism and flaws of this method as well as the technical route it represents. Based on the conclusions of this study, it may be necessary to re-examine or verify GAE-related methods and their domain applications. We argue that GAE is an interpretation method that focuses on the attention process. After pointing out the working mechanism and flaws of GAE, we propose Cumulative Asset Holdings (CAH), a more reasonable Transformer interpretation method integrating both process-based and feature-based ideas from an economic zero-sum games perspective. In addition, it is worth noting that our method is applicable to models with special tokens, where existing methods may suffer from limitations. The model simplification research method and the analysis of additive operations adopted in this study may provide inspiration for other research works in XAI.

AI.tldr: 本文通过模型简化的方法深入分析了Transformer解释方法GAE（Generic Attention-model Explainability）的真实工作机制和固有缺陷，并基于经济学零和博弈视角提出了一种新的Transformer解释方法CAH（Cumulative Asset Holdings）。
AI.motivation: 当前XAI研究存在严重的指标驱动范式问题：研究者过度追求在有缺陷的代理指标上的表现，忽视了方法本身的合理性和可解释性。GAE作为最具影响力的Transformer解释方法之一（被引用4411次），其工作机制从未被深入研究，却在有缺陷的代理指标上表现良好而被广泛接受。这促使作者提出XXAI（对XAI方法本身的可解释性研究）的概念。
AI.method: 1. 模型简化分析——以三层单头ViT简化结构为对象，通过具体的数值初始化追踪GAE的完整计算流程；2. 维度一致性分析——揭示GAE注意力展开中不同阶矩阵乘法项（长度、面积、体积量纲）的物理不合理性；3. 梯度加权机制分析——证明梯度加权本质上是单步IG（Integrated Gradients），并指出线性近似非线性过程带来的误差；4. 零和博弈建模——将ViT的注意力过程类比为经济学的零和博弈，提出CAH方法，在每个注意力层的输入特征上应用IG并累积各patch的贡献得分。
AI.result: 1. 揭示GAE的真实工作机制：GAE的解释结果本质上是一阶项（各层梯度加权注意力图的累加）的累积结果，而非高阶矩阵乘法项的贡献；2. 暴露GAE的固有缺陷：(a)注意力展开中的高阶矩阵乘法项在物理量纲上无意义（混合了长度、面积、体积等不同维度），理论上不合理；(b)梯度加权本质上是线性近似，无法满足Sensitivity公理；(c)当输入特征值较大时，高阶项可能主导结果，导致严重干扰；3. 通过ViT_base（5000张ImageNet图像）、LXMERT（10000个VQA样本）、DETR（5000个MSCOCO样本）的统计验证，加权注意力值普遍远小于1（一阶项主导是经验现象而非理论保证）；4. 提出CAH方法——结合基于过程和基于特征的视角，在每个注意力块输入特征上应用IG并累积各patch的贡献得分，解决了IG在含特殊token（如cls token）的Transformer中无法完整归因的问题。
AI.conclusion: 1. GAE相关方法及其领域应用可能需要重新审视和验证，因为其理论基础存在缺陷，高阶项在特定情况下可能导致严重干扰；2. 指标驱动的研究范式在XAI领域不再适用，因为现有评估指标（基于一致性假设或边际效应扰动）均存在根本缺陷；3. CAH方法作为IG的聚合框架，继承了IG的精度优势，同时解决了IG在含特殊token模型中的归因难题；4. 负责任的XAI方法必须本身具有可解释性、明确声明误差来源，并使用合理的评估方法（本文采用IG的归因误差而非传统代理指标）；5. 模型简化研究方法和加法操作的维度分析可为XAI领域的其他研究提供启发。

title: Distance-Aware Attention and Wall-Distance Expert Routing for Transformer-Based 3D Flow Prediction
summary: Transformer surrogates for 3D flow prediction compress an industrial mesh into a small set of tokens from which every prediction point reads. Two operations follow: the retrieval step in which a point gathers information from the compressed representation, and the feed-forward layer that transforms what it retrieved. In current backbones both are blind to where the point sits in the flow. We condition both on wall-related physical signals. Distance-aware cross-attention (DA-CA) reshapes each volume query by its wall distance before retrieval, so that a point deep in the boundary layer draws different geometric information than one in the outer flow. Surface-volume mixture-of-experts (SVMoE) replaces the shared feed-forward layer with a small set of experts, routed by wall distance for volume points and by local geometry for surface points. Neither mechanism is tied to one architecture, so we apply both unchanged to AB-UPT and Transolver-3. On DrivAerML with 50 training cases, DA-CA reduces the volume pressure error by 10.1%, and DA-CA and SVMoE together reduce it by 12.5%; DA-CA improves the near-wall region at some cost in the far region, which SVMoE recovers, and the volume experts settle into near-wall, transition, and free-stream bands without routing supervision. Retrained on 300 cases, the conditioning improves every field quantity, reducing volume pressure and velocity errors by 33.1% and 18.6% on AB-UPT and by 21.4% and 21.3% on Transolver-3. Under Leave-One-Body-Out evaluation on DrivAerNet++, it reduces the volume pressure error on unseen body types by up to 14.2%.

AI.tldr: 论文提出两种与具体 Transformer 压缩机制解耦的物理条件化模块：DA-CA 用点到壁面的距离调制体查询，使近壁点更倾向检索邻近表面锚点并获取不同几何信息；SVMoE 用表面局部几何特征和体壁距离分别路由表面与体的前馈专家网络。两者以互补方式解决现有 3D 流场代理在信息检索和非线性变换阶段忽略流场位置的问题。小样本、多骨干、数据外推及跨车体类型测试均表明该方法能稳定降低表面压力、壁面剪切、体积压力和速度误差。
AI.motivation: 工业 CFD 单案例计算成本极高，而神经代理必须保证边界层、分离流和尾流等工程关键区域的精度。现有 Transformer 代理虽能通过锚点或物理状态切片压缩超大网格，但其检索和前馈变换均主要依赖隐式特征相似性，无法显式利用壁面距离这一组织边界层流动的核心物理坐标。论文据此在信息检索和特征变换两个通用计算位置引入物理条件化，并验证其跨骨干、数据规模和几何类别的适用性。
AI.method: 方法包含两部分。第一，Distance-Aware Cross-Attention（DA-CA）：以对数尺度、多频 Fourier 特征编码点的壁距 dw，通过小型 MLP 生成各注意力头的缩放和偏置，对体查询进行 FiLM 式调制后再计算注意力；仅调制查询，不直接使用点—锚点距离，也不修改键、值和 anchor 结构。第二，Surface-Volume Mixture-of-Experts（SVMoE）：表面和体分支分别使用三专家 Top-2 软门控前馈网络；体路由器仅输入 log(dw)，表面路由器输入法向、来流对齐、邻域 PCA 特征及法向标准差等十维局部几何描述。输出通过可学习门控和残差连接加入原 token，并使用 λ=0.01 的负载均衡损失防止专家坍塌。模块以相同设计嵌入 AB-UPT 的锚点交叉注意力和 Transolver-3 的点—物理状态切片分配机制。
AI.result: 在 DrivAerML 的 50 样本设置中，DA-CA 将 AB-UPT 的体积压力误差由 5.94% 降至 5.34%，相对减少 10.1%；与 SVMoE 结合后降至 5.20%，减少 12.5%，四类预测量均改善。DA-CA 单独使用使近壁速度误差由 12.5% 降至 11.3%，但远场由 5.5% 恶化至 6.1%；SVMoE 进一步将近壁降至 10.9%、远场恢复至 5.3%。体专家无路由监督地形成近壁、过渡和自由流三个区间，路由占比分别为 77.8%、8.3% 和 13.9%。使用 300 个训练案例时，完整方法使 AB-UPT 的体积压力和速度误差分别降低 33.1% 和 18.6%，使 Transolver-3 分别降低 21.4% 和 21.3%，且四类误差均下降。设计空间外推中，方法在全部 50 个测试设计上优于基线，体积压力最大改善 22.6%。DrivAerNet++ 多车体训练下各量改善 7.2%–16.5%；Leave-One-Body-Out 的 12 个“车体类型×物理量”比较全部改善，体积压力最大降低 14.2%。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明，将壁面相关物理信号显式注入 Transformer 代理的信息检索和前馈变换阶段，能够同时改善精度、物理区域适配和几何外推能力。DA-CA 与 SVMoE 分别处理“检索什么”和“如何变换”，具有互补性，且不依赖锚点或物理状态切片等具体骨干结构。方法在稳态、高保真 CFD 数据受限场景尤其有潜力。不过，壁距作为单一标量无法区分同一径向位置上的尾流与自由流；实验限于至多 300 个训练案例和稳态流场，且跨几何家族的 OOD 结果主要验证于 AB-UPT。大规模、非稳态和 Transolver-3 的跨家族外推仍需后续研究。

title: Elastic Horizon: Discovering the Effective Interaction Frontier in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, 12 tables. Accepted to EMNLP 2026
summary: Scaling the interaction horizon-the maximum number of environment interactions per episode-improves LLM agents on long-horizon tasks, and curriculum-based methods that progressively expand the horizon outperform fixed-horizon alternatives. However, existing schedules are open-loop: they monotonically increase the horizon until a manually specified maximum, with no mechanism to detect when further expansion stops helping. We propose the effective interaction frontier hypothesis: a dynamic boundary beyond which additional interactions yield diminishing returns while cost grows linearly. We then introduce Elastic Horizon, a closed-loop controller that tracks this boundary via the 90th percentile of successful trajectory lengths. On AppWorld and BFCL, fixed-horizon sweeps reveal clear saturation plateaus; Elastic Horizon stabilizes the horizon inside the saturation band from both under- and over-capacity initializations, attains the best success rates across 7B and 14B backbones, and saves up to 25% of per-step trajectory tokens. Our work shifts the paradigm from how to scale interaction horizons to when to stop scaling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Elastic Horizon，一种用于智能体强化学习中交互回合长度（interaction horizon）的闭环控制器。作者发现并验证了"有效交互前沿"（effective interaction frontier）现象：当交互预算超过任务依赖的阈值H⁰后，成功率不再提升但计算成本线性增长。基于此，他们用成功轨迹长度的第90百分位数（P90）作为能力边界估计信号，配合固定探索余量（headroom Δ）和EMA平滑，实现对交互预算的双向自适应调整。在7B与14B模型、AppWorld与BFCL两个基准上的实验表明，该方法在两个骨干网络上均取得最优成功率，并节省高达25%的单步轨迹token。论文将范式从"如何扩展交互回合长度"转变为"何时停止扩展"。
AI.motivation: 现有的交互回合长度调度策略（ScalingInter-RL、TTI等）均为开环（open-loop）单调递增方案，依赖人工预设的增长率和最大回合长度K_max，但缺乏判断"何时停止扩展"的机制。作者观察到固定回合长度训练存在饱和现象：超过某阈值H⁰后，性能不再提升而成本线性增长，这构成一个根本性缺陷——如何自动检测并跟踪任务相关的有效交互前沿。
AI.method: Elastic Horizon是一种基于agent已展现能力的闭环（closed-loop）控制器。核心机制包括：(1) 维护一个FIFO缓冲区B，存储成功轨迹长度；(2) 用P90（第90百分位数）作为能力边界估计B̂_t；(4) 加上固定探索余量Δ形成目标K_t^target；(3) EMA平滑更新K_{t+1}=(1-α)K_t+α·clip(K_t^target, K_min, K_max)；(4) 具备双向收敛能力——无论从欠容量（K₀=10）或超容量（K₀=50）初始化都能稳定到饱和带内。超参数默认K₀=15, α=0.1, Δ=10, N=100, N_min=20。
AI.result: 在AppWorld和BFCL v3上，使用Qwen2.5-7B和14B：Elastic Horizon在两个基准、两个模型规模上均取得最佳成功率（例如14B AppWorld Best@8达90.42%，显著超越ScalingInter的82.54%和TTI的77.73%）。固定回合长度扫描显示AppWorld饱和带为K∈[30,60]，BFCL为K∈[20,50]。从K₀=10和K₀=50两个极端初始化均能双向收敛到饱和带内。中期训练节省25%单步token，累积节省28%（达到SR=50%时）。
AI.conclusion: 论文将"交互预算"从超参数转变为训练过程中自动测量的量，核心贡献是：(1) 在AppWorld和BFCL上实证发现交互回合长度的饱和平台和任务依赖的有效前沿H⁰；(2) 提出首个面向智能体RL的闭环回合长度控制器，采用基于百分位数的能力估计加EMA平滑；(3) 验证其双向收敛性——从欠/超容量初始化均能稳定；(4) 在不牺牲性能的前提下降低最高25%的单步轨迹token，将范式从"如何扩展"转向"何时停止扩展"。存在四点局限：冷启动依赖成功样本、单全局回合长度不适用于异构任务、P90缺乏一阶原理推导、token代理未涵盖完整计算成本。

title: SkillAlign: Aligning Skill Interfaces for LLM-based Agents
summary: Language-model agents increasingly rely on skills: reusable procedural knowledge for reasoning, tool use, and interaction. Existing work studies how skills are acquired, retrieved, compressed, or composed, but often assumes that once a skill is selected, its interface to the agent is fixed. We argue that this overlooks a key source of skill utility: the same skill can help, distract, or mislead depending on how it is exposed. We propose SkillAlign, a provider-agnostic framework that represents candidate skills as multi-view procedural cards and renders them through alternative exposure interfaces, including full instructions, hints, compressed summaries, workflows, or no exposure. This enables counterfactual evaluation where the task, agent, and candidate skills are fixed while only the exposure interface varies. Across ALFWorld and SkillsBench, we show that exposure form substantially affects task success and rendered context cost, and that compact top-k exposure can outperform full-library injection. We further conduct a replay-based policy-learning analysis on ALFWorld, showing that adaptive exposure contains learnable signal but remains far from oracle selection. Our results suggest that skill-augmented agents should optimize not only which skills to use, but also how those skills are presented.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SkillAlign 框架，将技能暴露接口作为一等决策变量，研究同一技能通过不同呈现方式（全文档、提示、压缩摘要、工作流、不暴露）对 LLM 智能体任务成功率和上下文成本的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有技能增强型智能体研究关注技能的获取、检索、压缩与组合，但默认技能一旦被选中，其呈现给智能体的接口是固定的。然而同一技能因暴露方式不同可能起到帮助、分散或误导作用，暴露形式本身是技能效用的关键来源却被忽视。
AI.method: SkillAlign 是与技能提供方解耦的暴露层：将每个原始技能表示为多视图程序卡（包含 v_full、v_hint、v_comp、v_flow 及元数据），通过五种暴露接口（none/full/hint/compressed/workflow）渲染后注入智能体提示。采用反事实评估协议——固定任务、智能体后端与候选技能集，仅改变暴露接口以分离接口效应；并通过反事实效用得分 U=R−αC−βT 构建 SFT/DPO 标签，用 LoRA 适配 Qwen3-4B 进行轻量级自适应暴露策略学习。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld（140 回合）和 SkillsBench（94 任务）上，使用三种智能体后端与四种候选来源（none/all/vector-top-k/graph-top-k）：(1) 固定候选下仅改变暴露接口即可引起显著性能差异（ALFWorld 上 MiniMax 后端 SR 47.9–72.1，GLM 70.7–82.1）；(2) 紧凑接口（hint/compressed）在更低上下文成本下常匹配或超过全文档注入；(3) 结构化暴露效果随技能库增大愈发关键（skills_1000 时 full 跌至 47.9，compressed 达 72.1）；(4) 学习的 SFT/DPO 策略略优于最佳固定接口（vector-top-k 下 DPO 达 78.6 vs 75.0），但与 oracle 暴露（92.9）仍有较大差距；(5) 人类审计显示生成视图保真度高（任务相关遗漏率 3.3–6.7%）。
AI.conclusion: 技能暴露形式是技能增强智能体的一阶因素；技能增强智能体系统应同时优化技能的选择与呈现方式。当前 SFT/DPO 策略仅是可行性验证，与 oracle 自适应暴露之间存在显著提升空间，未来工作需要更强的策略学习与更丰富的接口设计。

title: World Models Under Asynchronous Sensor Observations
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures. All authors contributed equally
summary: Learned world models typically assume that observations arrive synchronously, an abstraction inherited from simulators that return a complete state vector at each environment step. Physical sensing instead operates at heterogeneous rates, leaving most observation channels stale at any given instant. Interpolating stale channels introduces measurements that were never observed, while downsampling to the slowest sensor discards valid measurements. A natural alternative is to zero-order-hold the most recent reading and provide the known sampling schedule to the model through two features, staleness and time-to-refresh. We test this prediction using transformer world models across three regimes of increasing causal coupling: open-loop rollouts in continuous-control locomotion, closed-loop model-predictive planning in which each learned model serves as the planner dynamics, and a linear latched-actuator system in which refresh events apply a zero-order-held command to the plant. Our findings show that the effectiveness of time-to-refresh depends on the causal role of the sampling schedule, specifically when refresh events affect the system rather than merely report its state. These results establish when sampling schedules provide useful information for predictive world models operating under asynchronous physical observations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在异步传感器观测条件下,世界模型是否应将采样调度信息(尤其是前瞻性的"距下次刷新时间"ttr)作为输入。作者通过构造三级因果耦合实验(open-loop预测、闭环MPC规划、刷新门控执行器),系统验证了一个因果判据:仅当刷新事件参与系统动力学(而非仅报告状态),且其时序无法从其他输入推断时,ttr才有价值。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型普遍假设同步观测(来自仿真器),但物理传感器以异构速率工作。处理这一问题的常用方法(插值、降采样)各有缺陷。零阶保持(ZOH)配合两个调度特征——陈旧度(staleness)和距下次刷新时间(ttr)——是直观替代方案,但二者是否同等有用、ttr在何种条件下提供信息增益,尚不清楚。
AI.method: 1) 模型阶梯:三个容量匹配的Transformer世界模型——A-ZOH(仅观测)、F-blind(加staleness)、F(加ttr),以F-F-blind作为隔离ttr贡献的主对比。2) 三级实验设置递增强因果耦合:Act 1为MuJoCo连续控制环境的开环预测;Act 2为将模型嵌入固定CEM规划器的闭环控制;Act 3为受控的线性latched-actuator系统,通过paired-world probe测量预测轨迹分离度。3) 三种调度可预测性:周期、±10%抖动、±50%抖动。4) 两种评估协议:cut-off(无新观测)与sensor-faithful(按调度更新真实观测)。5) 理论依据:当未来刷新与系统状态条件独立时,ttr不能降低点预测的贝叶斯风险。
AI.result: Act 1(外生感知):27个cell的合并Δ(ttr)在cut-off下为+0.0310±0.0490,sensor-faithful下为-0.0005±0.0066,均无统计学显著效应,效应不随抖动增大。Act 2(通过控制的弱耦合):Ant的Δ(ttr)在±50%抖动下为-73±44(反方向),无正面证据。Act 3(刷新门控执行器,正控制):在因果动力学+±50%抖动+cut-off条件下,F恢复7.31/9.14的目标分离度,F-blind仅3.02,Δ(ttr)=+4.29±1.77;效应从周期条件的+1.07±3.62(冗余)增长到抖动条件的大幅效应,呈现剂量响应;sensor-faithful下优势消失(实时观测已揭示latch事件)。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了采样调度信息的因果判据:ttr(前瞻性刷新时序)仅在三个条件同时满足时有用——(1)刷新事件参与系统动力学而非仅报告状态,(2)其时序无法从其他输入推断(如在抖动下),(3)事件不通过数据自身揭示(如sensor-faithful更新)。Staleness描述已知信息始终有用;ttr的价值取决于系统布线——传感器刷新时序对世界模型价值有限,而执行器刷新时序在门控更新且不可推断时则显著提升预测。这为物理部署的世界模型设计提供了实用准则。

title: Weakly supervised neural network: segmentation of complex structures in X-ray microCT
summary: Segmentation of complex structures in X-ray tomographic data is a fundamental task in biomedical research, but it often requires large amounts of precisely annotated data, making fully supervised approaches costly and difficult to scale. In this study, weakly supervised deep learning is investigated as a strategy to reduce annotation effort while maintaining accurate segmentation. A two-dimensional convolutional neural network based on the nnU-Net framework was adapted to a weak supervision setting using sparse dot-based annotations, complemented by a limited number of fully segmented images. The approach was evaluated on high-resolution microCT slices of rat kidneys, targeting the segmentation of renal glomeruli, which are small, low-contrast anatomical structures. Results indicate that weak supervision provides a meaningful learning signal, enabling reliable localization of glomeruli even in the absence of dense labels. Incorporating a small set of high-quality annotations substantially improves segmentation performance, approaching that of a fully supervised model. These findings highlight the potential of weakly supervised learning as an annotation-efficient strategy for the analysis of complex structures in X-ray tomographic data, and suggest that alternative loss formulations tailored to sparse annotations may further enhance performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于nnU-Net的弱监督深度学习框架，利用稀疏点状标注结合少量高质量全标注数据，对大鼠肾脏microCT图像中的肾小球进行自动分割，旨在降低标注成本的同时保持分割精度。
AI.motivation: 肾小球是研究肾脏功能与疾病进展的关键结构，但其体积小、对比度低，在microCT数据中分割困难。传统全监督深度学习需要大量像素级精确标注，成本高昂且难以扩展；而弱监督学习可以利用稀疏或粗糙标注降低标注负担，在生物医学成像领域具有重要应用价值。
AI.method:
1. **数据准备**：约6000张切片中，约300张由专家进行像素级精确标注（每张约15-20分钟），约800张由非专业人员通过放置直径8像素的圆点标记进行弱标注（每张不超过2分钟）。
2. **网络架构**：采用基于nnU-Net框架的2D U-Net编码器-解码器结构，使用卷积块、批归一化和Leaky ReLU激活。
3. **弱监督训练策略**：定义两种损失函数——全标注数据使用标准Dice损失；弱标注数据使用稀疏Dice损失（仅在标注点附近像素区域Ω_w计算）；总损失为两者的加权组合（λ=0.5）。
4. **训练设置**：Adam优化器，初始学习率1×10⁻²线性衰减，批次大小4，训练约400轮（4小时）。
5. **评估**：对比三种训练策略——纯弱监督、混合监督（85%弱标注+15%全标注）、全监督，使用伪Dice相似系数评估。
AI.result: 三种训练策略的伪Dice分数为：纯弱标注（1152张）0.3223±0.0765；混合标注（960弱+192全）0.5748±0.1358；全标注（1152张）0.7710±0.0499。结果表明：弱监督单独使用可实现肾小球的可靠定位；混合监督中仅15%的高质量标注即可大幅提升性能，接近全监督水平；Dice损失与点状标注之间的不匹配是弱监督性能受限的主要原因之一。
AI.conclusion: 弱监督深度学习为microCT数据中复杂结构的分割提供了一种标注高效的可行策略。少量高质量标注与大量稀疏标注的组合能在标注成本与分割精度间取得有效平衡。未来工作应探索更适合稀疏标注的替代损失函数（如基于质心或距离的损失），以进一步提升弱监督分割性能。

title: DGCPath: Distribution-Aware Generative Contrastive Framework for Self-supervised Path Representation Learning -- Extended Version
comment: This paper is an extended version of DGCPath, which was published at IJCAI 2026
summary: Due to the proliferation of vehicle trajectory data enabled by advanced sensing technologies, path representation learning has become a pivotal task in intelligent transportation systems. Although existing self-supervised approaches have achieved promising performance, their dependence on deterministic contrastive learning paradigms and handcrafted view augmentation strategies inherently restricts their cross-scenario generalization capabilities. To address these limitations, we present DGCPath, an innovative Distribution-aware Generative Contrastive learning framework for Path representation. This framework establishes a synergistic connection between generative modeling and distributional contrastive learning, enabling the acquisition of robust and transferable feature embeddings. Specifically, our framework incorporates: (1) a diffusion-based view generator that autonomously produces semantically coherent yet diverse trajectory views from Gaussian noise; (2) a variational contrastive mechanism that enforces latent feature alignment at the distribution level, transcending conventional instance-wise consistency; and (3) a novel generative cross-supervision module that reinforces view-level consistency through cross-view reconstruction learning. Comprehensive evaluations on three real-world trajectory datasets demonstrate that DGCPath outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on two distinct downstream tasks, validating its enhanced generalization capability and representation effectiveness.

AI.tldr: DGCPath提出了一种分布感知生成式对比学习框架，用于自监督路径表示学习。其核心创新在于用基于扩散模型的视图生成器替代手工增强，将路径表示建模为潜在高斯分布（而非确定性向量），并通过Jensen-Shannon散度实现分布级对比对齐，同时引入交叉监督重建模块增强视图一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督路径表示学习方法存在两大局限：1) 依赖确定性对比学习范式（如InfoNCE），在实例级别进行对齐，限制了表达能力和跨场景泛化性；2) 依赖手工设计的视图增强策略（如节点删除、随机掩码），需要大量试错调参，缺乏自适应性和任务迁移能力。
AI.method: DGCPath框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 路径编码器（Node2vec+Transformer）；(2) 扩散式路径视图生成器（基于DDPM从高斯噪声生成语义一致的路径视图对）；(3) 生成式变分对比模块，通过f_μ和f_σ将视图映射为对角高斯分布，使用JS散度进行分布级对比对齐，并设计交叉监督重建损失（即用视图1监督从视图2重建的结果，反之亦然）。总损失为L = λ₁L_diff + λ₂L_vc + λ₃L_cs，采用不确定性加权策略。理论分析包含三个命题：JS散度最小化等价于抑制视图特定信息（I(G;V|C)）、对比损失上界指数依赖于正负分布间隔、交叉重建迫使编码器保留共享语义S。
AI.result: 在三个真实轨迹数据集（Aalborg、Chengdu、Harbin）上，DGCPath在路径旅行时间估计和路径排序两个下游任务中均优于10个基线方法（包括Node2vec、Toast、PIM、START、LightPath、RED等无监督方法和PathRank、HierETA等监督方法）。在Aalborg上旅行时间估计MAE降低13.27%，在Harbin上路径排序τ提升4.66%。消融实验证实三个模块均贡献显著（VCM影响最大），预训练实验显示PathRank经DGCPath初始化后可用更少标注数据达到相同性能，对噪声扰动具有强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: DGCPath通过将扩散生成、变分对比和交叉监督三者有机结合，突破了传统实例级对比学习的刚性约束，显著提升了路径表示的泛化能力和下游任务性能，为智能交通系统中的路径表示学习提供了一种新的自监督范式。

title: AAS-RAIL: Improving Information Extraction for Asset Administration Shells through Retrieval-Augmented In-Context Learning
summary: The Asset Administration Shell (AAS) is a cornerstone of Industry 4.0 and the Digital Product Passport, providing standardized digital representations of industrial assets. While manufacturers already maintain extensive technical product documentation, generating AAS instances from existing product datasheets remains a labor-intensive task because technical information is extracted from heterogeneous document structures and often involves company-specific terminology and conventions. In this work, we present AAS-RAIL, a retrieval-augmented information extraction (IE) approach that automatically generates Asset Administration Shells from PDF product datasheets using large language models (LLMs). Instead of relying on a fixed set of few-shot examples, the proposed retrieval-augmented in-context learning (RAIL) approach retrieves LLM-generated extraction helpers from similar Asset Administration Shells to provide instance-specific in-context learning (ICL). This enables the model to adapt its extraction behavior to company-specific naming conventions and formatting styles without fine-tuning. Our core contribution is the dynamic selection of company-specific AAS examples for each datasheet, replacing static prompting with an extraction pipeline that adapts to instances and combines semantic retrieval and structured information extraction. The proposed approach is evaluated on a collection of industrial product datasheets using a selection of open- and closed-weight LLMs. Experimental results show that RAIL consistently improves extraction quality over conventional few-shot prompting, yielding relative improvements of 30.4-52.4%. These results demonstrate that our approach provides an effective improvement for company-specific AAS generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AAS-RAIL方法，通过检索增强的上下文学习（RAIL）从PDF产品数据表中自动提取信息以生成资产管理壳（AAS）。该方法无需微调，通过动态检索相似AAS实例中LLM生成的提取助手，实现对公司特定命名约定和格式的自适应。在200对工业产品数据表上的实验表明，RAIL相比传统少样本提示使提取准确率相对提升30.4%-52.4%。
AI.motivation: 资产管理壳（AAS）是工业4.0和数字产品护照的核心，但从异构技术文档中手动提取信息生成AAS劳动密集。现有LLM方法依赖固定提示，无法适应公司特定的命名约定和建模实践（如同一属性不同公司使用"ArticleNumber"或"OrderCode"），而微调又需要标注数据和重复重训。
AI.method: 提出AAS-RAIL方法，包含三个核心组件：(1) 离线阶段——将现有AAS转换为RDF知识图谱，为每个属性生成LLM提取助手（包含Grounding、Evidence、Extraction Rule、Formatting Rule、Avoid五个字段）；(2) 分层检索策略——按公司>ECLAS产品分类>数据表语义相似度的优先级排序候选助手；(3) 在线推理——将检索到的助手作为实例特定的ICL示例嵌入提示，结合语法约束解码确保结构化输出。
AI.result: 在200对数据表-AAS和40对检索库数据（覆盖电气工程和流体动力领域）上评估：所有测试的LLM（开源：GPT-oss 20B、Gemma-4 26B、Qwen-3.6 35B；闭源：GPT-5系列、Claude-5 Sonnet、Gemini-3.5 Flash）均获得提升，绝对准确率从41.6%-59.6%提升至58.0%-79.3%，相对提升30.4%-52.4%。消融实验表明提取助手的贡献大于示例值本身（73.8% vs 62.6%），分层检索优于随机检索（73.8% vs 70.1%）。22.4%原先错误的属性被纠正，仅2.0%原先正确的变为错误。每属性4-8个检索助手时效果最佳。
AI.conclusion: RAIL通过动态检索公司特定的提取指导，有效解决了传统静态提示在异构工业文档中的局限性，实现了无需微调的适应性。开源模型具备竞争力，使本地部署成为可能。但最佳准确率79.3%仍不足以全自动生成，正则表达式搜索表明仅56.2%的属性值在文档中可明确识别，表明该系统应作为人工建模的辅助工具。未来工作将探索RAIL与智能体IE系统的结合。

title: Human-like moral judgments conceal divergent motive attributions in large language models
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 1 table; Supplementary Information (10 pages) appended
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are used to simulate human participants in psychological research. We asked whether LLMs that reproduce human evaluations of a whistleblower's moral character also reproduce the motive attributions that accompany them. Five LLMs and two human samples (N = 125 and N = 742) evaluated a physician who either remained silent about fraudulent billing or reported it to a hospital, regulator, or newspaper. Models reproduced the human ranking of the physician's moral character but portrayed whistleblowers as more helpful, less self-interested, and less hostile. In four of five models, competitive motives were less strongly associated with moral-character judgments. Model ratings changed little when prompts reproduced the narratives and demographic profiles of both human samples, although this comparison cannot isolate a perspective effect. Thus, agreement in average ratings can conceal differences in attributed motives, relationships among judgments, and sensitivity to context. Validating LLMs as simulated participants therefore requires testing psychologically informative response patterns, not average agreement alone.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨大型语言模型（LLMs）作为心理学研究中人类受试者模拟代理的有效性。研究发现，虽然五种LLMs能够复现人类对举报者道德品质的总体排序，但它们在归因动机上与人类存在显著差异——将举报者描绘得更为利他、更少自利、更少敌意，且竞争性动机与道德判断的关联性也较弱。这表明LLMs与人类在道德评价上的表面一致性可能掩盖了潜在心理结构的重要分歧。
AI.motivation: 随着LLMs被越来越多地用作心理学研究中的模拟参与者，研究者通常仅验证模型对平均评分或主效应的复现能力。然而，模型可能复现人类答案而无法复现使该答案具有科学意义的心理结构。本研究旨在检验：当LLMs复现人类对举报者道德品质的评价时，是否同时也复现了伴随这些评价的动机归因，揭示单纯平均一致性检验可能掩盖的心理表征分歧。
AI.method: 研究采用三层次比较框架：（1）H1检验五个LLM（DeepSeek-V3、GPT-4o、Gemini-2.5-Pro、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、gpt-oss-120b）与两个已发表人类样本（N=125第一人称框架，N=742第二人称框架）在四种揭发条件下对医师道德品质评级的结果级一致性；（2）H2检验道德判断与四种动机归因（义务性、利他性、个人主义、竞争性）的关联结构是否匹配；（3）H3探索性检验模型在两种样本规范（叙事框架+人口学匹配的persona）下能否复现样本间差异。每个模型在每个条件下生成200个有效响应（共800个/规范），persona随机抽样以匹配人类样本人口学特征（年龄、性别、学生身份），温度参数0.8。统计方法包括HC3稳健标准误回归、bootstrap置信区间、FDR校正、双侧等价性检验（TOST），以及persona匹配、加权、调整等敏感性分析。
AI.result: 关键结果：（1）模型复现了人类对揭发者道德品质的排序（条件均值r=0.75-0.95），但每个模型将揭发行为解读为更具利他性（增加0.65-3.52个量表点，人类仅-0.01），将自利动机归因降低0.91个点，竞争性动机降低1.07个点；（2）五个模型中有四个竞争性动机与道德判断的负向关联显著弱于人类（β从-0.13到-0.15 vs 模型-0.07到+0.01），义务性动机的关联在三个模型中也较弱；（3）模型在两种样本规范下的去义务性差异仅为-0.06至+0.07，远小于人类的-0.34（所有模型TOST P≤0.006）；（4）persona特征（年龄、性别、学生身份）对模型评级的区分作用极小（通常<0.10个量表点），且模型反应集中于量表高端（天花板效应明显），表明persona抽样仅产生同一系统的重复样本而非独立受试者。
