AI.method: SE-GoS 继承 GoS 的检索流程（含 PPR 扩散），对其底图进行三种训练自由的更新：(1) 拓扑演化——从成功试验中诱导 workflow/dependency 边、剪枝从未被使用的语义边，并引入 trace-certified 的 avoid 边（不引入 alternative 边）；(2) 边权重演化——对指向实际被使用技能的边进行强化（Hebbian 式 w ← w + η·r_t）；(3) 节点描述演化——采用 ProTeGi 单轮文本梯度方法，仅针对"被使用但排名靠后"的技能，使用 LLM 批评-编辑-释义+离线评估器选择最优描述（带 no-eviction 守卫）。冷启动图为纯词重叠的确定性语义相似图，无需嵌入服务或 LLM 验证。
AI.result: 在 SkillsBench（87 任务 ×2 次尝试）与 ALFWorld 上的三款 LLM 实验中：deepseek-v4-flash-0731 上 SE-GoS 将 GoS 的奖励从 52.4% 提升至 59.4%，相对全量加载减少约 1/3 输入 token；hold-out 37 任务评估显示泛化提升 +5.4 点；2³ 因子消融显示边权重更新贡献最大主效应 (+4.7)，节点描述 (+1.3) 和拓扑 (+1.4) 次之；多轮演化在第 2 轮趋于平稳，第 3 轮出现过拟合（54.0%）。检索接口消融显示表达方式（融合包 vs 三通道）对奖励影响很小。
AI.conclusion: SE-GoS 表明技能图可以从执行经验中自我演化，无需模型训练、不改动检索算法或技能内容，把静态检索图转变为可进化的检索基础设施；最佳部署为单轮更新，反复迭代会出现过拟合；为大规模共享技能库中"经验应存储于何处"提供了方案——检索底层而非模型或技能内容。

title: Style Over Substance: Content-Invariant Wrappers Flip LLM Safety-Judge Verdicts
comment: 8 pages, 1 table. Code, wrappers, and per-verdict labels: this https URL
summary: Automatic safety judges -- systems such as Llama Guard or a GPT-4o grading prompt that decide whether a model's reply is harmful -- produce the numbers behind almost every reported jailbreak success rate, defense evaluation, and safety leaderboard. We ask whether these judges grade what a reply contains or how it sounds. We keep a reply's content fixed and add content-invariant style wrappers: fixed strings placed before or after the reply that change only its tone (an educational disclaimer, a fake safety "reasoning" block, a token refusal followed by the unchanged harmful body), or, on harmless refusals, framing that merely sounds dangerous. The body is preserved byte-for-byte, so a faithful judge must return the same verdict, and any flip is an error of the judge, not a change in safety. Over 600 JailbreakBench replies x up to 7 forms x 8 judges, we measure flip rates with paired significance tests and measured noise floors. Findings are precise rather than universal: most judges barely move, but specific judges harbor cheaply exploitable blind spots. A token-refusal wrapper flips 19.9% of GPT-4o-mini's correct "unsafe" verdicts (noise floor 0.5%; 18.2% under majority-of-three re-scoring) yet moves Claude only 0.4%. The deployed Llama Guard 4 is deterministically gamed: an "educational course" framing flips 12.3% of its harmful verdicts to safe. A second deployed guard (gpt-oss-safeguard-20b) is immune, and rewriting only the grading prompt (StrongREJECT-style) cuts the attack tenfold on the identical model -- the vulnerability lives in the judge, not the content. A two-annotator human validation confirms 100% content invariance and 90% of flips as judge errors (kappa 0.95-1.0), and a bootstrap shows the underlying model ranking is already unstable to sampling alone. We release the dataset, wrappers, code, and per-verdict labels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"内容不变样式包装器"(content-invariant style wrappers)攻击,通过在LLM回复前后附加固定字符串(只改变语气、不改变内容),系统性地测试了8个安全评判器(Llama Guard 4、GPT-4o-mini等)是否会被样式而非内容所左右。在600条JailbreakBench回复上发现:特定评判器存在廉价可利用的盲点——token-refusal包装器可使GPT-4o-mini的19.9%正确"unsafe"判定翻转为safe,部署版Llama Guard 4被"教育课程"框架确定性地翻转12.3%,而gpt-oss-safeguard-20b则基本免疫。结果表明安全评判的游戏化是评判器特定的属性,而非LLM评判的普遍现象。
AI.motivation: 当前几乎所有越狱成功率、防御评估和安全排行榜的数字都由自动安全评判器(如Llama Guard、GPT-4o评分提示)产生,但这些评判器究竟是在评判回复的"内容"还是"听起来怎样"并不清楚。若评判器被样式而非内容左右,则所有依赖这些评判器的安全性结论都不可靠。
AI.method: 核心方法:在保持回复主体字节级不变的前提下,在其前后附加固定字符串(教育免责声明、虚假安全"推理"块、token式拒绝后接有害内容等),构成"内容不变样式包装器"。对600条JailbreakBench回复(300有害+300拒绝)×最多7种包装×8个评判器,采用配对设计——同一回复的原始版和包装版都由同一评判器评分,以McNemar精确检验+Holm校正评估翻转率,并测量评判器对相同输入的自不一致率作为"噪声底"。还通过StrongREJECT风格提示(同一模型仅改提示)分离"漏洞在评判器还是内容"。人工验证(145项,双标注者,kappa 0.95-1.0)确认内容不变性与翻转确为评判器错误。
AI.result: 主要结果:(1)GPT-4o-mini的token-refusal包装器将其19.9%的正确"unsafe"判定翻转为safe(95% CI [15.0, 24.0], Holm p<10⁻⁴, 噪声底0.5%);majority-of-3重评仍有18.2%翻转,系统性而非解码运气。(2)部署版Llama Guard 4被"教育课程"框架翻转12.3%,token-refusal翻转8.3%,均为确定性(三次重评几乎不抖动)。(3)gpt-oss-safeguard-20b免疫——任何包装器翻转均≤1.2%,低于其噪声底1.5%。(4)仅改评判提示(StrongREJECT风格,同模型)可将token-refusal攻击削减约10倍(19.9%→1.7%)。(5)纯语气包装器仍能在脆弱评判器上产生3-4倍噪声底的效果(GPT-4o-mini 2.1%, Llama Guard 4 1.7%)。(6)全评判组在原始形式上的全同意率仅55.5%,模型安全排名在bootstrap下不稳定(基线"最安全模型"仅39-93%稳定)。
AI.conclusion: 安全评判的游戏化是评判器特定的属性,而非LLM评判的普遍现象——脆弱评判器与免疫评判器同时存在。建议将"翻转预算"作为安全分数的必报指标,如同物理测量报告仪器误差;内容聚焦的评分规则和多数投票评判组是自然缓解措施。在评判器被信任用于排行榜前,应对其抗内容不变样式重塑的能力进行审计。

title: zScore-N: A Neural Network for On-Chain Wallet Reputation Scoring
summary: Wallet reputation scores decide who receives an airdrop, who can borrow, and who enters an allowlist across decentralised finance. They almost always begin as hand-written formulas: compositions of clamped logarithmic, linear and square-root transforms over behavioural features, with every threshold and point award set by hand. Such a formula is readable and deterministic, but it is piecewise and non-differentiable, it cannot improve as data accumulates, and it cannot distinguish a feature that is genuinely zero from one its pipeline failed to capture. We present zScore-N, the neural network that replaced ours in production. The formula served as its teacher: calibrated against 5,208,952 wallets sampled across 2019-2024 and verified to reproduce production output to within 2.3e-13, it supplies unlimited labelled training data at zero label noise. The trained network reproduces it to 0.58 points RMSE on the 1000-point scale (R^2 = 0.99997), against 2.25 for gradient-boosted trees and 28.04 for linear regression on identical features and splits. Trained with missing-value masks against uncorrupted targets, it halves the error that incomplete data introduces: at 10% feature-level missingness the formula drifts 51.4 points from its own complete-data output with a systematic -12.5 point bias, while the network drifts 17.9. The network carries the score at production scale, across a population of millions of wallets spanning six orders of magnitude in size and activity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 zScore-N,一种神经网络模型,用于替代传统的手写公式进行链上钱包信誉评分。该模型通过蒸馏学习复现了生产环境中的评分公式,并在保真度、可微性和对不完整数据的鲁棒性方面显著优于线性回归和梯度提升树基线。
AI.motivation: 链上钱包信誉评分(如空投资格、借贷准入等)传统上依赖人工编写、分段且不可微的公式,存在三个核心缺陷:(1)无法区分特征值为"真零"还是"管道未捕获";(2)数据积累时无法自我改进;(3)分段函数无法求导,难以进行敏感性分析。生产环境中 65.2% 的钱包存在未记录字段,导致评分系统性偏低。
AI.method: 方法核心是"知识蒸馏"框架:(1) 教师模型:在 5,208,952 个钱包上校准的确定性公式,精确复现生产输出至 2.3×10⁻¹³;(2) 学生网络:宽-收窄的 MLP,所有激活函数平滑且无穷可微(而非 ReLU/tanh),输入包含显式缺失掩码;(3) 训练策略:对完整记录追求最大保真度,对不完整记录使用掩码增强训练——随机遮蔽特征但目标保持完整分数不变;采用鲁棒回归损失(近零处二次,尾部线性);(4) 严格防泄漏:归一化统计量仅在训练集上拟合,所有拆分预先固化到磁盘。
AI.result: 关键结果如下——保真度:在 13,184 个测试钱包上,网络 RMSE 为 0.58 分(R²=0.99997),显著优于梯度提升树(2.25)和线性回归(28.04);激活函数消融显示平滑激活在 RMSE 和最差情况误差上均优于 ReLU 和 tanh;稳定性:三次独立初始化测试 RMSE 分别为 0.775、0.932、0.790,极差仅 0.157 分;不完整数据鲁棒性:在 10% 缺失率下,公式偏离完整数据输出 51.4 分(偏差 -12.5 分),掩码增强网络仅偏离 17.9 分,误差减半;生产部署:模型内嵌于 API 进程,单钱包评分中位数 142 ms,10,000 笔交易评分耗时 0.038 秒(较原 23.1 秒提速 608 倍),成功服务 66,966 个钱包零失败。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功将链上钱包信誉评分从分段公式迁移至神经网络,在保真度、可微性、鲁棒性和部署效率四个维度均达到生产标准。其核心贡献不在于架构创新,而在于严谨的实验方法论:预先验证教师模型、固定所有评估协议、与强基线对比、报告完整不确定性。研究将链上信誉评分置于信用模型而非营销主张的标准下进行验证。

title: Agentic ML Exploration (A-MLE) for Ads Ranking
summary: Modern industrial ads ranking stacks are increasingly bottlenecked not by model capacity or training compute, but by the throughput of human ML iteration - the cycles of research, implementation, training, debugging, evaluation, and launch required to surface a single statistically significant improvement. A typical ranking stack contains numerous differentiated models with heterogeneous data, architectures, and infrastructure constraints, and each cycle takes days to weeks of senior engineer attention per model. As a result, techniques that have proven effective on one model diffuse into others slowly and unevenly, leaving substantial recoverable signal unexplored. We present Agentic ML Exploration (A-MLE), an autonomous LLM-agent system that systematically explores ML techniques across a portfolio of ads ranking models. A-MLE decomposes ML iteration into five stages involving hypothesis generation, exploration strategy, experiment execution, result analysis and shared knowledge substrate which are orchestrated by a single agent that invokes domain-specific skills and agentic workflows against a sandboxed execution layer, with human-in-the-loop checkpoints at each stage boundary. We deploy A-MLE across a representative set of large-scale ads ranking models and evaluate it along a tiered capability framework (tool availability, autonomous workflow execution, and open-ended exploration). We further report a controlled cross-LLM study using a fixed agent loop, which surfaces qualitative differences in execution reliability and exploration aggressiveness across the Claude Sonnet, Gemini, and GPT families. We discuss failure modes and the design choices that govern reliability. Our findings suggest that agentic exploration is a practical force multiplier for ML engineers in industrial recommenders, especially for the long tail of models that rarely receive expert attention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出A-MLE（Agentic ML Exploration），一种用于工业级广告排序模型组合的自主LLM智能体系统。该系统将ML迭代分解为五个阶段（假设生成、探索策略、实验执行、结果分析、共享知识基底），由单一智能体在沙箱执行环境中调用领域技能和工作流进行编排，每个阶段边界设有"人在环路"检查点。系统在真实广告排序模型组合上部署评估，结果表明其能显著提升迭代吞吐量、训练成功率、提案通过率，并在多个模型上带来离线指标提升，尤其惠及长期缺乏专家关注的"长尾"模型。研究还包含跨LLM对照实验和失败模式分析，强调编排框架质量比基础模型推理能力更关键。
AI.motivation: 工业级广告排序系统包含数十个差异化模型，每个模型有独立的数据、架构和约束，传统的ML改进周期（从研究到上线）需资深工程师花费数天到数周。有限的人力导致技术成果在不同模型间扩散缓慢，大量可恢复信号未被探索。因此瓶颈不在模型容量或训练算力，而在人工迭代吞吐量。
AI.method: A-MLE系统由单一工具调用型LLM智能体驱动，将ML迭代拆解为五个阶段：(1)假设生成——读取模型当前状态并提出候选技术；(2)探索策略——在算力约束下规划探索与利用的实验序列；(3)实验执行——在沙箱中编辑代码、运行冒烟测试、提交训练任务并自动恢复基础设施故障；(4)结果分析——针对滚动基线计算统计显著性、按分段分解指标、必要时自动重跑；(5)共享基底——通过版本化结构化知识库实现跨模型知识迁移。每个阶段边界设有人工检查点。系统采用三层能力评估框架（L1工具可用性、L2自主工作流执行、L3开放式探索），并在固定智能体循环下对Claude Sonnet、Gemini、GPT家族进行跨LLM对照研究。
AI.result: 端到端吞吐量较基线提升数倍；训练成功率显著超越基线；智能体撰写提案通过率高于基线；L1能力测试中，领域装备智能体达68%正确率，远超通用ML智能体(16%)与通用LLM(8%)；L3探索中，多源（架构+效率）组合在M*模型上带来+2.557%相对回归误差改进，训练QPS几乎无影响；跨LLM实验显示Sonnet 3.5/3.7、GPT-5、Gemini 2.5在L2任务完整性上达90分以上集群，其余模型无法运行工作流循环；技术转移是智能体最强项，跨模型组合中5个技术族被验证。系统识别出五类失败模式：API幻觉、基线漂移、基础设施脆弱性、过度自信分诊、LLM特定失败。
AI.conclusion: A-MLE将工业ML瓶颈重新定义为人工迭代吞吐量而非单模型上限，并将这一重构实现为五阶段智能体系统。关键设计教训是：智能体的可靠性更多由编排框架质量（技能库覆盖、评估管道统计严谨性、执行层对基础设施噪声的弹性）决定，而非底层模型的推理能力。未来工作方向包括强化弹性执行、深化假设生成领域技能、以及将智能体探索从"广度"模式扩展到"深度"模式，使其参与新架构设计。

title: CircuTutor: Transforming Static Circuit Problems into Intelligent and Dynamic Tutoring
summary: Learning direct current circuit concepts requires learners to connect invisible physical quantities, such as current, voltage, resistance, and power, with observable outcomes such as bulb brightness. Conventional textbook materials and general-purpose circuit simulators provide opportunities for problem solving and exploration but offer limited support for explaining why circuit behavior changes or diagnosing the reasoning behind incorrect answers. We present CircuTutor, a circuit-state-driven intelligent tutoring system that transforms static textbook circuit problems into an interactive tutoring workflow. CircuTutor first uses multimodal problem parsing to extract the textbook question, circuit topology, component parameters, switch states, and answer options, which are converted into a structured task and validated through circuit simulation. Learners can then interactively explore the circuit (by changing parameters) and submit an answer while a SPICE-compatible solver computes physically consistent circuit states. After the learner submits an answer, CircuTutor presents a before-and-after circuit state animation corresponding to the selected operation, organizes the simulated state changes into a causal reasoning chain that explains the underlying circuit behavior, maps answer discrepancies to likely misconceptions, and generates adaptive follow-up exercises targeted at the diagnosed misconception. Our experimental results demonstrate that CircuTutor effectively improves conceptual learning and the overall learning experience. The proposed framework demonstrates how simulated circuit states can be transformed into intelligent and interactive tutoring for circuit education, with the potential to generalize to other STEM domains.

AI.tldr: CircuTutor 是一个面向直流电路学习的智能辅导系统，将静态教材题目转化为交互式辅导工作流，通过多模态题目解析、SPICE兼容电路仿真生成电路状态动画、因果推理链、误解诊断与自适应跟进练习，实验证明其能有效提升概念学习与学习体验。
AI.motivation: 学习直流电路需要将不可见的物理量（电流、电压、阻值、功率）与可观察的现象（灯泡亮度）建立联系，但传统教材和通用电路仿真器缺乏对电路行为变化原因的解释以及对错误答案背后推理的诊断能力。
AI.method: 系统采用三阶段架构：(1) 多模态题目解析，将教材图像转为结构化任务并通过模式与仿真双重验证；(2) 学习者交互与基于PySpice的SPICE兼容电路仿真，计算操作前后的物理一致状态并生成可视化动画；(3) 误解诊断与跟进练习生成，依据仿真证据通过规则匹配识别误解类别，并利用受约束的大语言模型生成针对性练习。因果推理链由物理依赖模板驱动，灯泡亮度由仿真功率推导而非手工标注。
AI.result: 在30名参与者的对照实验（CircuTutor组n=15 vs 控制组n=15）中，CircuTutor组在后测（p=.022, η²p=.18）、学习增益（d=1.04, p=.008）、首次尝试正确率（OR=3.64, p=.012）和任务完成时间（ratio=0.60, p=.004）上均显著优于控制组；在迁移测试上无显著差异；在心智努力（d=-2.49）和IMI兴趣/价值感上均显著优于控制组；SUS均值为73.33。专家评审中物理正确性最高（M=4.46, 93.1%≥4），诊断准确性次之（M=3.92, 73.6%≥4），但因果推理清晰度（M=3.54）与补救相关性（M=3.05）偏低；学习者对自适应跟进练习（M=3.87）与误解诊断（M=3.80）评分最高，对因果推理（M=3.13）评分最低。
AI.conclusion: CircuTutor通过将仿真电路状态系统地转化为可解释的教学反馈（动画、因果链、诊断、跟进），显著提升了概念理解与学习体验，同时保持了物理正确性；该框架展示了如何将仿真输出转化为智能动态辅导，可推广至其他依赖模拟的STEM教育领域。未来工作包括扩大样本与电路类型、增加误解类别、考察长期知识保留以及进行组件级消融研究。

title: Revoked but Still Authoritative: An Empirical Study of Revocation Enforcement in Agent-Memory Systems
comment: Code is available at this https URL
summary: Long-running language-model agents depend on persistent memory. Many agent-memory systems preserve history through soft revocation: a contradicted fact is marked invalid and retained rather than deleted. However, whether that mark is enforced at retrieval time is unexamined. In this paper, we measure five such systems: we load each with a revoked policy and its replacement, track whether the revoked fact is returned at retrieval and whether the agent then acts on it across nine policy scenarios and nine models, and score every trial under six defense conditions. We find that no system enforces revocation by default: the revoked fact is returned wherever the revocation label is visible to the retrieval layer, outranks its replacement, and leads agents to the unsafe action. Based on these findings, we develop a guard that sits between the agent and any memory backend and withholds records that are revoked or conflict with their replacement.

AI.tldr: 本文实证测量了五个主流智能体记忆系统（Graphiti/Zep、mem0、langmem、cognee）对"软撤销"机制的执行情况，发现没有任何系统在默认检索时强制执行撤销标记——被撤销的事实仍会被返回并排在替代事实之上，导致智能体在43.1%的试验中采取不安全动作。作者据此设计了一个位于智能体与记忆后端之间的"陈旧检索防护"（stale-retrieval guard），通过显式状态字段和事实间冲突检测在读取阶段拦截被撤销记录。
AI.motivation: 长期运行的智能体依赖持久记忆系统来保留历史。许多系统采用"软撤销"设计：被取代的事实仅被标记为无效而非删除，以支持审计和时间点查询。然而，这种撤销标记在检索时是否被强制执行从未被系统性地检验过。该研究填补了这一空白，回答一个根本问题：当一条事实被存储系统自身标记为撤销时，它是否仍会通过默认检索返回给智能体并影响其行为。
AI.method: 研究测量了五个智能体记忆系统（Graphiti、Zep、mem0、langmem、cognee）在两种插入模式（直接插入和间接插入）下的表现。研究者向每个系统加载一条被撤销的策略及其替代策略，然后用普通查询测试：(1) 暴露率（暴露指标 ER(s)）——默认检索是否返回被撤销记录；(2) 不安全动作率 Pr[a=a⁻]——智能体选择被撤销策略所暗示的不安全动作的频率。实验覆盖九个策略场景（部署审批、PII导出、回滚策略等）和九个模型（跨越六个厂商的旗舰、高效、开源权重三个层级），每对场景-模型组合在六种防御条件下各运行十次试验（温度0.7）。六种防御条件包括：无防御、存储级过滤、提示硬化、输出过滤、过滤+提示硬化组合，以及作者设计的防护机制。研究者还通过写回测量、多智能体传播测量和工具动作测量扩展了单次读取场景。
AI.result: 核心发现：没有任何系统在所有情况下强制执行撤销。五个系统以三种方式失败：(1) 撤销从未被记录（cognee、langmem、间接插入下的mem0）；(2) 撤销被记录但对调用者不可见（Zep不暴露状态标志）；(3) 撤销被记录、暴露但检索时不执行（Graphiti默认配置、mem0带过期标志覆盖）。在两个暴露系统中，被撤销记录在全部81/81场景中被返回且排在首位，导致Graphiti上44.2%（358/810）、mem0(exp.)上42.1%（341/810）的不安全动作率，总计699/1620（43.1%）。存储级过滤将不安全动作率降至0/1620，但提示硬化仅降至37.2%，输出过滤仅降至18.1%（且享有不公平优势——被告知了被撤销事实文本）。mem0的两个配置（启用/禁用过期过滤）在39/81匹配单元格中行为不同（p<0.001）。写回测量显示，智能体将其不安全决策记录为"当前"记录后，存储级过滤从0%反弹至71.6%-83.1%。多智能体传播测量显示，被撤销记录到达所有三个角色的查询，审查者与被投毒执行者96.3%一致，三角色平均不安全数1.32。工具动作测量中，无防御下危险工具调用率17.2%（62/360），确认数据外泄2.5%（9/360），其中所有外泄都发生在秘密外泄场景。作者设计的防护在暴露状态的后端上达到与存储级过滤相同的效果（0/1620），在间接插入的Zep上0/810（vs存储级过滤5/810和24/810），并在工具动作测量中匹配存储级过滤（8/360 = 2.2%）。
AI.conclusion: 研究得出三点结论：(1) 没有任何系统在所有情况下强制执行撤销；被撤销策略通过普通检索返回并导致智能体采取不安全动作，即使系统提示中存在显式禁止；(2) 失败在于检索而非任何单一产品——两个独立实现的系统行为一致，单个检索标志的改变就能在安全与不安全之间切换；(3) 失败超越单次读取：通过智能体自身的写入持续存在，对同一存储的二次查询并非独立检查，且在无攻击者的情况下通过工具动作重现。基于这些发现，作者提出了一个位于智能体与记忆后端之间的防护机制，在检索阶段拦截可确认为被撤销或与其替代记录冲突的事实。缺失的控制是"检索时有效性"（retrieval-time validity）而非来源（provenance）。在读取阶段实施的防护能将每个信号降至基线，而工具层防护与无防御在统计上不可区分。代码已开源：https://github.com/VulcanLab/Memory-Rebirth-Attack。

title: Evidence-Aligned Entity Verification for Hallucination Detection in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Hallucination detection is crucial for large language models (LLMs), as hallucinated content creates significant barriers in applications requiring factual accuracy. Current detection methods mainly depend on internal signals like uncertainty and self-consistency checks, using the model's pre-trained knowledge to identify unreliable outputs. However, pre-trained knowledge may become outdated and has coverage limitations, especially for specialized or recent information. To address these limitations, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has emerged as a promising solution by retrieving relevant evidence at inference time, grounding outputs beyond the model's parametric knowledge. In this paper, we target a critical and practical learning problem RAG-based hallucination detection (RHD), where RAG is employed to enhance hallucination detection by addressing information updating challenges. To address RHD, we propose a novel method Evidence-Aligned Entity Verification (EAEV), which detects entity-level hallucinations by leveraging RAG to align generated entities with retrieved evidence contexts. Specifically, EAEV evaluates entity-evidence alignment through three complementary dimensions and introduces counterfactual stability analysis to ensure robust alignments under evidence perturbations. Experiments across multiple RAG benchmarks demonstrate that EAEV achieves consistent improvements over existing methods with strong generalization capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文针对RAG场景下大语言模型的幻觉检测问题，提出了EAEV方法，通过实体级证据对齐和多维度验证实现细粒度、可解释的幻觉检测。
AI.motivation: 现有幻觉检测方法主要依赖模型内部信号（如不确定性、自一致性），但预训练知识存在时效性和领域覆盖的局限性。RAG虽然提供了外部证据，但现有基于RAG的检测方法通常在句子或段落级别操作，无法精确定位实体层面的事实错误，且容易被检索文本中的表面关键词重叠所欺骗（伪相关）。
AI.method: EAEV（Evidence-Aligned Entity Verification）包含四个核心阶段：(1) 多维对齐评估，从身份对齐（Id）、语义对齐（Sem）和一致性对齐（Con）三个维度评估实体-证据匹配；(2) 反事实稳定性分析，通过留一法去除证据、标点规范化、空白压缩、仅保留字母数字字符四种扰动来检验对齐的稳健性；(3) 实体中心聚合，将同一实体的多个提及信号合并为实体级判断；(4) EAEV引导的监督学习，将验证信号转化为token加权交叉熵的监督标签，迁移到单一模型中。
AI.result: 在RAGTruth、HotpotQA、DelucionQA三个基准上，使用Qwen2.5-7B、LLaMA2-7B、LLaMA2-13B三种骨干模型进行实验。EAEV在LLaMA2-13B上达到87.55%平均AUROC，超过最强基线TSV 3.34个百分点。消融实验表明反事实稳定性分析贡献最大（去除后AUROC下降5.52点），所有组件均有互补贡献。敏感性分析显示30 token窗口大小为最佳配置。此外在Qwen3-8B新模型上也验证了泛化能力，且比SelfCheckGPT快7.3倍。
AI.conclusion: EAEV通过实体级证据对齐解决了RAG幻觉检测中的关键挑战，能够区分真实事实支持与伪相关。实验证明该方法在多个基准和模型架构上均显著优于现有方法，并且完全基于检索上下文运行，产生可解释的验证信号，与实际RAG管道高度兼容。局限性在于依赖检索证据质量、LLM输出不稳定，且未直接处理生成阶段的幻觉缓解。

title: Three Types of Negation of Triple and its Elements and an Extension of Triple
summary: In various data models, the classical triple is a typical semantic data model. However, due to the design of the triple as a simple structure for representing positive assertions, it cannot sufficiently express different forms of negation present in the triple and its elements. This paper conceptually proposes that there are three distinct forms of negation within triples and their elements: contradictory negation, opposite negation and intermediary negation. Based on the the set SCOI and the logic LCOI+PLCOI with three kinds of negation, we propose an extension of triple that can distinguish and express these three different negations in the triple and its elements, called the TCOI triple with contradictory negation, opposite negation and intermediary negation. The TCOI triple is a semantic and structural extension of the classical triple. While retaining the ability to express positive assertions, it systematically introduces the three semantic dimensions of three negations, allowing these negations to independently act on the elements of the triple and on the whole triple. This significantly enhances the triple model capability to represent and reasoning about complex negative information. This paper also explores the expressive power and reasoning of the TCOI triple, as well as the application of TCOI triple implication reasoning in counterfactuals and counterfactual reasoning. We propose a truth-value (continuous value) algorithm for TCOI triple implication reasoning and perform its calculation through an example of the counterfactuals and counterfactual reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种经典三元组的扩展形式——TCOI三元组，通过引入矛盾否定、对立否定和中介否定三种否定形式，增强了三元组模型表达和推理复杂否定信息的能力，并探讨其在反事实推理中的应用。
AI.motivation: 经典三元组作为典型的语义数据模型，仅能表达正向断言，无法充分表达三元组及其元素中不同形式的否定信息，限制了其对复杂否定信息的表示与推理能力。
AI.method: 1. 概念上提出三元组及其元素中存在三种不同的否定形式：矛盾否定、对立否定和中介否定。2. 基于集合SCOI和逻辑LCOI+PLCOI，提出TCOI三元组作为经典三元组的语义与结构扩展。3. 系统引入三种否定的语义维度，使其能独立作用于三元组的元素及整个三元组。4. 提出TCOI三元组蕴涵推理的真值（连续值）算法，并通过反事实推理示例进行计算验证。
AI.result: 成功构建了能够区分和表达三种否定形式的TCOI三元组模型，保留正向断言表达能力，并系统化了否定信息的表示维度；提出了适用于TCOI三元组蕴涵推理的真值算法，并通过反事实及反事实推理示例验证了其可行性与计算效果。
AI.conclusion: TCOI三元组显著增强了三元组模型表示和推理复杂否定信息的能力，在反事实推理等应用中展现出良好的表达力与实用性，为语义数据模型中否定信息的处理提供了系统化的解决方案。

title: MemForest: Efficient Agent Memory Management via EventTree Partitioning and Progressive Merging
summary: Agent memory systems have demonstrated significant potential in long-term dialogue, personalized assistants, and video understanding. However, continuously accumulated memory introduces substantial storage and retrieval costs during inference. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{MemForest}, a general memory compression framework adaptable to various agent memory systems. Specifically, MemForest partitions historical memory into event-centric units by leveraging global semantic similarity and local temporal continuity. For each unit, it constructs a maximum spanning tree, termed an EventTree, and progressively merges redundant memory nodes by selecting high-weight edges, reducing storage overhead. Furthermore, we introduce an anchor-guided propagation retrieval mechanism that retrieves relevant memory nodes from the temporal neighborhoods of key nodes, improving retrieval accuracy. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of MemForest. Under the unimodal Mem0 framework, MemForest retains \textbf{97.1%} of the original performance while compressing \textbf{50%} of historical memory across three benchmarks (LoCoMo, LongMemEval, and PersonaMem), achieving a \textbf{1.89x} retrieval speedup. Under the multimodal M3-Agent framework, it preserves \textbf{99.7%} of the original performance with a \textbf{50%} compression ratio across two benchmarks (M3-Bench-robot and M3-Bench-web), achieving a \textbf{2.24x} retrieval speedup. \textcolor{RoyalBlue}{\textit{Our code is available at [ this https URL .}}]( this https URL .}})

AI.tldr: 本文提出MemForest，一种通用的智能体记忆压缩框架，通过事件树（EventTree）语义-时间划分与渐进式合并来减少长期记忆系统的存储与检索开销，并引入锚点引导传播检索（AGPR）机制以提升检索精度。
AI.motivation: 随着对话轮次累积，智能体记忆系统的存储与检索效率急剧下降，而现有压缩方法多聚焦于生成阶段或局限于特定场景（如流式视频），缺乏通用、可扩展的后处理压缩方案。此外，文本记忆语义密度高，需兼顾全局语义相似性与局部时间连续性。
AI.method: MemForest包含三大组件：(1) EventTree语义-时间划分模块——结合KMeans全局语义聚类与时间窗口局部连续性得分，将记忆节点划分为多个事件单元；(2) EventTree渐进式合并模块——在每个事件单元内构建最大生成树（Kruskal算法），按边权重迭代合并高相似节点（考虑节点度数保护核心节点），由LLM生成融合内容；(3) 锚点引导传播检索（AGPR）——选取锚点记忆并结合查询相似度与时间邻域传播得分进行排序。此外提供理论分析，证明优先合并高相似节点可保留更多查询相关性。
AI.result: 在Mem0框架下（LoCoMo、LongMemEval、PersonaMem三个基准），50%压缩率下保留97.1%原始性能，检索加速1.89×；在M3-Agent多模态框架下（M3-Bench-robot、M3-Bench-web两个基准），50%压缩率下保留99.7%原始性能，检索加速2.24×。AGPR机制在压缩后增益更显著（如M3-Agent 50%压缩下提升21.0%）。在30%-70%压缩率下均显著优于Random Pruning、KMeans、DART、ToMe、StreamMeCo等基线。消融实验验证了全局语义相似性与局部时间连续性、最大生成树策略及节点度数机制的必要性。
AI.conclusion: MemForest是一种通用且高效的智能体记忆压缩框架，通过事件中心的事件树划分与渐进式合并，结合锚点引导传播检索机制，在显著降低存储开销的同时保持了高检索精度与加速效果，适用于单模态与多模态记忆系统。未来可探索面向低冗余记忆的专用压缩方法、轻量化合并模型及安全性分析等方向。

title: Beyond Coherence: Benchmarking Professional Editing-Technique Execution in Multi-Shot Audio-Video Generation
summary: Recent multi-shot audio-video generators can produce increasingly coherent and cinematic outputs, but coherence does not imply the ability to execute editing techniques. Professional editing depends on shot structure, transition grammar, audio-video cut relations, and montage, yet existing benchmarks largely rely on proxies such as content quality, synchronization, or physical plausibility, systematically missing whether such editing instructions are actually executed. We introduce CutCraft, the first benchmark for editing-technique execution in multi-shot audio-video generation. CutCraft extends structured multi-shot prompts with explicit editing specifications and is paired with a hierarchical hybrid evaluation framework that combines shot-structure alignment, expert-model metrics, tool-grounded multimodal judgment, and rubric-based question answering. Beyond evaluation, we design an agentic editing baseline that decomposes generation into planning, shot-level synthesis, and post-hoc composition, explicitly realizing editing semantics such as J-cuts, L-cuts, and transition timing. Across 13 state-of-the-art closed- and open-source models, CutCraft reveals a consistent gap between coherence and editing-technique execution: current systems often produce plausible multi-shot videos yet fail to execute editorial instructions reliably. We find unstable shot structures, weak control of transition execution, and sharp degradation on higher-order montage, while aesthetic quality is only weakly correlated with editing-technique compliance. The benchmark and metrics, and the editing agent baseline are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: CutCraft是首个针对多镜头音视频生成中专业剪辑技法执行能力的基准测试。它通过结构化提示、分层混合评估框架（镜头对齐+专家模型+工具驱动多模态判断+评分问答）以及智能体编辑基线，揭示当前13个SOTA模型在连贯性与剪辑技法执行之间存在显著差距：能生成看似合理的多镜头视频，却无法可靠执行蒙太奇逻辑、过渡控制和音视频剪切关系（J-cut/L-cut）。
AI.motivation: 现有多镜头音视频生成评估主要依赖内容质量、同步性或物理合理性的代理指标，系统性地忽略了模型是否真正执行了剪辑指令（如J-cut、L-cut、蒙太奇结构等）。连贯性≠剪辑技法执行能力，需要专门的基准来衡量。
AI.method: 1) 数据构建：基于13种蒙太量子类型+9种内容类别+9种视觉风格+2-6镜头数，经LLM起草+专家多轮审核，从1500候选压缩至295样本（包含1228镜头、933转场）；2) 16维评估指标分6组（叙事/节奏/蒙太奇/转场/摄影/音频），采用三层证据路径：直接专家模型评分、VLM仲裁、问答判断；3) 镜头对齐预处理层解决生成视频的镜头结构偏差；4) 智能体编辑基线采用"规划-生成-合成-修复"流水线实现专业剪辑语义。
AI.result: 在13个SOTA模型（含8闭源+5开源）测试中：1) 整体最佳Minimax H3（0.635）领先但优势有限；2) 蒙太奇执行在非连续事件链上明显退化（C1：连续0.58 vs 不连续0.43）；3) 转场执行随镜头数增加而急剧下降（2镜头0.54→5-6镜头0.38）；4) 智能体基线在离散控制维度（A1/B1/D2）提升显著但对高级编辑逻辑帮助有限；5) 视觉质量E2与编辑执行相关性弱（Spearman 0.32-0.49，不显著）；6) 与11位专家人工评估高度一致（Pearson平均0.92）。
AI.conclusion: CutCraft揭示了当前视频生成的核心能力缺口：模型可生成视觉合理的内容但缺乏真正的编辑控制能力。视觉美学与编辑技法执行弱相关，表明现有基准可能系统性掩盖了关键缺失能力。该工作呼吁将评估从视觉合理性转向真正的编辑意图执行，推动"coherent"到"edited with intent"的范式转变。

title: LEBGen: An LLM-Enhanced Bayesian Network Framework for Few-Shot Travel Survey Data Generation
summary: Travel survey data are essential for transportation planning and travel behavior analysis, yet collecting large-scale representative samples is costly and time-consuming. A practical alternative is to generate synthetic survey records from a few-shot sample. However, such samples provide incomplete coverage of heterogeneous traveler groups and insufficient evidence for recovering the complex dependencies between demographic characteristics and travel behavior. Existing approaches have complementary limitations. Probabilistic generative models such as Bayesian networks (BNs) offer explicit distributional control, but structures learned from few-shot samples may omit meaningful dependencies or retain spurious ones. Large language models (LLMs) can help address these difficulties in BN structure learning by providing behavioral knowledge that complements the limited statistical evidence. We therefore propose LEBGen, an LLM-enhanced BN framework that uses this knowledge to refine network structure for few-shot travel survey data generation. Specifically, the LLM first identifies traveler personas from demographic attribute and travel behavior statistics, then recovers dependencies missed by the persona-augmented BN structure and prune spurious ones. The refined BN is parameterized exclusively from the observed data to generate synthetic records. Under a 2% few-shot setting on the 2022 Hong Kong Travel Characteristics Survey, LEBGen reduces the mean marginal Jensen-Shannon divergence from 0.0671 to 0.0091 and the mean absolute Cramer's V error by 14.3% over the best-performing baseline, substantially improving both distributional and dependency fidelity.

AI.tldr: LEBGen是一个面向少样本出行调查数据生成的LLM增强贝叶斯网络框架，通过在贝叶斯网络的节点层（旅行者画像发现）和边层（图结构优化）引入LLM语义知识，解决少样本下依赖关系学习不充分的问题。在2022年香港出行特征调查的2%少样本设定下，分布保真度和依赖保真度均显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 大规模出行调查数据采集成本高、周期长，少样本条件下纯数据驱动的贝叶斯网络结构学习容易遗漏有意义的依赖或保留虚假依赖，导致生成数据失真；而LLM蕴含的行为语义知识可弥补统计证据的不足，但现有方法未能将LLM知识有效整合到面向高维出行调查的生成式概率模型中。
AI.method: 框架分三阶段：(1) 基于BIC的爬山法从少样本离散化数据初始化BN结构；(2) 部署两个LLM智能体——Persona Discovery Agent从人口属性组合及其出行行为统计中归纳可解释的旅行者画像并输出确定性分配规则π，Structure Refinement Agent对persona增强图提出边的增删反转操作，经DAG有效性验证后形成精炼图G*；(3) 离散变量用Laplace平滑CPT、连续变量用条件核密度估计局部分布，通过祖先采样生成合成记录，persona变量仅用于生成过程而不输出。支持混合离散-连续变量的联合生成。
AI.result: 在2022年香港TCS的2%少样本设定下（生成80000条记录），LEBGen将平均边际JSD从最优基线MTabGen的0.0671降至0.0091，平均绝对Cramér's V误差从0.063降至0.054（相对降低14.3%），相关系数从0.850提升至0.868，膨胀率0.425接近理想值0.5。1%-10%数据预算区间优势最显著。消融实验证实persona增强与LLM引导的结构精炼提供互补贡献，但OD对联合分布重建仍是难点（JSD 0.0724，略逊于MTabGen的0.0536）。
AI.conclusion: LEBGen通过在BN的节点和边两个层级引入LLM语义知识，有效缓解了少样本出行调查数据生成中依赖学习不充分的问题。persona作为人口属性到出行行为的紧凑语义中介，结合LLM引导的图结构修正，显著提升了分布保真度和依赖保真度。未来工作需扩展至多城市调查、考察LLM选择敏感性、并引入空间信息以改善OD关系的重建。

title: FastE: Readout-Triggered Token Compression for LLM Embedding Inference
summary: In this study, we identify depth-dependent prefix redundancy in final-readout LLM embedding models, notably across representative backbones including Qwen3-Embedding and Qwen3-VL-Embedding. We find that removing prefix states is substantially more damaging in shallow layers than at greater depth, showing that prefix states become increasingly compressible as the prefix and readout states propagate through the network. To this end, we introduce FastE, a training-free, plug-and-play method. FastE uses a shared fixed threshold on batch-mean readout-prefix alignment as a lightweight online heuristic for selecting when compression occurs, and ranks prefix states by the attention scores they receive from the readout position to determine which states are retained in subsequent layers. Our evaluations demonstrate FastE's ability to substantially reduce computational costs: on NarrativeQA with Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, it reduces decoder-backbone FLOPs by 40.11% while retaining 99.53% of Full Forward nDCG@10. Across five text embedding benchmarks, two backbone scales, and three cross-modal retrieval tasks, the quality-efficiency trade-off is directly customizable through the maximum removal ratio without retraining. We believe FastE offers practical value for scalable embedding generation in retrieval, indexing, clustering, and multimodal representation systems.

AI.tldr: FastE提出了一种训练免费的即插即用方法，通过读出触发的token压缩来加速LLM嵌入推理。其核心发现是前缀状态在深层网络中具有深度依赖的冗余性，基于批次均值读出-前缀对齐阈值触发压缩，并利用读出注意力分数排序来选择保留哪些前缀状态。
AI.motivation: 长序列前缀的LLM嵌入推理计算开销巨大。现有的注意力剪枝、token合并和KV缓存压缩方法通常在固定深度操作或依赖模态特定信号，无法刻画前缀状态如何支持通过深度发展的单一读出状态。该研究旨在探索前缀状态在浅层和深层是否同等必要。
AI.method: FastE将前缀状态压缩分解为两个决策：(1)何时压缩——使用预热后的批次均值读出-前缀对齐作为轻量级在线启发式，首次跨越固定阈值时触发压缩；(2)保留哪些状态——使用当前层的读出位置注意力分数排序进行一次性Top-K选择，保留因果顺序和原始旋转位置编码。三个关键参数：预热深度l_w、对齐阈值θ、最大移除比率r_max。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B的NarrativeQA上，FastE减少40.11%的decoder-backbone FLOPs，同时保留99.53%的Full Forward nDCG@10，实现1.363×端到端加速。在5个文本嵌入基准、2个Qwen3-Embedding规模、3个跨模态检索任务上一致优于ToMe、FastV、RTPrune和OptScale基线。在39个工业任务上70%移除时宏平均AUC从0.8239降至0.8180（保留99.28%），在E5-Mistral-7B上NarrativeQA获得1.189×总端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: FastE提供了一种无需训练、无需自定义稀疏注意力内核的方法，通过深度相关的读出信号自适应地利用前缀冗余性。其训练免费、即时定制的质量-效率权衡使其适用于检索、索引、聚类和跨模态表示系统中的可扩展嵌入生成。

title: Feyospace-v1: How the Cyber Mercury Seven Trained Frontier Cyber Models
summary: Training capable cyber agents is often treated primarily as a problem of model scale, yet open-weight post-training is constrained more directly by the cost of executable environments, reliable multi-turn supervision, and access to strong teachers. We present a data-centric framework that addresses these bottlenecks through five complementary systems: Choulea analyzes hidden reasoning signatures, SkyReal reduces teacher-sampling cost, Hongzwang bypasses API restrictions on teacher execution, PSBreakup restores capabilities weakened by model merging, and Kreator converts expert interventions into trainable reasoning. Our data engine constructs resettable coding, vulnerability, CTF, kernel-history, full-exploit, firmware, and device-backed environments. Candidate trajectories are retained only after execution verification and evidence auditing, yielding 164,269 trajectories for long-context supervised fine-tuning. The three checkpoints improve over their starting models by an average of 23.76% on the full CyberGym suite and 10.49% across the pooled CTF suites. As of September 1, 2026, Feyospace-s1 achieves a verified success rate of 63.24% and ranks 10th on the official CyberGym leaderboard, while all three checkpoints rank 1st among models at comparable parameter scales. To our knowledge, this is the first end-to-end demonstration that a seven-person independent team can train open-weight models with leading agentic cyber capability.

AI.tldr: 一个七人独立团队（Feyospace）提出了一套以数据为中心的网络空间安全后训练框架，通过 Choulea、SkyReal、Hongzwang、PSBreakup、Kreator 五大互补技术解决了开放权重模型在网络智能体训练中面临的可执行环境、多轮监督、强教师访问等瓶颈问题。该框架构建了涵盖代码、漏洞、CTF、内核历史、固件、物理设备等多类可执行环境，产出 164,269 条经执行验证与证据审计的轨迹，对三个 Qwen3 系列模型进行长上下文 SFT，在 CyberGym 和 CTF 套件上分别取得 23.76% 和 10.49% 的平均提升，其中 Feyospace-s1 在 CyberGym 官方排行榜上排名第 10。
AI.motivation: 前沿网络智能体训练被普遍视为依赖模型规模的资源密集型任务，但对开放权重模型的后训练而言，真正的瓶颈在于可执行环境成本、多轮监督可靠性以及强教师访问能力。论文旨在证明小型独立团队也能通过数据与系统工程的创新，实现具有竞争力的网络智能体后训练效果。
AI.method: 方法由五大互补技术与环境驱动数据管线组成：① Choulea（Signature Hack）通过恢复闭源模型的隐藏推理签名进行认知方言分析，但未用作 SFT 标签；② SkyReal 利用灰市低成本账户渠道降低教师采样成本（未用于最终训练）；③ Hongzwang 通过七种变异策略、固定工作流与领域技能绕过 API 限制（未用于最终训练）；④ PSBreakup 通过双向探针与 token 级 reverse-KL 蒸馏恢复被 MOPD 模型合并削弱的网络能力；⑤ Kreator 将人类专家干预重写为教师原生推理轨迹。数据管线构建了基础编程（CVE A 类 69,854、CTF B 类 9,312、内核历史 C 类 12,993、EXP D 类 1,601、固件与物理设备 1,377）共 27,502 个基础编程环境，经四层证据审计（确定性筛选、泄露与奖励黑客审计、轨迹真实性与能力映射、高阶行为分析）后形成 164,269 条 SFT 训练轨迹，采用 token 加权（推理 0.8、最终答案与工具调用 1.0）损失与 262K 长上下文打包训练。
AI.result: 三个检查点（Feyospace-s0/s1/s2）在 CyberGym 完整套件上分别较起始模型提升 41.54、8.73、21.00 个百分点，验证成功率分别为 51.29%、63.24%、50.07%，平均提升 23.76%；在 CyBench、XBOW、NYU CTF 三大 CTF 套件上平均提升 10.49%，s1 达 52.21%。在 CyberGym 官方排行榜上排名第 10，同参数规模下排名第 1。CyberGym 上的配对分析显示 SFT 后提交次数显著减少（>1 次从 24.5% 降至 3.5%）。推理 token 数平均下降 13–18%，但 MoE 模型推理回合数增加。多轮攻击下 ASR 从基线的 24–36% 升至 86–96%，暴露了对齐缺失风险。
AI.conclusion: Feyospace-v1 首次证明七人独立团队能够端到端完成网络智能体后训练，在 CyberGym 与 CTF 套件上达到同规模领先水平。论文系统披露了数据构建、教师获取、轨迹筛选、损失设计与分布式训练等全流程工程实践，并贡献了涵盖编程、漏洞复现、CTF、内核历史、完整利用、固件与物理设备的综合网络数据构建管线。局限性包括：SkyReal/Hongzwang 因合规原因未纳入最终训练、PSBreakup 与 Kreator 的具体贡献难以在最终数据中精确归因、SFT 后多轮攻击 ASR 显著上升表明后续需要专门对齐阶段，且完整 EXP 能力（T2/T1 层级）在当前模型规模上仍未突破。

title: EvolveScaler: Synthesizing Information-Evolution Contexts via Executable State Machines and Natural-Language Rendering
summary: In persistent interactions, long contexts may encode an evolving process rather than a fixed record: later events can revise or revoke earlier information, changing what remains valid and what conclusions follow. We call this setting information evolution (IE). Solving IE requires identifying valid records, applying updates in order, and reconstructing the query-relevant state from the event history. Existing text-first synthesis pipelines make such data difficult to verify because state transitions and answer logic remain implicit. We introduce EvolveScaler, a code-driven framework that defines information evolution before rendering it as natural language. Human-authored operational specifications define state transitions, record validity, difficulty controls, and executable answer logic; a strong LLM then synthesizes a self-contained simulator from each specification. Executing validated simulators produces natural-language multi-turn event histories, while deterministic replay computes reference answers and atomic checklists. We instantiate EvolveScaler with 117 task prototypes and 159 final-question operators across five difficulty levels spanning approximately 7 to 1,200 events per instance, yielding about 35,100 training examples and 585 validated evaluation instances. On the very_long tier, the strongest model reaches 59.3% avg@5, while six models score below 10%. Training an internal A3B model on 6,000 EvolveScaler examples improves performance over its base checkpoint on all eight independently constructed out-of-distribution benchmarks, with a 5.25-point average gain. These results show that code-driven IE synthesis provides both challenging evaluation and transferable training supervision.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 EvolveScaler：一个“先定义可执行状态机、再渲染为自然语言”的信息演化（Information Evolution, IE）合成框架。其核心不是单纯增加上下文长度，而是让后续事件能够修订、撤销或排除先前记录，要求模型按顺序重放事件、识别有效记录并重建查询相关状态。作者构建了覆盖 12 个主题、117 个任务原型和 159 个问题算子的数据集，包含约 35,100 个训练样本和 585 个评测实例，事件规模约为 7 至 1,200。14 个模型在最难层级上的中位 avg@5 仅为 11.3%，最强模型为 59.3%，说明该基准对长时程、动态状态跟踪仍具较大挑战。使用 6,000 个样本继续训练内部 A3B 模型后，8 个独立分布外基准平均提升 5.25 分，表明这种代码驱动的监督具有迁移价值。主要错误集中在有效记录筛选、检索计数和带符号净变化聚合。
AI.motivation: 现有长上下文与多轮交互基准通常把历史视为静态记录，主要测试信息检索、跨轮一致性和指令遵循；它们没有系统地将“后续事件会改变先前信息有效性”建模为独立困难因素。直接让 LLM 先生成长文本、再生成答案，会使状态转移隐含且难以验证。论文因此将 IE 独立定义为一种推理问题，并提出代码优先的数据生成范式，使状态转移、记录有效性、难度和答案逻辑均可执行、可检查。
AI.method: 框架由四层组成：1）人类作者编写 operational specification Π，明确实体、时间结构、事件模式、状态变量、转移约束、记录有效性规则、干扰项、难度参数、问题算子和答案程序；2）强 LLM 按固定接口把 Π 编译为自包含 Python 状态机/模拟器 P_Π，而不是直接生成答案；3）通过随机种子执行模拟器，将状态变化渲染为多轮自然语言事件历史；4）确定性 replay 根据有效事件和采样问题算子生成参考答案及原子 checklist。模拟器必须通过多随机种子执行、不变量、确定性重放和 checklist 一致性等验证。对每个任务原型和难度层采样 60 个训练实例、1 个留出实例，形成约 35,100 个训练样本和 585 个评测实例。评测使用 gpt-oss-120b 严格检查 checklist 是否全部满足，并报告 pass@5 与 avg@5。训练实验对内部 A3B 模型用 GRPO 继续训练，并比较 200、2,000、6,000 个样本及固定预算下的单层/混合长度训练。
AI.result: 资源规模：117 个任务原型、159 个最终问题算子、约 35,100 个训练样本、585 个验证评测实例，覆盖 12 个主题和 5 个难度层；单实例约 7–1,200 个事件。14 个模型评测中，GPT-5.5-xhigh 最强，整体 pass@5 为 82.7%、avg@5 为 72.8%；其 very_long avg@5 为 59.3%。各模型在 very_short、short、medium、long、very_long 的 avg@5 中位数分别为 71.2%、67.8%、50.5%、21.9%、11.3%，显示轨迹规模和演化复杂度共同增加时可靠性急剧下降；very_long 上有 6 个模型低于 10%。训练方面，6,000 个样本使内部 A3B 在 8 个独立分布外基准全部提升，平均分由 33.17 增至 38.42，提升 5.25 分；200 和 2,000 样本分别达到 35.60 和 37.45。固定 6,000 样本预算下，混合短/中/长层级训练在 8 个基准上整体最佳。错误分析显示，Net-Change Aggregation 占语义失败约 46.2%–55.9%，Retrieval & Counting 为 16.8%–21.1%；二者合计至少 64.6%。Invalid-Record Handling 相对较少（不超过 5.5%），而 GPT-5.5-xhigh 的主要残余错误转向 Ranking & Tie-Breaking（29.8%）。
AI.conclusion: EvolveScaler 证明：自然语言历史可以由独立、可执行、可重放的状态机生成，同时保留语言表面的多样性和监督信号的确定性。数据集既能作为具有较强诊断性的评测套件，也能提供可迁移的状态跟踪与证据聚合训练信号。当前版本主要覆盖离散的、程序化定义的状态转移；未来可扩展到部分可观测、连续状态和多模态信息演化场景。

title: SRPO: Setwise Relative Policy Optimization for Multi-Agent LLMs
summary: Multi-agent large language models solve complex tasks by coordinating several policies in a shared environment. However, existing reinforcement learning methods usually optimize each response or trajectory separately, even when several outputs jointly cause one state transition. Consequently, the update unit differs from the action executed by the system. To address this problem, we propose SRPO (Setwise Relative Policy Optimization), which treats the active set the minimal set of outputs consumed by one transition, as one multi-agent action. Specifically, SRPO combines member log-ratios into one cardinality-normalized set ratio, assigns one relative advantage, and clips the set once. This formulation unifies division of labor and joint co-evolution as actions with different set sizes. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and multi-turn search demonstrate one training interface for fixed, mixed, and dynamically routed workflows across four model scales, with the strongest macro-average results among the reported comparisons. Optimization diagnostics further characterize its stability under different event reductions and set sizes.

AI.tldr: 提出SRPO(集合式相对策略优化)，将多智能体LLM中共同引发一次环境状态转移的多个输出视为一个"主动集合"动作，通过基数归一化的集合对数比、单一相对优势、一次性集合裁剪，将分工协作与协同共进化统一为不同基数的同一策略动作。在数学推理和多轮搜索任务、四种模型规模上取得最佳宏平均结果。
AI.motivation: 现有MAS强化学习方法分别优化每个响应或轨迹，即使多个输出共同引发一次状态转移，导致更新单元与系统执行的动作不匹配；分工协作和协同共进化需要不同的更新单元，限制了跨协作模式的统一优化规则。
AI.method: 定义"主动集合"为一次环境转移共同消费的最小新采样输出集合；将各成员的对数比通过1/√K归一化合并为一个集合比；为每个事件分配一个组相对优势；对完整集合一次性裁剪；当K=1时退化为普通响应级优化。配套实现：事件原子批采样、缺失成员使事件失效、选择输出即使未被聚合器引用也保留为动作的一部分。
AI.result: 数学推理（Qwen3-4B/8B，DAPO-Math训练，AIME'24/25、AMC'23、MATH500、Minerva、OlympiadBench）：4B宏平均Avg@16=61.3±0.5，Pass@16=77.9±0.8；8B分别为62.5±0.5和77.8±0.7，均超过Dr. MAS。多轮搜索（Qwen2.5-3B/7B，HotpotQA训练，NQ/TriviaQA/PopQA/HotpotQA/2Wiki/MuSiQue/Bamboogle）：3B宏平均Avg@16=40.1±0.5，Pass@16=56.1±0.8；7B分别为45.6±0.4和61.6±0.7，搜索任务上增益最大。消融实验显示√K归一化优于未归一化求和与1/K平均；事件级裁剪梯度变异系数更低。
AI.conclusion: SRPO提供了一个与工作流无关的多智能体动作定义，将分工协作和协同共进化统一为同一集合值策略的不同基数特例，在四种模型规模和固定/混合/动态路由工作流上均取得最佳宏平均；输出共同改变环境的应当共同优化。局限性：基线为跨论文参考而非配对重跑、序列级成员对数比仍受长度影响、成本分析使用输出侧代理而非端到端GPU时间与工具延迟。

title: Personalizing LLM Agent Memory Using Biometrics
summary: Personalized memory helps LLM agents deliver stable, tailored assistance by storing and reusing user-specific data across interactions. In multi-user scenarios, however, retrieval must consider not only semantic similarity but also whether the current requester matches the identity associated with the stored memory. We propose Bio-Memory, a biometric-aware memory architecture that conditions memory retrieval on both semantic similarity and biometric matching. Built on top of A-Mem, Bio-Memory augments each atomic memory note with a biometric embedding and uses biometric matching to form the retrieval candidate pool before semantic ranking. We evaluate Bio-Memory on LoCoMo in a 10-user shared-agent setting over 7 face benchmarks and 10 palmprint protocols. Across datasets, Bio-Memory consistently separates owner and non-owner queries. Under face-based personalization, the largest average gap reaches 27.29% / 21.15% in F1 / BLEU-1 on CALFW; under palmprint-based personalization, the corresponding gap is 25.75% / 19.22% on MS_Blue. These results support biometrics as a practical control signal for personalized memory retrieval in shared environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Bio-Memory，一种基于生物特征（人脸/掌纹）的 LLM 智能体个性化记忆架构，在 A-Mem 基础上为每条记忆附加生物特征嵌入，在语义检索前先进行生物特征匹配以构建候选池，实现共享环境下的用户级记忆访问控制。
AI.motivation: 现有的个性化记忆系统（如 A-Mem、MemoryBank、Mem0 等）依赖账号、会话或用户 ID 等逻辑凭证进行身份标识，但在多用户共享环境（智能家居、公用终端、企业助手）中，逻辑身份与物理请求者可能不一致，导致语义检索可能检索到他人的私人记忆，存在隐私泄露风险。需要一种不依赖外部凭证、能直接绑定物理请求者的记忆检索机制。
AI.method: 在 A-Mem 的原子记忆笔记结构（content、timestamp、keywords、tags、context、semantic embedding、links）基础上，新增生物特征嵌入 b_i。人脸特征使用 ArcFace，掌纹特征使用 CCNet，嵌入均经 L2 归一化并以余弦相似度匹配。检索流程：①生物特征匹配（通过基准特化的阈值 τ_D）筛选候选池 M_match；②对候选池按时间排序；③在时间排序后的池内进行语义余弦相似度排序，取 Top-K（K=10）；④将检索结果序列化输入 LLM 生成回答。若 M_match 为空，则不提供个人记忆上下文，模型仅依赖参数化知识回答。
AI.result: 在 LoCoMo 数据集的 10 用户共享智能体设定下，使用 7 个人脸基准（AgeDB-30、CALFW、CFP-FF、CFP-FP、CPLFW、LFW、VGG2-FP）和 10 个掌纹协议（CasiaM_460/700/850、IITD、MS_Blue/Green/NIR/Red、PolyU、Tongji）进行评估。Owner 与 Non-owner 之间在 F1/BLEU-1 上均存在显著差距：人脸场景最大平均差距出现在 CALFW（27.29%/21.15%）；掌纹场景最大平均差距出现在 MS_Blue（25.75%/19.22%）。Owner 的回答性能在各数据集和题型上保持稳定且较高，而非 Owner 性能接近基线，说明生物特征过滤在抑制他人记忆的同时保留了合法用户的有用记忆。定性分析进一步显示，Owner 与 Non-owner 的检索路径在候选池构建阶段即发生分化。
AI.conclusion: Bio-Memory 证明了生物特征可作为共享环境下个性化记忆检索的实用控制信号。它将个性化记忆从纯语义相关性问题扩展为"谁的记忆应被检索"的用户对齐问题。该方法以轻量级检索层扩展的形式实现，无需更改底层 LLM，同时保留了 A-Mem 等结构化记忆系统的优势。

title: BIO-MEMART: Biometric-Aware KV Cache Memory for Multi-User LLM Agents
summary: KV cache is evolving from a serving optimization into an external memory substrate for long-term LLM agents. In a shared multi-user deployment, however, reusable KV blocks introduce a missing access-control question: semantic relevance alone cannot determine whether a memory block is authorized for the current physical user. We propose Bio-MemArt, a biometric-aware KV-cache memory framework for multi-user LLM agents. Bio-MemArt attaches a normalized biometric template to each stored KV memory block, filters the shared memory pool with the current user's biometric probe, and then runs the original MemArt retrieval and KV reuse pipeline only inside the authorized candidate pool. This design preserves latent-space retrieval, direct cache reuse, and decoupled position encoding while adding physical-user access control to shared KV memory. We evaluate Bio-MemArt under Owner and Non-owner query conditions on long-term dialogue QA with face and palmprint benchmarks. Across face benchmarks, the average owner and non-owner biometric success rates are 95.71% and 0.86%; across palmprint benchmarks, they are 97.60% and 2.00%. In the efficiency study, average prefill tokens drop from 18,781.96 under full-context prompting to 28.57 with Bio-MemArt, showing that biometric gating preserves the low-token operating regime of KV-cache memory.

AI.tldr: Bio-MemArt 是一种面向多用户 LLM 智能体的生物特征感知 KV 缓存记忆框架，通过在共享 KV 内存池前端加入基于人脸/掌纹的身份验证门控，解决语义相关但未授权的记忆泄露问题，同时保留 MemArt 的低 token KV 复用优势。
AI.motivation: 在多用户共享部署场景（智能家居、公共终端、企业助理等）中，KV 缓存作为 LLM 智能体的外部记忆载体，仅靠语义相关性检索会泄露其他用户的私有记忆；现有 KV 系统工作（Mooncake、TokenCake、KVFlow、DualPath 等）以及 MemArt 均未解决"物理用户访问授权"这一部署缺口。
AI.method: 在 MemArt 原始记忆块 {K_i, V_i, c_i, t_i, a_i} 基础上附加 L2 归一化的生物特征模板 b_i；查询时先用当前用户的生物特征探针 b_q 与各块计算余弦相似度，通过数据集正负样本分布交叉点估计的阈值 τ 进行过滤得到授权候选池 ℳ_bio(b_q)，再在该池内执行原生 MemArt 的压缩键检索、多 token 聚合检索与解耦位置编码 KV 复用；不修改模型权重、注意力层或解码规则。
AI.result: 在人脸基准（AgeDB-30、CALFW、CFP-FF/FP、CPLFW、LFW、VGG2-FP）上所有者/非所有者生物特征成功率均值为 95.71%/0.86%，掌纹基准（CasiaM 460/700/850、IITD、MS Blue/Green/NIR/Red、PolyU、Tongji）上为 97.60%/2.00%；LoCoMo 长对话 QA 在 Owner 条件下 F1/BLEU 显著高于 Non-owner（如 LFW：23.54/17.70 vs 5.31/4.16）；效率方面，平均 prefill tokens 从全上下文提示的 18,781.96 降至 Bio-MemArt 的 28.57，响应时间 1.8743s 优于全上下文 3.6881s。
AI.conclusion: Bio-MemArt 通过生物特征门控在共享 KV 内存池上实现了物理用户级访问控制，验证了"语义相关 ≠ 授权访问"这一核心观点，同时保留了原生 KV 缓存记忆的低 token、低延迟优势，为多用户 LLM 智能体的安全部署提供了可行方案。

title: AgentGrad: Intervention-guided Prompt Optimization for Multi Agent Systems
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) achieve strong performance by employing specialized multiple agents, yet their performance depends on the prompt design of each agent. For MAS prompt optimization, textual gradient methods that guide prompt updates using natural-language feedback have emerged as a leading paradigm. In this paper, we identify limitations in two stages of existing textual gradient approaches: gradient extraction and gradient aggregation. In gradient extraction, previous works select a target prompt without verifying whether modifying it resolves the failure, and derive gradients without agent-level supervision over the corresponding agent's intermediate output. In gradient aggregation, individual gradients are randomly grouped and concatenated, often mixing unrelated failure modes and producing prompts that fail to generalize. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{AgentGrad}, a prompt optimization framework for multi-agent systems based on sequential intervention and semantic textual gradient abstraction. For each failure, sequential intervention modifies the behavior of one agent at a time to identify the target agent whose modification resolves the failure. The modified output of the target agent then serves as agent-level supervision for extracting a fine-grained gradient. Semantic textual gradient abstraction clusters semantically similar gradients to prevent mixing unrelated failure modes, and abstracts each cluster into a generalized gradient that captures the shared corrective pattern. Experimental results show that AgentGrad achieves state-of-the-art performance across five MAS benchmarks and reduces wall-clock optimization time by $2.5\times$ on average compared to the next-fastest baseline.

AI.tldr: AgentGrad是一个针对多智能体系统（MAS）的提示优化框架，通过顺序干预（sequential intervention）定位失败智能体并提取细粒度文本梯度，再通过语义文本梯度抽象（semantic textual gradient abstraction）将样本级梯度聚类并抽象为通用梯度，解决了现有文本梯度方法在梯度提取和聚合两个阶段的局限性，在五个MAS基准上实现最优性能并平均加速2.5倍。
AI.motivation: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统性能高度依赖各智能体提示设计。现有的文本梯度方法（如TextGrad、GEPA）在MAS提示优化中存在两个阶段的系统性缺陷：（1）梯度提取阶段：未经验证即选择目标提示、缺乏智能体级别的中间输出监督；（2）梯度聚合阶段：随机分组并直接拼接样本级梯度，导致无关失败模式混合、提示泛化能力差。
AI.method: AgentGrad框架包含三大组件：(1) 顺序干预（Sequential Intervention）：按反向执行顺序逐一干预各智能体，通过注入提示（hint）引导其产生修正输出，识别出能够单独解决系统级失败的目标智能体；(2) 智能体级监督的梯度提取：将干预前后同一输入下的原始输出与修正输出对比，以修正输出作为智能体级伪标签（pseudo-label），利用LLM梯度提取器生成细粒度样本级文本梯度；(3) 语义文本梯度抽象（STGA）：由聚合器LLM将语义相似的样本级梯度聚类为语义小批量（semantic minibatch），并对每簇抽象为单一通用文本梯度，采用循环调度的簇大小下界平衡粗粒度与细粒度修正。提示更新按语义小批量大小降序应用，并经小批量和验证集双重验证。
AI.result: 在五个MAS基准（HotpotQA、HoVer、PUPA、IFBench、MATH）上使用GPT-5-mini和Qwen3-8B两种骨干进行测试，AgentGrad均达到最优性能：GPT-5-mini下平均较无优化基线提升+11.76分，Qwen3-8B下提升+9.67分，超越MIPROv2、TextGrad和GEPA。优化时间平均136分钟，较次优基线GEPA（337分钟）加速2.5倍。小批量改进率（0.72 vs 0.28-0.44）和验证改进率（0.27 vs 0.14-0.21）均显著高于基线。消融实验表明目标识别（TI）、智能体级监督（AS）和语义梯度抽象（STGA）三者贡献互补。在同领域未见基准的迁移实验中同样取得最佳性能。
AI.conclusion: AgentGrad通过顺序干预和语义文本梯度抽象有效解决了现有文本梯度方法在MAS提示优化中的两大局限性，在性能和效率上同时取得显著提升，证明基于干预的目标提示识别、智能体级监督与文本梯度抽象相结合是MAS提示优化的有效路径。

title: A Three-Tier Persona Vector for Controllable User Simulation in Agentic Evaluation
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Extended treatment of the persona component of StateGen ( arXiv:2606.16307 )
summary: Evaluating tool-augmented LLM agents requires diverse, realistic user inputs yet most evaluation frameworks use flat role descriptions ("you are an angry customer") that produce near-identical conversations regardless of the underlying scenario. In this paper, we propose a three-tier persona vector with 23 operationalized dimensions: 6 categorical demographics (jurisdiction, age, channel, device, language proficiency, time availability), 12 continuous behavioral traits (patience, assertiveness, digital literacy, etc.) sampled with Gaussian noise around curated profile base vectors, and 5 continuous emotional states (frustration, anxiety, trust, confidence, stress) that shift in response to scenario context. Orthogonal to the persona, a 4-level query-complexity overlay controls utterance phrasing from direct to deliberately vague. We evaluate the persona model inside a synthetic data generation pipeline across 64,698 multi-turn conversations spanning 8 named profiles and 3 production corpora. Key findings: (i) a 15.8 percentage-point spread in agent goal-achievement across personas confirms trait vectors produce measurably different user behavior; (ii) the same persona behaves differently across scenarios due to scenario-reactive emotional state shifts, validating the scenario-reactive design; (iii) domain-specific projects show persona sensitivity on booking-flow compliance (~15-20 percentage points gap between tier-aware and pressure-test personas), demonstrating the model faithfully reproduces real-world difficulty distributions; (iv) seven rule-described trait correlations produce auditable co-occurrence patterns without requiring learned covariance matrices. The persona model is fully specified for reproduction.

AI.tldr: 提出一种用于智能体评估中可控用户模拟的"三层人格向量"（three-tier persona vector），包含23个可操作维度（6个分类人口属性+12个连续行为特质+5个连续情绪状态），外加正交的查询复杂度叠加层。通过64,698轮多轮对话实验验证，人格向量可产生15.8个百分点的目标达成率差异，并能真实再现生产环境的难度分布。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体评估框架普遍使用扁平角色描述（如"你是一个愤怒的客户"），导致不同场景生成的对话高度相似。用户模拟缺乏可测量、可解释、可泛化的结构化控制手段，要么是黑箱学习嵌入，要么是无法泛化的脚本化行为。
AI.method: 三层人格向量架构：(1) Tier 1 人口属性（6个分类维度）通过类别分布采样；(2) Tier 2 行为特质（12个连续维度）基于精心策划的profile基础向量加高斯噪声采样，并离散化为low/medium/high三档；(3) Tier 3 情绪状态（5个连续维度）初始化后根据场景delta表进行情境反应式偏移。此外正交叠加4级查询复杂度覆盖层（simple/medium/complex/vague），并通过7条规则描述特质相关性。所有维度的桶标签映射为自然语言提示字符串注入LLM系统提示。
AI.result: 在64,698轮多轮对话（8个命名profile、3个生产语料库）上的实验发现：目标达成率在不同人格间产生15.8个百分点的离散（51.2%-67.0%）；相同人格在不同场景下因情绪delta表现出显著不同行为（争议场景vs结账场景）；CRM预订流程合规性上tier感知型人格与压力测试型人格相差约23个百分点；人格与查询复杂度影响呈可加性；σ=0.08为最佳噪声校准（14.7%桶翻转率，3.1%重复率）。
AI.conclusion: 人格模拟可以走"中间路线"——既不需要扁平描述也不需要黑箱学习嵌入，而采用连续、可测量、可审计的结构化规范。三层架构支持因子实验设计和行为归因，为压力测试智能体提供可控的真实用户群体多样性。模型完全可复现。

title: Graph-Based Personalized Memory for LLM Agents: Representation, Evolution, Retrieval, and Evaluation
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are evolving from single-session tools toward long-term personal assistants that must adapt to individual users across tasks, contexts, and interactions. This shift makes memory a core requirement for personalization, since user preferences, goals, constraints, relationships, and past experiences are accumulated gradually and often change over time. Graph-based personalized memory provides a structured way to model such user information through explicit relations, temporal context, and evidence links. Such representations can model not only what an agent remembers about a user but also how memories are connected, revised, and retrieved to support personalized decisions. However, existing work remains fragmented across personalized agents and generic graph memory frameworks, making it difficult to understand the design space as a whole. This survey develops a lifecycle-oriented view of graph-based personalized memory for LLM agents. We organize existing studies around memory representation, memory evolution, memory retrieval, and memory evaluation. We further compare key design choices, discuss current evaluation practices, and open challenges in building reliable long-term personalized agents. This survey aims to clarify how graph-based memory can support adaptive, controllable, and user-centric LLM agents.

AI.tldr: 该综述提出了面向LLM智能体的基于图的个性化记忆（Graph-based Personalized Memory）的全生命周期视角，将其划分为记忆表示、记忆演化、记忆检索和记忆评估四个核心阶段，系统梳理了现有方法的设计选择与评估实践，并指出了长期、多模态、因果用户建模等未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体正从单会话工具向长期个人助手演进，个性化成为核心需求。当前研究将记忆视为平面条目或压缩摘要，难以表达用户事实之间的关系、时间演化及证据追溯。虽然图结构记忆已展现出独特优势，但相关研究在个性化智能体与通用图记忆框架之间呈碎片化分布，缺乏统一的生命周期视角来指导设计空间。
AI.method: 提出生命周期导向的分类体系：(1) 记忆表示——从节点角色（证据、事实、抽象、领域特定）、关系类型（时序、溯源、关联、领域）和结构模式（扁平、层次、超图、混合、多图）三个层面建模；(2) 记忆演化——涵盖准入、整合、冲突解决、巩固和移除五类操作；(3) 记忆检索——结合相似性、结构化与自适应/智能体式检索；(4) 评估——归纳现有基准（如LoCoMo、PersonaMem-v2、EngramaBench等）与五类指标（答案质量、证据检索、用户状态建模、记忆演化与结构、效率）。
AI.result: 系统对比了Mem0g、AriadneMem、GAM、HingeMem、ZEP等代表性系统在不同生命周期阶段的设计权衡：表示阶段需权衡证据丰富性与紧凑性、跨层一致性；演化阶段需解决过准入、提取错误传播与依赖传播问题；检索阶段需控制结构扩展并结合基础设置优化；评估阶段指出当前基准多停留在答案正确性层面，对图结构正确性、用户控制权、生命周期有效性的评估仍存在显著缺口。
AI.conclusion: 基于图的个性化记忆通过显式关系、时序上下文和证据链接为构建长期自适应、可控、以用户为中心的LLM智能体提供了结构化基础。未来需在可扩展终身记忆、多模态记忆图、因果与反事实用户建模等方向开展深入研究，以实现可靠的用户建模。

title: CLAMP: Constrained Decoding for Vision-Language Embodied Planning
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Embodied planning increasingly relies on vision-language models (VLMs) to translate instructions and visual observations into executable action sequences. However, fluent plans are not always executable. A VLM may refer to objects that are not visually observed, select actions whose required affordances are unavailable, or violate syntax and action constraints. We introduce CLAMP, a multimodal constraint-grounding framework that turns scene evidence into decoding-time constraints for a frozen VLM planner. CLAMP uses the initial observation to restrict object references to those supported by the scene, while a provided symbolic action model specifies state transitions and goals. During decoding, hard masks eliminate invalid next-token candidates, while a Hidden Markov Model (HMM)-based world-state lookahead module reweights the probabilities of the remaining feasible candidates based on action preconditions and goal reachability. This allows the planner to retain the VLM's language prior while preventing visually unsupported, unsafe, or infeasible candidates from entering the plan. For unseen tasks and environments, CLAMP adapts the HMM at test time using label-free continuations sampled from the frozen VLM. Experiments on VLABench, SafeAgentBench, and TaPA show that scene-grounded constraints improve object grounding and safety, while most remaining failures stem from perception errors or misaligned constraint specifications.

AI.tldr: CLAMP提出了一种多模态约束接地框架，通过场景证据生成解码时约束，使冻结的VLM规划器生成的行动计划在视觉、安全和可行性上更加可靠。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型(VLM)在具身规划中常生成流畅但不可执行的计划，表现为引用未观测物体、选择不满足前提条件的动作或违反语法约束，导致规划失败。
AI.method: CLAMP利用初始观察限制物体引用，使用符号动作模型定义状态转换和目标；在解码阶段采用硬掩码消除无效token候选，并结合基于HMM的世界状态前瞻模块根据动作前提条件及目标可达性对候选进行概率重加权；测试时通过无标签的VLM续写样本自适应调整HMM。
AI.result: 在VLABench、SafeAgentBench和TaPA三个基准上的实验表明，场景接地约束改善了物体接地与安全性；剩余失败主要源于感知错误或约束规约不匹配。
AI.conclusion: CLAMP通过将场景证据转化为解码时约束，有效弥补了VLM规划器在视觉支持、安全性和可行性方面的不足，同时保留了语言先验，为具身规划提供了一种轻量化且适应性强的解决方案。

title: GoAnt: Quality-Diversity Multi-Agent Search for Alpha Factor Discovery in Market Microstructure Data
comment: 14 pages, 1 figure, 8 tables, including supplementary appendices
summary: Automated alpha factor discovery searches symbolic trading signals from price-volume panels and order-book data under a fixed evaluation budget. Existing single- and multi-agent program-search systems can overfit predictive proxies that fail after execution costs and repeatedly explore redundant factor families, limiting execution robustness and behavioral diversity. We introduce GoAnt, a quality-diversity multi-agent search framework that combines non-communicating Explorer, Exploiter and Connector workers with a shared adaptive Mental Map and a compact Queen dispatcher. The Mental Map organizes candidates by leakage-free execution profiles and retains one elite per niche, while the Queen reallocates the evaluation budget from explicit search-state summaries. We also define a map-independent effective-yield protocol that counts high-quality, mutually nonredundant factors directly from each method's evaluation records, giving archive-based and map-free systems the same ruler. On real A-share microstructure data spanning 2023--2026, GoAnt reaches quality-weighted yields of 41.8 and 47.6 in price-volume and order-book settings, improving the strongest baseline by 57% and 97% under matched budgets. Its locked populations retain 0.64 and 0.67 of in-sample quality out of sample, compared with 0.61 and 0.63 for a static map.

AI.tldr: GoAnt是一个用于A股市场微观结构数据中alpha因子发现的质量-多样性多智能体搜索框架,通过非通信的Explorer/Exploiter/Connector工作蚁、共享自适应Mental Map(MAP-Elites存档)和蒸馏的Queen Ant调度器,在价格-成交量和L2订单簿两类数据上,在500次评估预算下,质量加权收益分别达到41.8和47.6,较最强基线提升57%和97%,且样本外质量保留率达0.64/0.67。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的单/多智能体alpha因子挖掘系统存在两个关键失败模式:(1) Execution Trap——仅优化预测代理(如RankIC)而忽略交易成本,导致强预测但执行后净收益为负;(2) Reasoning Trap——静态拓扑的多智能体协调器在噪声大、搜索空间广的金融场景中产生共识偏差,预算分配低效,因子种群同质化。论文主张解耦生成器、调度器和存档几何结构,并以统一标尺衡量存档型与无存档系统。
AI.method: GoAnt框架由三部分组成:(1) Mental Map——MAP-Elites存档,六维行为描述子(换手率、有效价差、算子链深度、信号自相关、截面偏度、多空倾斜)由无未来标签的执行剖面构造,中心出生时冻结,允许在线创建新cell但禁止中心移动,保证精英单调性;(2) Worker Ants——三个非通信岛屿生成器(Explorer高温度结构突变、Exploiter局部爬山修复、Connector基于k-NN图的语义交叉);(3) Queen Ant——Qwen2.5-Instruct 1.5B经LoRA蒸馏自8个前沿教师模型,基于显式搜索状态(覆盖、隔离、停滞、复制)做臂选择,目标为max αC̄+βQ̄−γD̄。实验采用500次评估预算、5个种子(101–105),用Mann-Whitney U做两两比较,Holm-Bonferroni控制族内误差,有效收益定义为在统一外部网格上预注册质量阈值q⋆之上且|Spearman|<0.7的最大独立因子子集,加权和报告超额质量。补充材料以结束时不变量审计静态存档(中心位移=0、节点创建=0、合并/重拟合=0),并报告决策级审计证明Queen与UCB的偏离率超过预设下限(0.38/0.41)。
AI.result: 在Exp 1(价格-成交量):GoAnt质量加权收益41.8,较最强基线AutoAlpha(GP)的26.6提升57%,独立因子数34对24;L2订单簿:47.6对24.2提升97%,独立因子数37对22。Exp 2的2×2分解:自适应容量单独贡献−27%(PV)/−34%(L2)的质量加权收益损失,中心移动反而使GoAnt下降13%/17%。Exp 3角色消融:三角色齐全最佳(41.8/47.6),Connector缺失代价最大(−8.7 PV/−10.9 L2)。Exp 4样本外保留:GoAnt 0.64/0.67,优于静态映射的0.61/0.63,远高于无映射的0.29/0.27。Exp 5调度器比较:Queen 1.5B(41.8/47.6)>UCB(38.4/42.0)>EMA(36.2/39.7)>Mock-Queen(35.6/39.0)>Round-Robin(34.9/38.1),Queen与UCB argmax偏离率0.38/0.41,确认非UCB伪装。
AI.conclusion: GoAnt通过解耦Worker生成器、Queen调度器与Mental Map存档,并在六维无标签执行剖面上以自适应容量(中心冻结、cell在线增长)组织候选因子,有效缓解了Execution Trap和Reasoning Trap;在500次评估预算内,质量加权收益与样本外保留均优于所有静态协调和标准QD基线。该框架的核心可分性贡献在于:把"动态存档"拆分为中心移动与自适应容量两个独立机制并独立归因,以结束时不变量定义静态控制,以无图独立协议实现存档型与无存档系统的公平比较。论文明确声明结论依赖预算,扩展工作应定位自适应容量与冻结切分之间的交叉点。

title: Application of curiosity driven exploration methods for hardware interference identification
summary: The transition from single-core to multi-core architectures in safety-critical embedded systems introduces significant challenges due to inter-core interference caused by contention for shared hardware resources. Such interference affects execution times and complicates the verification of strict temporal requirements, particularly in domains such as avionics where standards require comprehensive identification of interference sources. Existing interference analysis approaches, whether manual or model-based, struggle to capture the full range of behaviors arising from the complex interactions among micro-architectural components. In this paper, we frame multi-core interference analysis as the exploration of a complex system behavior space. We propose the use of curiosity-driven exploration algorithms from artificial intelligence to systematically and efficiently cover the space of possible interference behaviors. Using a simulator-based environment, we show that the proposed approach achieves broader and more uniform behavioral coverage within a limited experimental budget compared to traditional pseudo-random program generation methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将多核硬件干扰识别问题建模为复杂系统行为空间的探索任务，采用人工智能中的好奇心驱动探索算法（IMGEP），通过双核模拟器生成多样化的程序对来系统地发现干扰模式。实验表明，该方法在有限实验预算下比传统伪随机程序生成方法实现了更广泛且更均匀的行为空间覆盖。
AI.motivation: 在安全关键嵌入式系统（如航空电子）中，从单核到多核架构的转变带来了核间干扰问题。现有干扰识别方法（基于人工分析或模型）难以全面捕获微架构组件复杂交互所产生的行为空间，因为多核系统具有高度非线性、蝴蝶效应和吸引子效应等复杂系统特征，伪随机程序生成难以有效覆盖全部可能的干扰行为。
AI.method: 1. 构建双核架构模拟器（包含私有L1缓存、共享L2缓存、DDR内存及控制器、互联结构），仅模拟RD/WR内存指令。2. 将干扰识别问题形式化为参数空间Θ（程序对）与行为空间B（性能计数器差异，如隔离vs非隔离执行下的cache miss/hit、DDR bank/row访问、时钟周期差异）的映射关系，B⊂ℝ⁵⁹。3. 采用IMGEP（Intrinsically Motivated Goal Exploration Process）算法：a)通过kNN选择策略在B中均匀采样目标；b)基于k近邻选择历史程序段进行混合与变异操作（添加/删除/修改指令），生成候选程序对。4. 使用多维直方图非空bin数量作为多样性度量，与纯随机探索及随机混合变异基线进行对比。
AI.result: 经过N=10⁴次迭代（含N_init=10³随机预热）：1. IMGEP在整个行为空间及时间/DDR hit-miss子空间上的多样性增长速度均显著优于随机基线和仅含混合变异操作的基线。2. IMGEP在DDR各(bank,row)位置发现更多不同的miss比率。3. IMGEP生成的程序对产生干扰的比例约7/10（随机方法仅4/10）。4. 观察到了"互加速"现象——某对程序使得两个核心的执行时间均短于隔离执行时间（因缺少一致性管理，访问模式恰好避免PRE→ACT序列）。
AI.conclusion: 自动化发现算法能够有效与简化的双核架构模拟器交互，并成功鼓励了在真实SoC上探索的想法。基于性能计数器的行为空间可被IMGEP高效探索，其多样性显著优于随机程序生成。未来工作将致力于构建专门用于识别不同干扰机制（而非仅最大化干扰多样性）的行为空间，可能采用非欧几里得空间（如图、树或语义空间）来刻画不同类型的干扰源。

title: When Can One Obtain Certificates of Optimality Using Positivstellensaetze?
summary: We study certificates of positivity and optimality for learning problems whose objectives and constraints need not be polynomial. We isolate an axiomatic core of Fischer's constructive strict and weak Positivstellensätze and prove the resulting theorems for abstract function algebras over ordered fields. The framework separates two roles that can otherwise be conflated: objective and constraint functions may be built from broad classes of continuous or definable operations, while the auxiliary primitives used to construct a certificate satisfy explicit scalar and closure axioms. We give instances over continuous and definable function algebras, including ordered fields not closed under square roots, derive lower-bound and global-optimality certificates, and analyze both expanded term length and shared computation-graph complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文从 Fischer 的构造性严格与弱 Positivstellensatz 中提取公理化核心，在抽象函数代数与有序域上证明了相应的定理，分离了目标/约束函数与辅助原语的角色，给出了包括非实闭有序域上的实例，导出下界与全局最优性证书，并分析了项长度与共享计算图的复杂度。
AI.motivation: 深度学习训练中由于激活函数（光滑但非半代数的 sigmoid 与半代数但非光滑的 ReLU）导致现有最优性证明方法受限，需要一个不依赖半代数性或光滑性假设的统一公理化框架来生成 Positivstellensatz 证书。
AI.method: 在一阶语言 ℒ_oF 基础上扩展辅助函数符号 (σ, ρ, ξ, δ, ν)，对标量域与函数代数分别建立公理（如 (AsP)、(AwP)），提取 Fischer 构造中使用的 ε̃、ψ̃、s̃、h̃、φ̃、w̃、ũ、t̃ 等通用 ℒ_sP-项，在抽象代数下证明严格与弱 Positivstellensatz，并通过共享直线计算图模型分析复杂度。
AI.result: 在抽象公理下证明了严格 Positivstellensatz（定理 4.1）与弱 Positivstellensatz（定理 4.4），给出 ℚ 上的连续函数实例、非实闭有序域上 ReLU 类原语实例、神经网络公平性训练的最优性证书应用，以及 ℚ 上舍入函数的具体证书计算；严格证书展开项长度为 Θ(k³)，弱证书左端为 Θ(k)、右端为 Θ(k²)；共享计算图大小为 O(k)、深度为 O(log(k+1))。
AI.conclusion: 通过将 Fischer 的构造性 Positivstellensatz 公理化，成功将其适用范围从实闭域扩展到一般有序域，并兼容连续、可定义甚至非光滑函数代数，同时给出了精确的复杂度分析；但公理体系不涵盖经典 ℝ[X] 设置，最优性证书发现的高效算法仍开放。

title: It's All in the Way You Say It: The Role of Information Representation in LLM-Based Glycemic-Event Prediction
comment: Submitted to a journal for peer-review
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being investigated for physiological time-series prediction, yet their effectiveness may depend not only on the model itself, but also on how physiological information is represented and presented at inference time. This study investigates prompt-based general-purpose LLMs for postprandial hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia prediction in individuals with type 1 diabetes. Using the OhioT1DM dataset, we evaluate multiple open-weight LLMs under zero-shot and few-shot inference across prediction horizons of 30, 60, and 90 minutes. The analysis varies both the textual representation of the available physiological information and the amount of information exposed to the model, ranging from glucose observations alone to derived descriptors and additional contextual variables related to insulin, meals, carbohydrates, and physical activity. Performance is compared with conventional patient-specific supervised models and with Gluco-LLM, a language-model-based architecture explicitly adapted to glucose time-series forecasting. Results show a marked task-dependent behavior. Conventional supervised models achieve the strongest performance for hyperglycemia prediction, whereas the best observed prompt-based LLM configurations improve performance for hypoglycemia across all investigated horizons. The effectiveness of prompt-based inference is also strongly influenced by how physiological information is represented, while providing additional contextual information does not lead to a systematic improvement. Overall, these findings highlight physiological information representation as a central design factor in prompt-based LLM approaches to glycemic-event prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了基于提示词(prompt)的通用大语言模型(LLM)在1型糖尿病(T1D)患者餐后血糖事件预测中的表现，重点探讨了生理信息表示方式对LLM预测能力的影响，并与传统监督学习模型及时间序列适配的LLM（Gluco-LLM）进行了对比。研究表明，LLM的性能高度依赖于任务类型、信息表示方式和推理配置，且没有一种表示方法在所有场景下普遍最优。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型在医疗预测任务中的应用日益广泛，其在生理时间序列预测中的有效性可能不仅取决于模型本身，还取决于生理信息在推理时的表示和呈现方式。本研究旨在填补现有研究中对生理信息表示如何影响LLM提示词推理的理解空白，特别是在T1D患者餐后血糖事件预测这一临床重要场景下。
AI.method: 研究采用OhioT1DM数据集，构建了基于餐后时段的预测框架（高血糖和低血糖事件，预测时间窗口为30/60/90分钟）。比较三种方法：(1) 传统监督学习模型（Logistic Regression、XGBoost、CNN1D、LSTM）；(2) 基于提示词的通用LLM推理（Llama 3.1 8B、Mistral 7B、Qwen 2.5 7B、Gemma 2 9B），采用零样本(zero-shot)和少样本(few-shot, K=6)推理；(3) 时间序列适配的LLM（Gluco-LLM）。对于LLM方法，定义了三种信息表示方式：Raw（原始CGM序列文本序列化）、Structured（键值对描述符）和Narrative（自然语言描述），以及三种信息设置：CGM_only、CGM_derived和CGM_derived^context（含胰岛素、碳水化合物、餐食和运动等上下文变量）。评估指标包括Matthews相关系数(MCC)和均方根误差(RMSE)。
AI.result: 主要发现包括：(1) RQ1：高血糖预测中，传统监督学习模型在所有时间窗口上表现最佳；而低血糖预测中，最佳提示词LLM配置在所有时间窗口上均优于最佳监督学习模型，包括零样本推理。(2) RQ2：生理信息的表示方式显著影响LLM预测性能，但没有一种表示方法在所有条件下普遍最优；零样本推理中Structured表现较好，少样本推理中Raw更具竞争力；添加胰岛素、碳水化合物等上下文变量并未带来系统性改善。(3) RQ3：Gluco-LLM在回归实验中总体上比提示词通用LLM更接近Cui等人的任务专用模型，但Cui等人的LSTM模型在所有任务-时间窗口组合中均实现了最低RMSE，并在大多数MCC比较中表现最佳，表明针对生理时间序列的显式适配优于纯提示词推理，但仍未完全弥合与专用模型的差距。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，通用LLM不能被视为血糖事件预测中传统监督学习模型的普遍替代方案，其性能存在明显的任务依赖性。生理信息的表示方式是提示词LLM方法的核心设计因素，而非简单的实现细节。没有一种表示策略（Raw、Structured、Narrative）在所有模型、任务和推理条件下普遍最优。增加上下文信息（胰岛素、碳水化合物等）并不系统性地提升预测性能。在低血糖预测等特定场景中，适当配置的通用LLM可以在无需任务专用训练的情况下实现有竞争力的事件检测性能。整体而言，研究揭示了任务专用模型的一致性与提示词推理的训练无关适应性和表示灵活性之间的权衡关系。未来工作应扩展到更多数据集、更大规模的语言模型、重复推理协议，以及能保留异构生理信号时间关系的适配策略。

title: Closing the Consistency Gap: Self-Evolving Agents That Learn to Stay on Course
summary: Large language model (LLM)-powered agents can be accurate on average yet unreliable in production, a discrepancy that has been observed but remains largely unaddressed. When given the same task five times, a ReAct agent on the AppWorld benchmark using GPT-4.1 succeeds in all five runs only 53% of the time, even though its per-run pass rate averages 77%. We call this 24-point shortfall the consistency gap, and we argue that addressing it is a precondition for trustworthy AI agent deployment. We present a self-evolving agent framework that reduces this gap by identifying unstable, low-consistency steps in agent trajectories and converting them into episodic memory the agent can draw on in future runs. At its core is a Consistency Analyzer that pinpoints where and why a trajectory is likely to flip across executions, and a Guideline Generator that converts the diagnosis into targeted guidelines, committed to memory and injected into future agent executions on similar tasks. On AppWorld with ReAct/GPT-4.1, our framework raises the fraction of tasks that succeed in all five runs by +16 points on same-task evaluation and +13 points on similar-task generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"一致性差距"(consistency gap)概念,揭示LLM智能体平均准确率高但重复执行时可靠性低的普遍问题。基于AppWorld基准,ReAct/GPT-4.1智能体平均通过率77%,但5次全部通过率仅53%。作者提出自进化智能体框架,通过黑盒一致性分析器(重采样估计响应变异性)和指南生成器(将不稳定步骤转化为情景记忆指南),在同任务和相似任务上将5次全通过率分别提升+16pp和+13pp,且不牺牲平均准确率。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM智能体在实际部署中面临可靠性问题:同一任务多次运行结果不一致,平均准确率掩盖了重复执行的不可靠性。这种"一致性差距"是可信AI部署的前提障碍,却长期被忽视。Mean@k指标无法反映用户实际体验的稳定性。
AI.method: 框架包含两阶段离线管道:(1)一致性分析器:对智能体轨迹中每个推理点进行N次重采样(温度≤0.5),通过SBERT余弦相似度(自由文本/代码)、Jaccard相似度(分类响应)或加权组合(结构化响应)估计步骤一致性分数;轨迹级聚合为AUROC 0.699的通过率预测器。(2)指南生成器:将一致性分数低于阈值(θ=0.85)的不稳定步骤,通过LLM转化为strategy/recovery/optimization类别的自然语言指南,经聚类去重后存入情景记忆,在后续运行中检索注入提示。构建于Fang et al.(2026)的轨迹知情记忆框架之上。
AI.result: 在AppWorld test_normal(168任务)上:ReAct/GPT-4.1同任务评估Pass^5从53.0%→69.0%(+16pp,相对30%提升),相似任务泛化+13pp;Mean@5不降反升+3.6pp;标准化一致性从0.68→0.85。ReAct/GPT-OSS-120B基础更低但相对增益更大,Pass^5从10.1%→16.1%(同任务)和18.8%(相似任务),相对提升59%。GPT-OSS-120B在Hard任务上从0%标准化一致性跃升至0.29(相似任务)。不同模型的不一致模式不同:GPT-4.1的不一致随难度单调上升,而GPT-OSS-120B在简单任务上更严重(受能力上限封顶效应)。
AI.conclusion: 一致性差距是LLM智能体部署的关键可靠性障碍,与平均准确率是独立的一阶目标。基于响应变异性诊断+提示级指南注入的离线自进化框架,能在不修改推理循环、不依赖模型内部信息的前提下显著提升重复执行一致性,且指南可跨相似任务泛化。该工作为智能体记忆系统的可靠性提供了针对性探针,未来工作包括指南验证门、自适应重采样降低成本、以及跨架构(CUGA等)的扩展。

title: API Benchmark Scores Do Not Reliably Transfer to Chatbot Interfaces
summary: Benchmark scores are a central currency in model releases: they inform purchasing decisions, shape public trust, and influence policy. Yet, a key assumption underlying benchmark scores is that the model performance measured through APIs faithfully reflects the behavior of deployed systems. We challenge this assumption by auditing ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini across seven systems and nine benchmarks spanning general capability, social bias, and sycophancy. We find systematic API--interface differences in both accuracy and consistency. On average, API evaluations score 3.4 percentage points higher in accuracy and 2.1 percentage points higher in test--retest agreement than corresponding interface evaluations. For ChatGPT, the performance difference between API and interface access exceeds the API-only difference between GPT 5.3 and GPT 5.4. Put differently, switching access surfaces can degrade performance as much as downgrading a full model generation. We further test whether exposed API controls can reproduce interface behavior by varying system prompts, sampling parameters, and reasoning settings. These controls shift behavior in some cases but do not reliably eliminate the gap. Our findings document a context-validity gap: measurements obtained through APIs do not necessarily generalize to corresponding deployed interfaces, complicating the use of API evaluations as proxies for deployed systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过对ChatGPT、Claude和Gemini三大平台的七个系统、九个基准进行审计，发现通过API获得的基准测试分数系统性地高于通过聊天机器人界面获得的分数（平均高3.4个百分点），且一致性也更低（低2.1个百分点）。接口与API之间的性能差距在某些情况下甚至超过不同模型版本之间的差距，表明API评估不能可靠地代表已部署聊天机器人的真实行为。
AI.motivation: 基准测试分数在AI生态系统中扮演核心角色，影响购买决策、公共信任和政策制定。然而，这些分数隐含一个关键假设：通过API测量的模型性能能够真实反映已部署系统的行为。该论文质疑这一假设，探讨评估"上下文效度"（context validity）问题，即API评估结果能否推广到实际部署的聊天机器人界面。
AI.method: 研究采用控制性审计方法：1）在ChatGPT、Claude和Gemini三个平台上选取七个系统（如GPT 5.3 Instant、GPT 5.4 Thinking、Claude Haiku 4.5、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Claude Opus 4.6、Gemini 3 Flash Fast/Thinking）；2）使用九个基准测试（包括ARC、GSM8K、HellaSwag、MMLU、TruthfulQA、WinoGrande等通用能力测试，以及BBQ、AITA、AA-Omniscience等风险测试）；3）对相同提示同时通过API和Web界面发出，进行五次独立试验；4）控制请求路由、会话个性化、工具调用、时间漂移、输出标准化等混杂变量；5）使用线性混合效应模型和配对Bootstrap进行统计推断；6）通过改变系统提示、采样参数和推理设置来测试能否复制界面行为。
AI.result: 主要发现：1）API准确率平均比界面评估高3.4个百分点（SE=1.11，p=0.002），所有七个系统的API准确率均显著高于界面；2）API测试-重测一致性平均比界面高2.1个百分点（96.9% vs 94.8%，p<0.001）；3）在某些情况下，界面性能退化超过模型版本差异（如GPT 5.4 Thinking在WinoGrande上的接口-API差距+19.0%，是GPT 5.3与5.4版本差距9.0%的两倍多）；4）访问表面可逆转排行榜排名——九个基准中，API排名与界面排名的平均Spearman相关性仅为0.52；5）添加近似的系统提示虽改善了一致性，但未能缩小准确率差距；6）采样和推理控制参数的调整对准确率影响微乎其微（所有p>0.30）。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出结论：API基准测试分数与已部署聊天机器人界面之间存在显著的"上下文效度差距"。测量结果高度依赖于评估发生的访问表面，API评估不能直接推广到已部署产品。这一发现限制了API评估作为已部署聊天机器人行为代理的有效性，对AI治理、模型比较和决策制定具有重要启示。研究者应避免在没有跨表面稳定性证据的情况下将API结果推广到用户面向的产品行为，同时基准测试报告应记录获取分数的访问路径和部署上下文。论文还发布了一个开源工具，用于审计和持续监测已部署聊天机器人系统的行为。

title: SkillAdam: Stable and Efficient Skill Evolution for Agents
summary: Agent skills provide a lightweight way to equip frozen language-model agents with domain knowledge and procedural guidance, yet obtaining high-quality skills remains costly and difficult to scale. Expert-written skills require substantial human effort. Recent skill self-evolution methods automate an iterative loop that uses execution feedback to revise skills, but their heuristic update strategies often yield unstable optimization and low iteration efficiency. We identify two challenges in realizing stable and efficient skill self-evolution. Direction Stability requires effective corrections to accumulate rather than be overwritten by iteration-local feedback. Update Adaptivity requires the scope of each revision to reflect the consistency of recent case-level improvements. We introduce SkillAdam, an Adam-inspired framework for optimizing discrete and non-differentiable skill documents. As a functional analogue of Adam's first moment, an optimization memory records identified problems and the outcomes of prior solution attempts to stabilize the update direction. As a functional analogue of Adam's second moment, a volatility-driven edit budget tracks the history-weighted variation of recent case-level improvements and adaptively controls the update magnitude. Across seven benchmarks that span short- and long-horizon tasks, SkillAdam achieves state-of-the-art performance with more stable optimization dynamics. It also obtains stronger skills with substantially fewer optimization iterations and lower cost than prior methods. Code repository: this https URL

AI.tldr: SkillAdam是一个受Adam优化器启发的技能自我演化框架，通过优化记忆（Evolving Issue Tracker）和波动性驱动的编辑预算（volatility-driven edit budget）两个机制，在离散、不可微的技能文档空间中实现稳定高效的迭代优化，在七个基准测试上取得最优性能并大幅降低优化成本。
AI.motivation: 现有技能自我演化方法采用SGD式的启发式更新策略，存在两个核心问题：方向不稳定性（有效修正被迭代局部反馈覆盖）和更新适应性不足（编辑范围未能反映近期改进的一致性），导致优化不稳定且迭代效率低。
AI.method: 将Adam优化器的两个核心机制功能性地迁移到离散技能空间：（1）优化记忆（类比一阶矩）记录已识别问题及其历史解决尝试，稳定更新方向；（2）波动性驱动的编辑预算（类比二阶矩）通过案例级改进的方差指数移动平均自适应控制更新幅度。
AI.result: 在七个基准测试（短horizon：SearchQA、SpreadsheetBench、OfficeQA、DocVQA、LiveMath；长horizon：ALFWorld、DeepPlanning）上取得最优性能；DeepPlanning上优化token消耗减少67.3%，API请求减少68.8%；跨模型迁移保留率从76.2%提升至81.3%；技能质量评分从3.30提升至3.88。
AI.conclusion: SkillAdam成功将Adam优化原理适配到离散技能文档空间，通过优化记忆和波动性驱动的编辑预算实现了稳定且高效的技能自我演化，在性能、成本和跨模型迁移性三个维度均优于现有方法。

title: PlannerForge: LLM Agents for Scenario-Based Testing of Motion Planners in Autonomous Driving
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 35 pages including appendix
summary: Ensuring the safety of autonomous driving is a critical challenge. Scenario-based testing is a systematic process used to validate Autonomous Driving Systems (ADSs), but it remains a fragmented modular pipeline in which scenario generation, retrieval, modification, ADS execution, and results analysis are performed by separate tools with little interaction. Large Language Model (LLM) agents have shown promise across ADS sub-systems such as perception, planning, and control. However, no prior work covers the whole scenario-based testing pipeline for ADSs with a unified LLM-agent framework. We present PlannerForge, an LLM-agent framework that extends all scenario-based testing stages (from Scenario Generation to ADS Assessment) and adds two further LLM-enhanced stages: ADS Enhancement and ADS Benchmarking. We evaluate PlannerForge with 10 off-the-shelf LLMs across all tasks (Generation, Selection, Modification, Module Routing, Planner Testing, and Enhancement) under 5 prompt conditions. Best-per-task scores range from 0.88 to 1.00, and open-source 20-35B backends match commercial APIs on most tasks. Open-source models such as Qwen3.6:35B match commercial APIs on three of the five tasks. Chaining the modules end-to-end retains 83% / 78% of seed queries (commercial / open). It outperforms Scenario Factory 2.0 (Finkeldei et al., 2025) on natural-language generation (193 vs. 144 executable of 200) and realises 92-96% of requested city, road and vehicle attributes. It outperforms BM25 (Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009) at rank 1 selection (92.0% vs. 67.5%) and From-Words-to-Collisions (Gao et al., 2025) on physically valid edits (>=94% vs. 31%). At N=400, cost-tuning lifts planner success from 50.4% to 70.2% and cuts collisions from 19.0% to 8.4%, without domain-specific fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: PlannerForge是首个统一LLM智能体框架，将基于场景的运动规划器测试全流程自动化，覆盖场景生成、检索、修改、测试执行到结果分析，并新增ADS增强与基准测试两个LLM增强阶段。该框架在10个开源/商用LLM、5种提示条件下系统评估，模块最佳得分0.88–1.00；端到端管线保留83%/78%（商用/开源）的种子查询；多项指标优于Scenario Factory 2.0、BM25和From-Words-to-Collisions等基线；在N=400时成本调优使规划器成功率从50.4%提升至70.2%，碰撞率从19.0%降至8.4%。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶系统（ADS）的安全验证面临真实路试成本高昂的难题，基于场景的仿真测试成为主流方案，但现有流程呈碎片化：场景生成、检索、修改、ADS执行与结果分析由各自独立的工具完成，缺乏统一交互。先前LLM辅助工作多局限于场景生成单环节，缺乏覆盖全流程的统一LLM智能体框架。
AI.method: 提出PlannerForge框架，采用Gradio前端+LangChain后端的聊天机器人接口，集成六大模块：Module Router（意图分类，分发至modify/tune/test/analyse/qa五动作）、Generation（自然语言→OSM+SUMO→CommonRoad两阶段合成）、Selection（基于五层元数据的漏斗式检索+RAG兜底）、Modification（经SUMO往返的T/B/P/G四类编辑：轨迹/行为/参与者/目标）、Testing（统一π_P接口封装Frenetix与MP-RBFN两规划器）、Analysis（LLM解析批量执行结果）。提示工程采用Contextual Prompt（CP）、Chain-of-Thought（CoT）、In-Context Learning（ICL）三种技术，五种提示条件（baseline至cp_icl_cot）。形式化建模为自然语言到结构化输出的映射序列，并设计可执行验证护栏（schema校验+下游执行检查）隔离LLM幻觉。
AI.result: 在10个LLM（5商用+5开源20–35B，涵盖推理与非推理模式）、5提示条件、5任务×4修改子任务、N=200查询/单元的全面评估中：（1）模块最佳得分：Generation 0.957、Selection 0.880、Modification四子任务近100%、Router 0.997、Planner 1.000；（2）端到端管线保留83%（Qwen3.6-plus）/78%（Qwen3.6:35b）种子查询；（3）优于基线：生成193 vs 144可执行场景/200且实现92–96%请求属性、rank-1选择92.0% vs BM25 67.5%、修改物理有效性≥94% vs FWtC 31%；（4）成本调优在N=400时将规划器成功率从50.4%提升至70.2%，碰撞率从19.0%降至8.4%；（5）可迁移洞察：CP饱和封闭词表任务、ICL用于拒识、CoT利于联合约束；外部CoT与原生推理模型冲突；可靠性需可执行验证护栏。
AI.conclusion: PlannerForge是首个覆盖ADS场景测试全生命周期的LLM智能体框架，凭借Module Router实现灵活的对话驱动测试流，经80,000次免微调调用验证有效，在模块级与端到端层面均优于现有规则/关键词/LLM基线。未来工作将闭合规划器回路并扩展至CARLA等仿真器。局限性：轨迹与参与者编辑在SUMO往返中丢失12–17%查询，Selection因标签过度预测成为瓶颈，分析模块尚无ground truth评分，且当前为开环评估、CommonRoad场景偏德国。

title: Good Pretraining, Bad SFT: Checkpoint Quality Across the Training Stack
summary: Language-model checkpoints are commonly selected by pretraining loss or benchmark scores, assuming that the highest-scoring checkpoint will remain the best starting point for subsequent training. We show that this assumption can fail in a full 30B mixture-of-experts training pipeline. The checkpoints that perform better after the full downstream training stack also have higher solution density, i.e., retain downstream performance under local weight perturbations.

AI.tldr: 在30B MoE训练流水线中，验证损失或基准测试得分最高的模型检查点，并不一定是后续下游训练的最佳起点。提出“solution density”（解密度）作为更可靠的检查点选择指标。
AI.motivation: 语言模型预训练中，普遍通过预训练损失或基准分数来挑选checkpoint，并默认最优checkpoint在后续微调中仍保持最优。然而这一假设缺乏在完整训练流水线下的系统性验证。作者发现该假设在大规模MoE训练中可能失效，因此需要一种更鲁棒的早期检查点选择准则。
AI.method: 在完整的30B参数MoE训练流水线中进行实验：①基于预训练损失/基准得分挑选checkpoint；②对各checkpoint进行局部权重扰动，度量其下游任务性能保留率，即“solution density”；③比较不同选择准则与最终下游训练后性能的相关性。
AI.result: 预训练损失或基准得分最优的checkpoint，在完成下游训练后并不一定是表现最好的；而那些下游训练后性能更优的checkpoint，在被选中时具有明显更高的solution density，即对局部权重扰动更具鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 在30B MoE的完整训练流程中，传统基于验证损失/基准的checkpoint选择准则不可靠；solution density可作为更有效的预训练checkpoint选择信号，能更好地预测后续下游训练的最终性能。

title: Deposon: An Auditable, Conservation-Guaranteed, Game-Theoretically Tested Scattering Layer over LLM Reasoning Paths
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures. Author affiliation: School of Chemistry and Life Resources, Renmin University of China. Code: this https URL
summary: Multi-step LLM reasoning lacks a machine-recheckable ledger: discarded reasoning paths leave no auditable record. We propose the Deposon scattering layer, which binds each node of an LLM-generated concept-decomposition graph to a two-parameter Deposon state; paths undergo three-channel scattering -- transmission, reflection, irreversible dissipation -- obeying T+R+A=1 for arbitrary parameters, with a maximum per-path energy-audit deviation of 2.2E-16 (machine epsilon). We report all three evidence tiers honestly. On synthetic trap benchmarks the path-filtering gain is closed (pre-registered): unified reaches 100% versus a decoy-capture baseline at 7%/10%. On real benchmarks the layer is indistinguishable from a trivial six-keyword rule filter (GSM8K 0.87 >= 0.85, McNemar p=0.5; StrategyQA 0.899 = 0.899); no difference is detected here, so we sharpen the claim to "the differential value lies solely in machine verifiability."
