Fusion yields a second negative result: convex combinations with a semantic prior never improve (physics 0.484 -> 0.452), and the apparent lambda=2 gain is an anti-field artifact; any fusion gain must be nonlinear. Modeling the reverse dynamics as a potential game on the graph, we evidence an auditable scalar's monotonicity and near-gradientness and quantify the empirical coordination ratio (ECR). The three formalized dynamical-equivalence propositions (P1a/P1b/T-P1c) are falsified under the pre-registered kill protocol, and the potential-game claim is downgraded to approximate (cyclic-graph median residual 0.669): only consistency-level evidence survives at the dynamical level. Code: this http URL .

AI.tldr: Deposon 提出一个叠加在 LLM 推理路径上的"散射层",将每条路径的节点绑定到一个双参数 Deposon 状态,执行三通道散射(透射 T / 反射 R / 不可逆耗散 A)并以 T+R+A=1 作为构造性恒等式。文章同时报告已关闭的正面证据(守恒审计、势函数单调性、ECR)与大量诚实的负面结果:在真实基准上散射层与六关键词规则过滤器无法区分,凸组合融合只会稀释语义先验,三层动力学等价命题全部被预注册 kill 协议证伪。最终价值主张被压缩为"机器可验证性"。
AI.motivation: 多步 LLM 推理(CoT、搜索式分解、自一致性投票)在丢弃候选路径时缺乏机器可重算的账本——没有人能事后回答"这条路径为什么被丢弃、消耗了多少预算"。已有工作在组织级审计、密码学可验证计算、差分隐私审计三个层面之间留下一个空层:运行期、逐实例的不变量层。Deposon 旨在用物理学散射的构造性定义来占据这一空层,以"守恒即审计"为核心思路。
AI.method: 1. 概念分解图 + BFS 生成候选路径;每个节点绑定 (g_couple, g_aether) 双参数 Deposon 状态,以 T=1/Λ、R=g_eff/Λ、A=g_aether/Λ 三通道分配能量,T+R+A=1 由构造保证。2. dissipate() 原子累计到单调计数器,无 recover(),对应无限维正交以太的不可逆性。3. 守恒审计:逐路径逐节点独立可重算,实测最大偏差 2.22e-16(双精度机器ε)。4. 逆动力学建模为图上的势博弈:每个 leave-one-out 任务为玩家,势 Φ=-E,执行单纯形自然梯度退火。引入 ECR=field_mean/max(self-interested) 作为分布级运行度量。5. 全部结论按预注册纯函数评判,证据强度三档(closed pre-registered / consistency / motivation only)从不混合。
AI.result: 正面(closed):T+R+A=1 审计残差 2.22e-16;GT-5b 22/22 图 Φ 轨迹单调;GT-6 中位非势残差 1.594e-29(三个环状图例外);ECR 中位数 1.333>预注册线 1.2;P3 附带发现 g_a>0 保障谱条件 ρ(G)<1(机制前提证据)。负面(killed):E9.5 显示散射层在 GSM8K/StrategyQA 上与六关键词规则过滤器无显著差异(McNemar p=0.5/1.0),优势归因于 E9.4 控制揭示的"BFS 最短路优先 + 节点类型标签";融合实验 λ∈{0.25,0.5,1,2} 凸组合在所测设置上从不优于任一单臂(physics 0.484→0.452),λ=2 假性增益被 E9.6 消融证伪为反场伪影;P1a/P1b/T-P1c 三层动力学等价命题在 61 图×338 任务×6760 状态的系统化 kill 协议下全部被证伪,势博弈声明降级为近似(环状图中位残差 0.669);耗散通道在所有已测任务上零收益,仅保留动机性论证;H-A1 被杀,适用域收缩为"对琐碎结构基线稳健 + 高 hub 图局部优势"。
AI.conclusion: Deposon 不是更准确的推理方法,而是一本可被任何持有双精度算术的第三方逐节点、逐路径重算的账本。其价值主张被三组负面结果严格限定:在所测样本量下散射层与六关键词规则过滤器无检测到的精度差(GSM8K 95%CI [-11.8,+7.8]pp、StrategyQA [-8.8,+8.8]pp,小于约 ±10pp 的增量不可排除);凸组合融合所测设置均为稀释;"动力学=最优响应"已被证伪。文章主张负面结论与正面结论权重相等,三个证据强度档从不混合,主张任何动力学等价读法已不可立足,势博弈读法仅在一致性层面存活于 §3.2 的 GT-5b/GT-6 协议下。

title: Answer-Distribution Trajectories: A Stochastic-Dynamics View of LLM Reasoning
summary: Chain-of-thought reasoning provides a structured computation between a model's input and final answer. Yet it is often evaluated through endpoint accuracy, which ignores the path taken to reach that answer. An emerging line of work addresses this limitation using entropy profiles, which track how uncertainty evolves over the reasoning process but do not reveal which competing hypotheses account for that uncertainty. We introduce answer-distribution trajectories, a stochastic-dynamics-inspired representation that tracks the model's full predictive distribution over answers as reasoning unfolds. As a strictly finer representation than endpoint and entropy summaries, answer-distribution trajectories enable us to characterize a trace through a dynamical reasoning profile spanning exploration, revision, motion, and commitment, and to distinguish different dynamical mechanisms of reasoning success and failure. Across sixteen open-weight language models and four reasoning benchmarks, we show that traces with the same endpoint and similar entropy profiles can exhibit substantially different reasoning dynamics. We further find substantial variation in these dynamics both within and across models and tasks, with different objectives favoring different dynamical profiles. Additionally, we show that training and inference choices systematically reshape these profiles. Our results suggest that answer-distribution trajectories provide a rich framework for analysing and evaluating the dynamics of LLM reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"答案分布轨迹"(answer-distribution trajectories)框架，通过追踪CoT推理过程中模型对最终答案的完整预测分布随时间的演化，来分析LLM推理动力学。该表示严格优于端点预测和熵剖面，能揭示传统评估方法遗漏的推理路径差异。
AI.motivation: 现有CoT推理评估主要依赖端点准确率，忽略了推理路径；而新兴的熵剖面方法虽能追踪不确定性演变，却无法揭示产生该不确定性的具体竞争假设。作者旨在提供一种更精细的表示来刻画LLM推理过程。
AI.method: 1) 形式化定义答案分布轨迹：对每个推理前缀，通过Monte Carlo采样独立续写，估计模型对离散答案的预测分布；2) 理论证明轨迹表示严格细于端点和熵剖面（给出反例构造）；3) 提出四维动力学剖面度量：探索（有效支撑）、修订（主导假设切换）、运动（总变差路径长度）、承诺（锁定时间）；4) 定义成功/失败机制分类（稳定成功、救援、绕道、脆弱/未发现、逃逸、失败救援、随机失误）。
AI.result: 在16个开源模型和4个推理基准（GSM8K、ARC、SVAMP、MATH）上的实验表明：(1) 相同端点和相似熵剖面的轨迹可呈现显著不同的动力学；(2) 模型内和模型间均存在大量动力学变异，单一模型-任务对不对应单一特征剖面；(3) 不同目标偏好不同剖面——高精度对应更聚焦、更早承诺的推理，而短CoT对应更广泛、更晚承诺的推理；(4) 指令微调、模型规模和采样温度系统性地重塑动力学剖面。
AI.conclusion: 答案分布轨迹为分析和评估LLM推理动力学提供了丰富框架，随机动力学是描述LLM推理路径的自然数学语言。开放问题包括：开发更廉价的轨迹近似方法、控制研究以分离架构/规模/后训练效果、以及将该信息转化为实际收益（如错误预测、自适应测试计算、过思考诊断与缓解、推理模型优化等）。

title: Time-Varying Data as Sheaves: an Invitation to Narratives
summary: Modern science and engineering increasingly rely on time-varying data, yet the mathematical tools used to model temporal phenomena are often developed within separate disciplines, obscuring common principles and limiting the transfer of ideas across fields. This chapter presents the theory of narratives, an abstract framework for time-varying objects of any mathematical kind that supports both theoretical investigations and applications. To illustrate this perspective, the chapter develops three vignettes, each illustrating a different research direction. The first addresses a general concern: What information loss can occur when switching between different representations of temporal data? The second concerns structural and algorithmic approaches: How can we systematically decompose time-varying data into simple pieces and obtain invariants describing its structural complexity? The third is an application to control theory: How can we model multi-agent systems with switching communication topologies? More important than any individual vignette, the central message of this invitation is that a suitable abstract perspective can organize and guide research across remarkably diverse mathematical and scientific domains.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍"叙事理论"(theory of narratives)，一个用于建模时变数据的抽象数学框架，通过三个不同应用方向展示其跨学科普适性。
AI.motivation: 现代科学与工程越来越依赖时变数据，但各学科独立发展的时间建模工具阻碍了思想跨领域交流。需要一个统一的抽象框架来揭示共同原理并促进跨学科迁移。
AI.method: 提出"叙事理论"作为时变对象的通用抽象框架，涵盖任意数学类型的时变对象。通过三个研究方向的示例(vignettes)进行阐释：(1)表征切换中的信息损失问题；(2)时变数据的结构分解算法与不变量；(3)切换通信拓扑下多智能体系统的控制建模。
AI.result: 展示了一个抽象视角能够有效组织并指导跨越多种数学与科学领域的研究，三个具体应用方向分别涉及信息论、结构分析(分解与不变量)及控制理论(多智能体系统)。
AI.conclusion: 核心结论是：适当的抽象视角能够统一并引导跨领域研究，这一框架为时变数据建模提供了通用语言，促进不同学科间的思想交流与方法迁移。

title: Everything in Moderation: Per-Domain Coverage Optima and Alignment-Resistant Domain Gaps in Multi-Domain Mid-Training
summary: Mid-training, the stage between pre-training and alignment, is where a model's per-domain data composition is typically set by data availability rather than principled design. We ask what that decision buys, and whether a later alignment pass can undo it. In a controlled logical-reasoning setting (Qwen3-8B-Base, with a 4B replication; five semantically rule-disjoint KOR-Bench domains) we train 30 allocations spanning the five-domain simplex, 24 sweep configurations plus six withheld from the fit, at five seeds each. Three findings emerge. First, every domain has an interior coverage optimum: the moderate band ($10\%$-$40\%$) is best for all five domains, and a calibrated permutation test for quadratic interiority gives $P\approx0.010$; the fitted mid-training-only curves, with 8B peaks between $9.9\%$ and $35.1\%$, reproduce for curve shape but not peak location. Second, the gaps survive a fixed-budget alignment pass: compensatory SFT raises 116/120 cells (mean $+4.32\%$) yet bridges $0/240$ pairs at a $5\%$ threshold and $30/240$ at a $10\%$ ratio, an equal-budget uniform control behaves almost identically, and a permutation null would bridge $13.8\pm3.3$ and $77.9\pm8.5$ pairs ($P<0.001$). Third, zero coverage collapses mid-training-only accuracy, though a FineWeb-Edu-only control shows the collapse is commingled with generic drift. An exploratory $\theta^*$ allocation attains the largest full-pipeline gain ($+4.36\%$ vs. $+0.80\%$/$+0.64\%$\,pp) but is marginal under Welch test.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大语言模型中间训练（mid-training）阶段中各领域数据配比对模型性能的影响。通过在 Qwen3-8B-Base 上使用 KOR-Bench 五个逻辑推理领域进行 30 种数据配比的受控实验，发现每个领域都存在一个适中的最优配比区间（10%-40%），且这种由配比差异导致的性能差距在固定预算的 SFT+RL 对齐阶段后基本无法弥合，仅在调整补偿策略时需以牺牲平均精度为代价。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型训练通常分为预训练-中间训练-对齐（SFT/RL）三个阶段，但中间训练阶段各领域数据配比通常由数据可用性而非原理性原则决定。本研究旨在探究两个核心问题：(1) 这一决策带来了什么？(2) 后续的对齐阶段能否弥补中间训练阶段的数据配比失衡？现有研究多关注整体性能或单领域，但中间训练配比对齐阶段鲁棒性的系统性测试尚属空白。
AI.method: 采用受控实验设计：(1) 以 Qwen3-8B-Base 为主，Qwen3-4B-Base 为复制验证，使用 KOR-Bench 五个语义规则不相交的逻辑推理领域（密码学、数学运算、形式逻辑、约束谜题、反事实推理）；(2) 构造 30 种数据配比配置（24 种扫描配置 + 6 种保留配置），每种配置训练 5 个随机种子；(3) 训练阶段固定为中间训练→SFT→GSPO RL 流水线，仅改变中间训练阶段五领域配比；(4) 通过补偿性 SFT（基于 60% 阈值加权补偿覆盖不足领域）和均匀 SFT 对照测试差距弥合能力；(5) 使用非参数置换检验、留一交叉验证、Aitchison 同位素对数比成分分析等统计方法验证结论的稳健性。
AI.result: 三项主要发现：(1) 每个领域存在内部覆盖最优值，适中区段（10%-40%）对所有五个领域均为最佳（置换检验 P≈0.010），8B 模型拟合峰值在 9.9%-35.1% 之间；(2) 固定预算的补偿性 SFT 在 116/120 个配置-领域单元提升精度（平均 +4.32pp），但仅在 5pp 差异阈值下弥合 0/240 对、在 10% 比率阈值下弥合 30/240 对，均匀 SFT 对照行为几乎相同，置换零假设会分别弥合 13.8±3.3 和 77.9±8.5 对（P<0.001）；(3) 零覆盖会导致中间训练阶段精度崩溃（如反事实 83.6%→45.6%），但 FineWeb-Edu 对照表明这种崩溃与通用分布漂移混合存在；探索性 θ* 配置获得最大全流程增益 +4.36pp（对比 +0.80/+0.64pp），但 Welch 检验下不显著。
AI.conclusion: 在受测试的 KOR-Bench/Qwen3 设置下，中间训练阶段的数据配比决策具有持久影响：对齐阶段在固定预算下无法弥合配比导致的领域间差距（0/240 对在 5pp 阈值下被弥合），即使强化补偿策略也需以约一半平均精度增益为代价（γ=∞ 时 12/60 对弥合，但平均增益从 +4.34 降至 +2.26pp）；每个领域存在适中的内部最优值，但这些是简单形层面的边际量而非联合最优混合（成分响应面在所有领域中均表现为鞍点）。实践意义是有条件的：覆盖配比分配值得显式审计，但 θ* 增益在统计检验下是边缘性的，且受单形设计混淆的影响。本研究支持"待检验假设"而非"应遵循规则"。

title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Approximate Value Iteration in Self-Play
summary: Combining search with function approximation has driven major advances in game-playing programs, making self-play algorithms more competitive than ever. Still, the computational overhead of the most popular methods, based on Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS), can be substantial. In this work, we investigate whether simpler methods remain competitive in non-trivial, moderately sized games such as Connect Four, Hex(7x7) and synthetic games. We train a minimal self-play implementation of Approximate Value Iteration (AVI) and use ground-truth oracles for exact evaluation. Contrary to expectations, our results demonstrate the surprising effectiveness of AVI: it learns more accurate value functions than those learned by AlphaZero, while its one-step-lookahead greedy policies remain competitive with MCTS-based policies at substantially lower training and inference costs. Preliminary experiments on Othello and Go(9x9) show that AVI trains stably on larger games and learns effective value functions. These findings suggest that the success of MCTS-based methods may have eclipsed simpler approaches that have become increasingly practical with modern deep-learning tools.

AI.tldr: 论文重新审视一种极简自博弈价值学习法：在二人零和游戏中，以神经函数逼近器通过 ε-greedy 自博弈采样，并执行一步 negamax 备份。作者发现，在 Connect Four、Hex(7×7) 和三类合成 F-Games 上，直接 AVI 学习到的价值比受控的 AlphaZero 基线更准确，且一步贪心策略在更低训练与推理成本下已具备竞争力；其价值还能改善 MCTS 和更深 minimax 搜索。Othello 与 Go(9×9) 上，AVI 训练稳定并能为 MiniZero 的 MCTS 提供更好的叶节点价值，但纯贪心策略仍弱于搜索型智能体。核心结论是：搜索或许主要承担推理时计算分配，而不必是价值监督本身。
AI.motivation: AlphaZero 将 MCTS 与深度网络结合并取得巨大成功，但树搜索在训练和推理中带来大量神经网调用，以及探索、策略学习与价值学习之间复杂的耦合。经典近似价值迭代虽然简单，却因函数逼近、自举和离策略学习构成的“致命三元组”被认为可能发散。本文旨在检验：在现代深度学习工具下，最小化的一步 negamax AVI 是否仍能稳定学习准确价值，并能否以远低于 MCTS 的成本支持有竞争力的决策。
AI.method:
研究采用零和、确定性、完全信息、双方交替行动的游戏，并以当前行棋者视角写为 negamax Bellman 方程。AVI 仅使用共享的 ε-greedy 自博弈、一个固定版本的神经网络以及一步 successor-value 最大化来构造目标：
y(s)=max_a[R(s,a)−γV_{\barθ}(f(s,a))]，
再以 MSE 回归，算法在数据收集和优化间交替，并使用循环经验回放池。AlphaZero 基线使用相同的 JAX 环境、回放、优化代码和骨干网络，但增加策略头，并在自博弈时以 S={32,64,128,256,512} 次 MCTS 模拟产生搜索策略、用最终对局结果作为价值目标。主要在 Connect Four、Hex(7×7) 和三种结构可控且真值已知的 F-Games 上，依据固定评测集比较价值 MAE、一步策略 regret、与完美求解器对弈的错误率、blunder rate、互相对弈得分及 forward-equivalent compute。Connect Four 强 oracle 还给出精确胜负距离；Hex(7×7) 的 MoHex 仅给出 Win/Loss，故对同等结果动作不作区分。F-Games 比较深窄（h=20,b=2）、平衡（h=10,b=5）、浅宽（h=5,b=20）结构。随后在无精确 oracle 的 Othello 和 Go(9×9) 上，以 200 次 MCTS 的 MiniZero 为基准，测试 AVI 训练稳定性、直接互博和跨推理：将 MiniZero 策略先验与 AVI 叶值配对，以分离价值函数贡献。Connect Four/Hex(7×7) 的主要结果分别平均 20 个 AVI 随机种子和 5 个 AlphaZero 种子；Othello/Go(9×9) 为 5 个种子；F-Games 每种结构 10 个独立生成实例。
AI.result: 在 Connect Four 和 Hex(7×7) 上，AVI 随训练平滑降低价值误差，所有 20 个随机种子均未出现发散；其最终 MAE 低于所有测试预算下的 AlphaZero。Hex 上，贪心 AVI 的 regret 和对 oracle 错误率均低于全部 AlphaZero 配置。Connect Four 上，贪心 AVI 的 regret 和错误率接近最强 AlphaZero；其对 512 次模拟 AlphaZero 的直接对弈得分为 −0.09±0.04，说明总体接近，而 Hex 得分为 0.38±0.09，贪心 AVI 更强。推理时，512 次模拟的 AlphaZero 每步需要 512 次网络评估，而 AVI 至多只需 Connect Four 的 7 次或 Hex(7×7) 的 49 次。F-Games 上，AVI 在三种树结构中的价值误差均较低；在深窄树上策略差异较小，原因是 MCTS 能以额外搜索补偿较差叶值。交叉推理实验中，在固定 AlphaZero 策略先验和搜索预算下，将叶值替换为 AVI 价值会降低 Connect Four 与 Hex(7×7) 的错误率；纯价值 minimax 搜索也得到同样结果。Othello 和 Go(9×9) 上，AVI 持续稳定训练，但纯贪心 AVI 仍弱于 200 次 MCTS 的 MiniZero；AVI 价值用于同一 MCTS 预算时则改善两种游戏的对弈表现。论文将交替博弈中的稳定性解释为：某方的高估在对手视角及上一层会反转符号，误差可能振荡抵消而非同向累积；不过作者明确指出这仍是待验证假设。
AI.conclusion: 该工作说明，极简的一步 Approximate Value Iteration 并未因“致命三元组”而必然不稳定。在具有精确 oracle 的多个中型游戏上，它比受控 AlphaZero 学习到更准确的价值，并以一步贪心决策获得竞争性表现，同时显著降低训练和推理成本；其价值对 minimax 与 MCTS 都是更可靠的搜索指导。扩展实验还表明，AVI 能在更复杂游戏中稳定训练，并可增强现有搜索型智能体。因此，论文主张重新评估直接价值学习：MCTS 不一定应被视为价值学习不可或缺的一环；更合理的设计可能是让训练监督保持简单，而在复杂、动作众多的部署场景中，用 MCTS 负责把高质量价值集中分配给更有希望的动作。论文未证明 MCTS 不必要，也未说明 AVI 接近最优；其精确结论主要限于 Connect Four、Hex(7×7) 和 F-Games，大型游戏仅以固定 MiniZero 基准评估。纯贪心推理在 Othello 和 Go(9×9) 上仍存在明显局限，未来方向包括更有针对性的状态与动作采样、学习式动作先验，以及将 AVI 风格价值与策略先验共享表征的混合系统。

title: SAEScientist-Bench: Can AI Agents Conduct Autonomous SAE Interpretability Research?
summary: While research on recursive self-improvement (RSI) has predominantly automated model training pipelines, reliable autonomous development demands a missing pillar: post-hoc monitoring and auditing to understand what models learn and ensure safe alignment. Mechanistic interpretability tools are essential to bridge this gap, among which Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) serve as a cornerstone by isolating interpretable features for model inspection and steering. In this paper, we introduce SAEScientist-Bench to evaluate whether AI agents can act as scientists utilizing SAE tools for autonomous mechanistic discovery. Given a target concept, an agent designs contrastive probes and navigates a Gemma Scope dictionary of 131K+ features in Gemma-2-9B-IT to discover the optimal feature, evaluated against curated expert reference features anchored on Neuronpedia across activation rank, concept selectivity on contrastive texts, and causal steering. Across 10 agent configurations and 20 tasks, frontier agents demonstrate genuine discovery capabilities and lead different evaluation dimensions, but remain well behind the expert baseline, approaching expert levels on separating target concepts from contrastive controls while lagging substantially in causal generation steering. Further analysis reveals that although agents can design contrasts to rule out spurious candidates, they frequently misinterpret experimental measurements. These results establish experimental model understanding as a measurable capability for closed-loop autonomous AI R&D. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: SAEScientist-Bench 提出一个基准,用于评估 AI 智能体是否能够作为科学家,利用稀疏自编码器(SAE)工具进行自主的机制可解释性发现。在 Gemma-2-9B-IT 的 Gemma Scope 字典(131K+ 特征)中,智能体需针对给定目标概念设计对比探针并发现最佳特征,通过对齐 Neuronpedia 专家参考特征,从激活排名、概念选择性和因果引导三个维度进行评估。10 个前沿智能体配置在 20 个任务中展现出真正的发现能力,在不同评估维度上各有所长,但仍远落后于专家基线:接近专家级的概念分离水平,但在因果生成引导方面严重滞后。
AI.motivation: 递归自我改进(RSI)研究主要自动化模型训练流程,但缺少关键的"事后监控与审计"支柱。机制可解释性工具,特别是稀疏自编码器(SAE),是桥接这一缺口的关键,可用于隔离可解释特征以进行模型检查和引导,但目前缺乏标准化基准来严格评估 AI 智能体利用这些工具进行自主科学发现的能力。
AI.method: 构建 SAEScientist-Bench 基准,包含 20 个发现任务,涵盖多语言理解、专业格式和安全关键主题等概念领域;智能体在 Gemma-2-9B-IT 的 Gemma Scope 第 9 层和第 20 层 SAE 字典(131,072 个特征)中,通过 `probe_sae` 接口(每次最多接受 64 条文本)进行多轮交互,设计对比探针并提交一个特征 ID。统一评分框架包含三个互补维度:(1) 激活排名(相对于专家基线的字典排名)、(2) 激活选择性(正例文本与对比控制的 AUROC)、(3) 因果引导(通过激活加法干预后,自动 GPT-4o 评判器对目标相关性和指令保持度进行 0–4 评级)。评估 10 个前沿智能体配置,每个任务进行三次独立运行。
AI.result: Kimi K3 以 65.82 的综合总分领先,Claude Opus 5(65.41)和 Sonnet 5(65.04)紧随其后。Claude Opus 5 在激活排名上领先(75.35),Kimi K3 在激活选择性上领先(92.91 vs 专家 98.92),Grok 4.6 在因果引导上领先(31.47)。所有智能体与专家基线(85.56)存在显著差距,因果引导差距最大(31.47 vs 57.75)。整体得分与 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.2 呈强秩相关(ρ=0.800),激活选择性呈完美秩相关(ρ=1.000)。行为分析揭示:智能体能设计对比探针排除伪候选,但经常误解实验测量;成功发现取决于严谨的假设测试和准确解读实验反馈,而非搜索量。
AI.conclusion: SAEScientist-Bench 建立了评估 AI 智能体进行自主机制可解释性研究的标准化基准。前沿智能体在概念分离方面接近专家水平,但在因果引导方面存在显著能力差距。有效发现依赖于严谨的假设检验、设计信息丰富的反例以及准确解读实验反馈。该基准将机制可解释性与自主 AI 研究相结合,为递归自我改进循环中验证内部表示提供了必要的基础。

title: MeClear: Cooperative Game-Theoretic Attribution and Risk-Aware Memory Clearance for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
summary: Long horizon Large Language Model (LLM) agents rely on external memory systems to preserve user preferences and task knowledge across extended interactions. Conventional retrieval mechanisms optimize semantic compatibility rather than downstream utility, frequently introducing outdated, misleading, or conflicting evidence into the active context. We present MeClear, a task conditioned memory clearance framework that identifies memories featuring negative downstream utility through cooperative attribution and selectively suppresses them from agent execution. MeClear combines Leave One Out screening with sampled cooperative Shapley attribution to distribute utility across interacting evidence, effectively resolving redundant conflict masking where single removal evaluations fail. Utilizing attribution rankings, MeClear executes a query scoped minimal clearance strategy over a nested filtration, verifying task recovery on the cleared context without permanently altering the persistent memory bank. Comprehensive experimental evaluations across ten long dialogue memory pools demonstrate that MeClear achieves a target recall of 85.9% and an overall task recovery rate of 82.3%, representing a 25.5 percentage point improvement over Leave One Out (LOO) baselines.

AI.tldr: MeClear提出一种任务条件下的记忆清理框架，通过结合LOO筛查与采样协作Shapley归因，识别并抑制对LLM智能体下游任务产生负面效用的有害记忆，在不永久修改记忆库的前提下实现检索时的可逆上下文清理，有效解决冗余冲突掩盖问题。
AI.motivation: 长时程LLM智能体依赖外部记忆保留用户偏好和任务知识，但传统检索机制优化语义相似性而非下游效用，常引入过时、误导或冲突证据。语义相关不等于任务有用，单条记录删除评估在冗余有害记忆场景下会产生零效应掩盖（LOO盲点），且永久修改记忆库存在跨任务灾难性回归风险。
AI.method: 四阶段框架：(1)冻结检索上下文；(2)LOO局部反事实筛查；(3)基于排列采样的协作Shapley归因估计各记忆在多样化联盟中的边际贡献，识别冗余掩盖下的负贡献记忆；(4)按归因排序构建嵌套候选清除序列，结合任务增益与恢复谓词验证，选择最小干预的最优清除集。证明了两条理论定理（冗余危害盲点、查询范围清除保证）。
AI.result: 在10个长对话记忆池的745个因果验证案例上（1115条故障记录），MeClear取得85.9%的目标召回率、47.0%的精确集匹配率和82.3%的任务恢复率，相比LOO基线恢复率提升25.5个百分点，在冗余冲突场景下表现尤为突出（LOO恢复率仅6.3% vs MeClear 68.4%）。
AI.conclusion: MeClear将协作博弈论归因引入LLM智能体记忆维护，确立了基于联盟感知的非破坏性上下文清理作为安全长时程记忆管理的基础支柱，证明了检索时验证清除相比永久编辑的优越性。

title: A Generalization of Amari's Bayesian Duality
summary: Amari's contributions to information geometry and machine learning are well known. Here, we revisit Amari's work on Bayesian duality which has not received as much attention. We connect Amari's Bayesian duality to a convex duality of Bayes' rule. Using this connection, we present a generalization of Amari's Bayesian duality and discuss its relevance for modern artificial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文将Amari(1996)提出的贝叶斯对偶性（一种基于信息几何的、要求似然与后验具有相同指数族形式的方法）推广为基于吉布斯变分原理凸对偶的更一般框架，使得在任何贝叶斯模型中都能实现从后验到似然（或损失函数）的逆向映射，并将其与核方法、SVM、变分推断、LLM知识追踪等现代AI研究联系起来。
AI.motivation: Amari(1996)提出的贝叶斯对偶理论曾用于解释大脑高低阶神经系统的信息处理机制，但因其严格要求似然与后验具有相同的指数族形式而难以推广到多数实际机器学习模型（如共轭贝叶斯、岭回归）。本文旨在将这一被忽视的思想与更广泛的凸对偶文献相联系，突破其限制，并讨论其对现代AI的启示。
AI.method: 方法主要包括：(1) 回顾Amari在指数族流形上的双坐标互换机制；(2) 将贝叶斯规则写为吉布斯变分原理（Gibbs variational principle），即q* = arg sup E_q[log p(y|θ)] - D_KL(q‖p)；(3) 利用Donsker-Varadhan公式建立其对偶问题：D_KL(q‖p) = sup_t E_q[log t(θ)] - log∫t(θ)p(θ)dθ，从而实现从后验q反推似然映射t(θ)=exp(⟨λ̃, T(θ)⟩)；(4) 在高斯例子和岭回归例子上分别验证该对偶框架能恢复Amari的双射结果；(6) 通过f空间的推前测度将岭回归的对偶与经典的SVM式对偶（对偶向量α* = y - f*）联系起来。
AI.result: 结果包括：(1) 证明Amari的双射是高斯情形下吉布斯变分对偶的特例；(2) 在岭回归中，对偶问题给出λ̃₁* = x⊤y、λ̃₂* = x⊤x，正确恢复了似然函数；(3) 在f空间中求解时同样得到a* = y、B* = I，恢复了原始似然；(4) 贝叶斯对偶的解并不唯一，因此后验与似然之间一般不是双射；(5) 与非贝叶斯凸对偶（如岭回归的经典对偶向量α*）存在等价关系；(6) 与核方法representer定理、SVM对偶、变分推断对偶（Khan et al., 2013; Adam et al., 2021; Möllenhoff et al., 2026）以及LLM知识追踪等现代AI应用建立了联系。
AI.conclusion: 结论是Amari的贝叶斯对偶可被严格纳入凸对偶的统一框架中，推广后不再要求似然与后验同形式，并能在岭回归等一般贝叶斯模型中实现后验到似然的逆向映射。这一对偶视角为研究模型与数据的关系（如追踪LLM所学知识的紧凑表示）提供了新工具，并有望在变分推断、对抗解释、知识适应、联邦学习等现代AI研究中产生持续影响。

title: ExecCritic: Learn to Test, Test to Improve for Coding Agents
summary: Execution feedback can guide coding agents toward correct repository repairs, but only when the tests capture the behavior requested by the issue. Agent-generated tests can encode incomplete or incorrect behavioral targets; when the same trajectory writes both the patch and the test, their errors can agree and create false confidence. We introduce ExecCritic, combining a test--verify--revise scaffold with a role-specific reinforcement learning recipe for training agents within it. The scaffold separates test construction from source-code repair: a Test agent independently generates repository-native tests, a fail-closed harness qualifies and freezes them, and a Repair agent revises source code from their execution feedback without changing the tests. Both roles use Qwen-3.5-35B-A3B as the backbone and are trained separately. In Learn to Test, the Test agent learns to produce behaviorally valid tests that distinguish correct from incorrect patches. In Test to Improve, the Repair agent learns both direct task resolution and feedback-guided revision. On SWE-bench Verified, test quality determines whether feedback helps: holding the base Repair agent fixed, tests from the base Test agent reduce resolved rate from a no-test baseline of 61.2% to 57.3%, whereas tests from GPT-5.6-sol raise it to 65.3%. Role-specific post-training raises the Qwen Test agent's Base-to-Gold success from 22.2% to 62.2%; composing the two post-trained Qwen agents reaches 72.6%, an 11.4-point gain over the original no-test baseline without stronger-model or Oracle feedback at evaluation time. Code is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: ExecCritic提出"测试-验证-修订"框架，将测试生成与源代码修复解耦：测试代理独立编写回归测试并由harness冻结，修复代理仅根据固定测试的执行反馈修改源码；通过角色专属强化学习（GRPO）分别训练两角色，在SWE-bench Verified上将组合后的Qwen-3.5-35B-A3B系统从61.2%提升至72.6%，证明执行反馈的价值取决于生成测试的质量。
AI.motivation: 仓库级代码修复中，代理自生成的测试可能编码不完整或错误的行为目标；当同一轨迹同时编写补丁和测试时，两者的错误可能一致而造成虚假通过（false confidence）。因此需要：(1) 提升生成测试的行为质量；(2) 使验证标准独立于源码修复过程。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：(1) Learn to Test — 测试代理独立生成仓库原生测试补丁、行为契约和执行命令；fail-closed harness要求其在Base仓库上干净失败，并通过Gold验证和候选补丁平衡准确率（BA）提供奖励；采用SFT初始化（5K DeepSeek-V4-Flash轨迹）+ GRPO RL。(2) Test to Improve — harness冻结测试束，修复代理在每轮（最多5轮）接收有界执行反馈后修改源补丁，使用Oracle F2P测试训练反馈，并设计兼顾直接求解与反馈引导修订的奖励函数（Round 0通过得1.5，修订后通过得1.0）。两角色基于Qwen-3.5-35B-A3B分别训练。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Verified上的关键结果：(1) 固定Qwen修复代理下，Qwen生成测试使解决率从61.2%降至57.3%，而GPT-5.6生成测试提升至65.3%——证明测试质量决定反馈价值。(2) 角色专属后训练：测试代理Base-to-Gold成功率从22.2%升至62.2%；修复代理Round 0从61.2%升至68.3%。(3) 组合训练后的两代理达到72.6%，较原无测试基线提升11.4个百分点，且评估时不依赖更强模型或Oracle反馈。GPT-5.6在Verified上从81.5%提升至85.7%。
AI.conclusion: 执行反馈对仓库修复的价值高度依赖于生成测试的行为质量；通过将测试构造与源码修复解耦并为两角色设计专属强化学习目标，可显著提升开源模型在SWE-bench Verified上的表现（+11.4 pp）。框架的关键在于：测试在修复过程中保持固定，防止修复代理通过弱化验证标准来"通过"测试；官方评估器保留最终裁决权。未来工作包括多检查harness、共享权重联合训练、跨语言扩展（C和Java性能仍有限）。

title: Co-Evolving Harnesses and Models: On-Policy Correction Helps Weaker Models Catch Up Where Imitation Fails
summary: Agent harnesses (the system prompt, tool set, execution hooks, and context-management scaffolding around a model) are a critical determinant of agentic task success. Automated harness evolution can enable smaller models to perform well on domain-specific tasks at a fraction of frontier-model cost. Since both the harness and model weights shape behavior, we ask how harness evolution and lightweight fine-tuning should be combined. Across seven enterprise agent tasks, we first evolve a harness with the weaker model, then find that a stronger expert often uses it more effectively, suggesting expert supervision could close the remaining gap. However, training the weaker model on the expert's complete trajectories under the evolved harness backfires: performance regresses on all seven tasks by 4 to 30 points across Qwen3-Coder and Gemma 4, even though the same procedure helps under the unevolved harness. Our analysis shows that imitation transfers knowledge and increases scaffold usage, but disrupts model-harness fit: the weaker model adopts the expert's planning strategy without the competence to execute it and no longer matches the harness evolved around its native planning style. We therefore develop an on-policy expert-correction pipeline, automated by a meta-level MLE agent, that localizes the failing turn in the weaker model's own rollout and asks the expert to rewrite only that turn. This preserves the model's planning style and combines the gains of harness evolution and model adaptation. Our results identify and resolve a source of contention between harness and weight updates, yielding a compatibility-preserving recipe for economical co-evolution on domain-specific enterprise tasks.

AI.tldr: 在进化后的Agent Harness下，弱模型若直接模仿强模型专家的完整轨迹会出现性能倒退；改用On-Policy Expert Correction（由元级MLE代理定位弱模型自身rollout中失败的回合并仅让专家重写该回合）可保持模型与Harness的契合度，使Harness进化与模型轻量微调协同增益。
AI.motivation: Agent能力由模型权重和外部Harness（系统提示、工具、钩子、上下文管理）共同决定。Harness自动进化能让小模型以低成本逼近前沿模型，但如何与轻量微调（LoRA-SFT）协同/共进化尚未明确。尤其当Harness已针对某弱模型的原生规划风格做过适配后，强模型专家监督信号若以整轨迹模仿方式注入，可能破坏既有的模型-Harness契合度。
AI.method: 1) 任务与基座：基于Yang et al.(2026)的7个企业级Agent基准（工资审计、预算审批、库存预警、异常检测、浏览器自动化、网站管理、代码重构），用GEPA式搜索以gemini-3.1-pro-preview为reflection model、用Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B作为执行器进化Harness h*。2) 基线比较：弱模型在h0与h*、专家模型在h0与h*下的测试成功率。3) 全轨迹模仿（SFT-imit.）：在h*下收集专家成功轨迹并对弱模型LoRA-SFT；同时在h0下做相同流程作为消融。4) 跨族复现：换用gemma-4-26b-a4b-it作为弱模型在Webarena任务上重复。5) 失败分析：基于六类失败本体（工具使用、指令遵循、隐含知识、长上下文、规划、其他），用LLM-as-judge对失败rollout分类，并统计各模型对h*各组件的采用率。6) On-Policy Expert Correction（SFT-corr.）：由自驱MLE代理在弱模型自身rollout中定位失败回合，由专家仅重写该回合（采样N=3并由质量裁判筛选），再LoRA-SFT。7) 在相同h*下评估并做失败类别分布对比。
AI.result: - Harness进化显著提升弱模型：Qwen平均从29.2%→78.0%（+48.8），跨七任务稳定。- 进化Harness可向上迁移到专家：专家在h*下从84.4%→93.6%（+9.2），几乎所有h*组件被使用（93.6–100%），暴露模型侧剩余能力空间。- 全轨迹专家模仿在h*下反致退化：Qwen从78.0%→63.1%（-14.9），七任务全部下降（-4.2到-29.9）；在h0下同一流程却提升29.2%→35.5%（+6.3）。- Gemma上复现：弱Gemma在h*下55.6%，模仿后退化至41.1%（-14.5，相对h0也-5.6）。- 失败归因：模仿后模型对h*采用率不降反升（如domain-computation recipe由30.8%→76.1%），知识类失败略减（46.2%→44.5%），但规划类失败从1.1%飙升至14.6%（+13.5）；h0下规划失败也升（0.9%→11.5%），但知识收益占优使净效果为正。- On-Policy Expert Correction在h*下：Qwen平均从78.0%→79.7%（+1.7），五项任务提升（Web +5.6、Stock +2.2、Refactor +2.2、Anomaly +1.7、Playwright +1.2），其余在噪声内；规划类失败仅由1.1%→1.8%，知识类失败进一步降至43.2%（-3.0）。- 训练开销：单次LoRA-SFT在一小时内完成。
AI.conclusion: 当Harness已围绕某弱模型的原生规划风格做过适配后，简单的全轨迹专家模仿会复制专家的规划策略但弱模型缺乏执行能力，从而破坏模型-Harness契合度并抵消Harness收益。On-Policy Expert Correction——在弱模型自身轨迹的失败回合处做最小化专家改写——能保留其规划分布，同时注入知识增益，使Harness进化与模型适配协同累加。该流程轻量、可由MLE代理端到端自动化、可叠入迭代的Harness-模型共进化循环，为经济地部署面向领域的企业Agent提供了兼容性保持的实用方案。

title: A Data-Driven Framework for Identifying and Prioritizing RPA Opportunities in Healthcare Processes
summary: Robotic Process Automation (RPA) is widely used to reduce administrative burden in United States hospitals, yet an estimated 30-50% of RPA initiatives underperform because processes are selected informally, without a repeatable method to catalogue candidates, prioritize them, match each to an automation tier -- a Python bot, an open-source orchestrator such as n8n, or an enterprise platform such as UiPath -- and forecast financial return before committing resources. We propose a four-module, data-driven framework unifying these decisions: a Process Taxonomy of twenty recurring hospital processes across five value streams; a Prioritization module deriving an Automation Suitability Index from an Analytic Hierarchy Process matrix with an explicit consistency check; a Tool-Tier Selection module recommending the least-cost technology sufficient for a process complexity, integration, and compliance profile; and a Return-on-Investment module quantifying labor savings, error-cost avoidance, payback, and net present value. Applied to a synthetic portfolio spanning all twenty processes, plus a reference data-flow architecture linking it to hospital EHR/payer/ERP systems: 12 of 20 clear the prioritization threshold; the ranking is robust to +/-20% weight perturbation (Spearman correlation 0.83, top-5 set preserved 97.7%, 2,000 Monte Carlo trials); an Automation Risk Index flags four qualifying processes as Critical risk; a budget-constrained portfolio optimization shows diminishing marginal NPV as spend scales from $400K to $1.03M; and a second Monte Carlo analysis shows portfolio NPV stays positive at its 5th percentile. The framework is a conceptual synthesis of the literature rather than an instrument calibrated on primary hospital data; we discuss HIPAA governance and a research agenda for empirical validation. A supplementary Python implementation accompanies the paper.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向美国医院的RPA（机器人流程自动化）机会识别与优先级排序的数据驱动框架，包含四个模块：流程分类法、多准则优先级排序、工具层级选择和ROI量化。基于20个常见医院流程的合成组合进行验证。
AI.motivation: 美国医院面临员工短缺、行政成本攀升和支付方文档要求等多重压力，而30-50%的RPA项目未达预期，主要原因是流程选择缺乏客观、可重复的方法。现有研究存在三个空白：缺乏医疗领域流程分类法、缺乏工具选择决策程序、ROI估算不透明。该框架旨在填补这些空白。
AI.method: 四模块流水线框架：(1) 流程分类法模块——标准化20个医院流程，分5个价值流；(2) 多准则优先级排序模块——基于AHP（层次分析法）的自动化适宜性指数（ASI），含一致性比率检查，另设自动化风险指数（ARI）；(3) 工具层级选择模块——在Python代码机器人、n8n低代码编排器、企业级RPA平台（如UiPath）三种层级中按最小成本足够原则推荐；(4) ROI量化模块——计算年度劳动节省、错误成本规避、回收期和三年NPV（净现值）。通过合成数据进行投资组合规模仿真，并进行蒙特卡洛稳健性分析。
AI.result: 在20个合成流程中，12个通过ASI≥3.5的优先级阈值；AHP权重在±20%扰动下排名稳健（斯皮尔曼相关系数0.83，前5名保留率97.7%，2000次蒙特卡洛试验）；4个合格流程被ARI标记为Critical风险；预算约束下的投资组合优化显示从40万美元到103万美元的NPV边际递减；第二个蒙特卡洛分析显示投资组合NPV在第5百分位数仍为正。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将流程发现、AHP优先级排序、工具选择和ROI量化整合为单一可审计流水线，为美国医院提供从"某流程似乎可自动化"到"成本化、风险标记、预算约束的实施计划"的可重复路径。框架的核心局限在于权重和成本假设源自文献综合而非医院一手数据校准，这界定了未来实证验证的研究议程。

title: Procedural Graphs: Self-Evolving Execution Structures for LLM Agents
comment: 36 pages including references and appendices, 6 figures, 11 tables
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed as agents that plan over long horizons and act through external tools. Most agents select actions through unconstrained generation over an accumulating history, leaving implicit the procedural knowledge of what to do, in what order, and under which conditions. As trajectories lengthen, agents can lose track of their objectives, invoke tools out of order, and repeat unproductive actions. We introduce the Procedural Graph: just as a knowledge graph organizes factual knowledge into (entity, relation, entity) triplets for what-is questions, a Procedural Graph organizes procedural knowledge into (procedure, relation, procedure) triplets for what-to-do questions. At each decision step, the framework localizes the agent's active node, and a guidance model translates the surrounding subgraph into step-level situational guidance that biases the solver's next action without dictating it. The graph is self-evolving: an LLM refiner contrasts failed trajectories with successful ones and edits the graph's topology and attributes, committing edits that preserve or improve held-out validation performance while retaining rejected ones to discourage repetition. Starting from a minimal skeleton, the loop builds graphs that match or surpass hand-designed ones. It can also repair a flawed expert prior. Across multiple datasets, task types, and LLMs, the Procedural Graph delivers consistent gains over memory-based baselines, and self-evolution further improves performance without manual engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"过程图"(Procedural Graph, PG)，将程序性知识显式建模为 (procedure, relation, procedure) 三元组的有向属性图，用于指导LLM智能体的长时程执行。框架包含两个互补阶段：在线推理时通过定位当前节点、提取h-hop邻域子图并由引导模型生成情境化建议；离线自演化通过对比诊断轨迹、提出拓扑/属性编辑，并由验证门控和拒绝记忆保障更新质量。实验覆盖6个基准（HotpotQA、MultiChallenge、GDPval、ALFWorld、τ-bench、BFCL v3、EnterpriseArena）和4个LLM，在21/24配置中排名第一，并能从最小骨架自构建或修复有缺陷的专家先验。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体通过非受控生成从累积历史中选择动作，将"做什么、按什么顺序、在何种条件下"的程序性知识隐式化。随着轨迹变长，智能体易偏离目标、乱序调用工具、重复无效动作。文本记忆和状态条件规则虽提供经验但缺乏步骤间的连接，工作流/状态机虽显式但通常需人工设计。需要一种可编辑、可演化、既能引导又能保留推理自由度的结构化程序性知识表示。
AI.method: 1) 形式化定义PG为有向属性图 G=(V,R,E,Φ)，节点抽象工具动作/推理步骤/状态，边编码合法转移并携带condition/guidance/pitfalls三类文本属性。2) 在线生成式引导：在每步通过Match定位当前节点u_t，取其h-hop有向邻域 G_t，引导模型 Ψ 将边属性翻译为情境指导 g_t 附加到求解器提示中；求解器以 a_t~P(q,T_t,g_t) 选择动作。3) 离线四步自演化循环：诊断回滚→LLM refiner对比成功/失败轨迹提出拓扑增删与属性修订→结构校验后候选图在验证集 D_val 上门控（不降低即接受）→被拒候选记入拒绝记忆 H_rejected 作为后续refiner的负证据。算法1给出完整伪代码。4) 配置：h=2跳邻域、轨迹窗口w=3；评估4个LLM（Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 3.1 Pro、Gemini 3.5 Flash、Grok 4.1 Fast），与7个基线（Vanilla ReAct、MemoryBank、RAP、ExpeL、AutoGuide、AWM、KnowAgent）共享同一ReAct求解器。
AI.result: 主结果（表1）：在6基准×4LLM的24配置中PG 21次排名第一/并列第一；对比最强基线19胜2平3负（单侧二项符号检验 p=4.3e-4）。最大增益：BFCL v3 (Gemini 3.5 Flash) +9.00点、GDPval (Gemini 3.1 Pro) +7.41点、τ-bench (Gemini 3.1 Pro) +6.96点。EnterpriseArena长程稳健性（表8/图3）：全周期存活率从基线44.0%升至58.0%（Claude）、6.0%→34.0%（Gemini 3.1 Pro）、26.0%→40.0%（Grok 4.1 Fast）；关键改进来自提前融资而非工具调用次数。构建策略（表2）：Mode 5（Scratch+在线演化）在HotpotQA达78.79% F1；MultiChallenge上Mode 3从有缺陷先验恢复至92.86%，超越Mode 5的91.07%。自演化轨迹（图4/表11）：EnterpriseArena 10轮中验证存活率从0%→90%，测试集85% vs 基线0%（Fisher精确 p=2.6e-8）；揭示了"审计现金→预测→保存笔记→检查市场→资本决策"主干的涌现。效率分析（表3）：子图定位生成式引导在三基准均最优，比全图生成式减少70.9%/18.1%/14.8% token，但相对无图基线仍增加token开销。
AI.conclusion: PG将程序性知识外化为可检查、可检索、可演化但无需重训的显式图结构，结合属性化转移、邻域引导与拓扑优化，为LLM智能体提供了"下一步做什么"的可查询回答。核心贡献在于：(1) 程序性图表示，(2) 在线邻域引导机制，(3) 离线闭环自演化，(4) 跨任务/模型的实证一致性。局限：引导调用增加token消耗（即使缩短轨迹），且跨求解器和工具接口的迁移性有待评估；未来工作可探索引导复用与选择性生成。

title: When Do Options Help? Policy Necrosis and Redundant Coverage in Option-Critic
summary: Option-critic learns options: sub-policies together with a learned rule for when each one hands control back. Its headline result is that performance improves as options are added. We explain that result, with theory and experiment. First, the termination rule option-critic learns by maximising return contributes nothing. When the termination test and the policy that picks options read the same values, the test fires at every step, so the learned rule is identical to always terminating. When that policy explores and the test does not, as in option-critic itself, the rule can block the exploration; there are instances where it suffers $\Omega(T)$ regret while always terminating holds to $O(\log T)$. Forcing termination at every step leaves the option-count curve intact. Second, the policy inside an option barely explores at all, so a state locks onto the first action that looked good and never updates again. We name this policy necrosis, give a state-level test for it, and find three fifths of states necrotic in a typical option. Restoring exploration repairs those states, and one option then solves the task. Third, extra options improve no option; what falls is the chance that all of them fail in the same state, from $59\\%$ to $4\\%$, and performance follows that joint quantity.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过理论与实验证明Option-Critic算法中"增加选项数量提升性能"的现象并非源于时序抽象，而是源于三个相互作用的失败/修复机制：终止函数无效、下层策略"坏死"、以及多选项冗余覆盖。
AI.motivation: Option-Critic的标志性实验结果是"增加选项数量K能提升性能"，常被解读为时序抽象带来的增益。然而这一曲线中混杂了三个混淆因素：时序结构变化、容量/优化几何变化、以及路由决策负担变化。该论文旨在通过控制变量法分离这些因素，揭示性能提升的真实来源。
AI.method: 理论与实验相结合：(1)在两层UCB老虎机模型中证明终止规则的理论性质（Proposition 1、Theorem 2、Theorem 3）；(2)提出"策略坏死"诊断——状态级测试，基于最优可接受动作集A*(s)判断选项是否在某状态"坏死"；(3)使用FourRooms环境（表格+神经实现），350个匹配种子，采用冻结检查点零探索评估协议；(4)五种转移核（局部滑移、全局传送）×两种奖励（稀疏、恒定代价），包括直接行动和惯性两种连续变体。
AI.result: 三个核心发现：(1)终止函数β≡1（每步重选）时K-性能曲线完全保留，学习的终止函数在K=2时有利、K=8时有害，方向随K反转；(2)softmax温度τ=10⁻³与学习率0.25的组合使状态在一次更新后即"坏死"——约3/5状态坏死；恢复下层探索后，单个选项从306.7降至55.4步，350/350种子改善；(3)增加选项不改善任何单个选项（单选项坏死率稳定在~60%），但联合坏死率从59%降至4%，性能跟随联合指标变化；有效独立选项数κ在K=8时约为6.20。
AI.conclusion: Option-Critic的K-缩放结果不源于时序抽象，而源于：(a)下层softmax的坏死失败，(b)多选项冗余作为该失败的变通方案，(c)下层探索作为根本修复。一旦探索被恢复，单个选项足以完成任务，更多选项开始带来路由成本。终止函数在一致值下是恒等操作，在不一致值下可能成为无次线性保证的探索否决器。论文的更广泛启示是：任何架构先验若被放在有可修复缺陷的基学习器之上，会被错误归功于它所掩盖的缺陷。

title: DART: A DAG-Based Reputation and Incentive Framework via Blockchain-Enabled Governance for Trustworthy LLM Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) predominantly rely on centralized orchestration and lack formal verification mechanisms for agent reliability, participation, and system-level behavioral alignment. These shortcomings leave open environments severely vulnerable to uncooperative or malicious agents. This work proposes DART, a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG)-based reputation and incentive regulation framework for trustworthy multi-agent collaboration, combining centralized operational orchestration with blockchain-enabled decentralized governance and accountability. DART unifies DAG workflow orchestration, capability and reputation-aware task allocation, dynamic behavior updates, multi-factor incentives, and smart contract accountability paired with IPFS storage. Under this paradigm, agent selection dynamically balances task alignment, historical reputation, and workload, while post-execution behavioral evidence continuously calibrates agent trust and the probability of future participation. Evaluated across four axes, DART achieves 93.6% Pass@1 on GSM8K and builds a full-stack application in 142 s using two agents, outperforming centralized baselines. Across five independent 150-round longitudinal trials, Full DART achieves a mean task success rate of 93.33 +/- 2.26%, output quality of 0.9357 +/- 0.0117, retry rate of 0.2307 +/- 0.0816, and allocation delay of 1.1153 +/- 0.0408 s, consistently outperforming its ablated configurations DART isolates persistent and intermittent malicious agents, obtaining a 99.3% output containment rate and restoring system success to 99.8%. These results demonstrate the potential of coupling reputation, incentives, DAG-based coordination, and verifiable blockchain-enabled governance to support adaptive and accountable multi-agent collaboration.

AI.tldr: DART 提出了一种基于 DAG 的信誉与激励机制框架，结合区块链去中心化治理，用于 LLM 多智能体系统的可信协作。它将 DAG 工作流编排、能力与信誉感知的任务分配、动态行为更新、多因素激励与智能合约问责制统一起来，通过四组实验验证了其在任务质量、效率和抗对抗攻击方面的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 多智能体系统主要依赖中心化编排，缺乏对智能体可靠性、行为合规性的形式化验证机制，在开放环境中易受恶意或不合作智能体攻击。同时，现有区块链类框架缺乏对复杂任务依赖的建模能力，且信誉与激励机制松散耦合，无法有效驱动自适应协作。
AI.method: DART 采用双层混合架构：(1) 编排层——包含元规划器、领域专家规划器、计划合并器、DAG 调度器与执行智能体池，通过 Meta-Planner→Domain-Expert Planners→Plan Merger 三阶段生成 DAG 工作流；任务分配基于综合适配度评分（能力匹配+历史信誉+负载）经 Softmax 采样完成。(2) 区块链层——通过智能合约管理智能体/任务/动作/信誉与激励四个注册表，IPFS 存储执行产物。核心机制包括：基于余弦相似度的能力匹配；多因素激励（正奖励 R 与惩罚 P，含复杂度、成功、质量、令牌效率、超时、能力失配、负载等因子）；行为异常评分 B（加权聚合失败率、质量、验证分、能力失配、超时）；短期滑动窗口异常率 Ψ 与长期累计失败率 Ω；信誉通过 EMA 更新并耦合长期惩罚项 ρ^{t+1}=clip(ηρ+(1-η)(P-κΩ-μΨ),0,1)。恶意智能体在短期异常率超过阈值 θ_flag=0.65 时被永久隔离。
AI.result: 四组实验结果：(RQ1) GSM8K 达 93.6% Pass@1，优于 MegaAgent(93.0%) 与 AutoGen(87.8%)；HumanEval 88.0%、MBPP 81.0%、MATH 64.0%，具竞争力。(RQ2) 五子棋全栈开发中，DART 仅用 2 个智能体在 142s 内完成（满足全部 C1–C4），较 MegaAgent 7 智能体 800s 降低 82.2%；分阶段令牌消耗总计 76,662。(RQ3) 五轮 150 轮独立实验，Full DART 任务成功率 93.33±2.26%、输出质量 0.9357±0.0117、重试率 0.2307±0.0816、分配延迟 1.1153±0.0408s，全面优于六种消融配置；OS Interaction 域信誉快速升至 0.80 后平台化。(RQ4) 三类对抗智能体（Beta 100%/Alpha 70%/Gamma 60% 损坏率）分别在第 32/41/50 轮被隔离，OCR=99.3%，无假阳性，隔离后系统成功率恢复至 99.8%。链上 Gas 消耗在 29K–169K 区间，IPFS 检索 2.59ms、上传 31.70ms。
AI.conclusion: DART 通过耦合 DAG 编排、信誉感知分配、多因素激励和区块链治理，证明了在 LLM 多智能体系统中实现可信、可审计、自适应协作的可行性。它能在标准基准上保持竞争力，在复杂多智能体协调中显著提升效率，并通过行为异常检测与滑动窗口隔离有效应对持续性和间歇性对抗智能体。然而，评估未涵盖完全自适应、阈值感知的对手，且参数敏感性分析表明检测延迟与窗口大小 W 和阈值 θ_detect 之间存在可预测的权衡，需未来进行自适应校准与公链规模化部署验证。

title: When Agent Governance Helps
comment: 35 pages, 14 figures. Companion empirical study to a Purdue this http URL dissertation. Introduces the GAMPO framework from a 321-source qualitative evidence synthesis and probes a prompt-layer instantiation on the CHI-Bench healthcare benchmark across open and frontier models
summary: No specification says how a governed autotelic AI agent organization, where agents pursue self-generated goals inside guardrails, should be designed and evaluated. We answer in two parts. First, we synthesize the Governed Autotelic Multi-Agent Product Organization (GAMPO) framework from a document-based qualitative evidence synthesis of 321 sources, integrating agency, agile, platform, and governance theory into a runnable specification. Second, we probe a prompt-layer instantiation of GAMPO on CHI-Bench, a long-horizon healthcare benchmark, across open and frontier models. The result is a boundary condition: governance benefit is gated by a model's spare capacity and is domain- and model-specific. On capacity-constrained open models the full procedure yields no reliable benefit, whereas a single "verify your writes" sentence doubles task success (pass@1 2/20 to 4/20). At the frontier the same scaffold lifts prior-authorization 24% to 40% but nets zero on another model, a gap traced to a stable recommendation-override disposition. A second result refines the first: replacing the generic procedure with an answer-blind, per-task definition-of-done, keyed only to the case's own policy and published standards, never the hidden key, raises prior-authorization to 84% under best-of-five self-consistency (68% single-attempt, confirmed by a held-out board) and utilization-management to 44%, while care-management meets a subjective content-quality wall. The contribution is a named, auditable framework and capability-gated evidence that governance should be sized to spare capacity, and that at the frontier a case-grounded specification beats a uniform procedure. Findings are exploratory: partial instantiation, small per-cell samples (n = 5-25), and single trials.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个名为GAMPO（Governed Autotelic Multi-Agent Product Organization）的框架，用于规范和评估由AI代理组成的自治产品组织的设计与运行。通过对321个来源进行定性证据综合，并使用CHI-Bench医疗基准进行实证测试，论文发现治理效果取决于模型的"剩余容量"（spare capacity）：对容量受限的模型，简单的单句验证提示比完整框架更有效；而在前沿模型上，基于案例的盲答式规范定义比通用程序更有效。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型驱动的自主代理组织开始承担产品与软件工作，领导者亟需知道两件事：(1) 一个可辩护的治理设计是什么样的；(2) 为代理增加治理结构是否真正能改善结果。目前缺乏整合性的框架来规范此类系统的设计、运营和评估，也缺乏实证证据说明增加治理支架对有能力代理的任务行为是否有助益。
AI.method: 研究分为两部分：(1) 基于文档的定性证据综合（QES），采用PRISMA 2020对齐流程，从1847条记录中筛选出321个来源，使用AMSTAR 2、CASP、JBI、AACODS四种工具进行评估，整合自主性、精益敏捷、平台和治理理论构建GAMPO规范；(2) 经验性基准探测，将GAMPO实例化为约5200字符的提示层脚手架，附加到CHI-Bench医疗工作流基准（75个任务跨三个领域）的代理前，对开放模型和前沿模型进行配对A/B测试，包括通用程序、单句验证、轻量版、答案盲式逐任务定义完成等变体。
AI.result: 主要发现：(1) 治理效益取决于模型的剩余容量——在能力受限的开放模型上，完整框架平均无效甚至有害（35B模型PA域Delta=-0.114），但一个单句"验证写入"提示使pass@1翻倍（2/20到4/20，pooled fractional 0.431→0.590）；(2) 在前沿模型Claude Opus 4.8上，完整框架使先授权（PA）从24%升至40%，利用率管理（UM）从8%升至16%，care-management从40%升至56%；(3) 跨厂商复制验证：Gemini 3.1 Pro和Kimi 2.7-code在PA上均显示+0.056的提升；(4) 答案盲式逐任务定义完成（answer-blind per-task definition-of-done）在前沿模型上将PA进一步提升至84%（best-of-five自一致性），单次尝试68%（已由held-out板确认），UM达44%（单次39.2%）；(5) Care-management遭遇主观内容质量天花板，通用程序（56%）反而优于内容咨询（40%）；(6) 在Opus 5上的跨代际复制得54.7%总体准确率。所有结果为探索性，每格样本n=5-25，单次试验。
AI.conclusion: 论文贡献了一个可审计、可命名的代理治理框架（GAMPO），以及关于代理治理的能力门槛证据。核心结论是：治理应与剩余容量成比例（govern in proportion to spare capacity）。对容量受限的生产模型，简单的行动落地验证检查优于全面程序；对前沿模型，应优先采用基于案例的答案盲式规范，而非更长的通用程序。预期效益具有领域和模型特异性，而非普遍提升。这些发现是探索性的关联结果，应被视为设计启发而非因果保证。框架已在可运行的gampo-runtime仓库中实现，但实证研究仅测试了提示层内核（26个组件中的8个）。

title: TamilEOT: A Dataset and Model for Semantic End-of-Turn Detection in Tamil Telephone Speech
comment: 13 pages, 7 tables. Code, data and models: this https URL
summary: A voice agent has to decide, at every pause, whether the user has finished speaking. Without a model of the language that decision falls back to a fixed silence timeout: set it short and the agent interrupts, set it long and every turn pays the full wait. Open semantic end-of-turn detectors exist, but to our knowledge none covers a South Indian language. We release TamilEOT: 18,485 labelled turn boundaries cut from 116 real Tamil telephone conversations, and two audio-only detectors fine-tuned from Smart Turn v3. On a held-out split of 4,168 clips from 30 unseen calls, accuracy rises from 70.30% zero-shot to 83.71% (8.7 MB) and 86.13% (21 MB); ROC-AUC rises from 0.751 to 0.921. Both models run in under 150 ms single-threaded on a laptop CPU. We also report what building it cost. Rule-derived labels, checked against a blind human listening pass, were right 95.9% of the time on the positive class and 44.4% on the negative class, which is below chance, because the rule answered a different question than the model is asked. Replacing them with an audio-LLM labeller measured at 97.5% human agreement cost US$5.69. Of every training lever we measured, only encoder capacity moved the result; three runs at identical config and seed span 0.87 accuracy points, which is the floor below which none of our other deltas mean anything. Replaying the same labelled boundaries through the production VAD and streaming adapter costs a further 2.60 points, and 7.8% of boundaries are never surfaced to the model at all. Data, weights, code and every negative result are public.

AI.tldr: 本文发布 TamilEOT：首个面向泰米尔语电话语音的开放式语义话轮结束（EOT）检测数据集（18,485 个标注边界，源自 116 段真实双声道通话），并基于 Smart Turn v3 微调了两个轻量音频模型（tiny/base，int8 后 8.7 MB/21 MB）。在 30 通未见电话的 4,168 条保留测试集上，准确率从零样本 70.30% 提升至 86.13%，ROC-AUC 从 0.751 提升至 0.921，单线程 CPU 推理延迟 <150 ms。核心贡献不仅在于模型，更在于一套经过验证而非仅凭假设的标注协议：通过盲听检验发现规则标注在负类上仅 44.4%（低于随机），并以 5.69 美元成本的音频 LLM 重新标注，得到 97.5% 的人类一致率。
AI.motivation: 现有的开放语义话轮结束检测器（如 Smart Turn v3）覆盖 23 种语言，但不包含任何南印度语言。语音助手若仅依赖固定静音超时，存在打断用户或响应迟滞的两难。架构（Whisper 编码器+分类头）已开源，缺失的是泰米尔语的有标注数据与经过验证的标注方案。
AI.method: 1) 数据源：SPRING-INX Tamil R1 的 116 段双声道窄带电话通话，每条通话的两条腿单独录音并人工转写，因此声源天然与说话人对应，无需说话人日志化。2) 边界检测：对每条腿独立运行 Silero VAD 取语音起止，转写仅用于剔除对侧串扰和反向通道词。3) 样本几何：每条样本为语音偏移后 200 ms 截止的 8 秒音频，正负类尾部静默长度严格对齐以防止"读静音长度"的捷径。4) 标签验证：先以规则生成（话者切换=完整，段内停顿=未完整），再以 197 条样本盲听测试，发现负类一致率仅 44.4%（低于随机），因规则回答的是"说话人是否打算继续"（Q2）而非"语句是否句法完整"（Q1）。5) 重标注：用 7 个音频 LLM 烘焙对比，最终 Gemini-3.7-flash 以 97.5% 一致率、5.69 美元完成全池标注。6) 模型：复用 Smart Turn v3 架构，Whisper-tiny/base 编码器+注意力池化+二元头，BCEWithLogitsLoss+per-batch pos_weight，6 epoch、lr=5e-5、T4 单卡训练；导出 fp32 ONNX→int8 dynamic。7) 服务评估：配对回放同一标注边界穿过真实 Silero VAD 与流式适配器，对比离线剪辑窗口与实时窗口。
AI.result: 主结果：TamilEOT-base int8 dynamic 达 86.13% 准确率/0.921 ROC-AUC，tiny 版 83.71%/0.905，均优于零样本 v3.2（70.30%/0.751）；同尺寸下 int8 dynamic 几乎无损（tiny -0.10~+0.36）。六个训练杠杆中唯一有效的是编码器容量（tiny→base +2.88），其余如蒸馏、漏斗松弛、学习率微调、数据翻倍、类再平衡均落在 0.87 点的复现性地板之下或反而有害（int8 static 量化在 base 上 -12.76）。服务回放：同一 461 条边界，离线 86.12%→实时 83.51%，损失 2.60 点（VAD 关闭比标注偏移晚 90 ms），7.8% 边界从未被送入模型。延迟：单线程 CPU，tiny 83 ms、base 143 ms（含 12 ms mel 前端，端到端 120–155 ms）。基线零样本 v3.2 在阈值 0.5 下把 36.4% 的未完泰米尔话轮判为完成——仅排名有效而决策边界错位。
AI.conclusion: 泰米尔语义话轮结束检测的瓶颈不是架构而是数据与可信标注。三点可推广经验：1) 用听感而非直觉验证标签规则——无见证人的那类会系统崩塌；2) 先建立运行间波动地板再报差异，本工作在 0.87 点之下多个杠杆不可证伪；3) 度量"服务代价"——离线 86% 与实时 83% 不是同一数字，VAD 覆盖与窗口偏移是部署端独立损失源。同套流水线（双声道语料+结构化标签预言机）应可移植至任何语言。代码、模型、数据集与全部负结果均以 CC BY 4.0/BSD-2 公开发布。

title: PAC-Private Autoregressive Generation: Calibrating Noise to Ensemble Disagreement
summary: Language models adapted on private text are often served through APIs, so privacy leakage occurs through generated outputs rather than exposed weights. Private prediction protects these releases. Methods such as PMixED incur privacy cost at each release and increasingly rely on the public model over long horizons. PAC privacy instead calibrates noise to output variability across possible secrets, adding less noise when predictions are stable. To our knowledge, PAC-private prediction has not previously been extended from classification to autoregressive generation. We construct $m=128$ overlapping worlds from the private corpus, with each record appearing in exactly $m/2$ worlds, and train one adapter per world over a frozen public model. The realized world is the secret. At each token, the public model defines a candidate set, the worlds vote, and their posterior-weighted disagreement determines the PAC noise; unanimity requires no calibration noise. We prove $I(S;Y_{1:T}) \leq I(S;H_T) \leq bT$. Our contributions are extending PAC privacy to autoregressive generation, handling adaptive self-generated contexts, and introducing coupled decoding that preserves privacy accounting while avoiding greedy degeneration. On WikiText-103 with GPT-2-small, we retain 74% of the fine-tuning gain at a per-token budget of $2^{-32}$, while membership-inference success is bounded by 51.08% after $10^6$ tokens; posterior-entropy estimates of leakage are roughly 17% of the charged budget. Inference privacy is not content protection: even when membership advantage on a memorized canary is indistinguishable from zero, the canary is emitted at the same rate. Against PMixED under matched membership-inference bounds on the same data universe and test set, we retain 98% of non-private headroom from $10^2$ to $10^6$ tokens, versus at most 56%, with no crossover.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将PAC隐私预测（PAC-private prediction）从分类任务扩展到自回归语言生成任务。核心思想是从私有语料构建m=128个重叠子集（"世界"），每个记录恰好出现在64个世界中，每个世界训练一个LoRA适配器。在每个token生成时，公共模型定义候选集，所有世界在候选集内投票，其后验加权分歧决定PAC噪声校准；一致投票无需噪声。作者证明了端到端互信息上界I(S;Y_{1:T}) ≤ bT，并提出了耦合Gumbel解码以避免采样带来的虚假分歧。在WikiText-103和GPT-2-small上的实验显示，该方法在每token预算b=2^{-32}下保留了74.3%的微调增益（贪婪解码）和84.4%（耦合Gumbel），成员推理成功率被限制在51.08%以下，10^6 token后；通过后验熵估计的实际泄漏约为固定记账的17%。在相同成员推理约束下，对比PMixED基线，在10^2到10^6 token的所有查询范围内保留了98%的非私有性能上限（而PMixED最多保留56%），且无交叉点。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在私有文本上微调后通过API部署，隐私泄漏通过生成输出而非模型权重发生。现有隐私预测方法（如PMixED）在每次发布时消耗隐私预算，随着生成长度增加越来越依赖公共模型，导致效用下降。PAC隐私通过根据输出在不同可能秘密间的变异性来校准噪声，稳定的预测只需更少噪声，但此前仅适用于分类任务，未被扩展到自回归生成。
AI.method: 1. 私有语料U（含2,048篇WikiText-103文章+16个金丝雀记录）分配到m=128个重叠"世界"，每个记录恰好在64个世界中；2. 每个世界训练一个LoRA适配器（r=8）于冻结的GPT-2-small基础模型上；3. 每步t：公共模型定义top-200候选集V_t，所有128世界在V_t内投票（贪婪或耦合Gumbel τ=1.0）；4. 计算后验加权投票协方差C_t = diag(π_t) - π_t π_t^T，秩至多a_t-1；5. 在C_t的活动子空间上用PAC校准函数Σ(P_{t-1}, M_t, b)确定噪声协方差Σ_t；6. 形成内部向量R_t = e_{v_S} + Z_t，更新后验P_t，发布Y_t = argmax_{v∈A_t}(R_t)_v；7. 耦合Gumbel解码使用共享随机变量U_t以保持确定性条件和边际保真度。理论证明包括四个核心引理/命题：标记释放（数据处理不等式）、活动子空间校准（处理奇异协方差）、自回归查询可纳性、耦合解码保持记账。
AI.result: 1. 稳定性普查：k=200时83.4%位置上所有128世界投票一致，中位数不同投票数为1，第95百分位为2；2. 隐私-效用权衡：在b=2^{-32}下，贪婪解码保留74.3%微调增益（42.44% vs 公共38.16% vs 非私有43.92%），耦合Gumbel保留84.4%；3. 预算平坦性：在b从2^{-4}到2^{-32}的2^28范围内，精度几乎不变（42.43-42.87%），因为一致投票占主导；4. 实际泄漏估计约为固定记账的17%（跨15个cell稳定在17.0-18.8%），相当于约5.8倍保守性；5. 金丝雀压力测试：强制记忆下，b=2^{-16}时成员推理优势统计上与零无显著差异，但金丝雀字符串发射率仍基本不变（48.9-51.3%），区分了推理隐私与内容保护；6. 与PMixED对比：在ε≈1匹配成员推理界下，PAC-Gumbel在T=10^2到10^6所有查询范围保留98.0-98.4%的非私有性能上限，而PMixED最多55.7%（慷慨记账）至0.9%（严格记账），且PMixED的回退率（f_∅）从19%升至85%，说明其被迫用公共模型回答大多数查询；7. 计算成本：128世界批量前向传播29.71ms/token，机制本身仅0.223ms（0.74%），吞吐量33.4 tokens/s。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功将PAC隐私预测扩展到自回归生成，通过128个重叠世界的构造实现了：1. 端到端隐私保证I(S;Y_{1:T}) ≤ bT（定理4）；2. 处理了自回归设置特有的四个问题——标记输出而非向量、大词汇表下的奇异协方差、自生成查询流、采样解码的随机性；3. 经验上保留了大部分微调增益，且精度在宽预算范围内平坦；4. 实际泄漏仅为固定记账的约17%，表明固定预算记账约保守5.8倍；5. 相比PMixED在长查询范围下保持显著优势（98% vs ≤56%），无交叉点；6. 揭示了两个广泛教训：隐私泄漏在退化文本中可能人为变小（因为集成也倾向于一致），且低成员推理优势并不意味着记忆内容不能被重现。该方法的主要局限在于：评估基于单一语料和单一世界集合，记账在内部历史而非token流上的松弛未被量化，且推理隐私不等同于内容保护。

title: Who Maintains Agent Skills? A Longitudinal Study of Human-Governed, AI-Assisted Skill Maintenance
summary: Lifelong LLM agents increasingly rely on external skill artifacts as one element for preserving and reusing capabilities over time. These skills (usually portable Markdown files such as this http URL ) describe when and how to apply a capability and must be corrected, expanded, and consolidated as tools and usage patterns shift over deployment. Recent work seeks to automate skill curation, but it largely evaluates against automated baselines and treats human maintenance as an unmeasured bottleneck. We study that missing process directly. We mine the full commit histories of five public AI-skill repositories, a purposive sample of AI-tooling organizations, covering 873 commits, 143 skill files, and 254 substantive post-creation edits from October 2025 to June 2026. We code each edit with pre-registered governance, operation, and trigger-evidence codebooks. Three findings emerge. First, every substantive edit is authored or merged through a named human account, while 62% carry an AI co-author trailer, with large repository-level variation. Second, these edits are genuine curation: an audited sample shows that most change skill content, and the coded operations are dominated by additions and corrections. Third, a pre-registered rule-likeness axis fails its reliability gate; reliably coding rule-likeness from commit artifacts remains an open measurement problem. We release the corpus, codebooks, mining scripts, and a replay protocol for automated skill curators. For self-evolving agents, public skill maintenance currently looks less like an autonomous pipeline than a human-governed, AI-assisted loop that future curators must measure against and operate within.

AI.tldr: 该论文对五个公开AI技能仓库的git提交历史进行纵向实证挖掘，研究谁在维护LLM代理的Markdown技能文件（SKILL.md）以及维护内容是什么。研究覆盖873次提交、143个技能文件、254次实质性创建后编辑，得出三个核心发现：(1) 每次实质性编辑都通过具名人类账户完成（62%携带AI合著trailer），形成人类治理、AI辅助的循环；(2) 编辑以内容扩展和事实修正为主（增强占60%、修正占38%），但合并/弃用极少；(3) 预设的"规则相似性"编码轴可靠性失败（κ=-0.02），表明从提交工件中可靠编码规则泛化能力仍是一个开放的测量问题。此外，能力迁移测试（13个技能×11个任务）在设计控制后未发现维护带来的技能质量提升（效应值-0.09，CI[-0.28,+0.10]）。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化技能策展系统（如SkillOpt、SkillOS、Trace2Skill）通常仅与自动化基线进行评估，将人类维护视为可扩展性瓶颈而非可测量对象。尽管有基准测试显示人类编写的技能在任务成功率（74.5%）上远高于自动化方法（≤31.1%），但这些只是端点指标，并未揭示人类维护的实际过程。本文旨在直接测量该过程：通过挖掘公开技能仓库的git历史，回答"谁在维护代理技能"以及"维护由什么组成"这一先决性问题，为自动化策展系统提供可比较的基线和设计依据。
AI.method: 采用目的性抽样的五个公开AI技能仓库（getsentry/skills、trailofbits/skills、obra/superpowers、cloudflare/skills、anthropics/skills），覆盖2025年10月至2026年6月。分析单位为通过`git log --follow`追踪的单个SKILL.md文件，定义"实质性创建后编辑"为创建后修改≥5行且非机器人/非琐碎的提交。使用三个预注册编码本进行双重LLM编码（Opus 4.8两次独立遍历）：治理轴（机械性源自commit元数据：机器人作者、AI合著trailer、人类作者+web合并committer、纯人类作者+committer）；策展操作轴（八类操作：内容扩展、事实修正、重构、失败修复、描述调整、合并去重、弃用、其他，可归并为修正vs增强二分）；触发证据轴（0-3级阶梯：L3显式问题/失败链接、L2具名具体失败、L1一般、L0无）。额外进行50条样本的盲人工重编码和跨家族（gpt-4o、gpt-5.5）重编码以验证可靠性。能力迁移测试采用预注册设计：13个技能×11个任务×3个重复，跨家族求解器（gpt-5.4-mini）与盲法评判，固定样本量下功效为0.77-0.90。
AI.result: 三个主要发现：(1)治理方面，254次实质性编辑中62%携带AI合著trailer、38%无trailer，但每一次编辑都通过具名人类账户完成；合并/合并工作流可丢弃trailer，因此62%是trailer可见的AI合著率下限；不同组织差异显著——单一维护者项目几乎全部人类编写，部分组织几乎全部经web合并PR无AI trailer，部分组织AI合著占主导。(2)维护内容方面，八操作中内容扩展（72次）和事实修正（56次）合计占一半；归并后增强60%、修正38%、其他2%；合并/弃用仅占4.3%，呈现显著的累积而非修剪模式；技能文件轨迹以稳定或增长为主（32个增长>10%、7个缩减>10%、81个稳定）；编辑间隔中位数为5天。(3)预注册的"规则相似性"三分类轴未通过可靠性门（κ=-0.02，受试者率悖论驱动；PABAK=0.34、Gwet's AC1=0.44），即使跨家族重编码也仅达到κ=0.43。能力迁移测试发现v_new与v_old的评判质量差异为-0.09（95% CI[-0.28,+0.10]），符号检验p=0.58、Wilcoxon p=0.55，5/13技能偏向v_new；该零结果经长度控制、深度子集、弱求解器重跑等多种敏感性分析后保持稳定，但判断者ICC(2,1)=0.52低于预设的0.6门槛。
AI.conclusion: 公开仓库中的技能维护是一个高频次、由人类账户治理（每次编辑通过具名人类账户完成）且通常在commit trailer中可见为AI辅助的循环——更像是人类治理、AI辅助的回路。累积显著超过修剪，合并/弃用仅占4.3%，这表明策展系统可能需要显式的合并/退役预算来应对无止境技能学习中的预算压力。"规则相似性"可靠性失败揭示了一个核心测量障碍：即使两个独立LLM编码遍历都无法从commit工件中可靠区分规则型与实例型编辑，这意味着试图泛化策展规则的系统面临同样的编码难题。本文提出了五项设计假设（显式合并预算、人类拥有的发布/合并控制、不可单独依赖失败溯源、按操作类型而非大小分诊、按仓库而非全局建模治理），并发布了commit级语料库、三个编码本、挖掘脚本与回放协议，为后续自动化策展系统的可重现评估提供基础设施。

title: Analysis of Respiratory Sinus Arrhythmia with Neural Networks
summary: The paper introduces a neural network-based approach for analyzing ECG signals to estimate respiratory rate by leveraging the phe- nomenon of Respiratory Sinus Arrhythmia (RSA). Our method employs a deep learning model trained to predict respiratory waveforms directly from ECG input data. To achieve this, we developed and evaluated three different neural network architectures capable of automatically extract- ing relevant features from ECG signals without the need for manual preprocessing. The proposed approach offers a robust and scalable solu- tion for non-invasive respiratory monitoring, with potential applications in healthcare and wearable technology

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于神经网络的端到端方法，通过心电图（ECG）信号重建呼吸波形，利用呼吸性窦性心律失常（RSA）现象实现非侵入式呼吸监测。研究比较了三种R波检测架构（循环、U-Net和Transformer），最终选用循环网络提取RR间期（RRI）和R波幅值（RPA），并将其与ECG一起输入双向LSTM模型进行呼吸波形回归。实验结果表明，在中等呼吸频率（7–11 BPM）下，所提神经方法在NCC和RPE指标上均优于NeuroKit经典算法，但在高频呼吸下因RSA现象减弱而性能下降。
AI.motivation: 传统ECG呼吸信号提取算法（如EDR）依赖手工特征工程，对噪声和个体差异敏感，且在复杂条件下鲁棒性不足。深度学习方法能够自动学习特征，提升在噪声环境下的鲁棒性，并支持个性化适配，因此适用于基于RSA的非侵入式呼吸监测。
AI.method: 1. 数据采集：使用Aidmed One设备同步采集单通道ECG和鼻插管呼吸信号，并结合MIT-BIH、Fantasia公开数据集。2. R波检测：比较了循环层、U-Net和Transformer编码器三种架构，基于AAMI标准选择循环网络（F1最高）。3. 输入增强：将RRI和RPA通过线性插值扩展为与ECG等长的通道。4. 呼吸波形回归：采用两层双向LSTM + 线性层 + 归一化 + 插值层的网络结构，使用KL散度与L1加权的混合损失函数（α=0.9）。5. 数据筛选：剔除呼吸频率<9 BPM的窗口，限制训练在RSA显著的频段。6. 评价指标：NCC、RPE，与NeuroKit的Van Gent算法对比。
AI.result: 1. R波检测器在Fantasia上acc=0.999、F1=0.989，自采数据集上acc=0.998、F1=0.968，泛化能力强。2. 呼吸回归模型最终epoch训练NCC=0.938，验证NCC=0.9436。3. 在中等RR（7–11 BPM）下，神经方法NCC=0.95、RPE=30.20%，显著优于NeuroKit（NCC=0.89、RPE=49.53%）。4. 加权平均NCC从NeuroKit的0.69提升至0.84，RPE从64.45%降至42.42%。5. 在高RR（>12 BPM）下，神经方法因训练范围受限表现较差（NCC=0.47 vs 0.74），反映RSA在此频段衰减。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明，基于RSA的神经网络端到端方法在中等呼吸频率范围内显著优于经典EDR算法，具有良好的鲁棒性和非侵入式监测潜力。但模型在极端呼吸频率（高频和低频）下性能下降，主要受RSA现象生理限制及训练样本不足影响。未来工作包括：扩展训练数据覆盖全频段、引入个性化训练、利用可穿戴设备数据、定义个体心率对呼吸频率的敏感阈值，并结合眼动或EEG等多模态信号预测自主神经系统状态。

title: Newton Matching for Generative Modeling: A Unified Framework for Fine-Tuning and Sampling
summary: We develop Newton Matching, a unified framework for fine-tuning and sampling in generative modeling. The target is $\pi\propto\mu e^{\tau r}$, where $r$ is the reward, $\tau>0$ the inverse temperature, and $\mu$ denotes the pretrained model's terminal density for fine-tuning or the constant $1$ for sampling. We shift the paradigm from isolated losses to iterative optimization over canonical models: population minimizers of standard conditional matching for terminal densities. Under compatible smooth-realization assumptions, canonical velocities form a manifold diffeomorphic to the density manifold. Transporting the Fisher-Rao metric and mixture connection to this manifold, we show that the reverse-KL Hessian equals the metric, so the Newton direction coincides with the negative Fisher-Rao gradient. At terminal density $\rho$, each stage takes a tangential step generated by the regularized reward $r-\frac1\tau\log(\rho/\mu)$, followed by terminal-density-preserving canonicalization. This canonical retraction yields an exact finite-stepsize density characterization. For the ideal iteration, we prove strict reverse-KL descent away from the target for $0 < \eta \le \tau$, global convergence under mild conditions, and local quadratic convergence for full steps ($\eta=\tau$). Covariance and gradient forms, each with forward or reverse regression-pair constructions, yield sample-wise tangential-update losses with the same population minimizer, without importance sampling or full-trajectory backpropagation. We develop approximate updates and define critical-point consistency as vanishing tangential displacement if and only if $\rho=\pi$. We recover representative methods as exact realizations, critical-point-consistent approximations, or objective-altering variants, enabling modular algorithm design. Our work advances the theory and algorithms of reinforcement learning for generative models.

AI.tldr: Newton Matching: 一个统一的生成模型微调与采样框架，将迭代优化与条件匹配相结合，将反KL最小化的牛顿方向与Fisher-Rao负梯度对齐，并在规范流形上提供收敛性保证，统一并恢复多种现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的dataless生成模型微调与采样方法缺乏统一的理论框架，难以清晰区分本质差异；不同方法虽声称采用不同原理，但隐含的结构与计算等价性未被揭示。Newton Matching旨在将迭代优化视角与条件匹配的可扩展性相结合，为这一分散的方法景观提供统一的数学基础、收敛性保证和模块化设计空间。
AI.method: 核心方法包括：(1) 在条件匹配定义的规范速度场上构建规范流形，通过终端密度映射和典范速度映射的微分同胚建立几何结构；(2) 装备Fisher-Rao度量和混合联络，证明反KL Hessian等于Fisher-Rao度量，使负梯度与Newton方向重合；(3) 设计规范回缩（切向更新+规范化）实现有限步长更新，得到精确的终端密度递推公式；(4) 推导精确匹配形式的训练损失（协方差形式、梯度形式Mayer/Bolza实现）以及多种近似方案（直接线性化、参考伴随等）；(5) 证明有限步长反KL下降、全局收敛和局部二次收敛性。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) Newton方向与负Fisher-Rao梯度的等价性；(2) 严格反KL下降保证（步长在(0,τ]内）；(3) 全局收敛的充分条件；(4) 满步Newton迭代的局部二次收敛；(5) 恢复多种现有方法（ETM、ITM、DiffusionNFT、RAM、BAM、LAM、Flow Sampling、Adjoint Sampling）作为特例，建立统一的设计空间。
AI.conclusion: Newton Matching为生成模型的奖励反馈微调提供了统一的理论基础和模块化设计空间，揭示了现有方法之间的联系，并通过规范流形几何和Newton方法的连接，为算法设计提供了原则性指导。

title: Data Scout: Targeted Web Crawling for Domain-Specific Pretraining Corpora
summary: The dominant approach to building domain-specific pretraining corpora is to filter large web archives such as CommonCrawl. This works well for popular domains but breaks down for specialized ones, where relevant content is sparse and often beyond the reach of popularity-driven crawlers. We present Data Scout, which inverts this: instead of filtering an archive, it directs a targeted crawl. An LLM expands a root topic into a taxonomy and thousands of search queries; the returned URLs (seeds) are grouped by subdomain and screened with a user-supplied classifier (the probe), admitting each subdomain on the basis of a small sample. This works because relevance has a sharp boundary at the subdomain level: in mathematics, a page is 21x more likely to be relevant than one on a sibling subdomain. With the FineMath classifier as the probe, 21.9% of crawled pages are high-quality math content, 70x the 0.31% rate from filtering a comparable web sample, so the crawl wastes far less effort. But the payoff is not just efficiency: 63.2% of these pages are missing from CommonCrawl altogether, yet just as useful for training. Continued pretraining of Llama-3.2-3B on 1.9B Data Scout tokens matches FineMath corpus on GSM8k. Because the probe is the only domain-specific component, Data Scout can in principle apply to any domain with such a classifier.

title: Diffs vs. Whole Files: An Empirical Comparison of Iterative Edit-Based and Direct Generation for Flutter/Dart Code Models
summary: Large language models used for code editing can be trained and deployed in at least two output regimes: direct generation, where the model emits the entire modified file in one shot, and iterative diff-based generation ("steps"), where the model emits a sequence of localized search/replace edits applied one at a time until it signals completion or a step budget is exhausted. The diff-based regime is attractive because it mirrors how developers edit code and should require far fewer generated tokens per turn. We train two code models - a 100M-parameter model trained from scratch (Rainbow-Pony-100M) and a fine-tuned Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B - in both regimes on a shared Flutter/Dart dataset, and evaluate all four resulting models on a held-out set of approx 1,790 tasks per model. Direct generation substantially outperforms diff-based generation on every metric we measure - compilation/static-analysis pass rate, bits-per-byte, character-level similarity to the reference, and blinded LLM-judge ratings of goal fulfillment, correctness, and code quality - and the gap persists after controlling for task difficulty via a matched-ID comparison and when restricting to code that compiles on both sides. We then identify a single, architecture-independent mechanism behind the conditions where diff-based generation does win: it is competitive on short, spatially localized edits, and its category-level wins concentrate in exactly the two task categories - refactoring and error-handling/edge-case fixes - with the lowest mean edit-step count in our dataset. We term this task locality and discuss its implications for when an edit-based training regime is and is not the right choice for a code-editing model.

AI.tldr: 本文在Flutter/Dart代码编辑任务上，对比了两种训练与部署范式：一次性生成整个修改文件的直接生成（direct）vs. 迭代式diff生成（steps/search-replace）。在两种截然不同的模型架构（从头训练的100M Rainbow-Pony-100M 和微调的 Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B）上，direct 在所有指标上一致大幅胜出，且差距在控制任务难度和仅比较双方都编译通过的代码后仍然存在。差距主要来自正常完成的steps轨迹中的"静默语义漂移"，而diff模式在短而局部的编辑（低轨迹步数）上确有竞争力，作者将这一机制统一为"任务局部性"（task locality）。
AI.motivation: 虽然迭代diff生成在工业界（Aider、IDE工具）广受欢迎，因为更贴近开发者习惯且理论上token更少，但作为训练目标（而非推理接口）的优劣并不清楚，且不同研究结论相左（LintSeq支持编辑序列训练，Aider指出diff格式对弱模型易产生malformed edits，Cheng等2026提出自适应格式）。因此需要一次端到端、可控的实证比较：在单一领域、同一数据集上比较direct vs. steps两种输出机制本身的效果差异。
AI.method: 采用2×2因子设计：两个backbone（Rainbow-Pony-100M从头训练 + Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B微调）× 两种输出机制（direct整文件生成、steps迭代search/replace），共享14,600个Flutter/Dart手写任务数据。Steps模式将每个任务分解为前向/反向的edit序列（受LintSeq启发），并用首匹配启发式处理search span歧义。评估指标包括dart_pass（dart analyze静态分析）、bits_per_byte、字符相似度，并引入matched-ID（控制任务难度）和blinded LLM judge（gpt-4.1，对双方都通过的代码按goal fulfillment/correctness/code quality 1-5打分）作为更严格的检验。
AI.result: Direct在所有指标上一致大幅胜出：dart_pass差距达45.5pp（Rainbow-Pony）与39.9pp（Qwen），bits_per_byte和相似度同样如此。matched-ID和best-case比较显示差距并非由任务难度或budget耗尽导致；约84%/70%的steps失败发生在正常完成的轨迹中，属于"静默语义漂移"。其中search span歧义触发的fallback启发式是主要失败源（fallback轨迹dart_pass仅12-18% vs. 无fallback的57-80%）。盲审LLM judge在双方都编译通过的行上仍给direct显著更高分（Welch t检验 p<0.001）。Steps模式存在一个明确的小胜场：其获胜几乎完全集中在轨迹最短的任务上，且恰好对应 refactoring_edits 与 error_handling_and_edge_cases 两个独立地平均步数最低的任务类别——作者将这一统一机制命名为"task locality"。
AI.conclusion: 在Flutter/Dart代码编辑这一特定领域，direct生成是更好的默认选择；steps模式不是简单地失败于budget耗尽或malformed edits，而是在正常完成轨迹中发生语义漂移，搜索歧义是放大器。Steps模式在小且空间局部的编辑上确有竞争力，因此最佳策略应当是按编辑而非按模型自适应选择输出格式（与Cheng等2026的adaptive-format结论一致）。局限：单领域、greedy解码、steps模式无执行反馈、两种模式微调token量不匹配（steps多10倍）、fallback启发式为简化设计、judge未与人类评分校验、qwen-direct因调度器配置错误未正常退火学习率。

title: AtomCite: Verification and Correction of Supplied Page-Level Citations in Multi-Page Documents
summary: Large language models answering questions over multi-page documents are expected to cite the supporting pages, yet supplied citations are sometimes inaccurate, and current evaluations score citations at generation time or against text passages: no existing benchmark evaluates whether a system can verify and correct a page-level citation already attached to an answer. We propose AtomCite, an agentic framework that parses an answer into claims, checks each claim against the image of its cited page, and applies a deterministic repair policy. To evaluate it, we introduce DocCite, to our knowledge the first benchmark for systems that verify and correct page-level citations in document images. Built on MP-DocVQA and DUDE, it combines 928 validated injected instances with 2,468 candidate natural errors harvested from frontier- and efficiency-tier models, of which a two-annotator audit confirms 1,909 as genuine errors. Primary labels are assigned deterministically, not by LLM judges, with the human audit as a separate validation layer. Across three model families (Gemini, Claude, and GPT), AtomCite reaches around 93% binary verification accuracy on the injected benchmark, significantly outperforming every OCR-only condition, including a compute-matched control, and exceeding every prior text-based baseline given the same OCR text. Its repair policy lifts citation precision on the injected mix from a constructed 34% to 87-90% while retaining over 90% of correct claims. AtomCite also transfers: with frozen prompts and zero training, it raises the hallucination-detection scores of two open 7-8B models on five public benchmarks above the same models prompted as direct judges. Finally, the audit shows that noise in automatic labels biases measured verifier accuracy and can reverse system rankings, so evaluations relying only on synthetic or automatic labels risk mismeasuring verification capability.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AtomCite：一个面向多页文档图像的“答案后验核验—修复”框架。它将答案拆为“原子声明—引用页”对，并行读取所引页的 OCR 文本和页面图像；判决仅依据所引页，邻近页只用于提出修复候选。确定性策略将判决映射为 keep、fix-page、remove 或 flag-only。配套提出 DocCite 基准，其中合成注入集有 928 个经确定性扫描验证的实例，自然错误池含 2,468 个候选，经双标注员审计确认 1,909 个真实错误。AtomCite 在三个模型家族上的注入集二分类准确率约 93%，显著优于 OCR-only、直接提示和计算量匹配的顺序链；修复后引用精确率由 34.3% 提升到 87.0%–89.9%，同时保留约 92% 的正确声明。冻结提示且零训练迁移到五个幻觉检测基准时，也持续优于同骨干单次直接判定。论文的另一项关键发现是：自然错误自动标签中的噪声会显著扭曲验证器评估，甚至颠倒系统排名，因此人工审计层对可信基准不可或缺。
AI.motivation: 已有文档问答和引用评估主要在答案生成时评价引用，或要求证据以文本片段提供；它们没有衡量系统能否检查并纠正已经附在多页文档答案中的页码引用。页码错误会直接降低证据可核查性，尤其在合同、医疗记录和财务文件等高风险场景中。因此，论文聚焦一个部署明确的闭环任务：给定答案、页码引用、文档图像和 OCR，验证每条声明是否确实由所引页支持，并在可修复时改指正确页面，否则安全保留或删除。
AI.method: 任务：输入答案 A 和多页文档 D，输出每个（claim, cited-page）的支持判决及校正动作。AtomCite 分五步：1）确定性解析行内页码、页码范围、多引用组和脚注，得到“声明—引用页”对；2）取所引页图像与 OCR，并构造默认 ±2 页、最多 5 页的邻近窗口；3）每条声明通过两个并行通道核验：文本通道读取所引页 OCR，图像通道读取所引页图像；4）按类型规则合并：硬冲突记为 inconsistent，软冲突中图像优先，并在邻页寻找可支持页面；5）修复策略为 verified→keep，verified-nearby→fix-page，not-verified/false→remove，inconsistent/abstain→带标记保留。关键是所引页才能决定 verdict，邻页只能提供修复候选。评测包含多种消融：扁平 OCR、布局感知 OCR、四路计算匹配 OCR、直接提示、清单式提示、单转录顺序链、完整 Agent 框架，以及若干专门支持检测器。统计采用以文档为聚类的配对 bootstrap（B=10,000）和 Holm 校正。基准采用两层真值：Layer 1 为文档范围模糊匹配所得页级定位标签；Layer 2 为盲法双标注语义审计，作为独立校验层。
AI.result: 在 DocCite-Syn（n=928）上，完整 AtomCite 的二元引用支持准确率为 Gemini 93.7%、Claude 93.0%、GPT 93.0%，正确声明召回率分别为 90.4%、90.4%、91.0%。与最强的 MinerU OCR 条件相比，完整框架分别领先 4.9、2.3、3.9 个百分点；与计算匹配的 OCR 条件和顺序链的 18 项关键配对比较中，16 项在 Holm 校正后仍显著。OCR-only 条件的问题主要是高误拒：Gemini 的 supported recall 从图像框架的 90.4% 降到最佳 OCR 的 72.6%。把图像通道的预算换成额外文本处理也不能消除差距。文本基线中，同骨干 CiteEval-Auto 为 88.2%–89.0%，AtomCite 仍领先 4.1–4.9 个百分点。消融表明，图像权威仲裁规则贡献最大：改成对称保守合并使准确率下降 7.4 个百分点；更细粒度原子事实分解使多声明准确率下降 1.2–1.8 个百分点，原因是严格合取累积噪声。默认 ±2 页窗口下，修复将引用精确率从 34.3% 提升到 87.0%–89.9%，正确声明保留率为 91.8%–92.5%；同类基线 CiteFix 为 50.3%，RARR 为 36.8%。在 DocCite-Nat 人工审计的 2,359 个确定项上，AtomCite 检测 97.3%–98.6% 的 1,909 个真实错误，误报率 5.4%–12.3%；扁平 OCR 虽检出 99.7%–99.8% 的错误，却误报 43.8%–49.3% 的确认支持声明。迁移实验中，Qwen2.5-7B 和 Llama-3-8B 在五个公开幻觉基准的全部 10 个比较中均优于单次直接判定；例如 RAGTruth F1 分别由 49.5 提升至 71.2、由 56.4 提升至 66.2。审计还发现，自动自然错误标签中 72.9% 的 AtomCite 争议样本实际为标注噪声；直接使用自动标签时，OCR-only 看起来优于图像核验，而人工标签纠正了这一排序。
AI.conclusion: AtomCite 证明，核验多页文档答案中已附带的页级引用，需要同时读取 OCR 和页面视觉结构；仅靠更强 OCR、更多文本处理或更复杂的单转录提示无法等价替代图像通道。声明级、并行、类型化且保守的核验—修复架构，在三个前沿模型家族中实现约 93% 的引用定位准确率，并将合成混合集中的引用精确率由 34.3% 大幅提高到 87%–90%，同时保持约 92% 的正确内容。方法也说明，可靠的核验器必须避免把“页面有相似文本”误当成“视觉证据充分支持”，并应优先发现 OCR 遗漏。论文的主要方法学贡献是 DocCite 的双层真值设计：注入集使用确定性文档扫描，自然错误集再经盲法人工审计。核心警示是，自动生成或自动定位标签中的噪声足以改变验证准确率和系统排名；因此，引用验证基准不能把未审计的合成标签当作语义真值。更广泛而言，AtomCite 适合多声明、长答案和视觉复杂文档的证据一致性检查；其边界也很明确：不覆盖开放域检索、跨语言和原生数字 PDF，且验证单元若变成预原子化或单事实短答案，其结构优势会明显减弱。实际部署中 remove 与 fix-page 都应保留审计记录和人工复核，因为错误删除与错误改指同样可能造成高风险误判。

title: SAFEGuard: Detect Optimization-Based Jailbreak Attacks Through Harmful Semantic Analysis and Fluency Measurement
comment: Published as a conference paper at the Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026). Our project page is available at this https URL
summary: Despite the significant efforts devoted to aligning large language models (LLMs) with human values and ensuring safe deployment, recent work has revealed that LLMs remain vulnerable to adversarial jailbreak attacks that can bypass safety guardrails and elicit harmful responses. Many defense methods are proposed to detect jailbreaks but they are limited in their effectiveness to counter wide-range optimization-based jailbreak mechanisms that can yield highly fluency-optimized or harmful semantic obfuscated prompts. To tackle this challenge, we propose a unified detection framework SAFEGuard which incorporates a hybrid fluency measurement based on cross-layer distribution distance and perplexity, and the analysis of harmful semantics through gradient matching. Our method is grounded in a paramount observation: high fluency prompts maintain their malicious intention close to harmful prompts while harmful semantic obfuscated prompts often inject gibberish token sequences. Our evaluation demonstrates that SAFEGuard consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines and achieves significant improvement in accuracy across different optimization-based jailbreaks. This underscores the effectiveness of SAFEGuard against evolving jailbreak attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAFEGuard，一种针对优化型越狱攻击的统一检测框架，通过融合混合流畅度度量（跨层JSD分布距离+困惑度）和基于梯度匹配的语义分析，实现对多种优化型越狱攻击的高精度检测，在多个LLM上显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有越狱检测方法（基于困惑度的流畅度方法、基于梯度匹配的语义方法）存在根本性缺陷：困惑度对高流畅度攻击（COLDAttack、PiF）失效，梯度匹配对低流畅度语义混淆攻击（Adaptive）失效。需要一种统一框架同时应对两类攻击。
AI.method: 两阶段级联检测框架。第一阶段使用子序列级混合流畅度度量（结合跨层JSD分布距离与log似然，权重α=0.2最优）检测低流畅度攻击；第二阶段对未通过流畅度检测的输入计算与有害参考梯度的余弦相似度（梯度匹配）以检测高流畅度攻击。还提出SAFEGuard+无阈值变体，使用逻辑回归分类器。理论证明梯度匹配分数与损失变化成正比。
AI.result: 在5个LLM、6种优化型越狱攻击（CGC、AutoDAN、BEAST、COLDAttack、PiF、Adaptive）上，SAFEGuard平均检测率达94-99.8%，显著优于PPL、GradSafe、Gradient Cuff和Llama Guard 3；在Llama-2-7B-Chat上F1-score达0.98；在真实越狱数据上达80.8%准确率；对抗TAP多轮攻击达94%；在最佳情况下推理时间仅0.09秒。
AI.conclusion: SAFEGuard通过整合互补的流畅度和语义信号，在保持低良性误拒率的同时，对多样化的优化型越狱攻击实现了稳健且广覆盖的检测，是LLM安全防御的实用方案。局限性在于依赖白盒访问、对Llama-3.1等语义分离弱的模型效果下降、需要超参调优且存在推理开销。

title: Grounded and Faithful P&ID Reasoning: Constraining Vision-Language Models with Recovered Evidence Graphs
summary: Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs) are the authoritative maps of process plants: isolation, maintenance, and HAZOP decisions depend on what connects to what. Vision-language models describe these sheets fluently, yet they often invent or miss process connections---and an invented or missed link can reverse an isolation or reachability call, so a plant decision cannot trust a fluent answer that was never checked against the linework. We instead recover an explicit graph of the drawing---its symbols, the process connections between them, and the tags that name them---and then require the model to answer only by querying that graph through seven read-only operators, so a topology claim is returned only when it cites the query results that support it. On TopoPID-VQA, a new suite of 3000 topology questions over these sheets, Graph-Grounded Harness (Ours) raises exact match accuracy from 36.7--41.3% under image-only prompting to 74.3--76.0% for Qwen3-VL-4B, Qwen3-VL-8B, and Gemma-4-E4B. It does so on an imperfect substrate: on Digitize-PID dataset the recovered graph scores F1 0.742 on exact process connections, and 0.801 once symbols and tags are pooled in. The residual errors track that gap---grounding pays off where the recovered graph is right, and perception error still breaks topology questions where it is not.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Graph-Grounded Harness框架，通过从P&ID（管道仪表图）光栅图像中恢复显式的过程连接图（$G_{auto}$），并强制VLM仅通过七个只读图算子查询该图来回答拓扑问题，使每个拓扑断言都必须引用支持它的图实体证据。在新构建的TopoPID-VQA基准（3000道拓扑问题）上，该方法将Qwen3-VL-4B/8B和Gemma-4-E4B的精确匹配准确率从纯图像提示下的36.7–41.3%提升至74.3–76.0%，但其性能上限受限于恢复图本身的保真度（精确边F₁=0.742，属性化微F₁=0.801）。
AI.motivation: VLM虽然能流畅描述P&ID图纸，但常常凭空捏造或遗漏过程连接——在工业场景中，一条捏造或遗漏的连接可能逆转隔离或可达性判断，从而导致安全事故。因此需要一种机制使每个拓扑断言都能被追溯到图中的事实依据，而非依赖像素的自由推理。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：(1) Stage 1使用微调的YOLO11s（符号检测）、EfficientNet-B0 U-Net（实线/虚线分割）、YOLO-text+TrOCR（文本识别）进行感知，然后通过交叉点节点化、自适应接合捕捉、首次符号链接游走等确定性几何规则构建类型化过程图$G_{auto}$；可选的信号边层在虚线上添加仪表链接。(2) Stage 2为Graph-Grounded Harness：VLM规划器在六轮预算内通过七个事实返回型算子（节点查询、邻居列表、节点搜索、BFS、最短路径、边检查、集合操作）查询$G_{auto}$，最终答案必须遵守"答案契约"——至少调用一次工具、所有命名实体必须被查询、计数题必须引用匹配数量的支持实体——否则被拒绝。
AI.result: 在TopoPID-VQA基准上，Qwen3-VL-4B/8B和Gemma-4-E4B的汇总精确匹配准确率分别从40.1%/41.3%/36.7%提升至76.0%/75.1%/74.3%（绝对增益33.8–37.6个百分点，95%配对置信区间均排除零）。在Digitize-PID测试集上，恢复图$G_{auto}$的精确过程边F₁=0.742，连通一致性0.958，符号类感知F₁=0.984，符号标签F₁=0.866，线标签F₁=0.730，属性化微F₁=0.801。金查询上限约为88.9%，表明仍有约12-15点的差距源于图感知错误和复杂工具使用。合成-真值率（虚假声称拓扑连接）在简单/中等难度上大幅降低，困难难度仍有差距。
AI.conclusion: 当拓扑无法仅凭像素验证时，恢复的证据图加引用的工具结果可将不可靠的图像阅读器转变为可审计的推理器。Stage 1从预测的墨迹中冻结$G_{auto}$；Stage 2仅通过该图上的工具追踪作答。困难层级的遗漏和检查点间的家族级差异表明，答案的准确性同时受限于基础图的保真度和多步工具使用能力。仍需解决扫描工厂图纸、工具-感知消融、弃权机制以及信号边层QA等问题。

title: What if LLMs Ate Their Words: Causal History Effects in Multi-Turn Interaction
comment: 11 pages, 6 figures. Code and data are available at this https URL
summary: Multi-turn interaction creates a feedback process in which an LLM's previous responses become context for later behavior. Prior work shows substantial multi-turn degradation and that assistant-generated history can affect later behavior. However, it remains unclear how these effects manifest across models, tasks, turns, and inside a model. We study these gaps across six task families and five models. Degradation from fully specified single-turn input (FULL) to progressively revealed multi-turn interaction (SHARDED) is clearly task- and model-dependent, and stronger one-shot performance does not imply greater interaction robustness. We then retrospectively analyze completed SHARDED conversations by replaying the user messages already observed in each trajectory while editing only assistant-generated history. Replacing prior assistant responses with neutral content (termed neutralization) changes downstream min-max normalized performance by +.027 across 2,973 trajectories. On a prespecified length-controlled subset, short and length-matched neutralization yield nearly identical effects (+.069 versus +.068), showing that simple context shortening is insufficient to explain the effect of history editing. Turn Surgery further intervenes on one assistant turn at a time. Among 237 selected degraded trajectories, 63.7% contain at least one beneficial intervention, while most tested positions remain unchanged; for binary tasks, 48.4% admit a fail-to-success reversal. An open-weight case study links behaviorally consequential history changes to measurable downstream state differences, but finds task-dependent rather than universal internal signatures. Overall, assistant-generated history has active but selective effects on multi-turn performance, motivating selective rather than uniform history management.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统性地探究了多轮对话中LLM自身生成的助手历史对后续行为的影响。通过跨6类任务、5个模型的对照实验与回溯性干预，证明助手回复不仅是交互记录，更是因果性地塑造下游性能的计算上下文。研究提出Turn Surgery方法定位关键历史轮次，并发现内部表征变化具有任务依赖性。
AI.motivation: 在多轮交互场景中，模型此前生成的助手回复会成为后续轮次的上下文输入。先前工作已观察到显著的多轮性能退化现象，但助手自生成历史本身是否是因果性的退化来源、其影响在不同任务/模型/轮次上如何分布、是否在模型内部留下可测量的表征痕迹，均尚未得到系统解答。论文将这些"上下文污染"问题形式化为因果干预问题，主张历史管理应选择性地进行，而非一刀切式地清除。
AI.method: 基于Laban等人提出的sharded simulation评估框架（FULL vs SHARDED），对627条指令×5个模型（Luna、Grok、GPT-4o、DeepSeek V3.2、Qwen3-14B）进行对照评估。核心方法包括三类回溯性干预：(1) 整体中性化——将所有非最终助手回复替换为"Acknowledged."，并设计长度匹配的中性化作为对照；(2) Turn Surgery——逐轮中性化单个中间助手回复并回放后续用户消息；(3) 开源模型内部分析——在Qwen3-14B上提取残差流表征、进行表征恢复补丁（residual state patching）以及注意力重分配等多种探针测量。统计推断采用配对百分位置自助法（10,000次）。
AI.result: (1) FULL-SHARDED退化呈现明显的任务×模型结构（绝对差距.137至.224），且单轮能力强并不预示多轮鲁棒性。(2) 在2,973条轨迹上短中性化带来+.027的性能变化；在264条长度匹配子集上短中性化与长度匹配中性化效果几乎相同（+.069 vs +.068），证明该效应无法由上下文缩短解释。(3) Turn Surgery显示63.7%的退化轨迹至少存在一个有益干预，二元任务中48.4%可实现失败到成功的逆转；31.5%的位置产生正向效果、57.6%无变化、10.8%产生负向效果，且位置效应不能简化为近因性规则。(4) 内部分析显示正向干预产生更大的下游残差流发散，但不同任务间无统一的内部签名。
AI.conclusion: 助手自生成历史具有活跃但有选择性的多轮因果效应，这挑战了将助手历史视为被动记录的观点，呼吁进行选择性而非统一的历史管理。Turn Surgery提供的轮级因果信号可作为未来选择性历史保留/降权/丢弃方法的监督来源；同时内部表征变化具有任务依赖性，意味着需要任务特异性的机制理解而非追求统一的内部签名。论文将自身定位为诊断性研究，而非历史选择器的训练或验证方案。

title: AlignDiff: Exploiting Model-Intrinsic Information for Better Preference Data Selection
summary: Aligning large language models with human preferences remains a challenge, primarily due to the critical role of preference data quality in effective alignment. Existing datasets are frequently plagued by inherent noise and distribution shifts, which inherently limit model performance. To bridge this gap, we propose AlignDiff, a preference data filtering framework driven by intrinsic model signals. AlignDiff first identifies samples with clear preferences using both positive and inverse signals, then prioritizes the more challenging samples based on the average negative log-likelihood gap, encouraging the model to learn richer information from them. AlignDiff is evaluated on two widely used model families (LLaMA and Qwen) and three benchmarks widely adopted in the alignment community (AlpacaEval 2.0, Arena-Hard, and MT-Bench). Across all settings, it consistently outperforms seven strong baselines. We conduct comprehensive ablation studies to validate the effectiveness of AlignDiff, and further show that difficulty-based curriculum learning improves model performance.

AI.tldr: AlignDiff是一个两阶段偏好数据过滤框架，仅利用模型内部信号（无需外部奖励模型），通过"对齐差异"识别极性清晰的样本，再通过"平均负对数似然间隙"优先选择困难且信息丰富的样本，在多个基准上优于七种强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有偏好数据存在噪声和分布偏移问题，限制了对齐性能；现有过滤方法依赖外部信号（如LLM-as-a-judge评分）或仅利用模型隐式奖励的少量内部信息，可能引入与模型内在偏好不一致的数据并引发DPO优化中的"挤压效应"。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：(1) 对齐差异（Alignment Discrepancy, R_AD）——训练正反两个偏好策略模型（正向DPO与反向DPO），利用其隐式奖励边际的差值识别极性清晰的样本，并对反向偏好样本进行重排；(2) 样本难度感知校准（ANG）——使用chosen与rejected响应间的平均负对数似然间隙（ANG）对极性清晰的样本排序，优先选择"难chosen、易rejected"的信息丰富样本，以缓解挤压效应。
AI.result: 在LLaMA-3-8B-SFT和Qwen2.5-7B-SFT两个模型族上，使用UltraFeedback_Binarized数据集，在AlpacaEval 2.0、Arena-Hard和MT-Bench三个基准上均优于PPLGap、LCPP、EM、IM、M_AP、IM&EM、R.I.P、SDPO等七个基线。在AlpacaEval 2.0上，AlignDiff在LLaMA和Qwen上的LC比最强基线SDPO分别提升6.3和3.2个点；仅用过滤后50%的数据即接近翻倍Full数据集的LC（13.7%→26.4%）。在多评判者评估和WPO训练下也保持一致优势。计算效率方面，AlignDiff（80.5 GPUh）优于EM（128）和SDPO（162），略高于IM（43）。基于ANG的课程学习（易到难排序）可进一步提升性能（LC 33.4%→36.4%）。
AI.conclusion: AlignDiff证明了仅利用模型内在信号即可实现高效偏好数据过滤，无需依赖外部奖励模型；正反向偏好信号具有互补性，组合使用能更准确地识别极性清晰的样本；基于ANG的难度感知选择有效缓解了DPO的挤压效应；内在信号驱动的数据选择是一种有效的数据中心对齐范式。未来工作可扩展到更大模型和更广泛的偏好数据集。

title: UniRRM: Unified Reasoning Reward Models Across Languages and Evaluation Paradigms
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) excels on tasks with verifiable rewards, but in open-ended tasks, the reliability of reward models remains a key challenge. Existing solutions either depend on costly proprietary LLM-as-a-Judge systems or opaque scalar reward models that lack interpretability. Recent works on generative reward models offer a promising alternative, but they remain constrained by static evaluation criteria, fragmented evaluation paradigms, and limited multilingual support. To address these challenges, we introduce \textbf{MixReward}, a large-scale multilingual dataset spanning six domains and 103 languages, containing both pairwise and listwise data, and propose \textbf{UniRRM}, a unified reasoning reward model supporting multiple languages and evaluation paradigms.
