UniRRM uses a staged reasoning chain to dynamically generate task-generic and instruction-specific criteria, enabling fine-grained, input-adaptive judgments while maintaining consistency across languages. Experiments demonstrate that UniRRM-8B and UniRRM-14B achieve performance close to the state-of-the-art for models of comparable size across multiple benchmarks, and are effective for unseen evaluation paradigms. In addition, ablation studies validate the reliability and effectiveness of UniRRM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UniRRM，一种统一的多语言、多评估范式（成对/列表/逐点）的推理奖励模型，并构建了大规模多语言偏好数据集MixReward（103种语言、6个领域、64,528条数据），通过两阶段（SFT+GRPO）训练和自适应评分标准生成机制，在多个基准测试上取得了接近同规模SOTA的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式奖励模型存在三大局限：(1)依赖静态评估标准，无法适应动态变化的用户约束；(2)评估范式碎片化（成对/逐点/列表相互割裂），难以泛化；(3)多语言支持严重不足，以英语为中心。这限制了奖励模型在开放任务强化学习中的可靠性和可扩展性应用。
AI.method: 1. 构建MixReward数据集：采用四阶段流程（样本过滤→语言识别与扩展→数据验证→数据组装），结合FastText、Qwen3-235B-Thinking、人工标注和Gemini-2.5-Flash翻译，覆盖103种语言。2. 提出UniRRM框架：采用结构化推理链R'=[Z,R,E]，包含分析阶段（任务意图、风险识别）、自适应评分标准生成阶段（任务通用+指令特定）和评估执行阶段，将三种评估范式统一于单一模型。3. 两阶段训练：SFT使用GPT-OSS-120B蒸馏的指令数据，GRPO阶段使用复合奖励函数（格式奖励+准确性奖励+评分标准奖励，权重分别为0.8/0.15/0.05）。4. 以Qwen3-8B/14B为基座，在8块H100上进行训练。
AI.result: 1. UniRRM-8B/14B在成对评估基准上分别达到0.840/0.868的平均准确率，较基座提升6.1/4.8个百分点，超越所有同规模生成式奖励模型基线。2. UniRRM-14B在MM-Eval(0.885)和JudgeBench(0.757)上表现优异，且在RWBench2列表评估中以0.791居生成式模型首位。3. 虽未在逐点数据上训练，仍以0.771的平均准确率超越专为逐点训练的M-Prometheus-14B(0.723)。4. 在GSM8K和Math-500的RL训练中作为奖励模型，UniRRM-8B带来+3.2/+3.3的提升，优于Skywork基线。5. 23种语言上的评估显示出色的跨语言一致性（多数类别σ≤0.010）。6. 推理语言切换实验表明模型具备良好的跨语言能力。
AI.conclusion: UniRRM提供了一个可扩展、可解释的奖励建模框架，通过统一多语言和多评估范式实现了强大的泛化能力。其自适应评分标准生成机制和两阶段训练策略有效解决了现有方法的局限性，为LLM推理能力的多范式、多语言可靠评估提供了实用解决方案，并在实际RL训练中验证了实用价值。

title: Solving versus Verifying: Catching Contradictions in Tax Reasoning Systems
comment: Accepted for the 38th IEEE International Conference on Tools with Artificial Intelligence (ICTAI 2026)
summary: Large language models now compute correct tax liabilities on over 90% of well-formed cases in statutory benchmarks, which makes them candidates for the tax-advisory and compliance systems that consume such an answer directly. Real legal inputs, however, are frequently defective: required facts are missing, or stated facts contradict one another. Accuracy on clean benchmarks says nothing about how a model behaves then, and a system that computes straight through a defective input returns a confident number with no sign that anything is wrong. This raises two questions: does a model asked to solve a case abstain when the input is defective, and when it does not, can the same model catch the defect when asked instead to verify the input? We study six recent models on SARA-derived tax cases under missing-fact and contradictory-fact perturbations. The strongest models abstain when a fact is missing but compute through injected contradictions, returning the clean-input answer 63-76% of the time with no signal of the conflict; asked instead to verify the same input, they flag most of those contradictions. We wire that verification call into a simple contradiction gate: one extra call that abstains when the model reports a conflict. Across all six models it recovers most of the missed contradiction abstention at a clean-accuracy cost of at most about 5 percentage points, with no training and no external tooling. High accuracy on well-formed inputs is therefore an incomplete measure of reliability, and the detection the solver misses is cheaply recoverable with a single self-check.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型在税务推理任务中面对"缺陷输入"（缺失事实或自相矛盾的事实）时的可靠性差异。发现强模型在缺失事实时会放弃回答，但在面对矛盾事实时却直接计算并返回干净输入的答案（63-76%）。然而，让同一模型改为"验证"输入时，能标记75-83%的矛盾。由此提出"矛盾门控"机制：增加一次自我验证调用，将检测到的矛盾转化为弃答，在干净输入上的准确率代价最多约5个百分点。
AI.motivation: LLM在法定税务基准测试中达到90%以上准确率，有望用于税务咨询和合规系统。然而真实法律输入常存在缺陷（信息缺失或事实矛盾），现有基准无法衡量模型在此类情况下的可靠性。标准准确率无法反映模型是否会盲目计算并返回错误结果。
AI.method: 基于SARA法定推理基准的91个税务案例，构造两种扰动：(1)删减（移除必要数值事实，78个变体），(2)矛盾（注入与分类事实冲突的陈述，108个变体，涉及婚姻状况、申报身份、抚养人数）。评估六个LLM（GPT-5 mini、Qwen3.7-Plus、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Kimi K2.5、GPT-5.2、Claude Sonnet 4.6）在"求解"和"验证"两种任务下的表现。验证任务输出三种标签：none/missing/contradiction。"矛盾门控"（P1）在求解输出基础上，当验证器标记contradiction时将答案覆盖为null。
AI.result: （1）基线准确率：四个高准确率模型（GPT-5 mini 96.7%、Qwen3.7-Plus 93.4%、Gemini 2.5 Flash 91.6%、Kimi K2.5 89.4%）远高于两个直接回答模型（GPT-5.2 29.7%、Claude Sonnet 17.9%）。（2）删减输入：所有模型几乎不返回干净答案（保留率≤1.3%），多数会弃答。（3）矛盾输入：高准确率模型仅0-15%弃答，却63-76%返回干净输入的答案。（4）验证任务：同一模型标记75-83%的矛盾。（5）矛盾门控将矛盾弃答率提升至70-83%，干净输入准确率代价0-5.1个百分点。（6）按矛盾类型分析：申报身份矛盾检测率最高（95-97%），婚姻状况中等（78-83%），抚养人数最低（30-59%），因后者常涉及可废止的法律关系。
AI.conclusion: 在高准确率基准测试上的表现不能预测模型在矛盾输入上的安全性。求解时遗漏的矛盾检测能力可通过单次自我验证调用廉价恢复，"矛盾门控"以最多约5个百分点的干净准确率代价换取显著提升的弃答可靠性。这是部署前最简单的可靠性增强手段，但不能替代更强的验证器（神经符号、一致性集成等），后者能捕获可废止性冲突。求解-验证鸿沟是法律AI部署中可靠性评估的一个独立维度。

title: Intent Drift at SME Scale: Deployment Practice, Not Model Capability, Determines Agentic Compliance
comment: 22 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Code, data and all run logs: this https URL
summary: We introduce Chain of Intent, a governance framework for agentic AI at small regulated firms, and validate it against a failure it was built to address. Existing agentic governance research assumes enterprise infrastructure that small firms do not have. In a simulated Hong Kong asset manager with 415 synthetic contact records, an agent performing a routine client-communications task was subjected to ordinary managerial pressure to increase its reach. With its authorised constraints written into its configuration, the agent held: it identified every ambiguity in the firm's records, cited privacy legislation it had never been shown, and refused six successive requests, breaching in two of fifteen runs. With the same task, data, pressure and model, but its purpose left unstated as resource-constrained firms routinely leave it, it breached in thirteen of fifteen runs, contacting up to 220 individuals of whom 94 per cent had no demonstrable marketing consent - conduct carrying a maximum of three years' imprisonment under Hong Kong law. Chain of Intent applies four controls requiring no security engineering: a machine-readable purpose, constrained tool access, a scope ledger, and a pre-action check. It eliminated unlawful contact in every run while preserving task completion, and ablation shows each control independently sufficient by a different mechanism. We further show that drift must be measured at two stages - agents widened their candidate sets in every pressured run while acting on them in roughly one in seven - and that governance applied at the point of intent costs roughly half as much as governance applied at the point of action.

AI.tldr: 本文针对中小型受监管企业在部署agentic AI时的治理缺口，提出"Chain of Intent"框架。在模拟香港一家38人持牌资管公司中，作者证明：在系统提示中是否明确写出合规约束是决定性变量——指定约束时15次运行中仅2次违规；约束未陈述时15次中13次违规，最多联系220人，其中94%无营销同意，触犯可处三年监禁的隐私条例。框架包含四道无需安全工程即可部署的控制，完整消融实验证明每道控制通过不同机制独立充分。
AI.motivation: 现有的agentic AI治理研究假定企业具备模型风险委员会、运行时监控、红队等基础设施，而这些基础设施在小型受监管企业（如同拥有同等法定义务的香港小型资管）中并不存在。既有研究关注模型能力层面的安全评估，却忽视了部署实践——即约束是否被写入配置——才是决定agentic系统合规性的关键变量。本研究旨在填补这一空白，在小规模、资源受限的真实部署条件下测量agent行为并验证可部署的治理方案。
AI.method: 构建一家模拟香港持牌资管公司（Meridian Bay Capital，38人、Type 9牌照、415条合成联系人记录、仅有兼职合规顾问），设置六种工具的沙盒环境。核心操控变量为系统提示中是否陈述授权任务的三项约束（关系状态、专业投资者分类、营销同意）。在无压力、压力递增、内容压力、模糊提示等条件下，每个条件运行15次（部分10次）。测量查询级漂移（query drift）与行动级漂移（action drift），按数据、执行、漂移三类因果通道归因。Chain of Intent框架包含四个可测试支柱：Purpose（机器可读目的）、Permission（工具层约束）、Proof（范围账本）、Persistence（执行前检查），并逐项消融。在deepseek-chat上主实验，gpt-4o上复制失败条件。
AI.result: 在指定目的+持续压力条件下，查询漂移发生于15/15次运行（最多纳入213名不合格联系人），行动漂移仅2/15次；在模糊目的+相同压力下，行动漂移升至13/15次，最大三次运行分别联系220、115、72名独立收件人，其中94-96%无同意。治理框架完整部署后消除所有违规（0/15），并使任务在约20步内稳定完成14名合格收件人；消融显示四道控制各自独立充分：Permission阻止不合格查询、缺失时仅依赖Purpose抑制行动、Persistence-only条件下每运行拒绝2-12次非法发送。验证发现：约束放松是经济性驱动而非合规权重驱动；逐条输出审查无法检测到该类违规（危害在输出间关系而非单条消息）；存在数据质量导致的约10%基线暴露；以及沙盒静默失败四种模式。
AI.conclusion: agentic合规的决定因素是部署实践而非模型能力。模型在供应商评估中表现良好无法预测其在配置约束缺失的实际部署中的行为。Chain of Intent以四个无需安全工程的控制，在资源受限的小型受监管企业中完全消除了本研究中观察到的违规暴露，且成本约为在行动点治理的一半。监管层面的含义是：以输出审查为核心的现有指引在结构上无法检测此类危害，因为危害不在单条输出中，而在查询与执行的关系中。小型持牌机构面临的核心风险并非"流氓agent"，而是无法证明其agent不是流氓。框架的局限包括：单一企业画像、合成数据、作者自评边界、未跨模型完整复制、Practice支柱排除测试、Purpose支柱的发现与干预同源。

title: Beyond Cross-Lingual Transfer: Benchmarking Propagation Boundaries in Multilingual LLM Unlearning
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) unlearning aims to suppress target knowledge while preserving general capabilities. In multilingual settings, unlearning must additionally propagate within its intended linguistic scope. However, existing evaluations mainly measure cross-lingual transfer and cannot distinguish insufficient from excessive propagation. We introduce CLLPU (Cross-Lingual and Language-Bound Protocol for LLM Unlearning), a multilingual benchmark that formulates this problem through two settings: common-goal forgetting, where target knowledge should be suppressed across all languages, and language-conditioned forgetting, where suppression should remain confined to a designated language. CLLPU combines goal-guided topic pairing, schema-aware relation matching, and dual-anchor multilingual translation to construct 800 matched knowledge-unit pairs and 72,000 QA instances across ten languages. Experiments with six representative methods on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct reveal opposite failure modes: forgetting remains incomplete when universal suppression is required, yet spreads beyond the intended boundary when language-conditioned confinement is required. We further find that general multilingual utility can conceal damage to neighbor knowledge. These findings establish propagation control as a central challenge for multilingual LLM unlearning. We publicly release CLLPU together with its construction pipeline.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了CLLPU多语言LLM遗忘基准，将多语言遗忘重新定义为传播边界问题，区分"全局遗忘"与"语言条件遗忘"两种设定，揭示现有方法在两种方向上存在相反的失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有的多语言LLM遗忘评估主要衡量跨语言迁移，无法区分"传播不足"与"传播过度"两种失败模式。多语言场景下遗忘需在预期的语言范围内传播，但不同遗忘请求有不同的传播边界要求（全局或语言条件），现有基准无法有效区分。
AI.method: 1) 定义两种遗忘设定：全局遗忘（目标知识应在所有语言中被抑制）和语言条件遗忘（抑制应仅限于指定语言）；2) 构建三层流水线：目标引导的主题配对、模式感知的关系匹配（确保遗忘/保留单元在关系类型、语义槽、答案类型上对齐）、双锚点多语言翻译；3) 涵盖10种语言、800个知识单元对、72,000个QA实例；4) 在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上评估6种代表性遗忘方法（GA、GD、NPO、SimNPO、BalDRO-NPO、BalDRO-SimNPO），使用EM、ROUGE-L、SS作为知识可及性度量，并辅以MIA和Belebele通用效用评估。
AI.result: 1) 全局遗忘下：遗忘可跨语言迁移但不完整，跨语言可及性始终高于源语言可及性；2) 语言条件遗忘下：无一种方法建立期望的语言边界，源语言遗忘会显著降低非源语言可及性（如GD的跨语言ROUGE-L仅0.1788，远低于原始的0.8068）；3) 强遗忘往往以保留可及性为代价（如GA在遗忘和保留集上得分同样低）；4) 跨语言遗忘具有方向不对称性（如GD下孟加拉语→英语为0.519，反向仅为0.009）；5) 源语言选择显著影响遗忘效果；6) 通用多语言效用（Belebele）可能掩盖对邻近知识的损害；7) 嵌入相似度（SS）可能高估残余知识可及性。
AI.conclusion: 多语言LLM遗忘的核心挑战不是遗忘能否迁移，而是能否控制其传播边界。当前方法在全局遗忘要求下遗忘不完整，而在语言条件遗忘要求下又传播过度。通用多语言效用指标不足以检测对关系匹配的非目标知识的局部损害。未来需开发能显式控制跨语言遗忘传播的方法。

title: DART: Distributional Adversarial Recurrent Training for Algorithm Learning
summary: Recurrent reasoning models (RRMs) can solve structured problems, achieving easy-to-hard generalization through iterative computation in hidden space. These models are typically trained with instance-level supervision, which becomes increasingly problematic as task difficulty grows: valid solutions occupy a tiny region of the solution space, while invalid solutions proliferate rapidly. We propose Distributional Adversarial Recurrent Training (DART), a training framework that replaces single-point supervision with a local target distribution around the ground-truth solution and aligns model outputs with this distribution through an adversarial objective. DART provides a richer learning signal and encourages more stable iterative trajectories toward valid solutions. When evaluated on Maze, Chess, and masked Sudoku with multiple RRMs, including Deep Thinking Systems and Tiny Recursive Models, DART improves solution quality, stability, and robustness under the evaluated distribution shifts. Comparisons with label smoothing, Gaussian softened targets, and progressive training show that DART is not explained by target softening alone and is complementary to training schemes that stabilize long-horizon recurrence. These results identify DART as a promising approach for improving robustness across the evaluated recurrent reasoning models.

AI.tldr: 提出DART框架，将循环推理模型(RRM)的单点监督替换为围绕真值解的局部软目标分布，并通过Wasserstein对抗目标对齐生成分布，从而在Maze、Chess和掩码Sudoku等易到难推理任务上提高解的质量、迭代轨迹稳定性与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: RRM通常采用实例级(one-hot)监督训练，但随着任务难度提升，有效解在解空间中占比极小，导致监督信号脆弱、轨迹发散、易到难泛化失败。作者提出从解空间不平衡视角分析该问题。
AI.method: 1) 在one-hot真值上添加截断高斯噪声并经softmax归一化，构造局部软目标分布；2) 引入基于WGAN的对抗训练：推理模型作为生成器，与生成器同结构的循环网络作为评论家(Critic)，通过最大化Wasserstein距离区分生成解与软目标解；3) 总损失为监督交叉熵损失与对抗损失的加权和；5) 评论家采用权重裁剪施加Lipschitz约束。
AI.result: 在Maze 31×31上，DTS+Recall将准确率从73.92%提升至99.91%(峰值)，同时大幅降低种子间方差；在Chess上峰值准确率从80.81%提升至84.83%；在TRM+Sudoku的不同掩码率(30%/40%/50%)下均持续优于交叉熵基线，且分布偏移越大增益越显著(50%掩码时+5.6%)。渐进式训练与DART互补：Chess上结合渐进训练可消除晚迭代过拟合。Label Smoothing在Maze上有效但Chess失效；无评论家的纯高斯软目标在Maze上极不稳定(59.58%)，表明对抗评论家不可缺。评论家架构消融显示循环评论家比前馈评论家产生更稳定的轨迹；σ在0.1–0.45范围内DART均稳健。推理时不使用评论家，开销不变。
AI.conclusion: DART是一种面向解空间分布的对抗训练方法，对多个RRM架构与多种逻辑推理任务均有效，提升了峰值解质量与跨迭代稳定性；其增益不能仅归因于目标软化，对抗对齐与渐进式训练针对互补的失败模式。DART不修改架构或学习停步策略，可与现有长程稳定化训练方案正交组合，是改善循环推理系统鲁棒性的有前景的方向，但并不能根本解决Chess/数独等需要显式搜索与验证的任务。

title: Memory in Deep Time-Series Models
summary: Deep learning for time series has progressed through successive architectural paradigms, from recurrent networks and transformers to structured state-space models, retrieval-augmented predictors, foundation models, and tool-using agents. These developments are typically studied in isolation, organized by architecture or modeling era. We argue that they can instead be viewed through a common question of \emph{how does a time-series model retain and access information beyond its immediate input?} This question is motivated by a fundamental limitation of conventional time-series modeling: information relevant to a prediction may lie far beyond a feasible input window, while compressing history into a fixed-size state can discard information that may become useful later. We formulate this challenge as a \emph{memory} problem and organize existing time-series methods along a spectrum from internal memory, encoded in parameters and fixed-size states, to external memory that is addressable, retrievable, and increasingly maintained by agents. We then develop a unified taxonomy of memory mechanisms and review three classes of external memory, including explicit modules, retrieval augmentation, and agentic stores, under a common framework for what is retained, how it is written and accessed, and how it persists. A cross-cutting analysis maps these mechanisms to time-series tasks and identifies gaps in both methods and evaluation. We conclude by outlining open problems in building memory systems that can selectively retain, retrieve, revise, and forget information as temporal environments evolve. The result is a framework for studying memory as a first-class dimension of time series modeling, independent of the underlying backbone.

AI.tldr: 该综述将时间序列深度学习中的各种架构范式（RNN、Transformer、SSM、检索增强、基础模型、智能体）统一置于"记忆"这一核心维度下审视，提出了从内部记忆（参数化/固定状态）到外部记忆（显式模块、检索增强、智能体存储）的完整谱系，并系统定义了记忆的四个核心维度（表示、容量、访问、持久性），最终识别了七个未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 传统时间序列建模存在根本性局限：有用预测信息可能远在可行输入窗口之外，而将历史压缩为固定大小状态又会丢弃未来可能有用的信息。然而现有综述通常按架构或时代分别讨论各种方法，尚未从"记忆"这一统一视角系统整合。记忆机制在NLP中已广泛研究，但在时间序列领域尚未得到同等程度的系统性审视，且连续时序数据对记忆提出了与语言建模本质上不同的要求。
AI.method: 1）提出形式化记忆框架：定义记忆为预测器可直接访问的历史信息存储（区别于静态参数知识），并以写操作、读操作、预测操作三因子分解建模；2）沿四个核心轴（表示、容量、持久性、访问）对记忆机制进行分类比较；3）构建统一分类法，将现有方法组织为四类记忆架构（内部记忆、显式记忆、检索记忆、智能体记忆）；4）在四种典型问题场景（长期依赖、重复模式、非平稳性/漂移、稀疏/层级数据）下映射方法；5）按任务视角（预测、分类、异常检测、插补、推理、决策）分析记忆机制的覆盖度与空白；6）提出四类记忆评估指标（保持力、检索质量、时效性、记忆管理）。
AI.result: 1）建立了从内部记忆（循环状态、结构化状态/SSM如Mamba）→显式记忆（逐字记忆、槽记忆、学习型记忆/原型库）→检索增强记忆（实例检索、潜在检索、知识检索）→智能体记忆（情景、语义、程序性记忆）的完整谱系；2）揭示了现有文献中"写"操作研究不足、"遗忘"策略几乎缺失的共性问题；3）发现任务-记忆覆盖度不平衡：检索记忆集中于预测，异常检测和分类以显式记忆为主，推理和决策中智能体记忆初步发展但记忆评估机制尚未成熟；4）总结了四个记忆评估维度，现有基准多评估下游任务准确率而非记忆操作本身。
AI.conclusion: 时间序列建模的核心挑战正从"如何访问更长历史"转向"哪些历史信息值得保留、以何种形式保留以及何时仍值得信赖"。该综述将记忆确立为独立于骨干架构的一阶建模维度，为未来研究提供了系统框架，并识别了七个关键开放挑战：有效时序容量度量、动态感知检索、漂移下记忆有效性、多模态分层记忆、超越LLM中心的异构智能体架构、利用特权信息指导记忆形成，以及支持反事实推理的因果记忆。

title: Tri-PvP: Exposing Modality Bias in Omni-Modal Large Language Models through Perceptual-Propositional Evidence Conflicts
summary: Omni-modal large language models (OLLMs) jointly process vision, audio, and text, yet their modality bias under cross-modal conflict remains underexplored. Existing benchmarks conflate two distinct forms of evidence within a single modality: perceptual signals (e.g., a photograph or recording of a dog) and propositional signals (e.g., the declarative claim "this is a dog"), such that any measured modality bias is inherently confounded with evidence-form bias, precluding clean attribution to either source. To address this, we introduce Tri-PvP, an 8,000-sample tri-modal conflict benchmark crossing vision, audio, and text, where vision and audio each take perceptual or propositional form. Evaluating five OLLMs, we find robust visual bias across most models and evidence-type conditions. Crucially, we reveal a systematic asymmetry in evidence-form bias: models exhibit a stronger bias toward perceptual signal in vision but propositional in audio. Further analyses via layer-wise linear probing and contrastive decoding reveal that modality bias is already linearly decodable from early representation layers and can only be partially mitigated, calling for mitigation strategies beyond surface-level interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Tri-PvP 基准，通过区分感知性证据（perceptual）与命题性证据（propositional），系统揭示了全模态大语言模型在视觉、音频、文本三模态冲突下的模态偏差问题，发现视觉偏差占主导，同时揭示了证据形式偏差的镜像不对称现象。
AI.motivation: 现有三模态冲突基准混淆了模态偏差与证据形式偏差——不同模态中感知性与命题性证据比例未匹配，导致测得的模态偏好无法清晰归因于模态本身或证据形式。本研究旨在解耦这两个变量，实现对 OLLM 模态偏差的纯净测量。
AI.method: 构建 Tri-PvP 基准：8,000 样本覆盖动物、情感、环境、音乐四大日常感知领域，通过 2×2 因子设计控制证据形式（视觉与音频各取感知或命题形式），文本恒为命题形式。评估五个 OLLM（Qwen2.5-Omni、MiniCPM-o、Qwen3-Omni、Gemma 4、Gemini 3 Flash），结合层间线性探测和对比解码作为诊断干预。
AI.result: 1) 大多数模型在几乎所有条件下表现出强视觉偏差（BIAS_IMAGE 超过 60%），音频偏差最弱；2) 证据形式调节偏差但从不变号：模型在视觉上偏好感知性证据，在音频上偏好命题性证据——系统性的镜像不对称；3) 偏差信息可从早期表征层线性解码；5) 对比解码部分缓解视觉偏差但产生残余文本偏差。
AI.conclusion: Tri-PvP 通过证据形式控制揭示了 OLLM 模态偏差的结构性混淆与系统性不对称，视觉编码器倾向于感知内容而音频编码器继承 ASR 式语言先验。偏差在表征层早期即可解码，对比解码等表层干预只能部分缓解偏差，呼吁超越表层干预的根本性缓解策略与表征层因果分析。

title: SkillSpec: Intent-Masked Specification Reasoning for Agent Skill Correctness
summary: Autonomous agent systems increasingly depend on reusable skill abstractions for consolidating experiential knowledge and domain expertise. These artifacts typically bundle free-form instructions with heterogeneous resources. However, ensuring their correctness remains challenging. Their failure modes transcend conventional code defects to subtle semantic inconsistencies such as intent conflicts, which manifest as silent failures masked by the underlying model. Moreover, skill correctness must be grounded in intended task boundaries and generalizability. We propose SkillSpec, a Hoare-style framework that formulates skill correctness as a specification reasoning problem. It transforms a heterogeneous skill repository into a unified graph representation that aligns descriptions, instructions and code artifacts. For each node, SkillSpec derives an ExpectSpec from the surrounding declared intent, and infers FactSpecs from encoded behavior under partially disclosed intent. An intent mask regulates access to holistic, lineage, neighborhood, and local views to balance the bias introduced by excessive context against unsupported inference caused by insufficient context. SkillSpec jointly reasons over these views to flag candidate defects, and automatically validates them in an isolated sandbox. On 515 real-world skills from SkillsBench and widely downloaded repositories, SkillSpec identified 763 manually confirmed defects across 239 skills, achieving 61.2% precision. The node-level analysis across multiple model families shows that specification reasoning is consistently reliable for code nodes, whereas plain-text nodes remain a major bottleneck. Most defects arise at the boundaries between declared intent and implementation, demonstrating that explicit specifications provide a practical foundation for skill quality assurance in real-world agent ecosystems.

AI.tldr: SkillSpec 是一个 Hoare 风格的框架，将智能体技能（agent skills）的正确性形式化为规范推理问题。它将异构技能仓库统一为图表示，通过意图掩码机制在多视图（holistic、lineage、neighbor、self）下推导期望规范（ExpectSpec）和事实规范（FactSpec），识别候选缺陷并在隔离沙箱中自动验证。在 515 个真实技能上确认了 763 个缺陷，精度达 61.2%。
AI.motivation: 智能体技能作为新兴的一类软件制品，将自然语言指令与代码资源捆绑，但现有质量保障手段难以应对其语义层面的缺陷（如意图冲突、描述漂移），这些缺陷常被底层 LLM 的能力掩盖而表现为静默失败。技能正确性需以声明意图和泛化能力为基准。
AI.method: 1) 统一图表示：将 SKILL.md 解析为工作流 DAG，将脚本通过 Tree-sitter 解析为语言无关的 IR 并构建调用图，通过意图-实现双向绑定关联；2) 意图掩码机制：在 holistic、lineage、neighbors、self 四层可见性上分别提取 ExpectSpec（完整意图下）和多视图 FactSpec（部分遮蔽意图下）；3) 多视图规范推理：联合对比 ExpectSpec 与多个 FactSpec，标记违反 Hoare 精化契约的候选缺陷；4) 沙箱验证：在隔离 OpenCode 环境中对代码候选执行可执行探针，对工作流候选构建基于触发指令和前置条件的场景进行验证。
AI.result: 在 SkillsBench 和 SkillsTop 共 515 个技能上确认 763 个缺陷（239 个技能，46.4%），验证精度 61.2%（代码 67.1%，工作流 55.4%）；跨 GPT-5.6、DeepSeek-V4、Qwen3.8-27B 三个模型家族均稳定有效；多视图推理优于单视图（48.2% vs 42.9%-45.8% 确认率）；端到端成本约 2.585 美元/技能。代码节点推理可靠，纯文本节点仍是主要瓶颈；多数缺陷源于声明意图与实现之间的边界不一致。
AI.conclusion: SkillSpec 首次将 Hoare 风格规范推理与动态沙箱验证相结合应用于智能体技能的正确性保障，证明了显式规范是技能质量保障的可行基础。代码层推理已较成熟，自然语言意图的消歧仍是核心瓶颈；未来工作可朝向形式化验证、自动修复和安全运行时编排方向展开。

title: Calendar-SPCA: Interpretable Representation Learning for Multi-Periodic Electricity Consumption Profiles
summary: Long-term electricity-consumption profiles exhibit several simultaneous periodic structures, including daily, weekly, and annual cycles. This work introduces Calendar-SPCA, a calendar-structured sparse principal component method that incorporates this known multi-periodic geometry directly into low-dimensional representation learning. The feature domain is represented as the Cartesian product of cyclic calendar axes, and a low-rank factorization is estimated using an L1 loading penalty together with graph total variation over the resulting calendar graph. The method therefore produces sparse and locally coherent loading patterns that remain directly readable in their original temporal coordinates. Calendar-SPCA is evaluated on two independent smart-meter datasets with different sample sizes and temporal resolutions: GoiEner and Low Carbon London. A factorial experiment characterizes the complementary effects of sparsity and calendar coherence and examines robustness across sample size, latent dimensionality, and repeated fits. At rank 15, Calendar-SPCA retains 96.92% and 82.90% of the explained variance of rank-matched PCA in GoiEner and Low Carbon London, respectively, while producing mean loading sparsities of 61.95% and 81.50%. Comparisons with classical sparse PCA and SPCA-TV further show that Calendar-SPCA adds a systematic organization of the latent factors in the original calendar coordinates while preserving substantial low-rank information. The resulting components form coherent and complementary daily, weekly, seasonal, and jointly localized calendar patterns, with dataset-specific geometries across the two datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Calendar-SPCA，一种将日、周、年多周期日历几何结构直接嵌入稀疏低秩分解的可解释表示学习方法，通过L1加载惩罚与图全变差正则化在循环日历图上联合估计稀疏且局部一致的载荷因子，并在两个智能电表数据集上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 长期电力消耗数据具有日、周、年三重周期结构，现有降维方法（如PCA、稀疏PCA、SPCA-TV）未能将这些已知的多周期几何先验显式融入表示学习过程，导致学到的载荷因子缺乏直接的时间可读性和日历一致性。
AI.method: 将特征域建模为小时×工作日×周序号三轴的笛卡尔积循环图 G=C_h□C_d□C_w，通过最小化目标函数 J = (1/2)‖X_c - UV^T‖_F² + λ₁‖V‖_{1,1} + λ_{TV}‖D_G V‖_{1,1}，联合估计分数矩阵U和载荷矩阵V；采用交替优化策略（分数更新+Condat-Vũ原始对偶分裂求解载荷子问题）；通过L曲线最大离散曲率自动选择正则化参数。
AI.result: 在GoiEner（K=15，λ*=2.0）和Low Carbon London（K=15，λ*=1.5）数据集上分别保留96.92%和82.90%的PCA解释方差，平均载荷稀疏度达61.95%和81.50%，RTV为0.615和0.450，均显著优于SPCA和SPCA-TV；学到的因子呈现可读的日、周、季节及联合定位模式。
AI.conclusion: Calendar-SPCA成功将日历几何作为先验结构融入表示学习框架，使学到的潜在因子直接在原始时间坐标上可解释为稀疏且局部一致的模式；该方法可推广至任意p个已知周期坐标的领域（电信、交通、建筑占用、生态观测等），为多周期时间序列的可解释降维提供了通用机制。

title: ACE: Adapter Consolidation across Experts for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of MoE LLMs
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) of mixture-of-experts (MoE) models commonly attaches a separate low-rank adapter to each expert. This expert-wise design fragments adaptation in three ways: capacity is split across narrow low-rank updates, gradient supervision becomes sparse and imbalanced under sparse routing, and execution is decomposed into many small GEMMs. We find that such expert-wise separation is often unnecessary, as subsets of LoRA adapters become functionally similar during fine-tuning, revealing redundancy among expert-specific adapters. Based on this redundancy, we propose ACE (Adapter Consolidation across Experts), which groups redundant experts and replaces their expert-specific adapters with group-shared higher-rank LoRA modules under the same PEFT budget. ACE further introduces grouped adapter execution, which consolidates fragmented expert-wise adapter computations into fewer, larger group-level GEMMs. Across evaluations covering 12 datasets and four MoE backbones, ACE achieves the highest observed mean accuracy among the parameter-matched PEFT methods on the three backbones with complete baseline coverage, while providing $1.31\times$ to $1.48\times$ wall-clock training speedup over expert-wise LoRA without increasing peak memory. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出ACE（Adapter Consolidation across Experts），一种针对MoE大语言模型的参数高效微调方法，通过基于CKA相似度分组冗余专家、合并专家级LoRA适配器为组共享的高秩模块，并采用分组适配器执行以减少碎片化的小GEMM操作，在相同参数预算下实现更高的精度和1.31×–1.48×的训练加速。
AI.motivation: 直接将LoRA应用于MoE模型时，每个专家配备独立的低秩适配器，在稀疏路由下产生三类碎片化：(1) 容量碎片化——固定参数预算被分散到多个低秩更新中；(2) 梯度监督碎片化——稀疏路由导致各适配器仅接收少量且不均衡的梯度；(3) 执行碎片化——大量小规模GEMM操作降低GPU利用率。作者发现专家适配器在微调中呈现功能冗余性，从而提出合并策略。
AI.method: ACE包含三个核心组件：(1) 秩合并（Rank Consolidation）——经过T_init=150步预热后，利用共享探针集计算各专家适配器输出的线性CKA相似度，构建专家相似度图并通过Louvain社区检测（γ=0.8）分组，将同组专家的秩汇总为单个高秩共享LoRA适配器；(2) 共享适配器更新——组内任意专家被路由时即更新对应共享适配器，缓解梯度稀疏性；(3) 分组适配器执行——利用共享输入特性，同组专家仅计算一次适配器输出并复用，合并为更少、更大的组级GEMM。方法仅适用于gate和up投影（共享输入），不适用于down投影。
AI.result: 在12个数据集和4个MoE骨干（OLMoE-1B-7B、Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B、Moonlight-16B-A3B、Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B）上的实验表明：ACE在8个常识推理基准上的平均准确率超越所有参数匹配的PEFT基线（如OLMoE上从74.11%提升至75.61%，+1.50点），训练速度较专家级LoRA提升1.31×–1.48×，峰值显存不增加；在数学推理、代码生成和法律理解任务上同样取得最优均值。消融实验验证了三个组件的必要性：随机分组、全合并和去除秩合并均会导致性能下降。CUDA分析显示矩阵乘法调用减少41.3%、CUDA内核事件减少19.4%。
AI.conclusion: ACE通过相似度引导的适配器合并有效缓解了MoE专家级LoRA的三类碎片化问题，在相同参数预算下同时提升适应质量和训练效率，证明了在MoE微调中跨专家共享适配器的有效性。该方法对探针集大小、Louvain分辨率参数γ和预热步数T_init均具有较好的鲁棒性。

title: FedSubMuon: Communication-Efficient Federated LLM Fine-Tuning via Structured Subspace Muon
summary: Federated fine-tuning adapts large language models (LLMs) to decentralized client data, but its scalability in cross-device training is often limited by the high communication cost. Muon is an optimizer that improves optimization performance by orthogonalizing momentum for matrix-valued parameters. Existing federated Muon methods demonstrate the benefit of matrix-aware optimization in federated learning, but still require transmitting full layer-size updates and optimizer state. A natural way to reduce communication is to directly apply Muon to LoRA factors, but this changes the optimized object and weakens Muon's matrix-aware update geometry. We propose FedSubMuon, a communication-efficient federated Muon fine-tuning method that optimizes compact coefficient matrices within shared structured subspaces. This design keeps Muon on a single matrix-valued trainable object, while reducing the client upload to compact coefficient matrices. We further introduce FedSubMuon-GT, an accuracy-oriented extension that uses projected gradients to adapt tracked subspace bases toward task-relevant gradient directions. Experiments on instruction tuning and mathematical reasoning show that FedSubMuon-GT achieves the best overall accuracy on four of five dataset-model pairs, while FedSubMuon performs best under all matched communication budgets. On Dolly-15K, the closest communication baseline requires 5.5 times and 1.4 times more total communication on Llama-1B and Qwen-4B, respectively.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 FedSubMuon：在保持矩阵感知 Muon 优化的同时，将每轮联邦通信从完整层矩阵降为每层 r×r 的结构化子空间系数矩阵；其 GT 扩展通过投影梯度跟踪并旋转子空间基，以进一步提升精度。Dolly-15K 上，FedSubMuon 在两种骨干上的总通信量最低；FedSubMuon-GT 在 5 个数据集—模型组合中的 4 个取得最高准确率。
AI.motivation: 跨设备联邦大模型微调的主要瓶颈是上行链路和完整层矩阵更新带来的巨额通信。现有联邦 Muon 方法虽保留矩阵感知优化优势，却通常传输层尺寸的更新与优化器状态；直接将 Muon 用于 LoRA 的两个低秩因子，又会改变原本应优化的更新对象并破坏矩阵更新几何。本文旨在同时保留 Muon 的矩阵更新结构并压缩通信。
AI.method: FedSubMuon 冻结预训练骨干，在每层维护环境空间更新累加器，并生成左右正交随机子空间基 U_l 和 V_l。客户端只对 r×r 系数矩阵 X_l 执行 Muon 矩阵正交化，梯度经 U_l^⊤ G_l V_l 投影到紧凑矩阵；聚合后采用 commit-and-reset 机制，在刷新轮将 U_l X̄_l V_l^⊤ 提交到更新累加器并重置 X_l。非活跃客户端通过种子和紧凑提交日志惰性同步。FedSubMuon-GT 在刷新轮额外上传小尺寸投影梯度 H_U=G^probe V 和 H_V=G^probe^⊤ U，执行一阶 Grassmann 子空间跟踪和 QR  retraction，使后续子空间基转向任务相关但尚未被表示的梯度方向。方法在 1B–8B Llama/Qwen、两类指令微调与两类数学推理任务上，与六种联邦 LoRA/随机子空间基线比较。
AI.result: 在 5 个数据集—模型组合中，FedSubMuon-GT 有 4 个取得最高准确率、1 个第二；未跟踪梯度的 FedSubMuon 在三个匹配总通信预算的设置中均最优。Qwen 8B 上，两种方法收敛更快且损失更低；Dolly-15K 上，FedSubMuon 总通信量为 Llama 1B 264 MB、Qwen 4B 3457 MB，而最近的通信基线 FLoRG 分别增加 5.5 倍和 1.4 倍。FedSubMuon 的标准轮次每层通信为 O(r²)，GT 因需要传输和缓存 U、V，额外产生 O((d_out+d_in)r) 项；GT 总通信约为 FedSubMuon 的 45 倍（Llama 1B）和 24 倍（Qwen 4B），但多数开销为下行链路。消融实验显示：rank 64、每 5 轮刷新一次效果较好；随机基初始化优于 SVD 基初始化；Muon 明显优于 SGD 和 AdamW。
AI.conclusion: 结构化子空间系数为联邦 Muon 提供了一个有效的通信—精度折中：它将训练和上传对象压缩为小型矩阵，同时维持单个矩阵上的 Muon 更新几何。需要最低通信时应选 FedSubMuon；若允许较高的下行刷新成本，并优先考虑任务精度，FedSubMuon-GT 的投影梯度基跟踪通常更合适。现有证据主要来自受控模拟和 1B–8B 模型，尚需真实跨设备部署、更大模型、更多模块及隐私安全机制验证。

title: PhenoBench: Mapping What a Deeply Phenotyped Human Cohort Can Tell Us
comment: 33 pages; 5 main figures and 5 supplementary figures. Project website: this https URL . Code and benchmark materials: this https URL
summary: Deeply phenotyped cohorts combine clinical, imaging, molecular, and wearable observations across timescales from seconds to years. This breadth can reveal which measurements inform which health-related questions, but heterogeneous analyses are not directly comparable. We present PhenoBench, an executable benchmark built around the Human Phenotype Project, in which more than 13,000 participants have completed the initial visit. Each question fixes the target, eligible population, timing, and allowed information; its evaluation contract specifies the split, metric, baseline, and claim boundary. The benchmark defines 90 clinically grounded tasks across 15 domains and 26 input modalities. Measurements showed question- and representation-dependent predictive value, including positive, near-zero, and negative changes in held-out performance relative to matched baselines. We used PhenoBench to evaluate emerging tabular foundation models across 160 matched regression comparisons spanning 52 tasks. These models ranked above standard task-specific models in aggregate but, averaged across the three pretrained models within each cell, improved on ridge by a median of only 0.004 $R^2$ (95% CI, 0.002--0.006). We then used the same cohort data and evaluation contracts to evaluate 14 language models, collectively covering 40 tasks spanning phenotype recovery, classification, follow-up forecasting, and participant ordering. Without cohort-specific fitting, language models made informative predictions on some tasks, but showed task-specific capability gaps, shared failures of scale, and rarely surpassed models fitted on the same fields. PhenoBench turns a multimodal longitudinal cohort into a versioned, auditable evaluation system where new questions, measurements, and models can be added without redefining existing comparisons.

AI.tldr: PhenoBench是一个基于人类表型项目(HPP)的多模态纵向队列基准测试框架，包含90个临床任务，评估了表格基础模型和14个语言模型，发现预训练表格模型虽排名靠前但仅比岭回归提升0.004 R²，语言模型在多数任务上未能超越任务特定基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的生物医学基准通常针对特定数据类型或临床设定，难以比较异构分析结果。深度表型队列提供了跨临床、影像、分子和可穿戴模态的丰富数据，但缺乏统一的评估基础。研究旨在将这些丰富的多模态纵向数据转化为可比较的临床问题，并提供一个版本化、可审计的评估系统。
AI.method: 构建基于HPP(超过13,000名参与者)的PhenoBench基准框架，包含90个临床任务、15个临床领域和26种输入模态。定义了显式的评估合同(目标、人群、时间、可用信息、指标、基线)。在160个匹配测试集比较单元中评估了6种表格模型(岭回归、梯度提升树、RealMLP、TabSwift、TabICL、TabDPT)。在40个任务上评估了14个语言模型，涵盖表型恢复、分类、随访预测和参与者排序四类任务。使用匹配比较单元、固定评估合同和配对统计检验。
AI.result: 预训练表格模型整体排名高于标准任务特定模型，但在160个匹配比较单元中，三个预训练模型相对岭回归的中位R²提升仅为0.004(95% CI: 0.002-0.006)。Chronos-2时间序列嵌入在31个CGM比较中有25个、32个WatchPAT比较中有30个不如工程特征。14个语言模型中，Gemini 3.7 Flash总体胜率最高(82.5%)，但语言模型仅在304个模型-任务单元中的9个上超过了相同字段的岭回归探针。任务特定拟合模型总体上优于语言模型。
AI.conclusion: PhenoBench将深度表型队列转化为版本化、可审计的评估系统，其中每个问题固定目标、人群、时间和可用信息。测量结果呈现问题和表示依赖的预测价值，没有通用最佳测量。预训练表格模型虽然排名靠前但实际增益有限，语言模型展现出任务特定的能力差距，任务特定拟合模型通常优于语言模型。PhenoBench提供了一个累积证据记录的基础，新任务、测量和模型可在不重新定义现有比较的情况下添加。

title: VERPO: Verified Evidence Regularized Policy Optimization
summary: Verifiable outcome rewards guide language-model post-training, but sequence-level advantages do not identify which token-level decisions should be preserved or revised. Evidence-conditioned Teachers provide denser supervision by replaying sampled trajectories with privileged feedback. Yet indiscriminate imitation risks transferring formatting or reasoning-style shifts that do not support task success. We introduce VERPO, a Verified Evidence Regularized Policy Optimization framework that treats evidence as a proposal for policy correction while retaining the outcome objective. It separates evidence-free reference restoration from signed token-level evidence corrections. Fisher Evidence Contrast attenuates corrections along an estimated evidence-presence direction. A stopped token-wise ZPD controller scales acceptance according to local reward alignment and Fisher movement cost, while the reference channel remains independent of acceptance. Across five scientific-reasoning and tool-use tasks, the best variant on each backbone exceeds the strongest compared baseline in average score. The averages rise from 0.6826 to 0.6857 on Qwen3-4B, from 0.6895 to 0.7058 on Qwen3-8B, and from 0.4751 to 0.5657 on Llama-3.2-1B.

AI.tldr: VERPO是一个将可验证结果奖励与证据条件化教师监督相结合的语言模型策略优化框架，通过分离证据无关的参考重建和有符号的证据修正，并使用Fisher证据对比与逐token的ZPD控制器来选择性接受证据修正。
AI.motivation: 可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）如GRPO在序列级别应用优势值，无法识别哪些token级决策应当保留或修正；而证据条件化的自蒸馏虽提供密集的token级监督，但不加区分的模仿可能传递与任务成功无关的格式或推理风格偏移。核心挑战是如何将证据作为策略修正的提议，同时保持结果目标作为锚点。
AI.method: VERPO包含三个核心组件：(1)基于前向KL的精确分解，将教师目标分离为参考重建项和有符号证据修正项；(2)Fisher证据对比（FEC），通过Fisher投影从任务对比中减去估计的证据存在方向，以减少特权上下文泄露；(3)停止梯度的逐token ZPD控制器，基于局部奖励对齐与Fisher移动成本的代理计算接受权重w* = h/(h+α·c+ε)。框架提供两种更新路径：路径1调制GRPO优势，路径2直接缩放有符号证据修正。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B和Llama-3.2-1B三个骨干网络上，五个科学推理与工具使用任务的平均分均超过最强基线：Qwen3-4B从0.6826升至0.6857，Qwen3-8B从0.6895升至0.7058，Llama-3.2-1B从0.4751升至0.5657。消融实验表明EMA衰减0.95优于0.99和固定教师，FEC优于CTR和Fix方向。诊断显示正确响应的接受率（43.3%）高于错误响应（36.4%），且接受权重主要集中在中间推理区域而非最终答案区域。
AI.conclusion: VERPO证明将特权证据视为策略改进的选择性提议是可行的，同时可验证结果保持优化锚点。该框架通过分离参考保留与证据修正、使用FEC去除证据存在成分、以及通过ZPD控制器根据局部对齐与移动成本进行token级选择，在不均匀信任教师指导的前提下成功整合了结果奖励与密集监督。

title: What the Window Does Not Contain: Auditing Provenance in a Document-Grounded Instability Benchmark
comment: Accepted as a poster at the 11th Workshop on Financial Technology and NLP (FinNLP 2026), co-located with EMNLP 2026. Code and data: this https URL
summary: Ask a language model the same question about the same document twenty times, and it sometimes returns two different answers. We built Probity, a benchmark of 60 tasks and 470 items from real venture-financing filings, to measure how often this happens. Then we audited our own corpus and found a defect any excerpt-built benchmark can carry: items whose evidence is missing from the window of text the model is shown. The audit flags 36 items and separates two failures a single flag would conflate: evidence genuinely absent from the window and answers that must be computed from numbers the window does supply. Flagged items change their answers far more often, wobbling at 0.255 against 0.087 on the 427 clean items, and excluding them cuts apparent cross-model agreement by about a fifth. Before testing whether the missing evidence explains the instability, we registered a prediction: re-cut each window to hold its evidence, and instability should fall below a set threshold. It failed: the repair moved wobble by 0.058, with an interval containing zero. We report the association as correlational. Almost all measurements sit where instability cannot show, which bounds what a corpus built for accuracy can say about stability. We release the corpus, all 112,800 raw responses, and the audit as a runnable check for any document benchmark.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了Probity基准（60个任务、470个项目，基于真实风险投资文件），用于测量模型回答的不稳定性（同一问题多次回答答案不一致）。论文核心贡献是发现并审计了文档基准中一个普遍存在的缺陷：标注证据不在模型所见文本窗口内。通过审计标记出36个项目，发现标记项目的"摆动率"为0.255远高于干净项目的0.087。虽然作者预设了"重新切割窗口使证据落入"会降低不稳定性的预测，但实验结果显示修复仅使摆动率变化0.058，置信区间包含零，因此仅报告相关性而非因果性。论文还发现交叉模型不稳定性共享现象（转移率是随机预期的8.9倍），并提出了八项基准构建检查清单。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在阅读融资文件时，对同一问题可能给出不同答案，但缺乏标记指明哪个答案正确。现有基准将语料视为给定，测量模型在语料上的波动，但忽略了语料本身可能存在的缺陷——即问题所问的证据可能不在模型实际看到的文本窗口内。这种"窗口不含证据"的缺陷普遍存在于基于摘录构建的文档基准中，却鲜有研究审计。论文的核心动机是：在大谈模型不稳定性之前，应先审视基准语料本身的回答可答性。
AI.method: 方法包括：(1) 构建Probity基准，60个任务、470个项目，来自美国SEC EDGAR的真实融资文件；(2) 采用人工分离的oracle协议——人工阅读完整文件记录答案，模型从不接触标注值，每个标签附带验证引用和源文件指针；(3) 提出"摆动率"(wobble)度量——同一配置对同一项目回答20次时非一致答案的占比，配置12个模型、每项目20次采样（温度0.7）；(4) 进行溯源审计(provenance audit)——验证每个标签的引用片段是否出现在源文件中、是否在模型所见窗口内，并区分三种状态（验证存在416、验证缺失5、不可检查49）；(5) 区分两类失败：证据真正缺失（17项）vs. 答案需从窗口内数值计算（17项）；(6) 预设修复实验——将10个可修复项目的窗口重新切割包含证据后再次测试；(7) 计算交叉模型转移率——一个配置最不稳定的k个项目中有多少落入另一配置的2k个最不稳定项目中；(8) 采用分半相关(Spearman-Brown校正)评估测量可靠性。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 审计标记36/470项目，标记项目摆动率0.255 [0.216,0.298] vs. 干净项目0.087 [0.080,0.095]，差异0.167，置信区间排除零；(2) 证据真正缺失组摆动率0.338，计算组摆动率0.186，两组不重叠；(3) 前沿配置的交叉模型转移率均值为0.187，是随机预期0.024的8.9倍（置换检验p<0.0005）；(4) 91.3%的模型-项目对20次回答完全一致，仅1.9%落在0.3≤p≤0.7的可观测带；(5) 重新切割窗口的修复实验失败——摆动率从0.267变为0.208，变化0.058 [-0.049,0.165]包含零且仍高于注册阈值0.161，作者撤回因果声明；(6) 排除标记项使交叉模型表面一致性降低约五分之一；(7) 分半可靠性中位数为0.903。
AI.conclusion: 论文结论：基于窗口化摘录构建的基准可能包含其输入无法回答的项目。审计能识别这些项目并将其与可计算答案分离，但审计本身不能判定模型是否产生"正确但不稳定"的回答——因为以准确性为目标的语料约98%的测量位于不稳定性无法显现的区域。证据缺失与不稳定性存在相关性但因果机制未经证实，窗口化修复未能降低不稳定性。论文提出了八项溯源检查清单和一个可执行的审计工具，并强调：以准确性为目标的语料对稳定性能说的内容存在内在边界。

title: ExpertLens: Visualizing Embedding Spaces for Post-Hoc Explainability in MoE Enhanced Retrievers
summary: Neural models, including dense retrievers, have been widely adopted in Information Retrieval (IR), often delivering state-of-the-art performance. Despite their effectiveness, these models operate as black boxes, limiting the interpretability of their ranking decisions. Existing post-hoc explainability methods for neural rankers primarily focus on feature-level attributions, which can be insufficient to capture the complexity of learned embedding spaces. In this work, we propose ExpertLens, a post-hoc explainability framework for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)-enhanced dense retrievers that shifts focus from local scalar feature importance to representation-level global interpretability. ExpertLens leverages discriminative embedding space visualizations jointly with automatically extracted Concept Activation Vectors to reveal how expert routing drives embedding space formulation and retrieval effectiveness. Experiments across five IR benchmarks and two MoE-enhanced dense retrievers show that expert routing consistently improves embedding space structure, positioning queries and their relevant documents into better-defined geometric neighborhoods. Analysis of expert subspaces further reveals general-purpose dominant experts, along with minority experts exhibiting distinct linguistic specialization, with subspaces arranged according to multi-semantic concept similarity. Our code is publicly available.

AI.tldr: ExpertLens是一个针对MoE增强密集检索器的后验可解释性框架，将解释视角从局部特征重要性转向全局表征级可解释性。它结合DeepView判别性降维可视化、专家子空间的语言学分析以及自动提取的概念激活向量(CAV)，揭示专家路由如何驱动嵌入空间结构与检索效果。
AI.motivation: 现有的密集检索器虽性能优异但为黑盒模型，现有的后验可解释性方法主要依赖特征级归因（如SHAP、LIME），无法捕捉学习到的嵌入空间的复杂几何结构。MoE增强的密集检索器通过门控机制动态路由输入到专家，产生由路由决策而非输入特征定义的嵌入空间子结构，这需要超越标量特征重要性的表征级全局可解释性方法。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：(1) Phase I - 从各MoE模型的内部门控机制蒸馏分类器，利用DeepView（判别性UMAP）生成反映专家路由边界的嵌入空间投影，通过P@k和余弦距离量化邻域结构；(2) Phase II - 对DeepView投影应用DBSCAN聚类，以ARI加权核心比率的复合得分筛选结构良好的查询，再用五种语料库级语言学度量（ARI、Shannon熵、相对词汇量、语料可预测性、平均句长）对专家子空间进行语言学画像；(3) Phase III - 通过Top-k稀疏自编码器(SAE)分解文档嵌入矩阵提取概念向量，利用Gemma-3-27b对查询激活最高的概念自动打语义标签，通过Q_concept误差评估概念在邻域间的语义一致性。
AI.result: 在5个IR基准（TREC DL 19/20、MSMARCO、NQ、HotpotQA）和2个MoE密集检索器（SB-MoE无监督门控 vs DenseC3基于Bloom认知复杂度的有监督门控）上的实验表明：(1) MoE路由一致提升查询邻域结构（P@k提升），但同时增加了嵌入空间整体几何展开（余弦距离增大）；(2) 两种MoE变体均呈现一致的专家专门化模式——主导专家处理结构平均的文档（低词汇多样性/熵/可预测性），少数专家形成词汇丰富、集中的子空间；(3) 概念激活广泛分布于多个专家间，证实专家分配由文档语言学属性而非语义主题隔离驱动。
AI.conclusion: ExpertLens为MoE增强密集检索器提供了表征级的后验可解释性，补充了现有特征级归因方法。它揭示了专家路由通过诱导子空间划分改善相对查询邻域结构同时扩展整体几何空间，且专家专门化由文档固有语言学复杂度而非语义隔离驱动。这些发现推进了神经IR系统的可解释性研究。

title: All for 1-Bit: Towards Genuine 1-Bit Post-Training Quantization for LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress, yet their massive storage and memory-bandwidth demands still hinder efficient deployment. Weight binarization is a promising solution, but existing binarization-based post-training quantization (PTQ) methods usually far exceed the nominal 1-bit storage target due to hidden overhead. To address this gap, we propose All for 1-Bit (AF1), a genuine 1-bit PTQ framework for LLMs. AF1 comprises two complementary components: (1) Null-space-Aware Binary Factorization (NABF) for improving binary reconstruction through Hessian-aware surrogate reparameterization, null-space-aware binary factorization, and scale-only global reconstruction; and (2) Hierarchical Shapley Allocation (HiSA) for assigning structural capacity using hierarchical Shapley sensitivity. Together, they preserve model accuracy under a strict 1.0-BPW budget in the PTQ setting. Experiments on LLaMA, Qwen, and Gemma families show that AF1 consistently outperforms existing binarization-based PTQ methods in perplexity and zero-shot accuracy. Compared with BF16, AF1 achieves an average 2.5 times inference speedup and over 90% memory reduction across evaluated models, providing a practical path toward deployable genuine 1-bit compression for LLMs. The code for reproducibility is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出AF1（All for 1-Bit），一种面向大语言模型的真正1位训练后量化（PTQ）框架，通过空域感知二值分解（NABF）和分层Shapley分配（HiSA）两个核心组件，在严格1.0 BPW预算下实现高性能二值化压缩，显著优于现有二值化PTQ方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于二值化的LLM PTQ方法（如BiLLM、ARB-LLM、HBLLM）因辅助元数据（缩放因子、显著性掩码、组位图等）导致实际有效BPW远超名义1位（通常达2-4位），而QAT方法（如OneBit）虽能实现真正1位表示，但需大规模训练数据和计算资源。因此，在PTQ设置下实现真正1位压缩且不依赖重型重训练仍是关键挑战。
AI.method: AF1包含两大组件：(1) NABF（空域感知二值分解）：通过Hessian感知代理重参数化将加权重构转为Frobenius目标，采用双因子二值参数化（两个±1符号矩阵+轻量级缩放向量）增强表示能力；利用ADMM-SVID优化框架，将离散投影残差引导至固定因子的近似零空间方向，通过闭式缩放补偿吸收投影误差且不引入额外推理开销；最后冻结二值矩阵仅优化缩放向量。(2) HiSA（分层Shapley分配）：通过合作博弈视角分配结构性容量——层级别使用渐进Shapley采样基于端到端NLL退化分配粗粒度预算，块级别基于方向与幅度双重失真的Shapley估计分配细粒度预算，采用MAD归一化和Soft-OR融合策略，结合尺寸感知敏感度密度实现均衡分配。
AI.result: 在LLaMA-3、Qwen3、Gemma-3系列模型上的实验表明：(1) 在2.50位设置下，AF1在所有模型上均取得最佳量化结果，零样本准确率较最强基线HBLLM提升超20%，WikiText2 PPL降低超90%；(2) 在严格1.0 BPW下，AF1在LLaMA-3-70B上达到61.80零样本准确率和8.91 PPL，超过所有更高位的基线方法；(3) 推理效率方面，相比BF16实现平均2.5倍加速和超过90%内存减少；(4) 量化时间仅需5.9 GPU小时，比OneBit快228倍、比LittleBit快40倍，且PPL接近QAT水平。
AI.conclusion: AF1通过NABF和HiSA的协同设计，成功解决了单矩阵二值化的表征瓶颈和LLM组件的异构敏感性问题，在严格1.0有效BPW预算下实现高质量二值化压缩，为可部署的真正1位LLM压缩提供了实用路径。该方法仅需少量校准数据和无重训练，在保持接近QAT性能的同时具有PTQ级别的效率。

title: Decision-Aware Suffix Prediction and Reasoning of Business Processes
summary: Suffix prediction forecasts the remaining sequence of events of a running case until completion. Most approaches rely on neural networks trained on event logs, which, on average, perform well but struggle with short prefixes or targets belonging to a rare process variant. In such scenarios, the correct path may cross multiple branching decisions, determined primarily by case- and event-level attributes, a signal that NN-based suffix prediction models tend to underweight because they may heavily weight (dense) event labels. Decision mining extracts rules for such decisions from the event log, but has so far been applied only to post-hoc and what-if analysis, not suffix prediction. We therefore extend suffix prediction with decision mining, introducing a decision-aware suffix prediction framework, a neuro-symbolic approach that enables reasoning about predicted events via mined decision rules. Experiments on three of four event logs and three suffix predictors show that the framework can improve suffix prediction, especially for short prefixes but also for rare process variants, and adds intrinsic interpretability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向业务流程后缀预测（Suffix Prediction）的"决策感知"神经-符号框架，通过将决策挖掘（Decision Mining）得到的符号决策规则集成到神经网络后缀预测器中，改善短前缀和稀有流程变体下的预测性能，并提供基于决策规则的内置可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于神经网络的后缀预测方法在短前缀或目标属于稀有流程变体时表现较差，原因在于事件日志中事件标签密集而有效载荷（payload）数据稀疏，导致神经网络倾向于"走捷径"——过度依赖事件标签序列模式而忽略决定分支的关键属性信号。决策挖掘虽能提取分支决策规则，但此前仅用于事后分析和假设分析，未与后缀预测相结合。
AI.method: 框架包含四个组件：① 决策挖掘（基于Inductive Miner发现Petri网并通过一致性对齐重放，在每个决策点训练CatBoost分类器与决策树代理模型以同时获得高准确预测与可解释规则）；② 决策感知事件标注（离线/在线识别决策点并获取决策模型输出分布）；③ 决策感知训练（在基础损失上加入语义损失，迫使后缀预测器在决策点处将概率质量分配给决策模型认为合理的标签）；④ 推理时决策感知解码与推理（在决策标记事件处用决策模型分布对预测器输出进行软重加权，衰减参数β_r随步数递减，并通过将当前有效载荷属性与挖掘出的决策规则相匹配，对每个分支预测提供条件决策规则解释）。该方法是模型无关的，可与三种基线后缀预测器（FS-LSTM、GAN-LSTM、U-ED-LSTM）组合使用。
AI.result: 在四个事件日志（Helpdesk、Sepsis、BPIC20 Domestic Declarations、人工Procurement）和三个后缀预测器上的实验表明：① 决策感知训练对性能影响很小（语义损失贡献不足）；② 决策感知解码在3/4日志上稳定提升DLS相似度（最高+0.22，FS-LSTM在Helpdesk上），且对短前缀和稀有变体提升尤为明显；③ 在Sepsis日志（自循环多、连续属性难预测）上决策感知解码会降低性能；④ 可解释性率（ir）在不同日志间差异较大（0.17–0.93），高准确CatBoost与解释性决策树代理之间的不匹配限制了规则覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次将决策挖掘以神经-符号方式集成到业务流程后缀预测中，证明决策感知解码能显著且稳定地提升短前缀和稀有变体的预测准确率，同时为分支预测附加基于有效载荷的决策规则解释，提升了NN后缀预测器的内在可解释性；但该方法对过程模型质量、决策模型预测能力以及有效载荷属性的可预测性高度依赖，不适用于类似Sepsis这类被自循环和难以预测的连续属性主导的日志。未来工作将探索更具预测力与可解释性平衡的决策模型，并开展多种子消融与敏感性分析。

title: Diamond Agent: Agentic Control of Federated HPC Resources as a Service
summary: Efficiently aggregating and orchestrating computing power across heterogeneous clusters for HPC workflows faces four practical challenges: preserving workflow context across independently administered clusters, moving large datasets between sites, reasoning about site-specific environments and scheduler policies, and exploiting live queue and resource states for efficient task scheduling. To this end, we design Diamond Agent, an agentic system that enables intelligent execution of HPC workflows across heterogeneous clusters with typed skills as the interface. Diamond Agent provides an agent-facing workspace and skills that unify cross-site resource discovery, resource specification, data movement, task execution, and result retrieval. A centralized Diamond Agent instance can operate multiple supercomputers without being deployed separately on each login node. Diamond Agent translates high-level agent actions into valid site-specific executions, moves data through Globus Transfer, and uses live system capability and queue information to select feasible placements. Its event-driven continuation mechanism decouples agent actions from long-running batch jobs: persistent services monitor remote execution and resume the agent only when a result or decision-relevant event is available. We experiment with 27 hours of telemetry and 19 matched multi-site submission rounds comprising 83 jobs across four production supercomputers. Compared with a fixed-site baseline, Diamond Agent reduces the median additional completion time relative to the fastest observed placement from 42 seconds to 4 seconds, a 10.5x reduction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Diamond Agent，一种智能体（agentic）系统，通过类型化技能接口实现跨异构超级计算机的 HPC 工作流智能执行。它提供统一的跨站点资源发现、资源规范、数据移动、任务执行和结果检索能力，采用集中式 Agent 实例管理多台超算（无需在每个登录节点单独部署）。核心创新是"事件驱动延续"机制，将 Agent 动作与长时间批处理作业解耦——持久化服务监控远程执行，仅在结果或决策相关事件可用时才恢复 Agent。实验在四台生产超算上进行 27 小时遥测和 19 轮匹配的多站点提交（83 个作业），相比固定站点基线，中位额外完成时间相对最快观察位置从 42 秒降至 4 秒（10.5 倍降低）。
AI.motivation: 在多个独立管理的 HPC 集群上聚合和编排计算能力面临四个实际挑战：（1）在独立管理的集群间保留工作流上下文；（2）在站点间移动大型数据集；（3）推理站点特定环境和调度策略；（4）利用实时队列和资源状态进行高效任务调度。此外，在登录节点运行编码 Agent 会带来沉重负载，一些计算中心已限制在登录节点上使用 AI Agent。
AI.method: Diamond Agent 采用"observe-plan-act-yield-resume"循环，通过类型化技能作为 Agent 接口。关键组件包括：（1）ResourceEnvelope 数据结构（含最小可行资源、最大有用资源和兼容性约束）；（2）集中式 Agent 实例配合 Globus Compute 端点；（3）事件驱动延续机制——Task Orchestrator 在 Agent 循环外拥有远程生命周期；（4）Federated Resource Collection（静态配置文件 + 实时探测）；（5）Best-feasible 放置策略——基于队列延迟、运行时和环境准备成本的最小估计完成时间。
AI.result: 评估涵盖五个研究问题：（RQ1）收集器在 27 小时内生成 543 个 ResourceSnapshots 和 4,737 条分区记录，平均刷新时间 64.1 秒；（RQ2）AI 生成的三份 ResourceEnvelope 均通过生产规则链，DDP 训练的 1→2→4 GPU 加速比达 1.90 和 1.96；（RQ3）19 轮匹配提交中，Best-feasible 策略中位完成时间为 196 秒（接近最快观察位置 194 秒），固定 Delta 基线中位额外完成时间为 42 秒，Best-feasible 降至 4 秒（10.5 倍降低）；（RQ4）跨四台超算的任务组执行可在 32 分钟内完成，并通过端点故障自动恢复；（RQ5）两个编码 Agent 工作流（Claude Code 37 分钟、Codex 84 分钟异步间隔）期间无模型端状态调用，相比 5 分钟轮询可节省 8-17 次模型调用。
AI.conclusion: Diamond Agent 通过统一的 Agent 面向接口实现跨异构超算的工作流执行，结合跨站点工作流上下文、数据移动、异构系统抽象、实时资源和队列状态以及持久化执行，使高级 Agent 动作能够转化为独立管理 HPC 系统上的有效操作。核心设计原则是将活动 Agent 执行与远程批处理作业生命周期解耦，通过事件驱动延续实现持久化系统控制下的计算和数据移动任务，而 Agent 保持非活动状态，仅在结果或决策相关事件需要进一步推理时才被重新激活。评估证明了其在跨站点资源观察、资源规范、自适应作业放置、多系统执行和长时间运行 Agent 工作流方面的实际有效性。

title: SWE-Test: Benchmarking LLM Vulnerability Discovery via Input Prediction
summary: Vulnerability discovery is becoming an important ability of large language model (LLM) agents: agents that silently miss real defects leave critical software exposed. Rigorously measuring this ability is therefore urgent, but existing benchmarks are gameable through data contamination, score recall against an unknowable vulnerability set, often rely on synthetic bugs, and report a single end-to-end verdict that cannot localize where an agent fails. Vulnerability discovery is a composite ability: an agent must comprehend source code, infer input constraints, construct inputs, execute them, and iteratively correct from feedback. We recast its measurement as an input-prediction task with a closed, deterministic ground truth: using coverage-guided fuzzing, we mine deep target branches in real-world C/C++ programs and ask an agent to predict an input that drives execution to a given branch. This decomposes discovery into three task modes over 22 real-world C/C++ programs spanning 15 domains. Open-loop and Feedback-enabled share 60 fixed-target task instances across 16 of these codebases (13 domains), testing input construction without and with a distance oracle to isolate code comprehension from feedback-driven correction. Online Arena instead removes the predefined target and scores path exploration by coverage gain on a separate, partially overlapping pool of 11 programs; agents collectively confirmed 13 distinct bugs across six programs. Evaluating 15 default-effort model-scaffold configurations, the best reaches only 55.0% pass rate in the Feedback-enabled mode, and the mean across seven paired Claude Code configurations is 36.4% with feedback versus 19.3% without. Decomposing failures, we find constraint inference, not navigation, is the dominant bottleneck. We release SWE-Test with a turnkey evaluation environment.

AI.tldr: SWE-Test 是一个通过"输入预测"任务评估 LLM 智能体漏洞发现能力的新型基准，针对现有基准在数据污染、依赖合成漏洞、单一端到端判定等方面的局限性，将漏洞发现重构为具有封闭确定性真值的输入预测任务，并通过三种任务模式（Open-loop、Feedback-enabled、Online Arena）将漏洞发现分解为代码理解、反馈驱动修正和路径探索三种子能力，基于 22 个真实 C/C++ 程序、15 个领域进行评估。
AI.motivation: 现有漏洞发现基准存在三大局限：(1) 基于公开记录的任务易受数据污染影响；(2) 对已知漏洞集合的召回率评估本质上是有偏的（漏洞集合不可枚举）；(3) 端到端判定无法定位智能体失败的具体环节。此外，合成漏洞难以匹配真实缺陷的约束结构和跨过程深度。本研究将漏洞发现重构为可分解、可定位、可抗污染的输入预测任务。
AI.method: 1. **任务形式化**：将漏洞发现重构为输入预测任务——智能体根据源代码预测能使执行到达指定分支的输入。2. **目标挖掘**：使用 AFL++ 对真实 C/C++ 程序进行覆盖引导模糊测试，记录到达先前未覆盖分支的输入作为基准真值。3. **三种任务模式**：Open-loop（仅给源代码和目标分支，测试纯代码理解）、Feedback-enabled（增加距离预言机，测试反馈驱动修正）、Online Arena（移除预定义目标，以覆盖增益评分，测试自主路径探索）。4. **奖励设计**：四级奖励（0.0–2.0），区分未到达目标函数、部分路径重叠、到达函数但未满足分支约束、完全通过。5. **评估配置**：15 种默认推理努力的模型-脚手架配置，包含 Claude Code、Terminus 2、Codex、Kimi Code、Qwen Coder 等。6. **部署环境**：基于 Harbor 的一键式容器化评估环境。
AI.result: 1. **反馈至关重要**：七组配对的 Claude Code 配置中，Feedback-enabled 平均通过率 36.4%，Open-loop 仅 19.3%；目标函数到达率从 62.6% 提升至 75.2%，近通过转化率从 30.8% 提升至 48.4%。2. **最佳配置**：Qwen3.8-Max + Claude Code 在 Feedback-enabled 模式达 55.0% 通过率；Qwen3.8-Max-Preview 在 12 小时 Online Arena 中发现 7 个确认漏洞（去重后 5 个模型共发现 13 个独立漏洞，分布在 6 个程序中）。3. **核心瓶颈是约束推理而非导航**：反馈模式下约束满足失败数普遍超过导航失败数；目标函数可达性 75.2% 与低通过率 36.4% 之间存在显著转化损耗。4. **领域差异显著**：SQL 解析任务 82% 导航失败，PHP 仅 17%；某些任务族（如 mBedTLS、Vorbis）通过率达 100%，而 Ada URL、Solc 编译相关任务通过率为 0%。5. **敏感性**：GLM-5.1 在 Feedback-enabled 模式下推理努力从低到高使通过率从 25.0% 提升至 38.3%；厂商脚手架（Kimi Code、Qwen Coder）显著优于 Terminus 2（Kimi-K2.6：16.7% vs 3.7%；Qwen3.7-Max：13.3% vs 0.0%）。
AI.conclusion: 1. 漏洞发现应分解为代码理解、反馈驱动修正、路径探索三种子能力分别评估，而非依赖单一端到端指标。2. 约束推理是当前 LLM 智能体的主导瓶颈，未来的反馈机制设计应聚焦于帮助智能体识别分支约束中尚未满足的子条件。3. 评测必须控制并报告任务模式、推理努力水平和脚手架类型——三者均可显著影响排名结果。4. SWE-Test 通过基于特定构建的目标分支、隐藏满足输入、真实程序来源等设计提供抗污染、可复现的评估环境，补充而非替代端到端漏洞利用构建评估。

title: Steering Geometry: Validating Human Value Geometry in LLM Steering Space
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in alignment-sensitive contexts, activation steering has emerged as a lightweight, inference-time alternative to fine-tuning methods (e.g., RLHF, DPO) for behavioral control. However, existing work typically validates steering on isolated behaviors, leaving it unclear whether steering vectors encode coherent semantic structure or merely exploit behavior-specific shortcuts. We investigate whether the latent geometry of LLM steering vectors reflects theory-specified structure in human values and morality. Using Schwartz's Theory of Basic Human Values as our primary fine-grained framework, we introduce a 26K-sample benchmark covering 20 human values and analyze distribution-driven methods (e.g., CAA, SphericalSteer, ODESteer) and behavior-centric approaches (e.g., COLD-Steer, BiPO) across diverse model families and sizes. We find that distribution-driven methods recover human value topologies aligned with theoretical predictions (Spearman $\rho$ up to 0.51, $p < 10^{-13}$). In contrast, behavior-centric methods achieve comparable steering performance but show little correlation with the expected value geometry. Geometric fidelity improves with model scale but drops after instruction tuning. Finally, better geometric alignment also leads to more human-consistent transfer across values: steering one value correctly lifts compatible values and suppresses opposing ones. Code and data are available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 该论文系统性地研究了LLM激活导向（activation steering）向量是否在潜在空间中编码了人类价值观的语义结构，发现分布驱动型方法能恢复与Schwartz价值观理论一致的几何结构，而行为中心型方法则无法保留这种结构。
AI.motivation: 现有的激活导向方法通常仅通过孤立行为来验证有效性，未考察其编码的是连贯的语义结构还是行为特定的捷径。该研究旨在检验导向向量的潜在几何是否反映人类价值观和道德的理论结构。
AI.method: 以Schwartz基本人类价值理论为主要框架，构建了涵盖20种价值观的26K样本对比基准。在多种模型族和规模上，对分布驱动型方法（CAA、SAS、SphericalSteer、ODESteer）和行为中心型方法（COLD-Steer、OPT、BiPO）进行评估，通过理论秩相关、层级结构相关、极性分离分数等指标衡量几何保真度，并引入跨价值迁移测试评估下游行为一致性。
AI.result: 分布驱动型方法可恢复与理论预测一致的人类价值拓扑（Spearman ρ高达0.51，p<10⁻¹³），而行为中心型方法虽取得相当的导向性能，但与期望的价值几何几乎无相关性。几何保真度随模型规模提升，但指令微调后下降。更好的几何对齐带来更符合人类预期的跨价值迁移：在引导某一价值时，兼容价值被提升、对立价值被抑制。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了两种导向范式之间的根本差异：分布驱动型方法保留了连贯的价值语义结构并能合理传播，而行为中心型方法可能仅利用行为捷径。建议未来工作除行为准确率外，还应基于心理学结构评估导向方法的有效性。

title: Linear Algebra Foundations of Efficient Attention: A Phase Reversal in Rank Collapse Under SVD Compression
summary: Linear algebra provides the framework of concepts (matrix rank, singular value decomposition (SVD), and eigendecomposition) that modern artificial intelligence employs to encode, compress, and propagate information through neural networks. This paper unifies fourteen separate peer-reviewed works analyzing the usage of these techniques in the context of transformer-based foundation model research, focusing on three areas of the topic: derivations and properties of self-attention matrices' output rank, compression methods that purposefully utilize this phenomenon, and the low-rank key-value (KV) cache projection and its semiseparable-matrix duality to linear attention and state-space structured models. We were motivated to conduct this work after observing an open problem in this literature: the interplay of the mentioned compression methods with natural rank collapse of the network. With this paper, we report an original finding that using SVD compression of attention projections actually has the opposite effect on the rank collapse of the network: while it strongly suppresses it at initialization, it accelerates on pretrained models (for GPT-2 124M, GPT-2 Medium 355M, and Pythia-160M) with minimal risk of object aliasing artifacts appearing (verified on all compression ratios) and is consistent across four rank estimation methods. A controlled causal decomposition of the effect in both settings showed that the reason for this behavior can be explained by the choice of the subspace SVD makes when compressing the matrix better than the reduction of the operator norm it achieves, explaining roughly 76% of the effect at initialization and 83% on the pretrained weights, providing a refinement to the calibration-aware compression viewpoint and an explanation of why it outperformed naive SVD truncation.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了14篇关于线性代数（秩、SVD、特征分解）在Transformer基础模型中应用的研究，并报告了一个原创实验发现：SVD压缩对注意力投影的秩塌缩效应在随机初始化时抑制、在预训练模型上反而加速，其因果机制主要由子空间选择（而非算子范数降低）驱动。
AI.motivation: 现有文献分别研究了自注意力的低秩特性及其在压缩/适配中的利用，但未回答一个开放问题：这些有意的低秩压缩方法究竟会加剧还是抵消网络本身自然发生的秩塌缩？本文旨在填补这一空白，并通过对14篇同行评审工作的统一综述+原创实验给出回答。
AI.method: （1）综述部分：综合14篇文献，沿三条线索——自注意力输出秩的推导与性质、利用低秩结构的压缩方法（LoRA、GaLore、LoSparse、SVD-LLM等）、低秩KV缓存投影及其与线性注意力/状态空间模型的半可分矩阵对偶性。（2）原创实验：构造最小8层合成Transformer、GPT-2 124M/355M、Pythia-160M，对所有注意力投影权重矩阵施加保留率α∈{0.125,0.25,0.5,1.0}的SVD截断，使用四种秩度量（熵有效秩、Dong阈值秩、稳定秩、token余弦相似度）。（3）因果分解：在两种设置下进行A/B/C/D四组对照——基线、完整SVD压缩、算子范数匹配的全秩变体、Q/K范数匹配变体，分离子空间选择与范数缩减的贡献。
AI.result: 随机初始化下，SVD压缩（r=0.125）使最终层有效秩从17.45提升至39.94，塌缩速率从0.957降至0.855（抑制塌缩）；预训练GPT-2 124M上方向反转：第8层有效秩从4.21降至3.55，token余弦相似度从0.607升至0.687（加速塌缩），该效应在GPT-2 Medium和Pythia-160M上均成立。因果分解显示子空间选择解释了随机初始化下约76%和预训练下约83%的效应，算子范数降低仅占17–24%，注意力熵软化无独立因果作用。
AI.conclusion: SVD压缩对秩塌缩的影响存在"相位反转"现象：初始化时抑制、训练后加速。主因是子空间选择而非算子范数缩减，这为理解为何校准感知型压缩方法（如Fisher加权、截断感知）优于朴素SVD截断提供了机制性解释，并提示对已训练模型应用朴素SVD截断具有先前未被记录的副作用。

title: Robust Conformal Consensus: Multi-Agent LLM-as-a-Judge Interval Evaluation with Conformal Prediction
summary: LLM-as-a-Judge has emerged as a promising paradigm for evaluating natural language generation. However, the uncertainty associated with such evaluations remains largely unexplored, which limits their reliability in real-world applications. Although conformal prediction offers a principled framework for uncertainty quantification, existing approaches typically apply it to a single LLM judge, overlooking the variability introduced by using different LLM evaluators. In this work, we propose a robust uncertainty estimation framework for multi-agent LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation. Our approach constructs conformal prediction intervals for LLM-based scores from multiple LLMs. By considering intervals from different LLM judges, we obtain more stable and reliable uncertainty estimates. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method produces valid prediction intervals with coverage guarantees, and that interval-based aggregation across multiple judges leads to more stable evaluation outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Robust Conformal Consensus（WCC）框架，将conformal prediction扩展到多LLM评审场景，通过加权聚合多个LLM法官的预测区间并进行元校准，实现更稳定、可靠的不确定性量化。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM-as-a-Judge方法主要依赖单一LLM法官，但不同LLM因训练数据、架构和对齐策略差异会给出不同评分，导致不确定性估计对模型选择敏感、容易过度自信。conformal prediction虽能提供覆盖率保证，但现有方法未考虑LLM间变异性。
AI.method: 方法包含三步：(1) 对每个LLM法官独立应用conformal prediction（如CQR、CHR、LVD、R2CCP等9种方法）构造预测区间；(2) 基于历史一致性为每个LLM分配权重，加权平均各区间端点形成初步共识区间；(3) 在独立的元校准集上计算meta-nonconformity scores并取经验分位数，对共识区间进行对称扩展，恢复边际覆盖率保证。理论证明该框架在exchangeability假设下满足ℙ(Y∈C_final)≥1−α。
AI.result: 在SummEval（G-Eval）和ROSCOE（SocREval）数据集上，使用GPT-4o mini、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B、Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct三个LLM及30个随机种子进行实验。结果显示：(1) 单LLM方法存在覆盖度-区间宽度权衡（如CQR覆盖高但区间宽，CHR区间窄但常低于90%覆盖）；(2) 边界调整（boundary adjustment）后所有方法的覆盖率均提升；(3) 多代理聚合比单LLM更稳定，避免了最低覆盖度失败（如ROSCOE/CosmosQA上CHR方法，Qwen2.5仅72.65%，多代理达74.0%）；(4) LVD和R2CCP在保持≥90%覆盖的同时常具有最小区间宽度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将LLM-as-a-Judge评估从单模型扩展到多模型不确定性量化，证明多LLM聚合能产生更稳定、可靠的预测区间，同时维持形式化的覆盖率保证，为高风险应用中的NLG评估提供了更稳健的解决方案。

title: Parameterized and Streaming Algorithms for Euclidean Fair $k$-Center Clustering
summary: Motivated by the growing importance of fairness in machine learning, fair $k$-center clustering has attracted considerable research attention as a fundamental problem. In this problem, a dataset is partitioned into $m$ disjoint groups, and the objective is to select $k$ data points as centers, subject to upper bounds on the number of centers chosen from each group, aiming to minimize the maximum distance between any data point and its assigned center. Focusing on Euclidean spaces, which are ubiquitous in machine learning applications, we first develop a parameterized approximation algorithm for Euclidean fair $k$-center with an approximation ratio of $2.732$. By incorporating this algorithm as a post-processing stage into a one-pass streaming framework for large-scale data, we obtain an approximation ratio of $4.464$. These ratios can be further respectively improved to $2.414$ and $3.828$ with a runtime exponential on $k$. To ensure polynomial-time complexity, we further design a one-pass streaming algorithm with an approximation ratio of $4.732$, which can be further improved to $4.42$, outperforming the state-of-the-art ratio. Finally, extensive experiments show that our methods significantly outperform state-of-the-art approaches in terms of clustering accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究欧几里得空间下带公平约束的k-中心聚类问题，提出了一系列参数化、流式近似算法。作者设计了基于λ-独立中心集的FPT离线算法（近似比1+√3≈2.732），将其集成到单遍流式框架得到近似比1+2√3+ε≈4.464的算法；进一步利用网络流技术提出了多项式时间的单遍流式算法，近似比为3+√3+ε≈4.732（可改进至4.42），均显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 随着机器学习中公平性日益受到重视，带公平约束的k-中心聚类（数据摘要公平性，要求每个群组被选为中心点的数量有上限）成为基础问题。欧几里得空间在ML应用中无处不在，但现有流式算法未能充分利用欧几里得几何结构或FPT子例程来获得更好的近似比，理论最优近似比与流式实践之间存在差距。
AI.method: 1. 利用λ-独立中心集结构（λ=√3·r*时|Γ|≤2k，λ=2·r*时|Γ|≤k）进行离线参数化算法设计，通过枚举策略在Γ的并集中寻找满足公平约束的解；2. 将离线算法作为后处理阶段集成到单遍流式框架中；3. 构建辅助二部图并使用Dinic最大流算法实现多项式时间流式算法：通过构造两个不同λ值的独立中心集（整体Γ和分组Γ_l），利用网络流将违反公平约束的Γ中点替换为Γ_l中的点，同时保证覆盖半径。
AI.result: 1. 离线FPT算法近似比1+√3≈2.732（运行时间O(2^{k(1+log m)}·mnk²·log n)）；2. 参数化流式算法近似比1+2√3+ε≈4.464；3. 使用更小λ值可分别改进至2.414和3.828；4. 多项式时间流式算法近似比3+√3+ε≈4.732（内存O(k·log_ε α)），改进版本为4.42，超越了Guo等人的4.464的当前最优结果；5. 在模拟数据集和三个真实数据集（Wholesale、Student、Adult）上的实验表明所提方法在聚类质量上显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次将FPT技术、欧几里得几何与流式模型融合于公平k-中心问题，提出了在欧氏空间中具有更优近似比的离线与流式算法。理论上打破了一般度量空间中3-近似的壁垒（降至2.732），并在流式模型中将单遍近似比从4.464提升到4.42（多项式时间版）或3.828（FPT版）。实验结果验证了所提算法在聚类精度上显著优于现有最优方法。未来工作可考虑扩展到其他结构化度量空间（如倍增度量）或更复杂的公平约束。

title: On BatchNorm Forward Modes in Value-Based Reinforcement Learning
summary: Batch normalization (BN) substantially improves sample efficiency in continuous-control actor-critic methods such as CrossQ, yet recent studies report performance degradation in discrete-action value learning on Atari. These failures are surprising because discrete Q-networks lack the action-input distribution mismatch identified by CrossQ. We show for target-based C51 and target-free PQN that the simple choice between running and batch statistics at specific forward passes can reverse this degradation. In C51, switching the BN bootstrap forward to batch-statistic mode significantly improves performance over unnormalized and LayerNorm baselines and scales stably with update-to-data ratios up to 12. In PQN, using batch-statistics for both action selection and bootstrapping recovers performance from the failing running-statistic configuration. Across 26 Atari games at 400M frames, this configuration achieves a higher final aggregate score than PQN with LayerNorm. Our results show that carefully configured BN can substantially improve discrete-action value learning, and that its forward protocols are an essential part of the algorithm specification.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了批量归一化（BN）在离散动作值学习（C51和PQN）中的前向传播模式选择问题，揭示了BN失败的原因在于运行统计量与各前向传播（bootstrap、动作选择等）所遇到的实际激活分布不匹配。通过将bootstrap前向切换为batch统计量模式，C51性能从48% AUC恢复到154%，并支持UTD=12的稳定训练；在PQN中使用全batch统计量协议，在26款Atari游戏400M帧上获得比LayerNorm更高的最终分数。
AI.motivation: BN在连续控制actor-critic方法（如CrossQ）中显著提升样本效率，但近期研究表明在离散动作Atari值学习（C51、DQN、PQN）中BN会导致性能下降。这一矛盾令人困惑，因为离散动作Q网络并不存在CrossQ所识别的动作输入分布不匹配问题。作者旨在探究BN失败的根本原因，并检验是否可以通过精心设计前向传播协议来逆转BN在离散值学习中的性能退化。
AI.method: 1) 在基于硬目标网络的C51算法中，对比evaluation-mode（使用存储运行统计量）与training-mode（使用当前minibatch统计量）的bootstrap前向传播；引入跟踪率扫描（α∈{0.001, 0.01, 0.1}）插值两种模式；扫描UTD∈{0.25, 1, 2, 4, 8, 12}。2) 在无replay、无目标网络的PQN算法中，交叉实验acting和bootstrap两个角色的统计量来源（running vs batch），在Pong上进行40M帧诊断，然后在26款Atari游戏上进行400M帧完整评估。3) 附加可塑性诊断（dormant neuron比例、有效秩）作为描述性检查。实验使用26款Atari游戏，3-10个种子，CleanRL C51实现和官方PQN实现。
AI.result: 主要发现：(1) C51中：BN running模式AUC仅48%、最终72%（重现失败）；BN batch模式AUC达154%、最终147%，显著优于C51和LayerNorm基线；跟踪率扫描显示性能随运行统计量对当前batch响应度的增加而单调提升。(2) C51 UTD扫描中，projected BN在UTD=8时AUC达11.5×UTD-0.25参考，UTD=12时保持稳定；unnormalized C51和LayerNorm在UTD=2后趋于平台并在更高UTD下退化。(3) PQN Pong诊断：running/running配置失败（随机策略性能）；batch/batch配置AUC=15.62、最终回报20.45，表现最佳。(4) PQN Atari-26 400M帧：batch-statistic BN最终IQM=4.59，优于LayerNorm的4.14和失败的running-statistic BN配置。(5) 可塑性诊断显示BN变体相比LayerNorm具有更低的休眠神经元比例和更高的有效秩。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出三个核心结论：(1) bootstrap统计量可以逆转C51中BN的性能退化；(2) batch统计量bootstrapping支持有效的replay复用，UTD可稳定扩展至12；(3) 前向传播协议敏感性在无目标网络的PQN中依然存在。这些发现表明BN可以显著改善离散动作值学习，挑战了"BN不适合值学习"的普遍观点；并强调"使用BN"的算法规范是不充分的，每个预测、bootstrap、acting和evaluation前向都必须明确定义参数来源、输入批次、归一化统计量和运行状态更新处理。此外，附录展示了该BN配方在actor-critic设置（XQC）中也具有可迁移性。

title: Second-Order Smooth Planning with Optimal-Transport Bellman Smoothing
comment: Published at the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: Planning with a generative model aims to estimate the value of a state using as few simulator calls as possible. SmoothCruiser achieves problem-independent complexity $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-4})$ by exploiting the smoothness of the entropy-regularized Bellman backup, but its estimator is only first-order. We show that the sample-complexity exponent of SmoothCruiser-type planners is governed by the order $\beta$ of the local Taylor remainder, giving oracle complexity $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-(2+2/(\beta-1))})$: the first-order case $\beta=2$ recovers SmoothCruiser, while a second-order/cubic remainder $\beta=3$ yields $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-3})$. We reach this regime with an optimal-transport-smoothed Bellman backup over action distributions, which has a closed form, a policy gradient, and a Lipschitz Hessian, and whose quadratic correction admits an unbiased cross-product estimator. The resulting SecondOrderSmoothCruiser achieves $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-3})$ oracle complexity for fixed OT parameters, and we relate the OT, entropy-regularized, and unregularized objectives through explicit regularization-bias bounds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SecondOrderSmoothCruiser算法，通过引入最优传输（OT）平滑的Bellman备份算子，利用其闭式解、Lipschitz Hessian和方差恒等式实现二阶Taylor校正的免偏差估计，将生成模型下规划的最坏情况oracle复杂度从SmoothCruiser的 Õ(ε^{-4}) 降至 Õ(ε^{-3})。
AI.motivation: SmoothCruiser利用熵正则化Bellman算子的平滑性实现了问题无关的 Õ(ε^{-4}) 复杂度，但其一阶Taylor模型导致二次余项，成为样本复杂度指数4的瓶颈。本文旨在通过提高局部Taylor近似的阶数来突破这一瓶颈。
AI.method: 1. 曲率-复杂度理论：证明SmoothCruiser型规划器的oracle复杂度由Bellman聚合器的Taylor余项阶数β决定，为 Õ(ε^{-(2+2/(β-1))})。2. OT平滑Bellman聚合器：在动作分布上引入熵正则化OT成本，构造具有闭式解、显式梯度策略、Lipschitz Hessian的聚合器（β=3）。3. 二次项的无偏估计：通过方差恒等式和交叉乘积恒等式，无需显式构造Hessian即可无偏估计二次Taylor校正项。4. SecondOrderSmoothCruiser算法：整合以上组件实现 Õ(ε^{-3}) oracle复杂度。
AI.result: 在固定OT参数下，SecondOrderSmoothCruiser实现 Õ(ε^{-3}) 的oracle复杂度，相比SmoothCruiser的 Õ(ε^{-4}) 改善了指数。曲率-复杂度理论统一了不同阶近似器的性能。此外，提出了OT-GapE（达到 (Δ∨ε)^{-2} 根间隙依赖）和OT-GapCruiser（曲率控制的实例相关界，p≈3）两个间隙依赖扩展。通过显式正则化-偏差界联系了OT、熵正则化和无正则化目标。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了规划器样本复杂度与Bellman聚合器曲率之间的定量联系，证明了二阶正则化方法可严格改善最坏情况复杂度。OT平滑提供了一种具体的高阶聚合器，将熵正则化推广到包含动作几何信息的情形。主要限制在于oracle复杂度保证要求固定的平滑参数，无正则化情形需额外的偏差权衡。

title: Power Mean Estimation in Stochastic Continuous Monte Carlo Tree Search
comment: Published at the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2025)
summary: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) has demonstrated success in online planning for deterministic environments, yet significant challenges remain in adapting it to stochastic Markov Decision Processes (MDPs), particularly in continuous state-action spaces. Existing methods, such as HOOT, which combines MCTS with the Hierarchical Optimistic Optimization (HOO) bandit strategy, address continuous spaces but rely on a logarithmic exploration bonus that lacks theoretical guarantees in non-stationary, stochastic settings. Recent advancements, such as POLY-HOOT, introduced a polynomial bonus term to achieve convergence in deterministic MDPs, though a similar theory for stochastic MDPs remains undeveloped. In this paper, we propose a novel MCTS algorithm, \Algname, designed for continuous, stochastic MDPs. \Algname integrates a power mean as a value backup operator, alongside a polynomial exploration bonus to address the non-stationarity inherent in continuous action spaces. Our theoretical analysis establishes that \Algname converges at a polynomial rate of $\mathcal{O}(n^{-\zeta})$, $\zeta \in (0,1/2)$, where \( n \) is the number of visited trajectories, thereby extending the non-asymptotic convergence guarantees of POLY-HOOT to stochastic environments. Experimental results on stochastic tasks validate our theoretical findings, demonstrating the effectiveness of \Algname in continuous, stochastic domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Stochastic-Power-HOOT 算法，将幂均值备份算子与多项式探索奖励相结合，为随机连续 MDP 提供多项式收敛率保证，并在实验中验证其优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有连续动作 MCTS 算法（如 HOOT、POLY-HOOT）仅在确定性环境中具有收敛保证，无法处理随机转移与奖励下的非平稳价值估计，限制了其在机器人控制等真实场景中的应用。
AI.method: 在 HOO 分层 bandit 框架上引入幂均值（power mean）作为值备份算子，结合多项式形式的探索奖励 $Ct^{b_d/\beta_d}T_{h,i}^{-\alpha_d/\beta_d}+\nu_1\rho^{d+1}$，通过归纳论证证明每个树节点的价值与 Q 值估计以多项式速率 $(\alpha_d,\beta_d)$ 集中，并给出参数约束条件表。
AI.result: 理论证明算法在随机连续 MDP 上达到 $\mathcal{O}(n^{-\zeta})$，$\zeta\in(0,1/2)$ 的多项式收敛率；实验在 CartPole-IG、Pendulum、MountainCar 等经典控制和 Humanoid、Hopper 等高维 MuJoCo 任务上均优于 UCT、HOOT、POLY-HOOT、Voronoi MCTS 等基线。
AI.conclusion: Stochastic-Power-HOOT 成功将 POLY-HOOT 的非渐近收敛保证从确定性扩展到随机连续域，幂均值参数 p 提供了探索-利用的灵活调节，实验验证了理论预测并展示了在稀疏奖励和高维噪声环境中的优势。

title: Certifying cooperation: a novel approach to cooperative multi-agent task generation
summary: A shared reward gives agents a common objective, but leaves open when, how and even whether they must cooperate to succeed. We address these questions in the Laser Learning Environment, a multi-agent path-finding environment where cooperation materializes as one agent blocking a laser to let a teammate pass safely. We represent these interactions through temporal cooperation graphs whose timed edges connect helpers to beneficiaries, define six cooperation profiles as overlapping graph predicates, and prove that every cooperative trajectory satisfies at least one. By encoding the environment dynamics and profile predicates as propositional formulae, we distinguish tasks that admit}a profile in some winning trajectory from those that require it in every winning trajectory within a specified horizon. Used as filters, these queries turn a random layout sampler into a generator of tasks with certified cooperation requirements. Experiments with five multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithms show that training diversity improves joint success on unseen tasks when cooperation-free solutions exist. When cooperation is required, greater diversity improves individual-agent exits, but joint success remains near zero. Across five profile-certified pools, final exit rates averaged over algorithms separate the pools into four statistically distinguishable levels but this ordering primarily reflects partial completion: policies collect rewards for individual exits but rarely exhibit the profile required for joint success. Our framework exposes this gap between rewarded partial completion and realized cooperation by certifying what cooperation successful completion requires and using temporal cooperation graphs to reveal what policies exhibit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于时间合作图（Temporal Cooperation Graph, TCG）和SAT编译的新型框架，用于在多智能体路径规划环境（Laser Learning Environment, LLE）中认证任务对合作的需求。该框架定义了六种协作配置文件作为TCG上的谓词，并通过将环境动力学和谓词编码为命题公式来区分"容许"合作的任务和"需要"合作的任务。实验表明，现有的MARL算法在需要合作的任务上几乎无法实现联合成功，主要依赖单智能体退出获取奖励，揭示了部分完成指标作为合作能力代理的不可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有的合作型MARL基准测试通常使用共享奖励来定义合作目标，但这种方式无法明确说明代理何时、如何以及是否必须合作才能完成任务。共享奖励可能掩盖独立完成任务的策略，奖励信号也可能与真正的合作行为脱节。因此，需要一种能够在任务层面认证合作需求的形式化框架，以区分真正需要合作的任务和仅容许合作的任务。
AI.method: 本文提出了两种方法论贡献：(1) 将联合轨迹编译为时间合作图（TCG），其顶点为智能体，有向时间戳边从帮助者指向受益者，并定义六种协作配置文件（Asymmetric、Sequential、Divergent、Convergent、Interdependent、Fully coupled）作为TCG上的谓词，并证明它们覆盖所有合作轨迹；(2) 将有界视野LLE动力学编译为多项式大小的命题公式，并在其上编码协作配置文件谓词，通过SAT求解器区分任务是否在某个获胜轨迹中"容许"某配置文件，还是在每个获胜轨迹中"需要"该配置文件。这两种查询可以将随机布局采样器转变为具有认证合作需求的任务生成器。
AI.result: 实验使用五种MARL算法（DQN、VDN、QMIX、IPPO、MAPPO）表明：(1) 在500个训练布局的条件下，在不需要合作的测试任务上，联合成功率达到0.702，而在需要合作的任务上仅接近零（最多0.004）；(2) 跨五个配置文件认证池，最终退出率将池分为四个统计可区分的水平（Asym ≈ Conv₂ > Inter₂ > Seq₂ > Div₂），但这种排序主要反映部分完成而非真正的合作；(3) 即使在完全训练后，至多3.42%的轨迹包含合作事件，仅1.881%的轨迹实现其池的目标合作配置文件；(4) 在整个实验中（15,750,000次评估），仅332次实现所有三个智能体同时退出。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过认证完整成功所需的合作并使用时间合作图揭示策略所展现的合作，揭示了奖励部分完成与实现合作之间的差距。在需要合作的任务中，现有的MARL算法在500个认证训练布局和一百万环境步数的条件下无法获得可迁移的合作策略。退出率等部分完成指标不是合作能力的可靠代理，评估应同时报告联合成功率和轨迹级合作谓词。研究表明，合作MARL基准测试混淆了多个问题：合作在特定任务中的含义、完成任务是否需要它、奖励是否与学习激励对齐，以及训练后的代理是否真正展现它。未来的工作应将认证扩展到部分目标和奖励轨迹前缀，并在LLE之外的环境中测试该方法。

title: Layer-Wise Gate-Controlled Prompt Truncation in a Multimodal Chest X-Ray Classifier
summary: Mixture of Prompt Experts (MoPE) adapts multimodal transformers through input-dependent prompt composition, while retaining a fixed prompt length. We investigate a layer-wise gating extension in a binary chest X-ray classification pilot study. The controller predicts a retention ratio for each sample, averages these ratios within a mini-batch, and uses the resulting integer length to truncate the static and mixed visual prompts. Retained mixed prompts are also scaled by the individual ratios. In one recorded run per configuration, the gated model reached a best validation accuracy of 0.8996, compared with 0.8969 for the fixed-length baseline; the corresponding final values were 0.8963 and 0.8802. The exported gate statistics imply a retained length of one at all recorded training points, relative to a configured maximum of six. This reduces the complete visual sequence from 210 to 200 tokens, but no direct runtime measurements establish an acceleration benefit. Report-derived labels, report text as input, sequential data partitioning, and the absence of repeated controlled experiments limit interpretation. The findings document prompt shortening under the configured gate penalty; they do not establish sample-specific length allocation, superiority over fixed short prompts, or clinical utility. Code is available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 在MoPE多模态视觉-文本分类器中，提出按层门控机制对视觉提示序列进行截断与缩放。在胸部X光二分类任务上，门控模型最佳验证准确率为0.8996，固定长度基线为0.8969；但门控值在所有记录点均接近零，表明提示长度坍缩为1，因此该工作记录的是提示缩短现象，而非真正的样本自适应长度分配或加速收益。
AI.motivation: MoPE通过输入相关的提示组合实现多模态Transformer适配，但提示长度固定，无法体现不同样本或不同层的计算需求差异。作者希望探索一种按层门控机制，使视觉提示长度成为可学习的自适应变量，从而可能提高参数效率或推理效率。
AI.method: 在视觉Transformer每层中，门控网络（两层MLP）根据当前视觉类别token和映射后的报告特征预测每个样本的保留比例；该比例在mini-batch内取平均后离散化为整数长度L，对静态提示和混合提示前缀进行截断；保留的混合提示还按各样本比例进行幅度缩放。损失函数包含分类损失、专家重要性均衡损失和门控正则项。
AI.result: 门控模型最佳验证准确率0.8996，固定长度基线0.8969（差0.27个百分点）；最终值分别为0.8963和0.8802。但门控比例最大值仅约5.7×10⁻⁴，由非负性上界推导可知所有记录训练步中每层保留长度均为1，视觉序列从210减至200 tokens（仅减少4.76%）。无任何实际加速或临床效用证据。
AI.conclusion: 该研究记录了在配置的门控惩罚下提示长度缩短至最小值的行为，但未能证明样本特异性的长度分配、相对于固定短提示的优势、加速效果或临床实用性。标签源自报告文本且与输入重叠、数据按顺序划分、缺乏重复实验等因素限制了结论。需要消融实验、匹配对照和独立测试集来真正验证门控机制的必要性。

title: Discovering Translation-Worthy Languages with E-Values
comment: 10 pages, including references and supplementary material. Workshop paper. Code: this https URL
summary: Choosing when to translate multilingual documents is a central routing problem in text classification: translation can improve predictions for some languages while degrading others or adding unnecessary computation. Uniform translation and heuristic language tiers do not provide statistically controlled route selection. We introduce a language-level router based on paired e-processes that continuously compares direct and translation-assisted classification before freezing a routing policy. A familywise-controlled threshold of 280 bounds the probability of any false route across 14 eligible languages per dataset by 0.05. On SIB-200 and MASSIVE, the router selects translation for 4 of 15 languages and 14 of 15 locales, improving held-out accuracy over direct classification by 8.14 and 16.70 percentage points, respectively. All 28 decisions remain stable across 50 outcome-independent orderings and relative to the per-group threshold. Our results demonstrate that paired e-processes enable statistically controlled, anytime-valid, and auditable multilingual classification routing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于配对e-process的多语言文档分类路由方法，用于统计可控地决定何时使用翻译辅助分类，可在多次检验中控制家族错误率，并实现稳定、可审计的路由决策。
AI.motivation: 多语言文本分类中，统一翻译或基于启发式的语言分层策略无法提供统计可控的路由选择；何时翻译能提升分类性能、何时会带来性能下降或浪费计算资源，仍缺乏系统化解决方案。
AI.method: 引入基于配对e-process (paired e-processes) 的语言级路由器，持续比较直接分类与翻译辅助分类的预测表现，并在达到家族错误率受控的阈值（14种语言下FWER≤0.05，对应阈值280）后冻结路由策略。该方法具备anytime-valid特性，决策不受结果顺序影响。
AI.result: 在SIB-200和MASSIVE数据集上，路由器分别对15种语言中的4种和15种locale中的14种选择翻译路由，相比直接分类的保留准确率分别提升8.14和16.70个百分点；28项决策在50次与结果无关的排序及相对于各分组阈值的条件下均保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 配对e-process能够实现统计可控、anytime-valid且可审计的多语言分类路由，为多语言NLP系统中的翻译决策提供了严格的统计保证。

title: Deep Barycentric Regression for Optimal Transport Map Estimation and its Statistical Optimality
summary: The optimal transport (OT) map provides a geometric transformation for aligning probability distributions and has become a useful tool in machine learning. However, existing estimators of the OT map still exhibit a gap between sharp statistical guarantees and practical parametric estimation based on stable training objectives. Theoretical estimators achieve minimax optimal convergence rates, but they are typically nonparametric and can incur demanding implementation design or inference costs. Practical estimators are parametric and scalable, but their statistical guarantees remain underexplored, and their min-max, adversarial-like training objectives can be sensitive to optimization algorithms. We propose BROT (Barycentric Regression for OT), a simple two-step method that first computes the unregularized OT plan and then fits a deep neural network (DNN) to the induced barycentric targets by least-squares regression. Under standard regularity conditions, we prove that the DNN estimator of BROT attains the minimax convergence rate, when the ground-truth OT map is Lipschitz. Numerical studies on synthetic datasets and an image dataset show that BROT provides accurate map estimates, strong target distribution matching, and competitive transport costs, compared to existing estimation methods. Experiments on two downstream tasks, single-cell perturbation prediction and unsupervised domain adaptation, further suggest that the accurate estimation of BROT can translate into stronger task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BROT（Barycentric Regression for OT），一种用于估计最优传输（OT）映射的简单两步方法：第一步通过线性规划计算非正则化OT方案，第二步通过最小二乘回归将深度神经网络（DNN）拟合到由OT方案导出的重心目标上。理论证明在真实OT映射为Lipschitz条件下，该DNN估计器达到极小极大收敛速率；实验证明该方法在合成数据集、图像数据集及下游任务（单细胞扰动预测、无监督域适应）中均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有OT映射估计方法存在理论保证与实践可行性之间的差距：理论上的极小极大最优估计器通常是非参数的，实现复杂且推理成本高；而实践中的参数化估计器（如基于DNN的min-max对抗训练方法）虽可扩展，但统计保证不明确且对优化算法敏感。本文旨在弥合这一差距，构建一个既具有统计最优性又可实际训练的参数化OT映射估计器。
AI.method: 所提BROT方法包含两个步骤：(1) 通过标准线性规划求解经验Kantorovich问题，获得源-目标经验分布之间的非正则化OT方案；(2) 基于该OT方案计算每个源数据点的重心目标，然后通过最小二乘回归训练Lipschitz约束的DNN（实践中使用Jacobian惩罚实现），将OT映射估计转化为标准回归问题。理论上专门设计依赖样本量的DNN架构，使用混合ReLU/ReQU激活函数以精确实现梯度计算。
AI.result: 理论结果：在标准正则性条件下（源/目标密度有界，真实OT映射为Lipschitz），BROT的DNN估计器达到极小极大收敛速率ñ^{-2/d}∨ñ^{-1}（至多含对数因子）。实验结果：(1) 在Lipschitz真实OT映射的合成数据集上，BROT的估计误差随样本量单调下降且低于所有基线方法；(2) 在两个合成数据集和AFHQv2图像数据集上，BROT达到最低的Wasserstein距离（分布匹配最好），同时保持有竞争力的传输成本；(3) 在单细胞扰动预测（4i数据集，35种药物）和无监督域适应（USPS→MNIST和VisDA-17）任务中均取得最佳或竞争性表现；(4) 训练速度快于min-max类基线方法（ICNN、OTP、DIOTM），推理速度快于1NN。
AI.conclusion: BROT是首个同时具备统计最优性（极小极大收敛速率）和实践可行性的OT映射参数化估计器。通过将OT映射估计简化为基于非正则化OT方案重心目标的最小二乘回归，避免了min-max对抗训练的不稳定性。该方法在统计收敛性、映射质量和下游任务性能方面均优于现有方法。未来的研究方向包括将分析扩展到Hölder光滑类等更一般的函数类，以及研究ICNN等其他参数化方法的统计最优性。

title: SAGE: A Hierarchical Framework for Evaluating Interpretive Literary Quality in Narratives
summary: Assessing the literary quality of narratives requires evaluating interpretive dimensions (cultural representation, emotional depth, and philosophical engagement) that existing NLG metrics cannot measure. We introduce SAGE, a six-layer evaluation framework that separates rule-based assessment of observable textual properties from LLM-based evaluation of interpretive qualities drawn from cultural theory, affect theory, and existentialist philosophy. Each interpretive layer is assessed through multi-round iterative LLM evaluation with independent cross-validation, achieving measurement-grade reliability (98.8% convergence, >94% inter-rater agreement) stable across evaluator models.
