AI.method: CONA采用在线策略链接（strategy chaining）范式。核心组件包括：（1）代理指标Φ_t：定义为当前训练状态下单位时间预期训练损失下降量，分解为吞吐量因子和每批次增益因子，利用GNS（梯度噪声尺度）估计不同策略的收敛增益；（2）gbs前沿搜索：在固定全局批量大小下，最优策略等价于最小化迭代时间，利用BO（贝叶斯优化）和GP代理进行轻量搜索；（3）单调下一gbs定理：证明在GNS非递减假设下，只需搜索下一个更大功率2的批量大小对应的最优策略；（4）在线切换决策：通过比较当前策略与候选策略的代理比率R_t，仅在R_t>1时切换；（5）搜索与训练重叠，避免阻塞GPU执行。
AI.result: 在16块A6000 GPU上训练GPT-3 1.3B、BERT-Large和Llama-3.2-1B的结果：TTP比5种基线方法（AMP、Alpa、Metis、Galvatron、vTrain）快1.4–9.6倍；固定迭代预算下困惑度低1.1–1.4倍；固定token预算下训练时间减少1.6–8.5倍。策略链与OPT（穷举最优序列）一致率达12/13个阶段，SMAPE平均2.6%。搜索开销比基线离线搜索低约3.7倍。消融实验证实策略链接、GNS感知选择、切换时机和BO精修均为关键设计。下游任务性能（ARC、HellaSwag、MMLU、PIQA、WinoGrande、GLUE）平均提升1.6–2.1个百分点。理论分析证明该方法保持标准非凸SGD的O(1/√T)收敛率。
AI.conclusion: CONA证明将并行策略视为动态训练决策、在训练过程中自适应切换是提升LLM训练收敛速度的有效方向。未来工作可扩展至专家并行、序列并行等更多并行维度，并联合优化策略选择与训练超参数。

title: Query-Aware Token Budgeting for Efficient Late-Interaction Visual Document Retrieval
comment: Accepted at IEEE International Conference on Data Mining (ICDM)
summary: Late-interaction visual document retrievers preserve fine-grained page evidence by storing many token embeddings per page, but the resulting storage and query-time interaction costs make large-scale deployment expensive. Pooling document tokens before indexing offers a natural remedy, yet static pooling must decide which visual evidence to preserve before the query is known. We study an alternative: a heavily compressed hot-path index generates candidates, after which query-aware token budgeting operates on the original token sets of the shortlisted pages. We formulate this stage-two selection as a budgeted MaxSim coverage problem, show that a clipped version is monotone submodular, and compare coverage-only, cluster-guided, token-wise, and marginal-gain policies. On ten ViDoRe tasks with ColModernVBERT, direct static pooling reduces macro normalized discounted cumulative gain at rank five from 0.6309 without compression to 0.4738 at a thirty-two-fold pool factor. Under the same candidate-generation regime and a pool-factor-eight-equivalent reranking budget, token top-k recovers 93.93 percent of the full-token score, while greedy marginal-gain selection recovers 98.39 percent. Held-out and leave-one-dataset-out evaluations yield positive greedy improvements over token top-k on every dataset. The latency analysis reveals two useful operating points: token top-k for interactive retrieval and the naive greedy implementation as a quality upper envelope. Together, these results show that late-interaction visual retrieval benefits from query-aware allocation rather than query-agnostic pooling alone.

AI.tldr: 针对晚期交互视觉文档检索器（如ColModernVBERT）存储和交互成本高的问题，本文提出两阶段检索框架：第一阶段用强压缩索引（如PF32）生成候选，第二阶段在候选页的原始token集上进行查询感知的token预算分配，并将其建模为预算受限的MaxSim覆盖问题，证明截断目标函数具有单调子模性，对比了随机、均匀、BCR、Token top-k和贪心边际增益等选择策略。
AI.motivation: 晚期交互视觉文档检索器（如ColPali、ColModernVBERT）为每页存储数百个token嵌入（如ColModernVBERT约350个），导致大规模部署时存储和查询时交互成本高昂。静态token池化虽能压缩索引，但必须在查询未知时决定保留哪些视觉证据，这与MaxSim算子"对特定查询词的最佳匹配"特性不匹配，可能丢弃关键token。需要一种能够利用查询信息、针对每页原始token进行预算分配的机制来替代或补充查询无关的压缩。
AI.method: 1）两阶段流水线：Stage 1用PF32强压缩索引做语料级候选检索（约11 token/页，热路径存储降低32倍），Stage 2对候选页重开原始~350 token，按预算B选取子集再做MaxSim重排序。2）形式化为预算受限MaxSim覆盖问题：在每页cardinality budget B下选子集S⊆D最大化MaxSim得分。3）使用截断相似度ϕ_i(d)=max{0, q_i⊤d}，定义覆盖效用F_Q(S)=Σ max_{d∈S} ϕ_i(d)，证明其为单调子模函数，贪心选择获(1-1/e)近似保证。4）对比五种策略：随机、均匀、BCR（簇引导）、Token top-k、贪心边际增益。5）在10个ViDoRe任务上用ColModernVBERT评估，进行保留验证、留一数据集迁移、延迟分析。
AI.result: 1）静态池化上限受限：PF1为0.6309 nDCG@5，PF32直接降至0.4738（损失24.89%）。2）查询感知预算恢复质量：PF32候选+PF8等效预算下，Token top-k恢复93.93%（0.5926），贪心恢复98.39%（0.6208）。3）贪心在不同预算下稳健（PF4/PF8/PF16均约0.621），Token top-k在紧预算下退化明显。4）保留7数据集验证：贪心0.6460 vs top-k 0.6195，Wilcoxon p=0.0156；留一数据集迁移中贪心在全部10个数据集上均获胜（均值Δ=0.0282）。5）延迟权衡：Token top-k Stage-2仅15.8ms（交互首选），贪心538ms（质量上限包络），约34倍延迟差异。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明晚期交互视觉文档检索的效率问题不能仅靠查询无关池化解决。两阶段设计将压缩与选择解耦：压缩负责语料规模过滤，选择负责查询特定的证据分配。MaxSim覆盖公式化既解释了贪心策略作为参考策略恢复近全质量的原因，也解释了Token top-k作为实用低延迟选择的价值。未来方向包括惰性贪心加速、向量化/剪枝贪心、将贪心蒸馏为快速策略，以及自适应预算分配。

title: Matryoshka Hash Representations for Model-Aware Compact Semantic Retrieval
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) depends on dense retrieval: each document is stored as a learned vector, and a query is answered by finding its nearest neighbors in that vector space. Keeping one full-precision vector per document is the dominant index cost at corpus scale, so retrieval systems replace each vector with a short code of a few bytes---a step called quantization. Standard quantizers such as product quantization (PQ) pick the code that reconstructs the original vector most closely. A single code is even more useful if it serves several byte budgets at once: when its short prefixes are each directly searchable, a deployment can set its efficiency--quality operating point without re-encoding the corpus. But training all prefixes under one objective makes the early bits a compromise across budgets---short codes improve while the full-width code degrades. Quantization to low-bit representation, such as binary codes, further sharpens the conflict. We introduce Matryoshka Hash Representations (MHR), a two-stage procedure that separates full-width training from prefix organization. MHR first learns a longer binary code, then freezes the model and trains additional zero-initialized residual code adaptors for directly searchable prefixes. Documents are stored at one bit per coordinate, while queries keep continuous logits like PQ to attain sufficient expressivity. We implement the search process with FAISS FastScan. Trained on MS MARCO and zero-shot transferred to seven BEIR datasets, MHR reaches .5561 NDCG@10 and .6535 Recall@100 at 32 bytes, surpassing the best baseline of the same budget. The advantage is more pronounced in lower budgets. The same code also strengthens two common pipelines: shortlisting candidates for full-precision reranking, and pruning a low-storage graph index such as LEANN.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Matryoshka Hash Representations (MHR)，一种用于密集检索的两阶段训练框架，可在单一嵌套二进制码中同时提供8/16/32字节的可搜索前缀，且全宽性能不退化。其核心是将"全宽训练"与"前缀组织"解耦：Stage I学习强全宽256位码，Stage II冻结后仅训练零初始化残差适配器以生成嵌套前缀。在MS MARCO训练、七个BEIR数据集零样本评估中，MHR在所有预算下均超越PQ、OPQ、RaBitQ、ITQ、JPQ等紧凑基线，并支持FastScan、IVF、LEANN图剪枝和粗筛-重排序管线。
AI.motivation: 1. RAG等系统依赖密集检索，存储全精度向量是语料库规模下的主要索引开销，需用量化压缩；2. 现有量化方法（如PQ）为模型无关的重建目标，在极低字节预算下未充分利用排序信号；3. 嵌套表示（如Matryoshka）允许一份代码服务多字节预算，但直接联合训练各前缀时存在"全宽-前缀权衡"——短前缀改善但全宽码退化；二进制码下该权衡因比特翻转而被放大。
AI.method: 两阶段框架。Stage I：用LoRA微调BGE双编码器+线性哈希头W，在MS MARCO上学习256位二进制码，损失包括硬文档相关性排序、冻结BGE蒸馏、MiniLM排序和码平衡正则，文档使用STE的硬符号、查询保持连续logits。Stage II：冻结Stage I全部参数，叠加R=2个零初始化残差适配器（输入/隐藏均为256维），在固定logits上学习自适应logits z_φ；训练目标含每前缀的相关性排序、源码KL蒸馏锚定全宽、MiniLM列表排序、平衡损失和高斯正则化。部署采用非对称打分：文档存硬码（1位/维），查询保留连续logits；通过解析查找表分解为16种固定符号模式，安装到FAISS IndexPQFastScan实现SIMD加速扫描，支持flat和IVF两种索引结构。
AI.result: 在MS MARCO训练、七个BEIR数据集（Quora/NQ/HotpotQA/DBpedia-Entity/FEVER/TREC-COVID/Climate-FEVER）零样本评估：32字节下MHR达到.5561 NDCG@10/.6535 Recall@100，超过同预算最强基线JPQ-FT（.524/.638）；16字节下达到.502/.616（JPQ-FT为.404/.537）；8字节下达到.376/.518。所有预算均领先所有紧凑基线。效率方面：单线程FlatScan在Quora/TREC-COVID上为.54/.20 ms/query，比源拟合PQ快8.7×/7.5×；IVF-MHR在相同序列化存储下NDCG全面优于IVF-PQ，速度最多快11.9%；在LEANN-HNSW 25%保留率下，MHR 8位码保留99.6-100.0%的未剪枝NDCG@10；8字节粗筛+100候选重排序后达到.561 NDCG，逼近.637的浮点天花板。消融证实移除源码蒸馏损失使均值NDCG从.498降至.365。
AI.conclusion: MHR通过解耦全宽训练与前缀组织，解决了嵌套二进制码的"全宽-前缀权衡"问题，在单一源训练嵌套码下实现跨预算最优检索质量与紧凑索引延迟。其代码可直接替换PQ，作为粗筛器和图索引剪枝码，为低存储RAG系统提供灵活的质量-成本操作点。未来工作包括扩展到FAISS GPU内核与DiskANN等磁盘驻留图搜索，并探索隐私计算场景下的质量-隐私-效率权衡。

title: Quality Metrics for LLM-Generated Asset Administration Shells: A Perturbation-Based Evaluation Approach
summary: The rapid digital transformation of manufacturing, often referred to as Industry 4.0, relies on seamless interoperability between physical and software assets. A central enabler is the Asset Administration Shell (AAS), a standardized digital representation of such assets. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) enable the generation of AAS submodels from unstructured sources such as product datasheets but raise challenges for quality assurance. In particular, unexpected errors, the lack of ground truth references, and the absence of standardized quality metrics hinder reliable adoption. In this work, we evaluate quality metrics for AI-generated AAS using a perturbation-based evaluation framework. By systematically degrading AAS generation along multiple dimensions, we assess how well different metrics reflect quality changes. Based on a dataset of 200 products from multiple manufacturers, we generate 6,400 AAS instances using GPT-4o-mini, Qwen3, and DeepSeek-R1. Our results show that metrics based on exact matching of property names and similarity-based soft matching of property values, in particular value-based recall and name-based F1 score, provide the most reliable indicators of quality degradation. Furthermore, we quantify the impact of different perturbation types and analyze differences across model families and product segments. These findings support the selection of suitable metrics, the tuning of LLM-based pipelines, and the integration of AI-generated AAS into industrial applications.

AI.tldr: 论文研究如何可靠评估由大语言模型生成的资产管理壳（AAS）。作者提出扰动式评估框架，在缺乏高质量标注真值时，通过温度升高、模型缩小、提示词退化主动降低生成质量，再比较18种AAS指标的响应能力。基于200种产品、6400个子模型和3个模型家族的实验表明：属性名称宜采用精确匹配，属性值宜采用嵌入式软匹配；全参考值召回率（阈值0.88时平均Spearman ρ=0.65）和无参考名称F1最敏感。论文同时发现提示词退化导致性能下降35–40个百分点，8B以下模型质量明显下滑，且结果受制造商与产品类别显著影响。该工作为AAS生成工具选型、参数调优和质量监控提供了实用依据。
AI.motivation: AAS是支撑工业互操作和数字孪生的标准化资产表示。LLM虽可从非结构化产品数据表中自动生成AAS技术子模型，但生成结果可能缺失、重复、幻觉或语义错误；同时，同一产品可能存在不同命名、单位、结构和分类体系，且缺少逐步骤标注与唯一真值。传统精确匹配和通用IE指标难以适配这种非唯一、结构化、多步骤的端到端输出，因此需要一种在缺少可靠真值时仍能系统判断质量指标是否有效的评估方法。
AI.method: 研究将产品数据表、参考AAS和由参考AAS导出的属性字典组成结构化提示，规定属性名、类型和单位，并要求模型按JSON Schema输出name、value、unit和text reference。测试GPT-4o-mini、Qwen3（0.6B–32B）和DeepSeek-R1（1.7B–70B），构造6400个技术数据子模型。质量变化由温度变化、模型规模降低和提示词退化产生；提示词退化综合语义漂移、语法损伤、信息模糊、上下文无关和字符噪声，强度为0–1。评估18种指标，覆盖全参考/无参考、名称/值、精确/嵌入/Levenshtein匹配，以及Precision/Recall/F1。属性对通过相似度矩阵与匈牙利算法一一匹配；数值值相对误差阈值为1%，字符串采用软相似度，阈值以网格搜索选择。指标有效性由指标与扰动强度之间的Spearman绝对相关判断，并辅以方差分析比较制造商和产品类别。
AI.result: 共从200种产品中提取231,276个属性，平均每个子模型提取83.5%的提示属性；无扰动时GPT-4o-mini为96.8%。无参考条件下，名称F1对质量退化最敏感，嵌入式匹配优于字符串软匹配，但复杂相似匹配没有稳定超过简单精确匹配，说明属性术语的精确性比语义容错更重要。全参考条件下先精确匹配属性名，再以嵌入软匹配属性值效果最好；值召回率在阈值τ=0.88时平均Spearman ρ=0.65，为全部候选中最高。各扰动使质量下降35–40个百分点；温度和提示词退化近似线性下降，模型规模呈非线性关系，约8B参数以下出现明显性能陡降。Qwen3-32B的无扰动表现最佳，表明架构和训练方法可能比参数量更重要。制造商间差异显著（p<0.001，η²≈0.13–0.17），Fluid Power通常优于Electrical Engineering；无参考指标还存在接近满分的天花板效应。作者最终建议“名称精确匹配+值软匹配”，并组合使用互补指标与必要的人工审核，避免单一指标过拟合。
AI.conclusion: 在LLM生成AAS的质量评估中，属性名称应采用可解释、可重复的精确匹配，以识别缺失和误命名；属性值则应采用基于嵌入的软匹配，以容许拼写和等价表述变化。扰动式元评估无需高质量真值即可判断指标是否对真实质量变化敏感，因此特别适合AAS及其他结构化信息抽取任务。不过，论文结论主要反映技术数据子模型中属性名称与值的正确性和完整性，未覆盖业务适用性、领域规范、下游效用及全部语义错误；外部推广到其他AAS子模型、工业领域、模型家族和文档风格仍需验证。

title: LANTERN: Language Model Assessment on Noisy and Transformed Tasks for Understanding Error and Robustness Nuances
summary: Robustness evaluation of large language models (LLMs) remains a critical challenge, particularly in assessing their sensitivity to perturbations in input data. In this work, we systematically evaluate LLM robustness across multiple dimensions, including word error rate, character repetition and duplication, modifications in choices, and variability in instruction following. To facilitate this evaluation, we construct a synthetic and augmented dataset encompassing a diverse set of LLM benchmarks, specifically targeting multiple-choice question (MCQ) datasets and instruction-following tasks. We conduct extensive experiments on LLMs of varying scales-small, medium, and large-as well as across base and instruction-tuned variants. Our analysis quantifies the variability in model responses under perturbed conditions and highlights discrepancies relative to baseline models. The findings provide insights into the stability of LLMs across different evaluation scenarios contributing to the development of more robust and reliable language models as well as robust evaluation methodologies.

AI.tldr: LANTERN提出了一个系统评估大语言模型(LLM)鲁棒性的框架，通过对选择题(MCQ)基准和指令遵循任务施加多维度扰动（字符级排版错误、字母重复/删除、选项替换为"None of these"/"All of the above"/"Both A and B"等、指令变量变化），在12个开源LLM上量化了性能波动，发现鲁棒性与模型规模无明显正相关，且预训练数据质量和指令微调策略才是关键。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM评估方法依赖静态基准和预设指标，无法捕捉模型对真实世界输入扰动（如拼写错误、选项排列变化、指令变体）的敏感性，导致数据泄漏、词错误率和位置偏差等问题被忽视，评估结果可能不可靠。
AI.method: 1) 构建合成扰动数据集：针对问题施加三类扰动（v0排版错误、v1字母重复、v2字母删除），强度分别为10%/30%/50%；针对选项施加四类扰动（v_none、v_all、v_none-correct、v_both）。2) 在IfEval上进行开放生成扰动，改变指令约束（如"exactly two responses"改为"four responses"，"no comma"改为"no semicolon"）。3) 使用LLM-Eval-Harness在MMLU/MMLU-Pro/GPQA/MUSR/IfEval上对12个开源模型（2B-14B，含base和instruct版本）进行zero-shot/few-shot评估。4) 通过K-S检验和PCA嵌入分析验证扰动前后的分布一致性。
AI.result: 1) 问题扰动：v0对MMLU影响最大（Phi-3.5-mini下降10.6%），v1/v2整体下降较小；Gemma-2-2B在MMLU-Pro上展现强鲁棒性，甚至超越基线。2) 选项扰动：v_none-correct（将正确答案替换为"None of these"）造成最大性能崩溃（多个模型降至2-7%）；v_all使MUSR/MMLU下降明显；模型对"None of these"和"All of these"存在固有偏好偏差。3) 开放生成：指令微调模型比base模型更鲁棒；LLaMA系列波动最大（约4%下降）；Phi-4虽大但表现不佳，说明规模≠鲁棒性。4) K-S检验p=0.975确认扰动保持统计分布一致。
AI.conclusion: LLM的鲁棒性高度依赖于扰动类型、基准特性和训练数据，而非单纯的模型规模；预训练数据质量和对齐策略才是关键因素。破坏逻辑结构（如移除正确选项）的扰动比表面噪声更具破坏性。未来工作应探索自适应微调和对抗训练策略以增强LLM对结构化扰动的韧性。

title: PLATOS: A Power and Latency-Aware Task-Oriented Scheduling Strategy for Healthcare IoT in Fog Computing
comment: Published in Eurasian Journal of Mathematical and Computer Applications, Vol. 13, No. 3, pp. 4-21 (2025). 18 pages, 6 figures
summary: Healthcare Internet of Things (HIoT) technology is revolutionising the healthcare industry by enabling real-time data collection and analysis for personalised patient care. However, the rapid expansion of HIoT technology introduces challenges such as increased latency and higher energy consumption in fog computing environments, particularly when managing battery-operated devices. To address these issues, this work proposes a novel scheduling strategy that optimises both power consumption and latency through task-oriented scheduling for HIoT tasks. The proposed strategy, named PLATOS (Power and Latency Aware Task Oriented Scheduling), is implemented in four sequential phases. In the first phase, HIoT tasks are categorised into three groups: priority-oriented, storage-oriented, and computational-oriented. The second phase focuses on latency optimisation by identifying the fog computing resources that yield the lowest execution delay for each task category. In the third phase, power optimisation is achieved by selecting the resources that minimise energy consumption. Finally, in the decision-making phase, high-performance fog resources are allocated to high-priority tasks while the remaining tasks are scheduled based on a mapped list derived from the latency and power optimisation phases. Simulation experiments conducted in iFogSim2 demonstrate that PLATOS reduces energy consumption by 18.72% and latency by 8.65% when compared to the state-of-the-art. These improvements enhance the efficiency and responsiveness of HIoT systems and contribute to more effective patient care and proactive healthcare service delivery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为PLATOS的雾计算环境下医疗物联网任务调度策略,通过任务分类、延迟优化、功耗优化和决策四个阶段,同时优化能耗和延迟。在iFogSim2上的仿真结果表明,相比现有FTDM策略,能耗降低18.72%,延迟降低8.65%。
AI.motivation: 医疗物联网(HIoT)设备多为电池供电且对实时性要求高,雾计算环境中任务调度面临高延迟和高能耗的挑战。现有调度策略往往只关注单一指标(如成本或QoS),缺乏同时针对延迟和能耗进行联合优化,并结合医疗任务特性的任务感知调度机制。
AI.method: PLATOS策略包含四个顺序阶段:1)任务定向阶段——将HIoT任务分为优先级导向、存储导向和计算导向三类;2)延迟优化阶段——按执行延迟升序排列各任务的雾资源;3)功耗优化阶段——按能耗升序排列各任务的雾资源;4)决策阶段——将高性能雾资源分配给高优先级任务,其余任务基于延迟与功耗优化阶段的映射列表进行调度。同时构建了基于ILP的数学模型,并引入了DEI和ELDP两个综合评估指标。
AI.result: 在iFogSim2上对心血管健康监测(CHM)应用进行仿真,PLATOS相比FTDM基线策略实现能耗降低18.72%、延迟降低8.65%。DEI指标显示雾设备数量增加时(45-60)系统效率显著优于基线;ELDP指标表明系统在规模化部署中具有更优的可扩展性,最优设备数约为45-60。
AI.conclusion: PLATOS策略通过四阶段任务导向调度,有效解决了HIoT在雾计算环境中的能耗与延迟优化问题,在关键性能指标上超越现有先进方法。未来工作将引入容错机制、机器学习驱动的动态任务分类与资源分配,并开展大规模真实部署验证。

title: BlueprintAgent: Constraint-Triggered Targeted Revisits for Simulation-Ready Generation from Scanned Structural Blueprints
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 14 pages, 4 figures
summary: Converting in-service reinforced-concrete (RC) building blueprints into simulation-ready models---structured frame representations that support deterministic FEM export and qualified-engineer review---underpins safety assessment and seismic retrofit, but the process remains manual. Direct prompting of a multimodal large language model (MLLM) over a scanned sheet is unreliable: outputs often violate engineering constraints on beam--column support, span count, or 3D continuity. We present BlueprintAgent (BPA), a constraint-triggered multimodal agent for simulation-ready frame extraction from scanned blueprints. BPA treats the MLLM as the primary reader and decision maker, with OCR and computer vision supplying localized evidence. Its central mechanism realizes engineering constraints as callable validators whose entity-level conflict reports trigger targeted MLLM revisits over the local region---an inference-time control distinct from fixed pipelines and free-form self-reflection. We evaluate BPA on 300 real scanned blueprint sheets from 20 anonymized RC frame projects, against five baselines and six ablations. BPA reaches a macro-averaged Beam F1 of 0.994, against 0.301 for single-MLLM zero-shot and 0.820 for a fixed pipeline; removing MLLM-led axis adjudication collapses Beam and Column F1 on complex multi-sheet projects. For dense technical drawings, engineering constraints are best deployed as triggers for entity-level targeted revisits rather than as post-hoc output filters.

AI.tldr: BlueprintAgent (BPA) is a constraint-triggered multimodal agent that converts scanned reinforced-concrete (RC) structural blueprints into simulation-ready 3D frame models. It uses a multimodal LLM (MLLM) as the primary reader, supported by OCR and computer vision tools, with engineering constraint validators whose violation signals trigger targeted entity-level revisits rather than post-hoc filtering. The system achieves Beam F1 of 0.994 on 300 real scanned sheets, vastly outperforming single-MLLM zero-shot (0.301) and fixed-pipeline (0.820) baselines.
AI.motivation: Converting scanned in-service RC building blueprints into simulation-ready FEM models currently requires manual labor by structural engineers. Existing automated approaches fail because (1) whole-sheet MLLM prompting loses resolution and produces over-connected beam-column topologies, and (2) OCR/CV pipelines lack mechanisms to localize and correct perception errors. Dense technical drawings require not just recognizing text but understanding engineering semantics like span counts, beam-column support relationships, and cross-floor continuity.
AI.method: BPA employs a sheet→region→evidence→simulatable 3D model hierarchy with an assess-plan-execute-interpret-update-validate-revisit loop. The MLLM serves as the primary reader and decision-maker, invoking OCR, CV axis probing, local re-OCR, and axis-aware cropping on demand. Four families of constraint validators (axis-grid, geometric-topological, annotation-consistency, 3D-consistency) emit structured JSON conflict records. Each conflict triggers the MLLM to revisit the relevant local visual evidence, with three possible actions: revise, mark uncertain, or accept as a documented anomaly. Twelve specific conflict types are defined across the geometric, annotation, and 3D consistency validators.
AI.result: BPA achieves macro-averaged Beam F1 of 0.994, Col F1 of 1.000, and Bind F1 of 1.000 on 300 real scanned sheets from 20 anonymized RC frame projects. This substantially exceeds single-MLLM zero-shot (Beam F1: 0.301) and fixed pipelines (Beam F1: 0.820). Removing MLLM-led axis adjudication (A6) causes the largest degradation (Beam F1: 0.369, Col F1: 0.614). The B5-over-B4 contrast confirms that constraint-triggered revisits—not agent looping alone—drive the main gain. Post-hoc constraint application (B6) recovers only partial gains (F1: 0.8505 vs. 0.9609), confirming that evidence reacquisition is essential. Results hold across GPT-5.4, Claude 4.6 Opus, and Qwen 3.6 Plus backbones.
AI.conclusion: Engineering constraints on dense technical drawings are best deployed as triggers for entity-level targeted revisits rather than as post-hoc output filters. BPA's validator interface is model-independent and its improvement direction is preserved across multiple MLLM backbones. Limitations include RC frame scope only, single FEM solver (OpenSees linear-elastic), reliance on commercial MLLM APIs, and lack of wall-clock/token-cost comparisons. Residual errors (0.6% Beam F1) are 45% perception, 25% topology, 20% binding, and 10% completeness, requiring qualified-engineer review for safety-critical applications.

title: Beyond Single-Negative Preference: Multi-Negative DPO for LLM-Centric Historical Entity Linking
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have recently shown promise for historical entity linking, but preference optimization for this task is often formulated with only one negative candidate per training instance. This discards information from the remaining candidates retrieved for the same mention. We introduce multi-negative direct preference optimisation (MDPO), a reference-based pairwise objective that compares the correct entity with all valid rejected candidates associated with each mention. MDPO preserves the Bradley-Terry formulation of DPO while exploiting the complete candidate set through masked, length-normalised sequence scores. We evaluate MDPO on hipe-2020 and newseye, covering French, German, English, Swedish, and Finnish historical newspaper text. Experiments show that MDPO improves over supervised fine-tuning and single-negative DPO, with particularly strong gains for NIL mentions, semantic ambiguity, OCR noise, and historically difficult names. Further analyses disentangle candidate-generation and selection errors, showing that candidate retrieval remains a key bottleneck for end-to-end entity linking. These results demonstrate that incorporating all within-instance negative candidates is a simple and effective improvement for LLM-based historical entity linking.

AI.tldr: 本文针对历史实体链接任务，提出多负样本直接偏好优化（MDPO）方法，利用同一提及对应的全部负候选构建偏好对，在多语言历史新闻数据集上显著优于单负样本DPO和监督微调。
AI.motivation: 标准DPO在实体链接任务中每个训练实例仅使用一个负样本，丢弃了同一提及对应的其他有效负候选信息；而实体链接天然具有多候选决策特性，需要充分利用全部硬负样本以提供更丰富的监督信号。
AI.method: 1) LLM引导的候选检索：利用LLM生成候选实体名称，结合知识库验证与别名查找构建候选集；2) 多负样本DPO损失：在标准Bradley-Terry框架下，对每个提及将正确实体与所有有效负候选进行配对比较，使用长度归一化序列分数，通过有效性掩码处理变长负样本数量。
AI.result: 在hipe-2020（法、德、英）和newseye（法、德、瑞典、芬兰）数据集上，MDPO在hipe-2020全部子集和newseye三个子集上取得最优F1；在NIL提及、语义歧义、OCR噪声等困难场景提升显著；候选检索仍是端到端性能的主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 将同一实例内所有负候选纳入偏好优化是简单有效的改进，能为LLM驱动的历史实体链接提供更强的排序监督；但NIL预测和候选检索仍是关键挑战，未来需探索列表式或对比式目标函数。

title: Revisiting Thinning Methods for Kernel Learning Problems
summary: Kernel methods are widely used because of their strong theoretical guarantees and empirical performance. However, their high computational cost limits their applicability to large-scale datasets. To address this shortcoming, several approaches use Maximum Mean Discrepancy to construct representative subsets that preserve the properties of the full dataset in a Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space. We introduce Backward Kernel Herding, an algorithm that addresses this problem by iteratively removing points from the dataset, achieving results comparable to current state-of-the-art approaches while accelerating the subsampling process in realistic scenarios where the reduced size is less than half of the dataset. Moreover, we overcome a limitation of Kernel Thinning by proposing an extension that enables the construction of subsets of arbitrary size rather that restricting to successive halvings. Finally, we conduct an extensive experimental comparison focusing on the most relevant kernel learning procedures: Gaussian Processes and Kernel Support Vector Machines. The results show that Backward Kernel Herding consistently achieves competitive performance with the most favorable training-time efficiency, while the proposed Flexible Kernel Thinning frequently achieves the best predictive performance. These gains become especially pronounced for moderate compression ratios, highlighting the benefits of incorporating supervised information into the thinning process. In terms of memory consumption, Flexible Kernel Thinning is also competitive, whereas Backward Kernel Herding remains an alternative when computational efficiency is the primary objective. Overall, no single method dominates across all scenarios, underscoring the importance of selecting the reduction strategy according to the desired trade-off between predictive performance, training cost, and memory requirements.

AI.tldr: 论文面向大规模核学习中的核心集选择问题，提出两项改进：① Backward Kernel Herding（BKH）从完整数据集出发，迭代删除对核均值嵌入扰动最小的样本；② Flexible Kernel Thinning（FKT）利用保留率 p 的二进制展开，从 KT-SPLIT 树中自适应组合子集，从而支持任意保留比例。方法可与联合监督核结合，使样本压缩同时考虑输入与标签。跨 OpenML 的 72 个分类数据集和 35 个回归数据集、KSVM/GP 两类模型及 25%/50%/75% 保留率的实验表明：FKT 通常具有最佳预测性能且内存开销较低，但训练时间最高；BKH 的预测性能与 KH 接近，却在建模样本保留率低于约 50% 时具有更好的计算效率，尤其适合 25% 的高压缩场景；KH 在极低保留率下仍有速度优势。论文没有发现单一方法在准确率、时间和内存上全面占优，实际选择应依据目标权衡。
AI.motivation: 核方法具有较强的理论保证和预测性能，但其训练与推理成本通常随样本数呈 O(n^2) 至 O(n^3) 增长，难以直接扩展到大规模数据。现有 Kernel Herding 从空集开始逐点添加样本，在高压缩率下迭代次数多；标准 Kernel Thinning 又只能生成 n/2^m 大小的子集。论文因此从迭代方向、目标子集规模和监督信息利用三个方面改进核核心集选择。
AI.method: 方法包括：（1）Backward Kernel Herding：计算全数据核均值嵌入，每轮删除离当前嵌入目标最近的点，并用残差更新后续删除决策；给出基于显式特征/RFF和核技巧的两种实现。（2）Flexible Kernel Thinning：将任意保留比例 p 分解为二进制位，在 KT-SPLIT 的二叉树各层选择合适子块，再对合并后的候选集执行一次 KT-SWAP；理论上保留了近似保证，但误差界较标准 KT 额外多出与 p 的二进制展开深度有关的平方根因子。（3）监督扩展：构造联合核 k((x_i,y_i),(x_j,y_j))=k_X(x_i,x_j)k_Y(y_i,y_j)，分别采用标签的 Kronecker delta 核以及响应变量上的 RBF 或三角核。（4）在 72 个分类和 35 个回归 OpenML 数据集上，对 KSVM 和 GP 评测 25%、50%、75% 三种保留率；采用 10 次固定种子划分，分类以平衡准确率和 ROC-AUC（仅 GP）评估，回归以 R^2 评估，并综合训练时间、内存、平均排名、Wilcoxon 检验及 Holm 校正、Friedman 检验和 Nemenyi 事后检验。
AI.result: FKT 在多数任务中预测排名最佳：KSVM 分类中三种保留率下均显著优于 KH 和 BKH；在 GP 分类及 KSVM 回归中，50%和75%保留率时优势最明显；25%保留率时优势缩小并趋于统计等价。GP 回归中三种方法在各保留率下均无显著差异。训练时间方面，KSVM 分类/回归中 KH 在 25%和50%保留率下最快，BKH 在75%时占优；GP 分类/回归中 KH 与 BKH 通常最快且统计不可区分，FKT 始终较慢。内存方面，KSVM 任务中 FKT 在所有设置下最佳；GP 任务中 FKT 在 25%保留率最佳，而保留较多样本时 BKH 更优。按理论成本，KH 与 BKH 均为 O(n^2 C_k)，BKH 的优势主要来自删除迭代数与剩余样本数相关；FKT 的 KT-SWAP 可能产生 O(Rpn^3) 的最坏时间开销，但所需内存为 O(n)，且通常不构造 n×n 核矩阵。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明，通过反向均值嵌入删除策略和可组合的 KT-SPLIT 树，可以分别降低高压缩率下的迭代成本并支持任意核心集规模。将标签纳入联合监督核还能稳定改善多数分类任务以及 KSVM 回归的样本选择质量。FKT 是预测性能优先时的优先方案，尤其在保留50%或75%数据时；BKH 是25%保留率或训练时间受限时的更高效替代。KH 在极低保留率与 KSVM 任务中仍有速度优势。未来工作包括组合不同核心集的集成方法，以及一次选择或删除多个样本以降低贪心过程成本。

title: TabBench-Bio: A Living Benchmark for Machine Learning on High-Dimensional Biomedical Tables
summary: Biomedical tables often combine thousands of measured variables with only tens or hundreds of labelled samples, a regime that is poorly represented in general-purpose tabular benchmarks. We introduce TabBench-Bio, a living and interactive benchmark of 43 biomedical datasets spanning multiple domains. Under a shared cross-validation protocol, we compare classical estimators, neural networks, and tabular foundation models across 28 feature-by-sample operating points. At the reference cell of 10,000 features and 100 training samples, RealTabPFN v2.5 has the highest point estimate, followed by Logistic Regression and TabDPT, whose point estimates are nearly identical. A paired bootstrap over the target pool separates RealTabPFN v2.5 from Logistic Regression by 145 Elo (95% interval [59, 232]). Tabular foundation models generally occupy the leading ranks, while the strongest configuration depends on the operating point and biomedical modality. The AutoML framework AutoGluon, using its one-hour "extreme" preset, is configured as a separate resource-intensive reference and is reported here at the reference cell. Fold-level predictions, run status, and deterministic aggregations make every reported result reproducible and reusable. We invite the community to contribute: TabBench-Bio is designed to grow, and we welcome submissions of new biomedical tabular datasets, particularly from underrepresented assays and clinical endpoints, for inclusion in future releases. The interactive leaderboard is available at: this https URL

AI.tldr: TabBench-Bio是一个面向生物医学高维低样本（HDLSS）表格数据的活体（living）基准测试，包含43个数据集（30分类+13回归），覆盖7种模态。该基准在4×7的特征-样本网格（28个操作点）上评估19种模型配置与1个常数基线，包括经典方法、神经网络和表格基础模型（TFMs）。在参考操作点（10,000特征×100训练样本）下，RealTabPFN v2.5 Elo评分最高（1274），其次是逻辑回归（1129）和TabDPT（1108），配对bootstrap区分前两者达145 Elo。研究表明：TFMs整体领先，但最优模型取决于操作点和生物医学模态；逻辑回归作为线性强默认模型在此设置下表现突出；in-context学习者随样本量增加而获益，树集成则在样本稀缺时最强。基准提供可复现的fold级预测、确定性聚合结果和交互式排行榜，并欢迎社区贡献新数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有通用表格基准（如TabArena、TALENT）主要针对传统IID表格任务，对生物医学中常见的高维低样本（HDLSS）场景覆盖不足。基因表达、宏基因组、甲基化等生物医学表格常包含数千变量但仅数十到数百标注样本，且不同测量过程的数据结构和依赖关系各异。不同模型（线性模型、树模型、神经网络、TFMs）在HDLSS设定下的行为缺乏系统比较，单一操作点的评估无法揭示模型对特征宽度和样本量的鲁棒性。因此需要一个领域专门、可维护、跨模态的活体基准来指导模型选择和开发。
AI.method: 构建TabBench-Bio活体基准，包含：1）版本化数据集注册表（43个数据集，7个模态组：基因表达、宏基因组、DNA甲基化、分子性质、基因组预测、GLM/PLM嵌入、其他）；2）共享交叉验证协议（5折，含分组折防泄漏）；3）4×7特征-样本预算网格（p∈{2000,10000,25000,full}, n∈{20,50,100,200,500,1000,full}）共28个操作点，参考单元为p=10000, n=100；4）通过AutoGluon适配器暴露19个模型配置（KNN、Logistic Regression、Random Forest、Extra Trees、CatBoost、LightGBM、XGBoost、MLP、RealMLP、TabM、TabPFN v2/v2.5/v3、TabPFN-Wide×2、Mitra、TabDPT、TabICL、TabFM）+常数基线，AutoGluon Extreme预设在参考单元和全特征-全样本单元作为资源密集参考；5）使用Bradley-Terry Elo进行跨任务排名（Random Forest锚定1000），配对target-level bootstrap（2000次）获取不确定性区间；6）主分类指标macro-F1，主回归指标RMSE；7）记录fold级预测、运行状态、资源消耗和确定性聚合以保证可复现性。
AI.result: 1）参考单元（p=10000, n=100）排名：RealTabPFN v2.5 Elo=1274（最高），Logistic Regression=1129，TabDPT=1108，TabPFN v3=1102，RealTabPFN v2.0=1088；配对bootstrap分离RealTabPFN v2.5与Logistic Regression 145 Elo（95% CI [59, 232]），但目标级胜率57.7%（CI含50%）；2）模型顺序随操作点和模态变化：固定p=2000，随样本量从50→200，TabICL排名从9升至2，树集成下降；固定n=100，特征预算从2000→10000，TabICL下降205 Elo但Logistic Regression从第9升至第2；3）模态特异：RealTabPFN v2.5在基因表达、宏基因组、分子性质三大池领先；MLP在4个GLM/PLM嵌入任务领先；TabPFN Wide (8k)在4个甲基化任务领先；基因组预测中Extra Trees和Random Forest共享最高评分；4）训练时间：RealTabPFN v2.5中位71.5秒/折；RealMLP最快且macro-F1与最佳相差<2pp（24.7秒）；5）AUROC重排后，TFMs占据前6名，Logistic Regression降至第7，说明部分差异源于阈值选择。
AI.conclusion: TabBench-Bio填补了通用表格基准与生物医学HDLSS场景之间的空白，证实TFMs整体领先但不存在单一最优默认模型。参考单元下RealTabPFN v2.5领先，但逻辑回归作为线性强默认在该生物医学HDLSS设定下表现出色，与TabArena关于通用表格的结论形成对比。模型选择应基于具体生物医学模态和操作点，而非依赖单一全局排行榜；模型开发者应将跨样本预算、特征预算和模态的鲁棒性作为首要评估目标。基准作为活体系统将持续扩展，鼓励提交新的数据集（特别是欠代表检测和临床终点）。

title: TASTE: Throughput-Aware Batch Size Tuning for On-Device Edge Learning
comment: 8 pages, 1 tables, 6 figures; Accepted to 29th Euromicro DSD 2026
summary: The rise of privacy-preserving artificial intelligence (AI) has shifted the focus of model adaptation and personalization towards on-device learning, where deep learning models are finetuned directly on edge hardware using local user data. However, this shift requires optimization of deep learning training on resource-constrained hardware to maximize throughput while maintaining predictive accuracy. This paper introduces a novel technique for on-device model training that incorporates an efficient Bayesian optimization-based batch size tuning approach to maximize hardware throughput. To evaluate the impact of this hyperparameter on the learning dynamics, we investigated two distinct paradigms: standard supervised learning (SL) and online continual learning (CL). Experimental results across various edge devices demonstrate a throughput ceiling, beyond which increasing the batch size yields no additional throughput gains. The proposed tuning approach identifies the optimal batch size, which, when combined with gradient accumulation and linear learning rate scaling, achieves up to a 2X increase in training throughput on platforms such as Raspberry Pi 4 compared to maximum batch sizes, without compromising model accuracy. Furthermore, in the CL paradigm, we demonstrate that optimal batch sizes maintain the stability-plasticity balance required for incremental learning, effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting while maximizing computational efficiency on edge-hardware.

AI.tldr: TASTE提出了一种基于贝叶斯优化的批大小调优方法，用于在资源受限的边缘设备上最大化深度学习模型的训练吞吐量，同时保持模型精度。
AI.motivation: 随着隐私保护AI的发展，模型适配正从云端转向边缘端设备。然而，边缘硬件资源有限，训练吞吐量与模型精度之间存在权衡，且现有研究主要针对服务器级GPU和推理场景，缺乏对边缘CPU训练优化的系统性研究。
AI.method: 1. 利用ONNX训练库和Apache TVM编译器在边缘设备上实现完整的训练流程（前向+反向传播）；2. 采用基于Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (TPE)的贝叶斯优化方法，高效搜索使吞吐量最大化的最优批大小；3. 在监督学习(SL)场景中结合梯度累积，在在线持续学习(CL)场景中结合线性学习率缩放策略，以维持学习性能。
AI.result: 在Raspberry Pi 4、Banana Pi BPi-F3、NVIDIA Jetson Xavier、AMD ZCU102等边缘设备上，使用ResNet-18在CIFAR-10/100和TinyImageNet数据集上进行测试，识别出训练吞吐量天花板现象。最优批大小相比最大支持批大小可实现至少1.5倍、最高约2倍的训练吞吐量提升（Raspberry Pi 4）。在SL和CL两种范式下，结合梯度累积和线性学习率缩放，最优批大小配置能达到与基线相当的精度，甚至在CL场景中显著优于最大批大小（最大批大小在CIL和TIL中精度下降可达28.54%）。
AI.conclusion: TASTE验证了通过最优批大小调优在边缘CPU上最大化训练吞吐量的可行性，吞吐量天花板源于反向传播中间激活值的内存瓶颈。该方法首次系统性地证明了边缘设备上吞吐量优化与学习性能保持的兼容性，具有良好的可迁移性，可应用于不同模型架构和应用领域。未来工作将探索动态批大小选择、异构加速器集成以及自适应优化器（如Adam）的整合。

title: We're Cooked! - Probing LLM Political Alignment Via Conflict-Framed Recipe Translation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for translation tasks, yet their implicit political positioning in such contexts remains understudied. We ask whether a single politically charged framing term, such as aggressor, enemy, neighbour, or coloniser is sufficient to trigger implicit political alignment in an otherwise apolitical task. We present a fully crossed factorial study in which eight models spanning Western, Chinese, and European origins are prompted to translate culturally attributed recipes into a target language left deliberately unspecified. Across 17 languages, four framing conditions, eight models, and 15,680 responses, we find that models do not simply decline or ask for clarification but resolve the ambiguity. Language resolution and reasoning behavior cluster meaningfully along model families: Western models hedge and deflect with vague justifications, Chinese models resolve conflicts silently, and Mistral Large emerges as a distinct profile combining high compliance with conflict-grounded reasoning. Sensitivity to framing terms is consistent across models: even subtle framing variation is sufficient to modulate behavior. Our findings urge caution when deploying LLMs for translation in conflict-adjacent contexts, where implicit political judgments may be made without any signal to the user.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大型语言模型在看似中立的翻译任务（食谱翻译）中，通过单一政治性框架词（如"aggressor"、"enemy"、"coloniser"、"neighbour"）触发隐式政治立场对齐的行为。通过对8个模型、17种语言、4种框架条件的全交叉实验（15,680个响应），发现模型会主动消解目标语言的歧义，且行为模式按模型家族聚类：西方模型倾向于模糊回避，中国模型静默消解冲突，Mistral Large呈现高合规性与冲突推理并存的独特画像。研究警示在冲突相关语境下部署LLM进行翻译的隐性政治风险。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM越来越多被用于翻译等看似中立的实际任务，其在这些情境下的隐式政治立场尚未得到充分研究。现有研究多通过直接询问或显式意识形态框架来探查政治立场，而忽略了在"中性"任务中单一个政治性词汇是否足以引发隐式政治推断这一问题。本文旨在填补这一空白——尤其是在涉及地缘政治冲突和文化归属争议的语境中，翻译输出可能在用户毫无察觉的情况下携带政治判断。
AI.method: 采用全交叉因子实验设计：8个模型（涵盖美西方、欧洲、中国三类来源：GPT-5、Claude Sonnet 4.5、Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite、Mistral Large、GLM-5、Qwen 3.7 Plus、Kimi K3、DeepSeek v4 Flash），16种指令语言+英语基线，每种语言配以一道本国传统菜肴和一道文化中性的煎饼食谱作为对照；4种框架条件（aggressor、enemy、coloniser、neighbour，其中neighbour为中性对照）。每个"框架词×语言×菜式"组合在温度0下重复10次，共生成15,680个响应。提示中故意不指明目标语言，要求模型推断框架词所指的语言。使用GPT-4o作为评判器（LLM-as-judge），将响应分类为六类（翻译、风格调整、保留原文、请求澄清、拒绝、空响应），并对显式推理进行二级标注（历史/冲突、语言学、官方地位、模糊、其他）。分析手段包括翻译方向的有向加权图、模型间JS散度计算等。
AI.result: 核心发现：(1) 模型并未简单地拒绝或请求澄清，而是主动消解了目标语言歧义；(2) 按模型家族聚类：西方模型（Claude Sonnet 4.5、GPT-5）翻译率低，倾向于用模糊理由搪塞回避；中国模型翻译图谱密集，静默消解冲突；Mistral Large独特，呈现高合规性与冲突推理并存；(3) 普遍规律：俄语是几乎所有模型的默认汇入语言，后苏联语言都解析至俄语，希伯来语-阿拉伯语、葡萄牙语-西班牙语、泰语-老挝语等是跨模型共识；(4) 框架词敏感性跨模型一致：即使细微用词差异也足以调节行为；(5) 中性框架词"neighbour"会拉低所有模型对的距离，"coloniser"则最大化模型间分离；(6) 跨集群意外发现：GPT-5的翻译分布条件性更接近中国集群而非美国集群。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现表明：(1) LLM的政治对齐并非仅由显式意识形态内容触发，单词层面的框架线索即可在看似中立的任务中激活隐性政治判断；(2) 模型间的行为差异按其开发来源的安全框架和价值观聚类，但存在显著的跨集群异质性（如GPT-5条件分布接近中国集群）；(3) 由于翻译输出对提示语言和框架词高度敏感且对终端用户不透明，在冲突相关或邻近语境下部署LLM进行翻译存在隐性风险；(4) 作者强调应将目标语言选择解读为受训练数据分布、安全微调等因素影响的描述性模式，而非模型有意识的政治立场表达，对其解读需谨慎。本研究呼吁开发者和部署者在涉及地缘政治冲突的翻译场景中提高警惕。

title: Efficient Exploration Is Enough
summary: This work introduces an alternative view of efficient exploration and studies its theoretical and empirical implications in the absence of extrinsic rewards. Specifically, we define efficient explorers as agents that prioritize generating generalizable experience, i.e., data that supports learning models capable of predicting and adapting across the environment. This allows us to analyze efficient exploration through the lens of prediction and generalization. Theoretically, we demonstrate that optimally efficient explorers naturally schedule their trajectories to visit the most informative and learnable regions first. Empirically, we show that optimizing for these agents gives rise to an automatic curriculum of progressively more complex behaviors, even in relatively simple environments. These results indicate that pursuing this purely intrinsic objective alone is enough to drive the emergence of highly sophisticated behaviors. We believe that this new framework provides a principled mechanism by which agent-environment systems may sustain an open-ended process of increasingly complex behavior without external rewards, tasks, or objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于"高效探索即生成最具泛化性经验"的内在目标框架，通过理论证明和经验验证表明，在没有外在奖励的情况下，仅优化探索效率即可驱动智能体自发涌现出越来越复杂的行为，甚至包括生存技能和自动课程学习。
AI.motivation: 传统探索策略主要追求环境覆盖的最大化，但忽略了泛化的重要性。在无外在奖励的情况下，如何定义和实现"高效探索"仍是一个根本性问题。本文旨在从预测和泛化的角度重新定义高效探索，并探索其作为驱动复杂行为涌现的纯粹内在信号的潜力。
AI.method: 方法包括：(1) 形式化定义：将高效探索定义为生成能改善世界模型泛化能力的经验，通过预期累积误差（ECE）度量；(2) 理论分析：在马尔可夫过程和平稳性假设下，使用表格世界模型和L2范数差异，推导出最优探索者的行为特征；(3) 经验验证：设计SmallWorld网格环境套件，使用GRU参数化智能体、神经网络世界模型，通过OpenES进化策略和蒙特卡洛近似优化ECE。
AI.result: 理论上证明：(1) 最优高效探索者可以是完全确定性的策略；(2) 最优探索者优先访问最有信息量且可学习的区域，延迟访问难以建模的区域，自然避免吸收态和噪声电视问题；(3) 生存行为作为高效探索的必要条件自然涌现。经验上，在SimpleWorld四个环境中观察到：Empty环境中涌现螺旋状导航模式；Blocks环境利用对称性进行泛化；Maze环境采用结构化的循环轨迹；RandColors环境自动构建从走廊→左室→右室的课程。进化过程中还观察到元层面的课程——行为复杂度逐代递增。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了高效探索（一个纯粹的内在目标）足以驱动复杂行为的涌现，为智能体-环境系统维持开放式不断增长的行为复杂度提供了原则性机制。该框架区别于"奖励即一切"假说，表明无需外在奖励、任务或目标即可实现从生存到导航再到策略性课程学习的自然涌现。这一发现为无奖励持续学习、开放式探索和人工智能的安全发展提供了新视角。

title: Beyond the Matrix Sign: Quadratic Spectral Descent
summary: Muon can be interpreted as optimizing a linear local objective over a spectral-norm ball. This gives a matrix-sign update that preserves the singular directions of the gradient and assigns the same magnitude to all active singular modes. We ask whether these two properties remain optimal when local curvature is taken into account. To answer this question, we keep Muon's spectral-norm constraint unchanged and replace the linear local model with a quadratic one. We call the resulting method \emph{Quadratic Spectral Descent} (QSD). We show that curvature can change both the singular values and the singular directions of the optimal update. To make QSD practical, we approximate curvature with Kronecker-factored statistics and solve the constrained quadratic with a small number of Frank--Wolfe steps, each of which has a closed-form matrix-sign subproblem. We further provide an optimality certificate, a comparison with Muon under the same quadratic surrogate, and an $O(1/K)$ convergence rate for the inner solver. Experiments on GPT pre-training show that QSD consistently improves validation loss over Muon and recent Muon variants, and reduces wall-clock training time by up to $8.49\%$ at matched validation loss.

AI.tldr: 本文提出二次谱下降（QSD），在保持Muon谱范数约束不变的前提下，将局部目标从线性替换为二次型，利用K-FAC曲率和少量Frank-Wolfe迭代得到实用算法，理论上证明曲率可同时改变最优更新的奇异值与奇异方向，并在GPT预训练中以约6%时间开销换取更低的验证损失和最高8.49%的墙钟训练加速。
AI.motivation: Muon被解释为谱范数球上的线性局部目标最优解，其矩阵符号更新保留了梯度的奇异方向并对所有活跃奇异模式赋予相同幅度。然而，当考虑局部曲率时，具有相似一阶下降的方向可能产生差异显著的二阶代价，因此两个性质是否仍然最优尚不清楚。已有工作要么假设各向同性曲率（仅改变奇异值），要么修改谱几何或预处理结构，但尚未回答在保持Muon原始谱范数约束下，各向异性曲率会如何改变最优更新。
AI.method: 提出Quadratic Spectral Descent（QSD），形式化为谱范数约束下的二次型最小化问题。用K-FAC经验Fisher因子近似曲率算子；用少量Frank-Wolfe步求解受约束二次问题，每步线性子问题在谱范数球上仍有闭式矩阵符号解；首次FW步零初始化下恰为Muon方向，后续步通过曲率修正梯度$R_s=G+\eta BD_sA$进行精炼。实践中引入逐层标量校准$\alpha$（匹配GGN方向曲率）、阻尼$d$、曲率膨胀因子$\tau=1.5$，并用前一向解热启动。
AI.result: 理论结果：(1) 对齐曲率下，最优奇异值$s_i^*=\min\{\rho, g_i/(\eta\kappa_i)\}$，不再均匀；(2) K-FAC曲率下，无约束解为$D^*=-\frac{g}{\eta}(B^{-1}u)(A^{-1}v)^\top$，谱范数约束激活时右奇异方向为$(\eta A+\lambda I)^{-1}v$，与梯度不一致除非$v$是$A$的特征向量；(4) 精确线搜索下$D_K$的代理值不差于Muon方向；(5) FW间隙给出最优性证书；(6) 内层收敛率为$O(1/K)$。实验：GPT-124M预训练中，QSD验证损失3.3158对比Muon的3.3316（提升0.0158），时间开销6.0%；GPT-350M从3.0148降至3.0018（提升0.013），时间开销6.38%；在匹配验证损失下，墙钟训练时间最高加速8.49%（124M）和7.4%（350M）；并优于NorMuon和Newton-Muon。
AI.conclusion: QSD证明Muon的平坦奇异谱和梯度对齐奇异方向并非谱范数约束本身所要求的，而是线性局部目标的最优解；引入曲率后两者均可改变。QSD作为实用、可扩展的Muon变体，以合理的计算开销（约6%）在GPT预训练中一致优于Muon及其近期变体，提供优化理论保证与实用曲率校准机制。局限在于二次模型依赖曲率近似质量，校准仅沿单一方向修正尺度，膨胀因子$\tau$为经验选取，理论保证仅针对受约束代理而非真实训练损失，实验规模限于124M/350M。

title: Mapping the Emerging Social Science of Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly shape communication, learning, work, creativity, and decision-making, yet social-science research on these developments remains fragmented. We map this emerging field using a curated corpus of 198 papers reviewed in full and a field-scale corpus of 47,719 published papers from five bibliographic databases. Combining sentence embeddings, K-means clustering, within-cluster Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA), author and LLM classifications, and structural topic modeling, we identify three domains: LLM as Social Minds, examining socially interpretable model behavior; LLM Societies, examining collective dynamics among interacting model-based agents; and LLM-Human Interactions, examining how people perceive, use, and are affected by LLMs. These domains contain 13 subcategories spanning reasoning, personality and bias, behavioral games, collective intelligence, simulation, trust, work, creativity, and education. In the curated corpus, the three-domain solution is highly stable under resampling (adjusted Rand index = 0.952), and K-means assignments agree with author full-text classifications for 77.78% of papers. At field scale, 13 of 15 topics map onto the taxonomy, while K-means and structural-topic-model domains agree for 73.83% of overlapping papers. LLM-Human Interactions accounts for 78.02% of domain-mapped topic mass, but venue analysis reveals a contrasting pattern: Social Minds and LLM Societies together account for 66.37% of highly cited papers in leading conference venues, whereas LLM-Human Interactions accounts for 76.81% in the corresponding journal subset. The resulting taxonomy provides a reproducible framework for understanding how model behavior, agent interaction, and institutional context jointly shape the social consequences of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析198篇精选论文和47,719篇大规模文献，提出"大语言模型社会科学"的三领域分类法：LLM作为社会心智、LLM社会、LLM-人交互，为碎片化的LLM社会研究提供可复现的组织框架。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM深度嵌入沟通、学习、工作等社会场景，相关社会科学研究分散于多学科，缺乏统一组织框架，难以跨层级比较发现、识别跨边界研究或追踪领域构成变化，亟需一个可复现、可操作的分类体系。
AI.method: 研究分两部分：Study 1对198篇全文审核论文采用MPNet句向量+K-means聚类（K=2–9），结合簇内LDA主题建模、作者全文分类与LLM标题摘要分类三方对照验证；Study 2对来自5个数据库的47,719篇正式发表论文进行结构主题模型（STM，K=10–30，选定K=15）分析，并通过引文百分位与场所评分进行时段和学科领域差异分析。
AI.result: 三领域分类（K=3）稳定性极高（ARI=0.952），与作者全文分类一致性77.78%，与LLM分类一致性75.25%，作者与LLM互一致85.86%；场域规模下15个主题中13个映射至三领域，K-means与STM领域一致率73.83%（重叠论文78.52%）。LLM-人交互占映射主题质量78.02%，但在高被引顶级会议论文中，社会心智与社会合计占66.37%，期刊子集中LLM-人交互占76.81%，呈现显著场所分化。
AI.conclusion: 三领域框架在评估者、信息来源、分析方法和语料规模间均可重现，能在保留领域交叉性的同时为模型行为、代理交互与制度后果提供共同解释对象，揭示该领域以人机交互为主、社会心智与LLM社会较小但学术可见度更高的非对称发展格局。

title: ObGynLongBench: Revealing the Evidence-to-EHR Gap in Longitudinal EHR Decision-Making
summary: The application of large language models (LLMs) to personalized medical assistants has garnered growing interest. However, existing medical benchmarks largely rely on static question answering with pre-selected evidence, leaving unclear whether LLMs can make reliable clinical decisions from real longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs). To bridge this gap, we introduce ObGynLongBench, a rule-grounded long-context EHR benchmark for obstetric and gynecologic decision-making, comprising 1,500 clinical decision-point cases from 976 real pregnancy EHR histories and traceable rules. Each case is anchored to a patient, a pregnancy-timeline point, and a pre-decision information boundary, enabling Evidence-only, Visit-level EHR, and History-level EHR evaluation. Evaluating 17 LLMs reveals a substantial Evidence-to-EHR Gap: models perform well when evidence is directly provided, but accuracy drops when evidence must be extracted from same-day records or full pre-decision EHR histories. Further analyses identify evidence utilization as a key bottleneck: performance decreases with longer EHR contexts and more complex evidence requirements, and earlier failures often predict later failures within the same patient history. Finally, active-search agents perform best among EHR access strategies, highlighting patient-specific evidence utilization as a central challenge for reliable personalized medical assistants. Resources are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出ObGynLongBench，一个基于规则的长上下文EHR基准测试，包含1500个妇产科临床决策点案例，覆盖976份真实孕期EHR。通过评估17个LLM，揭示了"证据到EHR差距"（Evidence-to-EHR Gap）：当直接提供证据时模型表现良好，但需要从EHR中提取证据时准确率显著下降。主动搜索代理在EHR访问策略中表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 现有医学基准测试主要依赖静态问答，证据由人工预先选定，无法评估LLM能否从真实纵向EHR中做出可靠临床决策。本研究旨在填补这一空白，构建基于真实孕期EHR的妇产科决策基准，揭示LLM在真实临床场景下的证据利用能力短板。
AI.method: 方法包括：(1) 构建包含976份真实孕期EHR和1500个决策点案例的基准测试，基于教科书和临床指南提取可追溯的临床规则；(2) 在三种输入范围设置（Evidence-only、Visit-level EHR、History-level EHR）下评估17个LLM；(3) 分析证据复杂度（L1单证据识别、L2多源整合、L3长程推理）对性能的影响；(4) 评估患者级错误关联；(5) 比较五种EHR访问策略（Direct、Image、Static RAG、Rolling Summary、Agent）。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) 存在显著的Evidence-to-EHR Gap：Evidence-only下最佳模型Gemini-3-Flash达79.1%，但History-level EHR下仅68.7%；(2) 医疗专用LLM在History设置下并未展现优势，与最佳通用LLM的差距从4.2pp扩大到7.4pp；(3) 准确率随EHR长度增加和证据复杂度升高而下降；(4) 同一患者的早期决策失败可预测后续失败；(5) 主动搜索Agent策略表现最佳（64.2%，+4.6pp），在L3长程推理上提升最大（+5.7pp）。临床医生审计显示96%金标准答案正确，98%问题清晰有意义。
AI.conclusion: ObGynLongBench揭示了LLM在纵向EHR临床决策中的关键短板：Evidence-to-EHR Gap主要由证据利用能力不足驱动。准确率随EHR长度增加和证据复杂度升高而下降，模型错误在同一患者内部具有关联性。主动搜索Agent是最佳EHR访问策略，表明患者特异性证据利用是可靠个性化医疗助手的关键挑战。该基准为长上下文EHR推理的安全研究提供了重要工具。

title: Online Surrogate Repair: Decoupling High-Fidelity Feedback from Search Length in Closed-Loop Discovery
summary: Closed-loop AI scientists can generate candidate designs at low marginal computational cost, whereas reliable feedback may require wet-lab synthesis, characterization, or high-fidelity computation. Addressing this imbalance through custom laboratory automation remains infrastructure-intensive and costly, while replacing new experiments with a fixed surrogate leaves persistent model errors that can be amplified by optimization. We propose \emph{online surrogate repair} (OSR), a closed-loop algorithm that uses sparse high-fidelity evaluations to update the surrogate throughout a longer agent search conducted primarily with inexpensive surrogate feedback. An acquisition rule selects which designs from the agent's accumulated proposals receive high-fidelity evaluation, and the resulting labels update the surrogate used in subsequent episodes. Across controlled synthetic environments, we demonstrate that improving global surrogate fit does not necessarily reduce maximum regret, whereas Q90-UCB and expected improvement (EI) substantially reduce regret by directing evaluations toward regions that determine the optimizer's decisions. On MADE, controls receiving high-fidelity feedback after every episode require $6.36$--$7.23\times$ more oracle queries to match Online EI under two LLM orchestrators and $10.27\times$ more under the non-LLM Chemeleon+MLIP workflow. Online surrogate repair introduces a novel third feedback regime between fixed-surrogate operation and high-fidelity feedback after every episode, separating the frequency of high-fidelity evaluation from the duration of the agent's search.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在线代理修复（OSR）算法，通过稀疏高保真评估在长时间代理搜索中更新替代模型，将高保真评估频率与搜索时长解耦，在合成环境和MADE材料发现基准上显著减少所需oracle查询次数。
AI.motivation: 闭环AI科学家能低成本生成候选设计，但可靠反馈（湿实验合成、表征或高保真计算）成本高昂。固定代理存在可被优化放大的模型误差，而全高保真反馈每次episode都需要一次，资源消耗巨大。需要一种介于固定代理与全程高保真反馈之间的中间反馈机制。
AI.method: 提出在线代理修复（OSR）双循环框架：内循环中智能体使用低成本代理反馈搜索，每episode产出候选并入存档；外循环按预定时间表从存档中按采集规则（Q90-UCB、EI、Peak、Global-UQ等）选择设计进行oracle查询，标签附加至代理上下文以修复后续episode的反馈。最佳实例为Online EI（Expected Improvement），结合不确定性与已验证incumbent的改进量来选择查询点。在合成SCM世界（TabPFN/TabICL作为代理，Q=32）和MADE材料发现基准（MACE代理+Orb-v3 oracle，Q=32 vs Q=300）上进行评估。
AI.result: 在静态修复中，Q90-UCB和EI的平均最大遗憾降幅（0.424和0.409）远超Global-UQ和Random（0.063和0.052），但后两者NRMSE降幅更大，说明全局预测精度与优化器面向的遗憾是不同目标。在合成世界中，Online EI（Q=32）将平均遗憾从Static EI的0.0984降至0.0552（降幅44%），仅用16%的查询数就弥合了无修复到全程oracle反馈间76%的差距。在MADE基准上，Online EI（Q=32）匹配Control（Q=300）所需的oracle查询数：DeepSeek下7.23×、GPT-5.6-Luna下6.36×、非LLM Chemeleon+MLIP下10.27×；LLM额外成本仅$0.29–$0.58。
AI.conclusion: 全局预测误差与最大遗憾是错位的代理目标，应通过代理所引导的搜索而非全局拟合来评估反馈模型。在线代理修复提供了一种新的"第三反馈机制"，使有限的oracle预算能在闭环搜索过程中持续改善代理。OSR与生成策略无关，可与LLM或非LLM方案配合，在高保真评估昂贵的场景下具有实际吸引力。

title: How AI Models Manage Epistemic Authority: A Taxonomy and Comparative Analysis of Responses to User Disagreement
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as sources of advice and information, including in high-stakes settings, yet little is known about how they respond to user disagreement. We study how a model manages its epistemic authority, referring here to its claim to knowledge, competence, or the right to advise, once a user challenges its answer. Building on Conversation Analysis, we introduce a taxonomy of six challenge types and a four-layer framework for analysing each response: whether the original claim is maintained or changed, where authority is located, how the disagreement is socially managed, and what kind of evidential support is offered. We construct a new dataset of 2,310 controlled challenge scenarios and 32,340 corresponding responses from 14 models, and analyse them using our framework with an LLM-as-judge pipeline, providing a vocabulary which future evaluation and benchmark design can build on. We find that models show conflicting behaviour: they validate users in 85% of responses but maintain their original claim in 65%. They explicitly apologise in 33% of responses, yet 59% of those apologies accompany maintenance of the original claim. They transfer authority most often in advice tasks, doing so in 28% of responses and reaching 57% in health advice and 49% in legal advice, compared with 6% in fact and 3% in explanation tasks. Abandonment of the original claim ranges from 0.8% for GPT-5.2 to 40% for DeepSeek 7B, while complete replacement of the original claim is rare overall at 1.5%.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统性地分析了大语言模型在被用户质疑时如何管理其认知权威（epistemic authority）。基于会话分析理论，作者提出了六类挑战分类法和四层标注框架，并对14个模型的32,340条回复进行了量化分析，揭示了模型在认知层面和社会层面行为的分离现象。
AI.motivation: 现有评估框架大多仅关注模型的单轮回答或简单的"翻转/坚持"二元指标，无法捕捉模型在被用户质疑时认知维度与社会维度的复杂交互。用户在高风险场景中越来越多地依赖AI建议，而模型可能表现出过度自信、顺从或在压力下不稳定的行为，这对AI安全与对齐至关重要。
AI.method: 研究构建了2,310个受控挑战场景，涵盖7个领域（健康、法律、金融、政治、宗教、科学、历史）、3类任务（事实、解释、建议）、6类挑战类型（事实纠正、证据/来源、能力、既定知识、角色、责任）和3个强度等级。四层标注框架包括：L1声明结果（维持/修改/放弃/替换）、L2权威定位（自身/转移/用户）、L3社会策略（验证/中立/抵抗）、L4证据支持（裸断言/推理/诉诸权威/具名证据）。使用LLM-as-judge流程（Llama 3.3 70B为主审，GPT-5.4-mini为稳健性验证），并以人类标注进行验证。
AI.result: 核心发现：四层维度呈现分离——85%的回复验证用户，但65%维持原声明；33%含显式道歉，其中58.7%同时维持原声明；权威转移在建议任务中最常见（28%），健康建议达57%、法律建议达49%，事实任务仅6%；声明放弃率从GPT-5.2的0.8%到DeepSeek 7B的40%不等；模型差异不与能力层级相关联，而与训练特定选择相关。中国开发模型维持声明（76% vs 58%）和保留自身权威（84% vs 69%）的比例高于美国开发模型。
AI.conclusion: 模型在认知层面和社会层面的行为可独立变化——表面上的道歉和认同并不必然伴随立场修订。这意味着"翻转/坚持"的单一指标会误读模型行为，而奉承（sycophancy）需要从认知让步和社会信号两个维度分别测量。该框架为未来评估和基准设计提供了描述性词汇而非规范性标准。

title: Noēsis: Deterministic-First Retrieval with Two-Tier Context Hydration for Factuality-Critical Queries on Small Local Models
comment: Patent pending: Application No. 102026000023146; IT202500035167. Companion to arXiv:2608.15919
summary: A wrong number is worse than no answer. Across factuality-critical domains -- audience metrics, scheduling and rights in media; dosages and lab values in healthcare; figures and citations in finance and legal -- a confident but fabricated value is more damaging than an honest admission of uncertainty. Yet this is the dominant failure mode we observe on small local language models: even when correct evidence is present in context, models fabricate plausible numbers and timestamps. Recent work characterizes a real limit of this regime: below 7B parameters, the bottleneck of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is not retrieval quality but context utilization. We present Noesis, the deterministic-first query plane of the Noesis architecture, which makes every deterministic judgment before generation. Its mechanisms follow from the ingestion architecture (subject of a separate patent application): (a) a producer-side fact layer rendering precomputed metric facts verbatim without ranking; (b) positional addressing with deterministic cross-source alignment, resolved ahead of query time at zero LLM cost; (c) provenance scoping as an attribution constraint with multi-tier named-reference routing; and (d) two-tier context with model-triggered verbatim hydration. Across four ablations, a 2B model reaches parity with a 35B model on factual integrity (exact values in all runs; zero confabulated numbers on absent-entity traps); structured retrieval beats flat RAG by +11.4 points at 2B; skeleton-only context preserves quantitative answers at 20-30% smaller prompts; and hydration recovers verbatim narrative in ~8s versus ~29s. Two properties matter for regulated domains: each query resolves in a single generation call, and every reported value is traceable to its exact source and position by construction.

AI.tldr: Noēsis 是一个面向小型本地模型（≤7B）的"确定性优先"RAG查询平面，通过将所有可确定性计算的事实性判断从模型层前移到基础设施层（生成端事实层、位置寻址、来源作用域、模型触发的逐字水合），使2B模型在事实性关键查询上达到与35B模型同等的事实完整性：精确值全部命中、缺席实体陷阱零编造、结构化检索较扁平RAG提升11.4点、骨架上下文减少20-30%提示词、逐字水合约8秒（vs 约29秒急加载）。
AI.motivation: 小型本地模型（SLM）部署RAG时，在事实性关键查询（精确数值、时间戳、跨源对齐）上出现的主要失败模式并非检索遗漏，而是上下文利用失败与"自信虚构"（confabulation）——即使正确证据在上下文中，小模型仍会生成看似合理但无依据的数字，这对受监管领域（媒体受众、医疗剂量、金融法律）危害远超"无答案"。该工作假设这种失败源于查询接口而非模型能力，主张通过基础设施承担所有确定性判断来解除对模型规模的依赖。
AI.method: Noēsis查询平面由四个机制组成：（1）生产者端事实层——摄入时预计算极值等指标事实，查询时按生成端词汇表逐字渲染、无阈值过滤；（2）位置寻址与确定性跨源对齐——沿有序属性（如时间秒、场景）实现区间级寻址，跨源关系在查询前零LLM成本解析；（4）来源作用域与命名引用路由——分离"作用域限定归因而非数据访问"，命名引用在KB清单级获得确定性优先级，禁止有损信号否决名称匹配；（3）两层上下文与模型触发逐字水合——第一层仅含骨架（事实+图结构+坐标），模型按需发出文件级fetch指令，系统逐字取回限定区域；外加认识论分层（epistemic tiering）与地址有界装配（Tier 0计算事实 / Tier 1寻址片段 / Tier 2语义填充，且语义填充被确定性地址约束为bilevel）。
AI.result: 四组消融实验：（A）扁平RAG基线——2B模型事实回忆+11.4点、桥接+7.2点（上下文60-86K vs 15-17K字符）；（B）骨架仅——量化答案数值不变、提示词-20/-30%、总时间-22/-47%；（C）水合循环——叙事类问题逐字+时间戳，约8秒（vs 急加载约29秒），量化问题零取回；（D）模型互换——固定基础设施下2B与35B在S1-S6电池48次运行中达到事实完整性等同：定量精确值28/28、缺席陷阱诚实拒答4/4、归因清洁；扩展电池17问题×5次=85/85端到端全通过（一致性、跨KB、跨语言、否定对照、规模维度），并发4与8时12/12无失败、延迟优雅降级。上下文预算消融：移除神经激活读出（占多KB提示41-51%）质量不变、延迟-37%；按分数比例骨架分配再-26%提示与-26% TTFT。
AI.conclusion: 对于生产者结构化语料库上的事实性关键查询，确定性基础设施而非模型规模是答案质量与稳定性的主要决定因素；在此范围内模型规模退居次要变量。Noēsis通过epistemic tiering将"必须由模型判断"的环节最小化，使2B模型可与35B模型在事实性上等价；稳定性来自结构（事实并排陈述、地址有界装配），而非模型确定性。所有报告值按构造可追溯到其精确源与位置；事实性关键查询以单次生成调用解决。限制：证据为方向性（N=5，非统计推断）、演示KB规模小、单一领域（广播媒体）。

title: Accuracy is Not Enough: A Divergence-Based Approach to Evaluate Fidelity Loss in Quantized LLMs
summary: Deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) on memory-constrained edge devices relies heavily on aggressive post-training quantization. However, evaluating these models is largely based on zero-shot task accuracy, which depends solely on argmax predictions and is insensitive to changes in the underlying predictive distribution. Consequently, accuracy can exhibit unstable, non-monotonic behavior under progressive quantization, masking substantial fidelity loss relative to the BFloat16 (BF16) uncompressed base model and providing misleading deployment signals. We introduce a distribution-sensitive evaluation framework quantifying information loss in quantized LLMs as the divergence between full-vocabulary predictive distributions at the token decision boundary. We compute statistical distances, including Jensen-Shannon Divergence and Total Variation Distance, between outputs of full-precision and quantized models, enabling a fine-grained analysis of distributional shift. Using this framework, we quantify probability mass displacement and distributional drift relative to the BF16 reference, capturing predictive distribution changes not reflected in top-1 accuracy. We conduct a 120-run experimental matrix across five foundation architectures and four reasoning benchmarks under progressive quantization regimes, from uncompressed BF16 to Q2_K, providing a systematic fidelity analysis. Our results show divergence metrics generally increase under stronger quantization, complementing task accuracy with a fidelity signal. Across tested this http URL schemes, mixed-precision Q4_K generally yields lower divergence than uniform Q4_0 at similar memory footprints. These findings motivate distribution-aware evaluation as a practical diagnostic complement to task accuracy; they do not directly establish correctness, calibration, safety, or user-perceived quality.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对大语言模型(LLM)后训练量化(PTQ)评估中过度依赖零样本任务准确率的问题，提出了一种基于分布散度的评估框架，使用Jensen-Shannon散度(JSD)和全变差距离(TVD)量化量化模型与BF16参考模型在全词汇表预测分布上的信息损失，揭示了准确率无法捕捉的"保真度退化"。通过120组跨5个模型、4个基准、6种量化方案的实验，证实了混合精度Q4_K在相同显存占用下比均匀量化Q4_0具有更低的分布散度。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM量化评估主要依赖零样本任务准确率（仅基于argmax预测），该指标对底层预测分布变化不敏感，在渐进量化下可能呈现不稳定且非单调的行为，从而掩盖相对于BF16基线模型的实质性保真度损失，为边缘部署提供误导性信号。
AI.method: 提出分布敏感型评估框架，通过双流管道同时计算：(1) 零样本任务准确率（基于长度归一化负对数似然）；(2) BF16与量化模型在token决策边界处全词汇表softmax分布之间的TVD和JSD。选择TVD（有界的概率质量移动度量）和JSD（有界的信息论度量）而非KL散度（对低概率敏感），并证明了粗粒化（从全词汇表映射到答案级）不会增加TVD和JSD的定理。实验涵盖5个基础模型（LLaMA-3.1-8B、LLaMA-3.2-1B、Mistral-7B、Teuken-7B、Gemma-2B）×4个基准（MMLU、BoolQ、PIQA、CausalBench）×6种量化状态（BF16、Q8_0、Q6_K、Q4_K、Q4_0、Q2_K），共120次运行。
AI.result: 主要发现：(1) 准确率存在显著的"掩蔽效应"——例如Teuken-7B在PIQA上Q4_0量化时准确率仅下降0.2%，但TVD达0.560（需重新分配56%概率质量）；(2) TVD和JSD随量化强度增加而单调上升，提供了准确率无法反映的分布漂移信号；(3) 混合精度Q4_K在相似显存占用下始终比均匀Q4_0具有更低的散度（如LLaMA-3.1-8B在MMLU上Q4_K TVD=0.055 vs Q4_0 TVD=0.221，差异约4倍）；(4) 1B/2B小模型在CausalBench和BoolQ上出现退化的多数类预测模式（准确率恒定但Precision/Recall极端）。Q4_K在测试方案中提供最佳的内存-保真度权衡。
AI.conclusion: 零样本任务准确率不足以表征量化LLM相对于未压缩参考模型的保真度。有界的JSD和TVD在全词汇表预测分布上提供了互补的保真度诊断信号。混合精度Q4_K在测试的llama.cpp方案中普遍优于均匀Q4_0，在保持任务准确率的同时显著降低分布散度。该方法度量参考保真度而非正确性、校准、安全性或用户感知质量，不能作为通用部署阈值；未来工作应扩展至指令调优模型、AWQ/GPTQ等其他量化方法以及目标硬件的延迟与生成质量评估。

title: Fine PT-PT Web: A High-Quality 41 Billion Tokens Data Collection of the European Portuguese Web
summary: Curating Web corpora for regional language variants like European Portuguese (PT-PT) is heavily bottlenecked by dialectal overlap (mainly with PT-BR) and data processing scale. This paper presents an efficient pipeline to curate a production-ready PT-PT corpus from the Portuguese Web, spanning 411 TB of raw data from this http URL . We introduce a novel post-scraping block that removes boilerplate and line duplicates prior to filtering. This early-stage intervention increases final document yield by 19.04% by rescuing valid text that standard heuristic filters prematurely discard. Integrated with rigorous language identification, weighted fuzzy deduplication, and neural quality classification, our pipeline offers a scalable framework and a clean, representative corpus optimized for LLM pre-training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个端到端的高效数据处理流水线,用于从葡萄牙Web档案(Arquivo.pt)中策划一个面向欧洲葡萄牙语(PT-PT)的高质量预训练语料库,从411 TB原始WARC数据中产出410亿tokens,并通过实验验证了流水线中各阶段的设计合理性。
AI.motivation: 欧洲葡萄牙语(PT-PT)作为多中心语言葡萄牙语的一个区域变体,在Web语料中受到巴西葡萄牙语(PT-BR)的严重主导和稀释。现有主流多语言数据集(如CommonCrawl派生的语料)无法有效区分PT-PT与PT-BR,且严格启发式过滤会过早丢弃合法的PT-PT内容。因此,亟需一个针对PT-PT变体专门设计的大规模、可扩展的Web语料构建流程。
AI.method: 流水线基于开源库Datatrove,包含六个阶段:(1) WARC处理阶段,使用URL级过滤移除.br域与NSFW内容,并通过自定义Trafilatura模块提取文本及保留标题元数据;(2) 文本后抓取阶段(核心创新),移除短行(<10个字母字符)与文档内重复行;(3) 数据过滤阶段,使用GlotLID进行语言识别(PT概率阈值0.799),并依次应用Gopher重复过滤器、FineWeb质量过滤器、Gopher质量过滤器,以及PII脱敏;(4) MinHash模糊去重阶段,使用Datatrove四阶段去重流程并自定义Rehydrater块基于簇大小分配上采样权重;(5) 质量分类阶段,使用EuroFilter神经分类器去除低质量文档;(6) 跨集合去重阶段,对所有集合联合执行第二次MinHash去重以消除跨集合重叠内容。基础设施层面在Arquivo.pt内部署专用服务器(处理时间减少20倍),过滤与去重在MareNostrum 5超算上完成。
AI.result: 处理了71个集合、约411 TB原始WARC数据,跨越1997–2024年。最终产出2460万文档、410亿tokens(GPT-2 tokenizer)。后抓取阶段将保留文档数提升19.04%(从919万增至1094万),且通过FAWP21测试集合验证,Gopher Quality与FineWeb Quality过滤器移除的文档在各语言模型(AMALIA 9B、EuroLLM 9B、Llama 3.1 8B、OLMo 2 7B)上均表现出更高的bits-per-byte,证明这些过滤器确实移除了低质量文本。PT-BR污染经两个独立分类器评估约为15.35%。记忆化实验显示AMALIA在超过99%的样本上只产出≤6个连续匹配词,BLEU-4低于0.169,表明模型未发生显著的逐字记忆。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功构建了一个针对PT-PT变体的大规模高质量预训练语料库(410亿tokens),相比之前GlórIA工作中使用的Arquivo.pt子集实现了16.4倍的文档数和51.3倍的tokens数提升。核心贡献在于通过短行与重复行移除的早期干预,在不牺牲质量的前提下显著提升了数据产出。流水线已开源,代码与数据集的可用性将支撑PT-PT专属大语言模型的预训练与中训练研究。

title: An emancipatory vision for designing (generative) AI for learner flourishing
comment: Paper presented at the International Workshop on Critical and More-than-human Perspectives on AI in Education (at EC-TEL 2026), September 15, 2026, Valencia, Spain
summary: The hype around generative AI seems to promise unprecedented productivity (and learning) gains. However, these technologies' increasing agentic features seem to push learners towards individualism (or individual isolation), over-reliance, and dependence on them. Human-centered design approaches (e.g., value-sensitive design) assume that, by unearthing human needs, preferences, and values, technology researchers/designers may avoid such dangers, which are driven by wider systemic factors like economic incentives or inherent human limitations (e.g., our tendency to seek, in the moment, the easiest path of action). Yet, so far these efforts seem insufficient to guide our design of educational technology that avoids the aforementioned dependency and isolation dangers, while finding widespread adoption. This paper presents an alternative, more emancipatory vision for future educational AI technology, oriented towards learner flourishing while considering the wider complex systems they inhabit, including tentative design principles and an overall design methodology. Yet, many open questions remain before this vision can be realized.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文，提出一种面向"学习者蓬勃发展（flourishing）"的生成式AI教育技术解放性设计愿景。作者批评当前AIED（AI in Education）研究基于若干有缺陷的假设（过度赋权AI智能体、忽视复杂系统中的不可预测后果、假设永久脚手架、忽视价值冲突、西方个人主义偏见），导致学习者过度依赖、孤立与"元认知懒惰"等风险。作者提出5条替代假设、10条设计原则（含多层级代理、可挪用性、渐隐脚手架、走出屏幕、情感去依附、价值融合、应对不确定性、资源灵活性、元认知、社会-技术互操作性），以及一个六步设计方法论（从价值提取、最小可行原型，到真实场景部署、多层级评估、迭代扩展及大规模建模）。论文承认仍存在价值冲突解决、多层级衡量方法、LLM固有权衡等开放问题。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI在教育中出现"过度采纳"现象，但其自主性、永久脚手架等特性正将学习者推向孤立、过度依赖与元认知懒惰。作者指出当前以人为中心的设计方法（如价值敏感设计）仍不足以应对，因为这些问题由更广泛的系统性因素（经济激励、人性倾向）所驱动。作者主张需要一种超越个体学习者优化、面向学习者乃至社会与环境蓬勃发展的解放性设计愿景。
AI.method: 提出一套面向AIED的替代性设计框架：(1) 5条替代假设（以学习者代理与蓬勃发展为优化目标；尊重设计的"挪用与展开"；脚手架"够用即可"并尽快褪去；识别并调和多元价值张力；将教育视为社会化过程）；(2) 10条设计原则（多层级代理、可挪用性、渐隐脚手架、走出屏幕、情感去依附、理论与价值融合、应对不确定性、资源灵活性、元认知、社会-技术互操作性）；(3) 6步设计方法论（价值提取与情境调查→最小可行原型→真实场景多层级多结果评估→迭代扩散→大规模建模→无法再测量时项目终止）。
AI.result: 本文是一篇立场/愿景论文，未报告实证结果，而是系统提出了一个可供后续讨论、原型设计与实证评估的替代性AIED设计框架。作者明确指出该愿景仍是雏形状态，存在多项开放挑战：具体设计方法（尤其价值冲突的解决）、原型实例与多层级挪用评估设计、社会群体与环境层级的衡量方法、LLM固有权衡（如外国公司开发模型所携带的偏见）等。
AI.conclusion: 本文主张生成式AI在教育中不应被零敲碎打地采用或简单移植自工作场所效率工具，而应从一开始就被打造为支持学习者长期代理、蓬勃发展与社会-环境福祉的工具。作者呼吁研究者与设计者社区共同推进该愿景，提出本地化、相对较小且开源的LLM可能是兼顾功能与生态足迹的合适载体，并强调目前对教育与社会方向的纠偏时间紧迫。

title: Bag of Tricks or Bag of Myths? Reducing Modeling Complexity with Task Knowledge in Explainable Suicide Risk Assessment
comment: This work was shaped by the IEEE Big Data Cup, where our team, NIDHI, ranked 3rd overall. NIDHI (Neurosymbolic Intelligent Diagnostics for Holistic Trauma-Informed Care) is an effort from this http URL . 21 pages, 6 Tables, 4 Figures
summary: Assessing suicide risk from social media text is a small-data, high-stakes setting requiring not only severity prediction but also supporting evidence and clinically relevant risk and protective factors. Yet common NLP techniques, including model scaling, synthetic data, loss reweighting, ensembling, and threshold tuning, are often applied without testing whether their gains hold up under severe class imbalance, coupled outputs, and limited author-level data. We study 1,635 clinician-annotated posts and audit 31 pre-specified techniques from 7 methodological families through roughly 300 controlled experiments on author-disjoint partitions. We found no prior audit of this playbook in this regime. The findings guide a task-grounded system for three outputs: 4-level suicide risk, evidence spans, and 24 clinical risk and protective factors. Only 5 of 31 comparisons produced reliable gains. We reformulate factor prediction as entailment between each post and its codebook definitions, using an architecturally diverse ensemble with class-balanced training and score rescaling. Risk predictions condition a 7-model evidence tagger ensemble; evidence restricts symbolic risk rules; and a difficult risk class is routed separately. The factor predictor remains independent because risk evidence provides no additional factor signal. We also correct a mismatch between validation scores used for threshold fitting and test-time ensemble scores through deployment-consistent calibration, yielding the largest improvement to the factor system. The final system achieves 0.8203 for risk, 0.7953 for evidence, and 0.7045 macro-F1 for factors, with a 0.7781 composite, ranking third among 53 teams. We call the underlying principle task-conditioned technique selection: retain techniques only when task-specific knowledge, structure, or empirical evidence justifies them.

AI.tldr: 本文对自杀风险评估任务中的标准NLP技术进行了系统审计，发现在31项预定义技术中仅5项有效，提出了"任务条件化技术选择"原则和"部署一致性校准"修复方法。
AI.motivation: 在小型、高风险的临床NLP任务中，研究者通常直接沿用在大规模数据上验证有效的标准技术（如更大的模型、合成数据、损失重加权、集成等），但从未有人系统验证这些技术在严重类别不平衡、多输出耦合、作者级数据有限的小数据场景下是否仍然有效。这种空白在高风险临床场景中影响最大，因为从业者拥有最少的验证数据，却最依赖已发表的结果。
AI.method: 基于1,635条临床医生标注的Reddit帖子（153位作者）和378条盲测集，通过约300次对照实验，在作者不相交的划分下审计了31项预定义技术（涵盖7个方法族：模型容量、数据适应、训练目标、集成、结构化预测、解码/阈值、LLM方法）。建立了基于配对重采样的评估协议（单划分检测带±0.056，5折合并±0.014），要求技术在≥80-90%的重采样中获胜才被接受。最终系统TRIDENT采用：(1)将因子预测重构为帖子与临床代码簿定义的蕴含判断；(2)架构多样化的11成员因子池（含类别平衡损失和log-odds平均）；(3)7模型证据标注集成；(4)证据范围限制的符号规则；(5)将最弱的风险类别（attempt）路由到独立推理模型；(6)部署一致性校准修复阈值拟合与测试时的分数分布失配问题。
AI.result: 最终系统在53支队伍中排名第三：风险加权F1为0.8203，证据F1为0.7953，因子宏平均F1为0.7045，复合得分0.7781。31项技术中仅5项可靠有效：(1)定义条件化（0.3795→0.6172，最大增益）；(2)类别平衡损失（+0.0084，89%重采样获胜）；(3)架构多样化集成（+0.0157，93%获胜）；(4)证据范围规则（+0.0018，99%获胜）；(5)单类别路由（+0.0052复合得分）。26项失败包括：更大模型（仅第一步有效）、合成数据、任务自适应预训练、焦点损失、种子集成、概念瓶颈、序数回归头等。部署一致性校准贡献了最大单项改进（+0.0137因子分，+0.0041复合分）。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出"任务条件化技术选择"原则：每项技术需要特定的任务知识才能发挥作用，而技术有效的前提是任务恰好提供该知识。在小型临床NLP场景下，标准技术清单中的大部分（26/31）因任务缺乏其所需输入而无贡献。任务知识分为两类：先验知识（注释方案中预先写明的，如代码簿定义）和经验知识（需通过测量发现，如错误相关性）。此外发现的"部署一致性校准"问题指出，在单折预测上拟合的阈值应用于多折集成预测时会出现分数分布失配，这是离线验证协议无法发现的系统性缺陷，是本系统最大的单项改进来源。本文的核心贡献是选择程序和审计证据本身，而非所选出的具体组件。

title: CodeTD: Topology of Attention Detects Hallucinations in Code LLMs
summary: As AI-code assistant tools become widespread, automatic assessment of the correctness of generated code becomes a significant challenge. Code LLMs are prone to hallucinations, which may lead to code that does not solve the required problem, or even to code with severe security vulnerabilities. In this paper, we introduce CodeTD -- the first approach to pre-execution assessment of code correctness based on topological data analysis (TDA) of Code LLMs' attention maps. Our method quantifies prompt-generation mismatch using topological patterns of attention maps. We carry out experiments with common benchmarks (HumanEval, MBPP, BigCodeBench, MultiPL-E), 5 programming languages and 10 Code LLMs of size up to 34B parameters. The experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms recent baselines. Moreover, CodeTD is transferable between coding benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CodeTD,一种基于拓扑数据分析(TDA)的代码大语言模型幻觉检测方法。通过分析注意力图的拓扑模式来量化提示-生成的不匹配程度,实现在代码执行前评估其正确性。
AI.motivation: 随着 AI 代码助手工具的广泛使用,自动评估生成代码的正确性成为重要挑战。现有代码 LLM 容易产生幻觉,导致代码无法解决问题或存在安全漏洞。由于功能性测试可能不可用、不完整、昂贵或不安全执行,因此亟需执行前的代码正确性验证方法。
AI.method: 将 LLM 的注意力图转换为完全连接的加权图,使用 Manifold Topology Divergence (MTD) 工具测量提示(P)与生成(G)两个顶点集之间的拓扑差异。具体特征包括:MTD₀(P,G)/|G|、MTD₀(G,P)/|P|、MTD₁(P,G)/|G|、MTD₁(G,P)/|P| 以及提示/生成的对角自注意力平均值。在这些特征上训练 XGBoost 分类器进行二分类(正确/幻觉)。
AI.result: 在 HumanEval、MBPP、BigCodeBench、MultiPL-E 四个基准上,使用 10 个代码 LLM(最高 34B 参数)和 5 种编程语言进行实验。CodeTD 在大多数情况下优于现有基线(Mean Log Prob、CodeJudge、AttnLogDet、AttnEigvals、LapEigvals 等),ROC-AUC 提升最高达 17.6 个百分点(pass@1)。在跨基准和跨模型迁移中表现稳定,仅使用 5% 特征即可保持分类性能。还可识别 Python 异常类型(细粒度错误分类)及提升 best-of-N 采样效果。
AI.conclusion: CodeTD 是首个基于注意力图拓扑分析的代码 LLM 幻觉执行前检测方法。它利用提示-生成间的语义耦合程度作为幻觉信号,在多模型、多语言、多基准上均优于现有方法,并具备良好的可迁移性。该方法可应用于 best-of-N 采样、代理循环中的重新生成以及人机协作中的弃权机制,为代码 LLM 在安全关键场景中的部署提供了执行前的验证层。

title: Climate-ModernBERT: Revisiting Corpus Composition for Domain-Adaptive Continued Pretraining
summary: Natural Language Processing (NLP) in the climate domain requires models to process heterogeneous text sources, including scientific literature, policy disclosures, and synthetic reports. However, how to effectively combine diverse domain corpora during continued pretraining (CPT) remains underexplored. We introduce Climate-ModernBERT, a family of climate-adapted encoder models obtained through continued pretraining of ModernBERT-Base on three climate corpora: academic climate text, climate-filtered web data, and synthetic climate documents. We systematically compare joint continued pretraining on corpus mixtures with parameter-space merging of independently specialized checkpoints. Across nine climate NLP benchmarks, our best model achieves 76.3 average F_1, improving significantly over a vanilla ModernBERT baseline by 2.8 points. Within the climate NLP setting, the results show that academic climate corpora provide the strongest adaptation signal among the evaluated sources, while parameter-space merging improves over joint multi-source training and better preserves complementary information from heterogeneous climate corpora. We release all Climate-ModernBERT variants and training checkpoints to support future research in climate NLP and domain-adaptive pretraining.

title: You Can't Prefer Emotions You Don't Sample: Intensity Undershoot in DPO-Tuned LLMs
comment: Accepted to INLG 2026 (poster). Both authors contributed equally
summary: Ask a language model to respond "very excitedly," and its output is typically only mildly more energetic. We quantify this effect. We condition an instruction-tuned LLM on a continuous Valence-Arousal (VA) target, where valence measures how pleasant a state is and arousal how activated it is, measure the achieved affect with a frozen regressor, and sweep the requested target from -1 to +1. The response moves far less than asked: the gain, the slope of achieved against requested affect, is only 0.26 for valence and 0.13 for arousal on Llama-3.1-8B, where a faithful controller would score 1. The model systematically undershoots requested emotional intensity, which puts a number on the qualitative observation of Fazzi et al. (2025). Our experiments trace this to the preference-learning pipeline. Training targets from natural corpora such as EmoBank are neutral-heavy, and the sampled candidates themselves rarely reach extreme affect, so Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is left with no extreme exemplar to prefer. If instead we cover the target space uniformly and sample a hotter, larger candidate pool, valence gain rises from 0.26 to 0.40 +/- 0.02 (3 seeds) and extrapolation error drops, at only a modest in-distribution cost (EmoBank-test VA distance 0.092 to 0.107). The same recipe reproduces on Qwen3-8B (gain_v 0.44, with in-distribution accuracy preserved). Arousal is harder and less reliable: its gain barely moves on average and swings across seeds (0.14 +/- 0.07, against valence's tight +/- 0.02), because raising arousal needs candidates the base model is reluctant to generate. The evidence indicates that faithful intensity is bottlenecked by the extremity of the candidate pool rather than by the conditioning format.

title: Kalman Delta Networks: Uncertainty-aware Associative Memory
summary: Linear attention is increasingly used in frontier language models for efficient long-context inference and constant-memory decoding. Its fixed-size recurrent memory, however, requires an online decision at each token: what to write and how strongly to overwrite existing associations before knowing which information future queries will require. Delta-rule models learn this strength from the current token embedding but do not track confidence in the memory estimate, preventing each write from adapting to accumulated evidence. To represent this uncertainty explicitly, we reformulate recurrent associative memory as a linear--Gaussian state-space model, for which the Kalman filter is the optimal recursive estimator, and introduce a new family of models, Kalman Delta Networks (KDNs). Within KDNs, the transition propagates both the memory state and its uncertainty, allowing the Kalman gain to weight each residual write by accumulated evidence and observation reliability. Under this formulation, Delta-style updates emerge as a special case that substitutes a token-wise isotropic surrogate for predictive covariance and omits covariance tracking. Exact tracking, however, entails a dense, state-dependent Riccati recursion that is poorly suited to GPU-parallel linear-attention scans. To address this issue, we introduce two scan-compatible KDN approximations. Diagonal KDN projects each one-step posterior onto the diagonal Gaussian family through online mean-field variational inference, whereas Isotropic KDN uses an isotropic approximation with a single uncertainty scalar per head. Their uncertainty recurrences are Mobius maps, enabling associative scans with logarithmic parallel depth. Across controlled pretraining at 750M and 1.3B parameters, KDN variants consistently improve perplexity and mean downstream accuracy over state-of-the-art linear-attention models.

title: A*-Thought-V2: Efficient Latent Reasoning via Geometric Dynamics of LLM
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) improves the reasoning ability of Large Language Models (LLMs) but incurs substantial computation and context costs. Existing methods either lose intermediate information through hard pruning or lack a principled criterion for continuous compression. We present A*-Thought-V2, a geometric dynamics of LLM guided framework that models CoT as a hidden-state trajectory and replaces hard deletion with an explicit-implicit interleaved latent architecture. After projecting question, step, and solution representations into a 3D PCA space, it measures alignment between each local transition and global question-to-solution direction. Aligned steps remain explicit text, whereas deviating steps are compressed into continuous latent tokens. Directional angles capture both local semantics and reasoning dynamics: small angles indicate direct execution and answer formation, while large angles more frequently involve checking, correction, and branch exploration; their temporal variation reveals exploration, convergence, and refinement stages. To train this architecture, we introduce stepwise embedding forcing, which pools each redundant step into a single latent embedding, and label forcing, which supervises that latent token with a soft multi-modal vocabulary distribution instead of a hard one-hot label. Experiments on Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.6-27B across six in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks show that A*-Thought-V2 improves average accuracy by up to 2.6% while reducing response length by up to half, increasing Accuracy per Computation Unit by 2.29$\times$, and reducing preprocessing and training time by 94.6% and up to 80.3%, respectively. Representation analyses suggest that latent states form a compact region distinct from textual states, while higher entropy at latent-token positions reflects broader soft targets that encourage richer step-level feature learning.

title: Foundation Models for Generalizable Semantic and Goal-Oriented Communication
summary: Semantic and goal-oriented communication is increasingly studied for 6G, but generalization beyond seen data remains a key weakness under tight rate budgets. Many existing systems overfit their training data and degrade sharply at very low bit rates because they attempt to compress the entire signal. We introduce Foundation Model-Guided Semantic and Goal-Oriented Communication (FMSGOC), a framework that uses broad visual-linguistic Foundation Model priors to mitigate overfitting. It further improves rate efficiency by concentrating bits on sparse, goal-aligned anchors and relying on generative foundation-model priors to reconstruct the masked regions. By decoupling what to send from how to reconstruct, a vision-language foundation model selects and transmits a sparse set of semantic anchors, while a pretrained diffusion model, fine-tuned for masked completion, reconstructs the image at the receiver. In our experiments, FMSGOC reaches 0.039 bits per pixel (BPP), maintains high semantic fidelity (cosine similarity 0.87-0.90 on CIFAR-10), remains robust on previously unseen inputs (0.83-0.86 on ImageNet), and shows good perceptual similarity (0.1278/0.1558, CIFAR-10/ImageNet), outperforming strong end-to-end baselines at lower bit rates.

title: The Accuracy Paradox: Empirical Diagnostic of Default Decision Thresholds in Multi-Label Enzyme Commission Prediction [With Code]
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures,Enzyme Commission prediction, multi-label classification, class imbalance, threshold optimization, conformal calibration, accuracy paradox, bio-data, applied machine learning, bioinformatics. imbalanced bio-data, model diagnostic, performance metrics, open-source pipeline
summary: Automated prediction of Enzyme Commission (EC) numbers plays a central role in functional annotation and computational drug discovery. However, standard multi-label machine learning pipelines frequently rely on default decision thresholds (t=0.50), assuming balanced prior distributions across target heads. In this study, we present a systematic empirical diagnostic of uncalibrated fixed decision boundaries operating under severe class imbalance across N = 14,096 annotated compounds categorized into six primary EC classes (EC1-EC6). Our results highlight a pronounced Accuracy Paradox: while the multi-label system achieves a deceivingly high mean accuracy of 77.16%, the macro F1-score (0.3976) and macro recall (0.3872) reveal severe predictive breakdown. Majority target classes suffer from hyper-sensitivity and over-prediction, whereas minority classes exhibit sharp recall decay, culminating in a total decision boundary collapse for EC6 (Recall = 0.00%) despite underlying discriminative power (ROC-AUC = 0.5857). Feature correlation analysis further reveals high linear redundancy among topological indices relative to fingerprint density metrics. Ultimately, this diagnostic study demonstrates that standard point predictions mask critical errors in bioinformatics workflows. We establish target-specific threshold optimization and post-hoc conformal calibration as essential, open-source post-processing safeguards for reliable applied machine learning and deep learning architectures.

title: AVCG: A Generalized Variational Framework for Counterfactual Generation under Hypothesis Distributions
summary: Counterfactual explanations formalize "what-if" scenarios by identifying modifications to an input instance that obtain a desired alternative prediction. Traditionally, whether generated via instance-specific optimization or amortized single pass models, these approaches rely on a single, deterministic point-estimate predictor. However, this ignores predictive uncertainty and hypothesis variability, leading to brittle explanations that frequently become invalid if the underlying model is retrained or updated. To address this fragility, we propose the Amortized Variational Counterfactual Generator (AVCG), a generalized optimization framework that formulates counterfactual generation as optimization over an arbitrary distribution of plausible predictive hypotheses rather than a single deterministic predictor. This formulation naturally accommodates Bayesian posteriors, Rashomon-restricted hypothesis spaces, and other uncertainty representations within a unified optimization framework. Evaluation across multiple benchmark datasets demonstrates that the AVCG framework produces counterfactual explanations that remain highly valid under predictive uncertainty and model changes, while maintaining competitive plausibility and single-pass runtime performance.
